tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pa me long ye shes/sku rnam snang chos dbyings ye shes/zhes pa'i tshul gyis gsungs so/ /rdo rje phung po'i yan lag ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ru
pa me long ye shes/sku rnam snang chos dbyings ye shes/zhes pa'i tshul gyis gsungs so/ /rdo rje phung po'i yan lag ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ru

tei:div.tei:p: pa me long ye shes/

sku rnam snang chos dbyings ye shes/ zhes pa'i tshul gyis gsungs so/ / rdo rje phung po'i yan lag ni/ / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ru grags/ / zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ / ces pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i rtog tshogs byang chub sems/ / zhes pa la sogs pas ma dag pa 'khor ba'i gnas skabs na yang ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du ye nas sangs rgyas par 'dod de/ re zhig zab mo'i mdo sde sdong po bkod pa las kyang*/ gang zhig bdag dang sangs rgyas rnams/ / rang bzhin mnyam par rab gnas shing*/ /mi gnas len pa med pa de/ / de dag bde bar gshegs par 'gyur/ / gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang*/ / rnam par shes dang sems pa dag/ grangs med de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ / de dag thub pa chen por 'gyur/ / zhes pa dang*/ dri ma med pa'i mdo las kyang*/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung ngo*/ / zhes pa dang*/ skams las pad+ma mi skye'i/ 'dam las skye ba dang 'dra bar/ 'dus ma byas mngon du byas pa rnams las bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems mi skye'i/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba ri bo lta bu bskyed na bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems skye bar 'gyur bas/ de bas na nyon mongs pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung ngo*/ / zhes gsungs la/ thabs kyi zhags pa'i bsrung ba med pa'i dam tshig gi skabs las kyang*/ 'di ltar gti mug ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i khongs su 'dus pas spang blang med pa'i mtshan nyid ni sku de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs so/ / zhe sdang ni chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du gdug pa 'dul ba'i mtshan nyid rdo rje'i rigs so/ / nga rgyal ni chos mnyam pa nyid la sran tshugs pa'i mtshan nyid rin po che'i rigs so/ / 'dod chags ni chos thams la mnga' brnyes pa'i mtshan nyid pad+ma'i rigs so/ / phrag dog ni chos mnyam par ma rtogs pa rnams la las dge sdig yod phyir 'gro ba'i don byed pa'i mtshan nyid las kyi rigs so/

/ zhes pa dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa las kyang*/ gzugs kyi gti mug nyid bstan pa/ / blun pas bcings pa'i ngo bo'o*/ / tshor ba 'dod pas myos bstan pa/ / nga rgyal gyi ni ngo bo'o/ / 'du shes 'dod chags bdag nyid ni/ / dngos po la ni chags pa'i mtshan/ / 'du byed rtag tu phrag dog ste/ / rtse gcig bdag nyid bstod pa'o/ / rnam shes zhe sdang zhes bstan te/ / rgyu dang 'bras bur rab tu grags/ / 'di dag bde gshegs lnga yi rigs/ / zhes pa dang*/ rin cen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ / sangs rgyas med kyang sems can med/ / ces pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ / 'o na 'gro ba'i khams rnams ma dag pa sna tshogs su snang ba ji ltar yin zhe na/ ye nas dag cing dri ma med kyang*/ glo bur kun tu btags pas rtog pa'i spags pas las dang bde sdug sna tshogs su kun gzhi la nus pa sna tshogs bzhag pa las byung ba'o/ / de yang kun gzhi ni/ thams cad pa ste kun gyi rten yin par/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ kun gzhi kun gyi rten yin te/ / srid pa dang ni de bzhin du/ / rnam par byang ba'i gzhi ma'ang yin/ / zhes so/ / de yang ma dag pa 'khor bar snang dus de'i rten byed cing dbyer med pa bzhin yod kyang*/ dag pa'i chos kyi de nyid chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes bya bar ming gyur pa'o/ / de nyid la ni ye shes kun brten to/ / 'khor ba'i kun gzhi la ni kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa dang*/ nyon yid dang*/ yid shes dang*/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes brten to/ / 'di dag mdo rgyud la lar sbyangs shing gnas gyur pas ye shes lngar dag par 'dod do/ /kun gzhi chos dbyings ye shes su gnas gyur/ de bzhin du kun gzhi'i rnam shes me long ye shes/ nyon yid so sor rtog pa/ yid shes mnyam pa nyid/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su gnas gyur pa'o/ / de bzhin du gzugs rnam snang*/ tshor ba rin 'byung*/ 'du shes snang mtha'/ 'du byed don grub/

rnam par shes pa'i phung po mi bskyod par gnas gyur cing*/ sa sangs rgyas spyan/ chu mā ma kī/ me gos dkar mo/ rlung dam tshig sgrol ma/ nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug mar gnas gyur la/ dbang po dang yul rnams ni sems dpa' dang sems ma'i ngo bor gnas gyur cing sgo gsum 'dzin pa dang bcas pa sgo bar gnas gyur par grags kyang*/ gzhung 'dir ni/ snam bu tshos kyis bsgyur ba lta bu'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed gnas gyur pa lta bu mi 'dod de/ spang blang dang sbyong bsgyur las 'das pa'i phyir ro/ / de bas na ye nas ye shes su yin pa la yin par shes pas 'khor ba'i kun rtog ye shes su grol ba chab rom chur zhu ba'i tshul gyis/ 'khor ba nyid myang 'das su grol bar 'dod do/ / de'ang da lta kun tu btags pa'i dri mas sel du gyur pas dag kyang ma dag pa ltar snang ba nyid gnad zab mo la goms pas kun rtog phung po dang bcas pa ye shes su gyur nas/ dri ma spangs nas dbyings su dag pa ni dper na/ gser dang 'dres pa'i dngul chu'i gong bu re zhig mar gsar ram dngul chu'i rnam par snang gi gser du mi snang yang me dang phrad pa'i rkyen gyis gser du snang zhing*/ dngul chu'i rnam pa'i mar gsar gyi kha dog nyid rang yal du song ba bzhin no/ / de bas na me la cher bsregs pa na 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser ltar snang ngo*/ / de bzhin du lam zab mo goms pas nyon mongs pa las grol ba'i 'phags pa rig 'dzin gyi gnas skabs dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi sar shes par bya'o/ / gnyis pa gang gi rigs yin ngos gzung ba ni/ skabs 'di'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje'i rigs su byas nas/ gtso bo mi bskyod par snga rabs pa dag gis bshad kyang*/ de ni ma yin te/ dbus su rigs kyi bdag po mtshon byed kyi gdan 'khor lo dang seng ge byung ba'i phyir dang*/ yum kyang nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma byung ba'i phyir dang*/

zhi ba'i mdangs las 'phros pa'i khro bo'i skabs su yang gtso bo bud+dha he ru ka byung ba'i phyir dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'di yang ye shes rang snang ba gzhi la gtso 'khor ma 'khrugs par 'chad cing snang ba'i skabs yin pa'i phyir dang*/ slob dpon chen po pad+mas 'di'i sgrub thabs dang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga las kyang*/ hūm̐ me long ye shes rnam dag cing*/ / rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ / dbyings kyi dbang phyug phyag rgya yis/ / rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ / zhes pa'i yi ges kyang gnod la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyud kyi sde tshan gcig pa 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'grel pa pad+ma dkar po las kyang*/ me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad mthing ga dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi bdag nyid mi bskyod pa dkar por gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/ / 'o na rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba zhes bshad pas mi bskyod par 'thad do/ / zhe na/ ma yin te/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul drwa ba zhes bshad pas gtso bo lha mor thal ba la sogs pa'i skyon spong bar mi nus so/ / des na rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ni rigs thams cad kyi spyi'i sgrar bshad kyi/ mi bskyod pa kho nar 'chad pa ma yin te/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las/ rdo rje sems dpa' rigs rnams kun gyi bdag/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po shog/ ces pas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gang yin rdo rje sems dpar btags pa'i tshul dang gcig go / spar khab dang*/ gzhi bstod la sogs pa ni bod ma yin pas yid brtan mi rung ngo*/ / rngam glog las/ dbus su rnam par snang mdzad gtso/ / zhes pa'ang ma mthong bar zad do/ / de bas na 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi thugs kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor yin pas gtso bo ni rnam par snang mdzad thugs kyi lha yin la/ mi bskyod pa sku rdo rje'i bdag nyid do/

/ gsum pa gzhan gyi log rtog dgag pa ni/ 'o na rgyud gzhan las/ gzugs ni rnam par snang mdzad nyid/ / tshor ba rin chen 'byung ldan la/ / 'du shes snang ba mtha' yas te/ / 'du byed don yon grub pa nyid/ / rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa/ / zhes pa dang 'gal zhing*/ sku mdog kyang mthing gar bshad pas 'gal lo zhe na/ lan brjod pa/ kye bzhin bzang da dung thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyud sde gong 'og la blo kha ma phyogs pas re bden/ de lta na'ang khyed cag rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po dang zhes pa dang*/ mthing ga dang zhes pa'i sgra tsam la 'khrul par zad de/ 'dir ni 'og min rdo rje'i dbyings dang*/ snying ga na 'od gsal gyi dam pa rigs brgya 'od lnga'i klong na de nyid dang tha dad med par yod pa'i rang lugs 'dzug pa ste/ snying gi dgongs pa'i rgyud las/ rnam par snang mdzad mthing ga phyag na 'khor lo bsnams pa yum nam mkha' dbyings phyug ma dang zhal sbyar nas sangs rgyas kyi sku drug phrag gcig tu shar ro/ / zhes so/ / rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po zhes pa dang*/ mthing gar gsungs pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi thugs kyi rigs yin pa'i phyir ro/ / gzhan las rnam snang gzugs te sku'i rigs dang mi bskyod pa thugs su bshad pa ni thun mong ba'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa ste/ rigs lnga spyi tsam dang sku'i sku'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las gzhan du 'phros pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ / gzhan yang nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma ni sems nyid rang bzhin gyis dag pas go 'byed pa yin la/ rnam par shes pa ni sna tshogs su gsal zhing 'char bas rnam par snang mdzad de me long gi gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa lta bu ye shes so/ / sangs rgyas spyan ni mi g.yo zhing rtog pa med pas gti mug dang chos mthun pa'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyi spyod yul sa'i khams kyi sra ba'i cha/ gzugs kyi phung pos bsdus pa ni gzhan du mi 'pho bas mi bskyod pa zhes bshad do/

/ tshul 'di ni rgyud sde gong ma'i rnam bshad de gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'o/ / de bas na gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad la rigs kyi 'khor tshom bu rnams kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor du shes par bya'o/ / dai la kun gyi thugs rjes mnga' bdag ston pa kun tu bzang po yab yum dkyil 'khor 'di'i phyogs gang na yod pa yin zhe na/ kha cig na re khyams na byin gyis rlob pa'i tshul du bzhugs zer ro/ / de ni ma yin te 'khor du thal ba dang*/ gtso bo mthar gnas pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dkyil 'khor gang las kyang mi 'byung ba'i phyir na rigs pa ma yin no/ / de bas na 'di ltar yin te/ chos sku'i gnas skabs na rang byung gi ye shes chen po nyid dmigs bsam spros pa'i yul las 'das par bzhugs pas kun tu bzang po yab yum zhes bya'o/ / de skad du dpal sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ / rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog/ gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na// thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ / zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon chen po bi ma la'i rin po che'i sgron ma las/ mi gnas chos dbyings dkyil 'khor na/ kun bzang yab yum zhes bya'o/ / de las longs skur bzhengs pa na/ / rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas yin par grags/ / sprul pa'i 'gro don spyod pa na/ / rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin/ / grangs med dpag gis mi lang ngo*/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du rang snang ba'i tshe rigs lnga'i gtso bo nyid rnam snang ste kun bzang yab yum mo/ / dmigs pa la dga' bas bsgom pa'i tshe de'i thugs kar bsgom pa'i rim pa yang gsungs so/ / de yang mnyam sbyor las/ de nas 'gro ba 'dul thabs kyis/ / de nyid rigs rnams lngar snang yang*/ / yang dag grub pa gcig pu nyid/ / ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sbyar/ / zhes so/ / de las sprul pa'i 'gro ba 'dul ba na phyag na rdo rje dang*/

'jam dpal dang*/ spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa dang*/ thub pa drug gi rol pa dpag tu med pa snang ngo*/ / khyams su dgod par gsungs pa'i byed pa dang*/ bya ba gnyis ni gdangs thams cad 'char ba'i gzhi'i kun bzang yam yum zhes bya ste/ bar do la sogs par thog mar chos dbyings rnam dag gi gdangs snang stong gnyis kyi rnam pa de gnyis su snang ba las/ rim gyis zhi khro'i lha so so'i tshom bu 'char ba'i gzhir gyur pa ste/ khyams su gsungs pa'i don ni gtso bo thugs ka ste/ rgyab mdun ni zhal sbyar nas bzhugs tshul gyi ngo bo bstan pa'o/ / de bas na gzhi'i gtso bo ni dbus kyi gtso bo nyid yin la/ gdangs kyi yab yum gnyis ni de'i thugs ka na gnas pa ste snang stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yin no/ / tshul 'di ni thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyud dang*/ bla ma'i man ngag dang*/ sgrub thabs kyi yi ge chen po rnams las byung ba yin no/ / da lta gnas kyang zhu ba snying ga yin te/ nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rgyud las/ tsit+ta rin cen gzhal yas na/ / zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis/ / sku ni snang la rang bzhin med/ / cha phra 'od gsal snying khar bzhugs/ / zhes so/ / khro bo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad ni spyi bo na yod de/ de las/ gdangs kyi khrag 'thung lnga bcu brgyad/ / dung khang bhan+dha'i gzhal yas na/ /zhes so/ / tshul 'di ni slob dpon gyi bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs 'bṛng po'i las byang las/ zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor na/ / zhes pa dang*/ bhan+dha smug nag 'bar ba'i khang bzang du/ / mthu chen bdud kyi rgyal pos sgo bcad de brtsigs/ / rngams pa'i khro bo rnams kyi gzer gyis btab/ / dregs pa lha chen brgyad kyi ka gdung byas/ / gdug pa'i klu chen brgyad kyis rab tu gtams/ / gza' chen kha bad rgyu skar mig tshags byas/ / zhes so/ / bhan+dha ni mgo ste skra smug nag can no/ / gzhan ni mtshog gsang gnyis dang ltag gsang gnyis kyi sdud sgo dang rtsa'i gnas so/

/ spyi'i don bshad zin to/ / ༈ gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis te/ gtso bo'i bzhugs tshul dang phyag mtshan thun mong du bstan pa dang*/ yab yum so sor bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin 'gro ba thams cad la dus rtag tu gzigs shing rgyab kyis mi phyogs pa'i mtshon byed du dwangs shing 'od kyi rang bzhin phyi nang gsal ba'i sku~X de yang rags par ma grub cing thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi phyogs mtshams steng 'og gang nas bltas kyang zhal bstan par snang gi 'di ni mduna~X dnga~X 'di ni rgyaba~X tu snang ngo zhes 'gro ba phal pa la mthong ba ltar me~Xd pa~X tshom bu'i 'khor thams cad la mdun gyis gzigs pas phyogs thama~Xs ca~Xd du~X zhala~X gyi dkyil 'khor thala~X le~X ba~Xr gsa~Xl zhinga~X*/ sku la skyes bu chen po'i mtsha~Xn bzang po sum bcu rtsa gnyis dang*/

dpe~X byada~X bzang po brgyad cus ye shes dnga~X yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba'i mtshon byed du ldana~X pa~X'o/ / mtshan dpe la gnyis te/ thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ thun mong pa'o/ / dang po la'ang gnyis las/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis ni ye shes bcu drug gi rtsal sems dpa' bcu drug dang*/ de'i yul chos dbyings bcu drug gi rtsal sems ma bcu drug ste sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ / dpe byad brgyad cu ni sems dpa' bcu drug po re re la'ang ye shes lnga'i rtags rigs lnga lngas dbu rgyan gyi rigs lnga brgyad cu'o/ / yum bcu drug la dbu rgyan med de/ chos dbyings mtshon pa'i phyir ro/ / de dag mtshan dper 'jog pa ni/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pas gtso bo'i rang bzhin yang bkod pa mdzes shing phun sum tshogs pa ste/ me tog gi ze'u 'bru dang 'dab mas me tog gi bkod pa mdzes par byed pa lta bu'o/ / gnyis pa thun mong gi mtshan dpe la gnyis las/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan dang rus sbal zhabs/ / phyag dang zhabs sor drwa bas 'brel ba dang*/ / phyag dang zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags/ / 'di yi sku ni bdun dag mtho ba dang*/ / sor mo ring dang rting yangs sku che drang*/ / zhabs 'bur mi mngon spu ni gyen du phyogs/ / byin pa e na ya 'dra phyag ring mdzes/ / 'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog/ pags pa gser mdog pags pa srab pa dang*/ / spu ni re re nas g.yas legs 'khrungs dang*/ / zhal mdzod spus brgyan ro stod seng ge 'dra/ / 'di yi dpung ba'i mgo zlum thal gong rgyas/ / 'di la ro mi zhim pa'ang ro mchog snang*/ / sku ni n+ya gro ta ltar chu zheng gab/ / gtsug tor dbur ldan ljags ring mdzes pa dang*/ / tshangs dbyangs 'gram pa seng ge 'dra dang tshems/ / shin tu dkar dang tshad mnyam thag bzang dang*/ / grangs ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang ba dang*/ / spyan ni mthon mthing spyan rdzi ba mchog gi

/ 'dra ba 'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ / zhes so/ / dpe byad brgyad cu ni/ de nyid las/ thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang*/ / mdog snum mtho dang sor mo rnams/ / zlum rgyas byin gyis phra ba dang*/ / rtsa mi mngon dang mdud pa med/ / long bu mi mngon zhabs mnyam dang*// seng ge glang chen bya dang ni/ / khyu mchog stabs gshegs g.yas phyogs dang*/ / mdzes gshegs drang dang 'khril bag chags/ / byi dor byas 'dra rim par 'tsham/ / gtsang dang 'jam dang dag pa'i sku/ / mtshan ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ / sku yi kho lag yangs shing bzang*/ / gom snyoms pa dang spyan gnyis ni/ / dag dang gzhon sha can nyid dang*/ / sku zhum med dang rgyas pa dang*/ / shin tu grims pa'i sku nyid dang*/ / yan lag shin tu rnam 'byes dang*/ / gzigs pa sgrib med dag pa dang*/ / sku zlum skabs phyed ma rnyongs dang*/ / phyang nge ba dang lte ba ni/ / zab dang g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang*/ / kun nas blta na sdug pa dang*/ / kun spyod gtsang dang sku la ni/ / sme ba gnag bag med pa dang*/ / phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam dang*/ / phyag ris mdangs yod zabs ring dang*/ / zhal ni ha kyang mi ring dang*/ / mchu ni bim pa ltar dmar dang*/ / ljags mnyen pa dang srab pa dang*/ / dmar dang 'brug gi sgra nyid dang*/ / gsung mnyen 'jam dang mche ba zlum/ / rno dang dkar dang mnyam pa dang*/ / byin gyis phra dang shang mtho dang*/ / mchog tu dag pa dag dang ni/ / spyan yangs pa dang rdzi ma sdug/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba dang*/ / smin mtshams ring dang 'jam pa dang*/ / snum dang spu ni mnyam pa dang*/ / phyag ring rgyas dang snyan mnyam dang*/ / nyams pa rnam par spangs pa dang*/ / dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang*/ / dbyes che ba dang dbu rgyas dang*/ / dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag dang*/ / stug dang 'jam dang ma 'dzings dang*/ / mi gshor dri zhim skyes bu yi/ / yid ni 'phrog par byed pa dang*/ / dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni/ / g.yung drung 'khyil pas brgyan pa ste/

/ sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed/ / ces so/ / dpal gyi be'u man chad gcig yin cing gzhan ni so so'o/ / chos kyi dbyings dang*/ nam mkha'i khams dang*/ gdul bya'i 'jig rten bsa~Xm gyi~Xs mi~X khyaba~X pa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd du~X lhun gyis grub pa'i sku~X gsu~Xng thu~Xgs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo sna~X tsho~Xgs pa~Xr kuna~X tu~X sna~Xng ba~X'o/ / ji ltar snang na chos kyi dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i zhing khams su sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo chos sku kun bzang yab yum spros las 'das pa/ gsung mi zad pa brjod du med pa dang mnyan du med pa dang ngo bo nyid med pa dang*/ thugs mi zad pa gtan du spros pa thams cad zhi zhing rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa'o/ / nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas pa rang snang lhun stug po bkod pa'i zhing du ni/ sku mi zad pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ gsung mi zad pa zhal gyi dkyil 'khor las 'od 'phros pas brjod bya'i don khong du chud pa/ thugs mi zad pa ye shes lnga'i mtshan nyid du bzhugs pa'o/ / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten 'gro ba drug gi 'dul zhing nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa rnams su ni/ sku mi zad pa gang la gang gis 'dul ba sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang*/ so so skye bo dang*/ rgas pa dang*/ na ba dang*/ 'chi ba dang*/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ dud 'gro la sogs pa rigs mthun pa dang mi mthun pa dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ gru gzengs dang*/ grong dang*/ skyed mos tshal la sogs pa sems can la phan pa 'byung ba de dang de'i gzugs tshad med pa dang*/ gsung mi zad pa 'gro ba so so'i skad dang*/ pad+mo dang dpag bsam gyi shing la sogs pa las sgra byung bas chos kyi gsung sna tshogs par sgrogs pa la sogs pa dang*/ thugs mi zad pa ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad par snang ngo*/

/ de'ang sangs rgyas rnams kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas don mdzad pa yin pas 'di dang 'di'o zhes blos bsam par nus pa ma yin no/ / 'o na chos sku dang longs sku'i gsung mi brjod pa la gsung du ci gdags she na/ sgra dang tshig tu brjod pa'i mthar yang brjod med go bar bya ba las med la de nyid kyis dngos su brjod med go bar mdzad pa dang*/ tshig thams cad yi ger 'dus la de nyid a skye ba med par 'dus pas gsung gi snying po a'i don ston pa nyid gsung mchog chen po ste/ mdo las/ rgyal ba'i sras pos cang mi gsung*/ / ma gsung pa nyid rgya cher gsungs/ / zhes pa lta bu'o/ / gdul bya la snang ba'i sprul sku thub pas yan lag drug cus dbyings kyis gsungs pa lta bu yang gdul bya'i snang ba dang sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje 'dzom pa las gsung du snang yang sgra brnyan ltar don la gsungs pa med de/ rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar sgra brnyan gyis ni sgra/ / gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba/ / rnam rtog med cing bzo med pa/ / de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung*/ / gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba/ / phyi dang nang na'ang gnas ma yin/ / zhes pa dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa sku bltams nas gang gi mtshan mo la mya ngan las 'das pa de srid du tshig dang yi ger snang bas chos tshig 'bru gcig kyang ma gsungs te gdul bya'i snang bas go bar zad do/ / zhes so/ / 'di kha cig gis sprul sku kho na la sbyar ba mi 'thad de bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad du sku gsung thugs snang bar bshad pa nyid dang 'gal lo/ / sprul sku'i sgras skabs 'dir thub pa drug kyang zin pas thub drug gi gleng gzhi zhar la smos pa yin no/ / bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis mi 'thad ces pa ni skabs su ma babs pa'i rgol ba ste/ 'dir longs sku gzhi dang thub drug 'khor du bstan pas ston pa gnyis med do/

/ ༈ tha~Xbs snying rje chen po dnga~X shesa~X raba~X stong pa nyid kyi~X ye shes mnga' ba'i brdar zhaba~Xs gnyi~Xs te zung du 'brel bas srid zhu'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i brdar mnyama~X pa'i~X rang bzhin nyon mongs pa mtha' dag brtula~X cing ye shes chen po'i ngo bor bzhuga~Xs pa nyid kyi~X brdar rdo rje'i skyila~X mo~X krunga~X du~X ༵ bzhuga~Xs pa~X'o/ / 'dir kha cig yum dngos su ma bshad par 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ btsun mo dam pa snang ba'i dbyings yin pa'i phyir ro/ / ye~X shesa~X lnga dbyings rnam par dag pa'i ye shes dang druga~X gi~X mtshon byed du phyaga~X drug go / sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las gnyis su med pa'i ye~X shesa~X las dgos 'dod sna tshogs 'byung bas ri~Xn po~X che'i~X rang bzhin du mtshon pa'i phyir rdo rje la sogs pa'i phyaga~X rgya~X drug las 'od zer mu med pa 'ba~Xr ba~X cana~X ni ser sna dang*/ 'chal ba'i tshul khrims dang*/ khong khro dang*/ le lo dang*/ rnam par g.yeng ba dang*/ shes rab 'chal ba drug 'jom pa'i brda'o/ / kha cig ni gtso bo la phyag drugagazhan rnams la phyag gnyis par 'dod pa ni ma yin te/ thun mong du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / de'ang rdo rje rin po che 'khor lo pad+ma rgya gram dril bu ste/ rigs so so'i rtsa phyag gnyis kyi g.yas thams cad rang rang gi phyag mtshan/ g.yon thams cad dril bu ste/ thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa gzhan rnams so sor brkyangs pa'o/ / sangs rgyas gsang ba ni phyag drug na rin po che 'bar ba zur brgyad pa drug bsnams par bzhed do/ / sku~X gsunga~X thuga~Xs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo bsama~X gyisa~X mi~X khyaba~X pa~X mnga' ba'i~X mtshon byed du dbu~X gsu~Xm dnga~X ldana~X pa~X ni gtso bo'i rtsa zhal mthing ga g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ mi bskyod pa'i rtsa zhal dkar po g.yas mthing g.yon dmar/ rin 'byung gi rtsa zhal ser po g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ 'od dpag med kyi rtsal zhal dmar po g.yas dkar g.yon mthing don grub kyi rtsa zhal ljang gu g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ro/

/ gnyis pa yab yum so sor bshad pa la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung gi don no/ / dang po la gnyis te/ thams cad ye nas lha'i dkyil 'khor du bstan pa dang*/ rigs dbye ba'o/ / dang po ni rnam par snang mdzad la sogs rigs lnga'i mtshan nas mi brjod par/ rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po dang zhes pa la sogs pa phung po lnga'i mtshan nas brjod pa ci yin zhes snga rabs pa dag zer te/ 'di yang ma phyed par snang ngo*/ / phung po lnga la sogs pa rtog pa'i ming gis lha la brjod pa med de/ rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po dang zhes ldan chos phung po lnga las 'phags pa nyid bstan pa yin te/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po zhes brjod pa bzhin no/ / mya ngan gyi ming gis sangs rgyas la brjod pa ma yin gyi 'phags chos ngos gzung pa'i phyir dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ 'dod chags chen po rjes chags pa/ / zhes pa'ang bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes la brjod cing*/ gsang ba 'dus par yang*/ zhe sdang rdo rje zhes pa la sogs pas me long ye shes la sogs pa dngos su bstan pa bzhin no/ / des na rgyal po'i sgra ni chen po ste rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa yin zhing*/ 'khor gyi skabs su'ang byang chub chen po rdo rje thos pa la sogs pa gsungs pa la'ang shes par bya'o/ / gal te rtog pa'i sgras brjod na rnam par shes pa dang zhes brjod pa rigs kyi rgyal po zhes mi rigs so/ / khyad par 'phags chos su brjod pa ni 'khor ba'i gnas skabs na rnam par shes pa de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi gdung ngam rigs su gnas pas brjod pa'o/ / de yang rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i sangs rgyas nyid yin kyang ma dag pa'i tshe 'gro ba'i phung po lnga rnam smin las grub pa ltar snang ngo*/ / de las cung zad dag pa na dbang thob pa rnams kyi smon lam las grub pa'i lus la sogs par snang ngo*/ / shin tu dag pa'i tshe rgyal ba'i sku dang ye shes su snang ngo*/ / dper na chu gcig la'ang dmyal ba pas me dang*/

yi dwags kyis rnag khrag dang*/ mis dag cing 'dod yon du byed pa dang*/ dud 'gros btung ba dang*/ lhas bdud rtsi dang*/ zhing dag pa'i 'gro bas bdud rtsi'i chu klung dang*/ grub pas mā ma kī la sogs par snang ba nyid do/ / yang na dngul chu'i khams bzhin du'ang snang bar sngar brjod zin to/ / de'ang ma dag pa'i skabs na phung po lnga dang khams bco brgyad dang*/ skye mched bcu gnyis la sogs par snang pa nyid/ dag pa'i tshe na rigs lnga'i sku dang*/ 'khor gyi sems dpa' sems ma la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du snang ba'o/ / dper na mig la bad kan gyi skyon chags pa'i tshe dung ser por snang ba nyid dag pa'i tshe dkar por snang ba bzhin no/ / bad kan gyi tshe na'ang gzugs brnyan dung gi rnam pa mi 'dor ba bzhin du ma dag pa'i tshe'ang sangs rgyas kyi chos mthun brtsir yod do/ / ser por snang yang don la dkar po yin pa bzhin du phyi nang gi snang ba rtog tshogs dang bcas pa kun ma dag par snang yang don la dag pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo nyid yin no/ / gnyis pa so sor dbye ba la lnga las/ dang po rnam par shes pa'i phung po la dbye na brgyad de/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa me long dag pa'i ngos lta bu shes pa yul la ma 'phros la 'char gzhi byed pa dang*/ yid kyi rnam shes don spyi'i yul dang rjes kyi blos yul la spyod pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dgag sgrub tu byed pa'i shes pa las gsog par byed pa dang dang*/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes gzugs mthong ba la sogs pa rtog med lnga'o/ / de'ang mthong thos reg tshor gyi cha ni rtog med yin la/ de la so sor shes pa ni yid la/ de la dgag sgrub byed pa ni nyon yid do/ / sgo lnga dang yid shes tsam gyis ni las mi gsog la/ nyon yid kyis kun gzhi'i steng du las gsog pa'o/ / kun gzhi ni de thams cad pa'i rten yin te rtog med lung ma bstan no/

/ dper na gang du'ang rtog dpyod med cing gsal dngas med pa'i shes pa rang so'i gnas skabs lta bu'o/ / des mtshon pa thams cad do/ / kun gzhi'i rnam shes ni shes pa gsal dngas yul la ma 'phros pa'i gnas skabs so/ / sgo lnga ni yul de gsal bar snang ba'o/ / yid ni 'drer rung 'dzin pa tsam mo/ / nyon yid ni dgag sgrub tu skyes pa'o/ / 'dir ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes me long lta bu 'phags chos su gzung ngo*/ / tshor ba la gsum ste/ yul yid du 'ong ba la bde ba/ mi 'ong ba la sdug bsngal/ bar ma la btang snyoms su skye'o/ / 'du shes la gsum ste/ yul la 'jug pa rgya che ba/ chung ba/ bar ma'o/ / 'du byed la sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig ste/ ldan pa'i 'du byed/ reg pa/ yid la byed pa/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/ sems pa ste kun tu 'gro ba lnga dang*/

mos pa/ 'dun pa/ dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab ste yul so sor nges pa lnga dang*/ dad pa/ ngo tsha ba/ khrel yod pa/ bag yod pa/ btang snyoms/ mi 'tshe ba/ brtson 'grus dang*/ shin tu sbyangs pa/ 'dod chags med pa/ zhe sdang med pa/ gti mug med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ste bcu gcig dge ba dang*/ 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ 'jig tshogs la blta ba/ the tshom ste drugartsa ba'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ phrag dogaser sna/ g.yo sgyu/ rgyags pa/ rmugs pa/ rgod pa/ ma dad pa/ le lo/ g.yeng ba/ bag med pa/ brjed ngas pa/ shes bzhin ma yin pa/ 'tshe ba/ ngo tsha med pa/ khrel med pa/ khro ba/ khon 'dzin/ 'chab pa/ 'tshig pa ste nyi shu nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ 'gyod pa/ gnyid/ rtog pa/ dpyod pa ste bzhi ni gzhan du 'gyur ba'o/ / de rnams kyi nang nas tshor ba dang 'du shes las gzhan pa'i bzhi bcu rtsa dgu dang*/ ming dang mtshan ma la sogs pa mi ldan pa'i 'du byed 'khor 'das bskyed pa'i bya ba byed pa thams cad ni/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo don yod grub pa'i khyad par 'phags chos su ngos gzung ngo*/ / gzugs kyi phung po la dbye na bco lnga ste/ sa/ chu/ me/ rlung ste rgyu'i gzugs 'byung ba bzhi dang*/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya ste yul lnga dang*/ migarna ba/ sna/ lce/ lus kyi dbang po ste dbang po lnga dang*/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs te bco lnga las/ rig byed ma yin pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mi bskyod pa dang gzhan bcu bzhi sangs rgyas spyan sogs kyis bsdus pa'i khyad par 'phags chos su ngos gzung ngo*/ / gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis te/ dbyings ngo bo nyid kyi gtso bo dang*/ rang bzhin tha mi dad pa'i 'khor ro/ / dang po ni/ bcoma~X ldana~X 'dasa~X de~X bzhina~X gshegasa~X pa~X rnama~X para~X shesa~X pa'i~X rgyala~X po~X rnam par snang mdzad dnga~X*/ de~X bzhina~X gshegasa~X pa~X gzugasa~X kyi~X rgyala~X po~X mi bskyod pa dnga~X de~X bzhina~X gshegasa~X pa~X tshora~X ba'i~X rgyala~X po~X rin cen 'byung ldan dnga~X*/

de~X bzhina~X gshegasa~X pa~X 'du~X she~Xs kyi~X rgyala~X po~X snang ba mtha' yas da~Xng*/ de~X bzhina~X gshegasa~X pa~X 'du~X byeda~X kyi~X rgyala~X po~X don yod grub pa dnga~X lnga'o/ / rigs lnga po de~X dga~X kuna~X kyanga~X sku mdog ni rim pa bzhin/ me long lta bu'i ye shes 'gyur ba med pas rnam par snang mdzad mthinga~X ga~X dnga~X*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dri ma thams cad dang bral bas mi bskyod pa dkara~X po~X dnga~X*/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes che ba'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pas rin cen 'byung ldan sera~X po~X dnga~X*/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes 'gro ba'i don la rjes su chags pas 'od dpag med le~X brgana~X te dmar po dnga~X*/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyis sems can gyi don sna tshogs su mdzad pas don yod grub pa ljanga~X gu'i~X mdoga~X tu~X gsal zhing 'tshera~X ba~X ni rigs lnga ga'i rang bzhin dwangs la bkrag dang gzi brjid che ba'o/ / de dag gi yum ni longs spyod par bya ba'i gzhi dang gtso bo'i yum du gyur pa dang yon tan gyis cho rigs btsun pas btsu~Xn mo~X gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pas dma~X pa'o~X/ / dbyings nam mkha'i rang bzhin ni chos nyid yangs shing yon tan gyi go 'byed pa la mi bsgribs pas gsal bar byed pa'i phyir snanga~X ba'i~X ngo bo nam mkha' dbyinga~Xs kyi dbang phyug ma ༵ dnga~X*/ sa ni brtan zhing rten du gyur pa bzhin du ngo bo mi 'gyur zhing yon tan gyi rten byed pas sra~X ba'i~X dbyinga~Xs te sangs rgyas spyan dnga~X*/ chu ni gsher la skye bo'i gsos su gyur pa ltar 'gro ba'i rgyud brlan par byed pas mnyena~X pa~X'i dbyi~Xngs te mā ma kī dnga~X*/ me ni bsreg cing snang ba ltar nyon mongs pa bsreg cing shes bya thams cad gsal bar byed pas dro~X ba'i~X dbyi~Xngs te gos dkor mo dnga~X*/ rlung ni bskyod pa dang 'degs pa'i bya ba byed pa ltar 'gro ba'i don la thog pa med kyang nye bar 'tsho ba'i gzhir gyur pas bskyoda~X pa~X'i dbyi~Xngs te dam tshig sgrol ma dnga~X*/

de dag la~X soga~Xs pa~X rigs kyi btsu~Xn mo~X'i tsho~Xgs ma lus mi lus lus pa med pa thams cad dnga~X*/ thabs dang shes rab gnyi~Xs su~X med ༵para~X mnyam par sbyor bas bzhugs so/ / gnyis pa rang bzhin gyi 'khor ni chad snyam/ mdo rgyud mdzod na 'di ltar yod/ de dag gi rang bzhin nam bzhugs pa'i tshul lam grangs sam rnam grangs bstan pa ni/ snang srid thams cad la ye nas 'du 'bral med par khyab cing*/ khyad par du longs sku'i snang bas yul chosa~X kyi~X dbyi~Xngs nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa kun tuX sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i snang ba chen pos kuna~X tu~X mtha'a~X yasa~X para~X khyaba~X pa~X ni~X/ 'di~X lta~X ste~X dpera~X na~X tila~X gyi~X ganga~X bu~X kha phye ba bzhina~X du~X go mtshams med par sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyis ganga~X nasa~X thams cad kun tu khyaba~X para~X bzhu~Xgs so/ / spyir snang srid thams cad la ye nas khyab kyang 'dir bde gshegs kyi snang ba la sbyar ro/ / tshul 'di ni bar gyi gsal byed de gong gi rigs lnga yab yum dang*/ 'og gi sems dpa' sems ma la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la shes par bya'o/ / dkrugs te mi bshad do/ / ci'i phyir zhe na las dang po pas rtogs par dka' zhing phul chung ba'i phyir ro/ / gsum pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis las/ rang bzhin gyi 'khor ni gong du bstan zin cing*/ thugs rje'i 'khor la gsum ste/ nang gi sems dpa' yab yum/ phyi'i sems dpa' yam yum/ sgo ba yab yum mo/ dang po la'ang gnyis las yab bzhi ni/ gtso bo rigs lnga'i rang bzhin bshad pa de~X na~Xs sems dpa'i 'khor bshad par bshad ste/ de yang ston pa nyid byang chub chen po yin pa bzhin du rang snang ba'i thugs rje'i ngang las shar ba'i 'khor rnams kyang sgrib pa mtha' dag byanga~X zhing yon tan ma lus pa thugs su chuba~X pas sangs rgyas nyid yin pa'i phyir che~Xn po~X sar gnas kyi sems dpa' las 'phags so/

/ de yang rnam par shes pa'i sems dpa' bzhi la/ rdo~X rje~X ni dbyings dang ye shes snang ba dang stong pa gnyis su med cing 'jig 'bral med pa ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sra zhing snying po khang stong med/ / gcad dang gzhig par bya ba med/ / bsreg par byar med 'jig med pas/ / stong nyid rdo rjer brjod par bya/ / zhes pa dang*/ sgrib pa thams cad 'joms shing sgrib pas tshur mi gnod pa yin te/ rgyas pa las/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin sgrib pa kun/ / 'joms shing cis kyang mi tshugs la/ / rang byung ye shes lha yi lha/ / thams cad kun la 'bigs par byed/ / ces so/ / mig gi rnam shes kyis gzugs mthong ba las khyad par du 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis yul lnga ga la 'jug cing chos nyid ro gcig tu gzigs pa'i cha nas mthonga~X ba~X ste sa'i snying po dnga~X*/ rna ba'i rnam shes kyis sgra thos pa las 'phags pas sangs rgyas kyi snyan gyis yul lnga ga la 'jug cing de bzhin nyid du ro gcig par gsan pa'i cha nas byanga~X chuba~X che~Xn po~X rdo~X rje~X tho~Xs pa~X ste phyag na rdo rje dnga~X*/ sna'i rnam shes kyis dri tshor ba las 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi shangs kyis yul lnga ga la 'jug cing skye ba med par ro gcig tu tshor ba byanga~X chuba~X che~Xn po~X rdo~X rje~X bsnama~Xs pa~X ste nam mkha'i snying po dnga~X*/ lce'i rnam shes kyis ro myong ba tsam las 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi ljags kyis yul lnga ga la 'jug cing gnyis su med par ro gcig tu myong ba byanga~X chuba~X che~Xn po~X rdo~X rje~X myanga~X ba~X ste spyan ras gzigs dnga~X*/ de dag gi yum bzhi yang rim pa bzhin du btsu~Xn mo~X mtho~Xng ba~Xr bya~X ba~X ye shes kyi snang ba'i yul gzugs te sgeg mo dnga~X*/ de bzhin du mnyana~X pa~Xr bya~X ba~X phreng ma dnga~X*/ mna~Xm pa~Xr bya~X ba~X ni glu dbyings ma dnga~X*/ myonga~X ba~Xr bya~X ba~X ni rol pa'i dga' ba ste gar ma dnga~X bzhi'o/ / de ltar cung zad bsnol yang ming tsam ste don la nang gi sgeg mo bzhir 'dod pas mi 'gal lo/

/ ji lta ba'i sgrar rjod na mnyan par bya ba sgra ste glu ma/ mnam par bya ba dri ste bdug spos mar 'byung ngo*/ / dbang po'i sems dpa' bzhi la mthonga~X byeda~X ni mig gi dbang po zar ma'i me tog lta bu las khyad par du 'phags pa rdo rje'i spyan sgrib pa med pas yul lnga 'dzin pa'i rten byed pa ste byams pa dnga~X*/ thosa~X byeda~X ni rna ba'i dbang po gro ga gcus pa lta bu las 'phags pa snyan gyi dbang po nyams pa med pas yul lnga gsal ba'i rten byed pa ste sgrib pa rnam sel dnga~X*/ snoma~X byeda~X ni sna'i dbang po zangs kyi mo khab gshibs pa lta bu las 'phags pa shangs kyi dbang pos yul lnga la 'jug pa'i rten byed pa ste kun tu bzang po dnga~X*/ myonga~X byeda~X ni lce'i dbang po zla ba phyed pa lta bu las 'phags pa gsung ro bro ba'i mchog mkhyen pas yul lnga la 'jug pa'i rten byed pa ste 'jam dpal dnga~X de dag gi yum rnams kyang rim pa bzhin/ btsuna~X mo~X 'da~Xs pa~X ni sngar grags pa'i chos zhig nas med pa las khyad par du 'phags pa snga ma'i chos ji bzhin pa mngon sum du gsal ba'i rang bzhin 'das pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du bdug spos mar snang ba dnga~X*/ da ltar ni dbang po'i mngon sum la snang ba tsam las 'phags pa chos thams cad bskal don med par da~X ltara~X gyi dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du me tog mar snang ba dnga~X*/ ma~X byunga~X pa~X ni ma 'ongs pa'i yul la mngon du ma gyur pa las khyad par du 'phags pa ma 'ongs pa'i chos rnams kyang skyu ru ra phyag mthil du bzhag pa bzhin du da ltar gzigs pas ma 'ongs pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du snang gsal mar snang ba dang ༵/ 'byu~Xng b.ra~X ma~X ngesa~X pa'i~X tsho~Xgs dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes te rang byung gi snang ba ji bzhin pa'i ngang nas 'pho 'gyur med pa'i chos nyid la bzhugs pa'i mtshon byed du dri chab mar snang ba dnga~X bzhi'o/

/ de'ang 'das ma 'ongs da ltar mkhyen tshul ni me long gi ngos la pra phab pa'i snga rtags phyi rtags da ltar ba dang bcas pa 'char ba bzhin du sa le mkhyen pa'o/ / de skad du phal po che las/ 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar byung*/ / ji snyed ji bzhin mngon du gyur/ / ces pa ltar ro/ / sgo ba yab yum la gnyis las/ yab ni gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ mi 'jig rnam par mi shes pa/ / brjod med rnam par mi rtog pa/ / sangs rgyas byang chub ye shes 'di/ / shes na bde ba thob par 'gyur/ / zhes pa'i tshul dang mthun par bshad de/ 'jo~Xm pa~X ni thabs dang che~Xn po~X ni shes rab ste/ de gnyis kyi rnam par 'phrul pa chen pos bdud dang gshin rje la sogs pa gdug pa can rnams 'dul bar byed pas rdo~X rje~X'o/ / de yang gsum las lus kyi cha'i re~Xg pa'i ༵tshor ba bskyed pa la/ re~Xg bye~Xd lus/ re~Xg bya~X yul/ de gnyis phrad pa las re~Xg bya she~Xs pa lus kyi rnam shes te tha mal pa las khyad par du 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi skus reg bya'i khams yul lnga la 'jug pa'i phyir bdud rtsi 'khyil pa da~Xng*/ rta mchog dang*/ stobs po che dang*/ gshin rje gshed do/ / ngag gi cha'i reg pa nyid sgrar bsgyur te gzhung du lus kyi bzhi dang por dngos su bstan pas ngag yid gnyis shugs la bstan to/ / de yang sgra'i shes pa skye ba la/ rjod byed sgra/ brjod bya yul/ de gnyis brjod pa'i rkyen tshogs pa las sgra'i shes pa snyan mi snyan bar ma gsum 'byung ba las khyad par 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi gsungs dbyangs sgrib pa thams cad dang bral ba yul lnga la 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la sogs pa khro bo bzhir snang ngo*/ / yid kyi tshe chos su bsgyur te/ yid kyi yul chos kyi skye mched skye ba la/ rig byed yid/ rig bya don spyi'i rnam pa sna tshogs pa yul/ de gnyis phrad pa las bde sdug dgag sgrub la sogs pa'i shes pa skye ba las khyad par 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi ye shes sgrib pa med pa don spyi'i 'dzin pa la mi ltos par mngon sum du gyur cing chags sdang thams cad dang bral ba'i mtshon byed du khro bo bzhi sgo bar ye shes kyi rtsal las rang snang ba de yang skye 'jig med pa dang*/

brjod du med pa dang*/ rig byed med pa dang*/ rnam pa med par rtogs pa'i ye shes bzhi'o/ / de dag gi yum bzhi ni rim pa bzhin ngo bo gzugs la sogs pa'i chos thams cad rtaga~X pa~Xr ma~X yi~Xn pa~X ste med bzhin du snang ba gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar mtshon zhing rnam pa byams pa chen po dang sbyin pas sems can rnams sdud pa'i mtshon byed du lcags kyu ma'o/ / sgra la sogs pa'i chos thams cad cha~Xd pa~Xr ma~X yi~Xn pa~X ste ngo bo rang rang gi snang ba ma dor ba smig rgyu dang*/ 'dra bar mtshon zhing rnam pa snying rje chen po dang snyan par smra bas sems can rnams bsdud pa'i phyir zhags pa mar snang ba'o/ / yid kyi chos rnams la dgag sgrub kyis bdag tu~X bzung du med de ngo bo bda~Xg tu grub pa ma~X yi~Xn pa~X rmi lam dang 'dra zhing rnam pa dga' ba chen po dang don mthun pas sems can rnams dbang du byed pa'i brdar lcags sgrog ma'o/ / snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kyi ngo bo dngos po dang mtsha~Xn ma~Xr grub pa ma~X yi~Xn te gdod ma nas rang bzhin med pa sprul pa dang 'dra zhing rnam pa don spyod pa dang btang snyoms chen pos sems can rnams zhi ba la 'god pa'i mtshon byed du dril bu mar snang ba~X'o/ / de yang sangs rgyas kyi sa na dbang shes lnga po re res kyang yul lnga la 'jug par/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dbang po lnga rnams gzhan gyur na/ / don kun 'jug dang thams cad kyi/ / yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'byung*/ / zhes pa dang*/ mig gi dbang po la thog mar phyogs bzh-i steng 'og gnyis te drug tu phye la/ drug po re re la gdod phyogs bcur phye ba'i mig gi dbang pos shar phyogs kyi shar gyi gzugs mthong ba bzhag la/ sgra thos/ dri tshor/ ro myang*/ reg bya reg pa bzhi/ phyogs lhag ma dgu la bzhi bzhi ste bzhi bcu/ de bzhin du phyogs lhag ma lnga la'ang bcu bcur phye la bzhi bcu bzhi bcu ste/ dai ltar na bzhi bcu tshan pa drug la nyis brgya bzhi bcu ste/

rna ba dang*/ sna dang*/ lce dang*/ lus rnams la'ang rang rang gi yon tan bor la de bzhin du brtsis pas brgya phrag bcu gnyis te/ 'di dag ni sangs rgyas kyi sa'i yon tan khyad par can no/ / de ltar rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi yab dang yum dang sems dpa' dang sems ma dang sgo ba yab yum la~X so~Xgs pa~X dbus su snang ba ji lta ba bzhin du/ phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rang rang gi tshom bu'i 'khor 'bum phrag du mas bskor ba/

lha'i bkod tshul gyi mang nyung dang rnam pa rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor de~X lta~X bu~X'i tsho~Xgs nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab par rjo~Xd kyi~Xs mi~X la~Xng bar snang ba~X rnams dang ༵rang bzhin gnyi~Xs su~X me~Xd pa~Xr bzhuga~Xs te rang snang ye shes kyi rol pa gcig gis ngang las shar ba'i gnad kyis so~X/ / gsum pa ye shes kyi rang snang bkod pas don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ gang las bkod pa'i ngo bo/ tshul ji ltar bkod pa'i tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ gleng gzhi rgyas par bstan pa de~X na~Xs de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X yab rnams yum btsuna~X mo~X'i tsho~Xgs dnga~X rang bzhin gnyis ༵su~X me~Xd pa~X'i ngo bo gzhan gyi spyod yul du ma gyur pas gsa~Xng ba~X'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr rang snang ba de~X da~Xg nyida~X kyi~X gsa~Xng ba~X chen po 'di~X nyida~X/ sku~X rdo rje dnga~X gsu~Xng rdo rje dnga~X thuga~Xs rdo rje dnga~X yona~X tana~X rdo rje dang 'phrina~X lasa~X rdo~X rje~X lasa~X rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor rang snang ba'i don ston pa'i rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig 'di dag dgongs pa rang shar du ma brjod pa'i tshul gyis phyunga~X ngo~X*/ / gnyis pa ji ltar byung zhing rang snang du bkod pa la gsum ste/ rang snang gi dkyil 'khor de nyid gang gi ngang las bkod pa/ tshul ji ltar snang ba/ de nyid gang gi bzhugs gnas yin ngos bzung ba'o/ / dang po ni/ e~X chos sku'i ngang las e~X ma~X longs sku'i snang ba e~X ma~X ho~X sna tshogs su rang snang ba ngo mtshar ston pa'o/ / chos sku de~X bzhi~Xn nyida~X kyi~X dbyinga~Xs nyida~X kyi ngo bo la dba~Xng bsgyur ba~X la longs sku ye~X she~Xs lnga'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr lhun gyis grub pa ni ston pa nyid kyi bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thuga~Xs rje'i~X nganga~X las byung ba'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ de lta'i zhing khams lhun stug po bkod pa de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la ra~Xng snanga~X ba~X nyida~X de sangs rgyas kyi tinga~X nge 'dzina~X rnam par dag pa'i gzu~Xgs brnya~Xn ye shes kyi~X sgyu ma~X rang bzhin gyis rnama~X par dga~X pa'i ngo bor gsa~Xl cing snang ba~X ni~X zhes so/

/ gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku~X dang gsu~Xng dang thuga~Xs dang yona~X tana~X dang 'phrina~X lasa~X rnams nyes pa'i skyon cung zad tsam gyi'ang se~Xl meda~X pa'i~X bdag nyid/ yona~X tana~X phun sum tshogs pa yi~Xd bzhi~Xn ri~Xn po~X che ༵bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mnga' thang chen po mi~X za~Xd pa~Xr lda~Xn pa ye shes rgyana~X gyi~X 'kho~Xr lo~X mnga' ba'i rang bzhin rdo~X rje~X mchoga~X gi~X ngo bo 'du 'bral med pa dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i gna~Xs nyida~X do~X/ / zhesa~X sku gsung thugs kyi rdo~X rje~X gsu~Xng ba~X'i tshi~Xg rgyud kyi rang bzhin du~X'o~X/ / 'di la kha cig sdud pa po'i rnam par sbyor ba ni mi 'thad de rdo rje gsang ba'i snying po'i rgyud yin pa'i phyir ro/ / skabs 'dir bla ma rong pa/ de bzhin nyid kyi dkyil 'khor/ / byings kyi dkyil 'khor/ dbang bsgyur thabs kyi dkyil 'khor ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor/ thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor/ rang snang ba'i dkyir 'khor/ nyid kyi dkyir 'khor/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor/ rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor/ gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor du bzhed do/ / de yang rdo rje'i tshig yin pas gang du'ang sbyar du rung mod kyi/ 'on kyang skabs 'di ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa lam gyi dkyil 'khor ston pa'i skabs ma yin zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi rang snang lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor ston pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir ma 'brel lo/ / kha cig gleng gzhi bsdus par 'dod pa de dag gis kyang gzhung gi phyogs tsam yang ma mthong ba nyid do/ / gleng gzhi ston pa'i bkar bsdu ba ni/ kha cig na re gleng gzhi ni sdud pa po'i tshig yin pas gleng slong ba man chad bka' yin no zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ sdud pa po nyid ston pa dang tha dad med pas kyang de'i gsung bka' yin la/ ngan song sbyong bar dkyil 'khor phal cher gsang bdag gis gsungs pa'ang rgyud du bshad pa dang*/

gzhan yang snying rje pad+ma dkar po'i mdo las kyang*/ nga 'das pa'i tshe dge slong rnams bka' bsdu bar byed pa na/ thog mar 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na zhes pas gleng slong zhigaces gsungs pas 'dir yang chos mthun no/ / de ltar phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul brjod pa de dag gis gsa~Xng ba~X'i snying ༵po~X de~X kho~X na~X nyi~Xd nge~Xs pa~X'i le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod pa la~Xs/ rgyud 'byung ba'i lo rgyus dang nges pa sbyin pa dang gzhir gyur pa'i phyir gle~Xng gzhi~X'i don yin la/ le~X'u~X ni par ri ts+tshe ta'i sgra las yongs su bcad pa'am dum par byas pa la 'jug pas te 'dir yang de yin la/ da~Xng po~X'i ni le'u rnams kyi thog ma smos pa'i sgra de gral gyi 'go na gnas pa bzhin no/ / de'ang bam po ni kha mar blta la/ le'u rnams ni kha yar blta ba yin pas na so so'i le'u re rdzogs par bstan pa'i mtha' tshig go/ / / ༈ gnyis pa ston pa nyid rig lngar bzhengs pa'i thugs rang byung gi ye shes gnyis su med pas chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par ched du brjod cing thugs rje g.yo ba'i tshul bstan pa ni/ gleng bslang ba'i tshul gyis ston te/ de'ang chos sku'i ston pa yab yum nyid longs skur snang ba'i thugs rang byung gi ye shes shes bya'i yul gtan la 'bebs pa na/ 'bebs byed rigs pa ni yid rdo rje kun tu bzang po yab tu brjod la/ yul shes bya ni bya ba mo kun tu bzang mo ste yum du btags pa ni 'og tu tshogs sgrub pa'i skabs su gzungs yul yum dang 'dzin pa yab tu bshad pa bzhin yin la/ yab yum gnyis su med pa ni blos yul gzhal ba'i tshe gnyis ka rig pa'i ngo bor gcig pa ste dper na/ sems la lha sa'i don spyi lam gyis gzhal dus/ sems ni yab/ lha sa ni yum/ de gnyis rang gis sems su ro gcig pa ni gnyis su med pa bzhin no/ / de ltar spyi'i go don yid la bzhag nas/

da ni le'u gnyis pa'i gzhung don nyid brjod pa la gnyis te/ don gyi dgongs pa gleng bslang ba dang*/ de ma rtogs pa'i sems can la thugs rje g.yo ba'i tshul bstan pa'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ yab kyi/ yum gyi/ gnyis su med pa'i dgongs pa gleng bslang ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ dgongs pa gleng bslang bar 'jug pa'i rgyu dang*/ gleng bslang ba dngos so/ / dang po ni gleng gzhi bstan pa de~X na~Xs bco~Xm lda~Xn 'da~Xs rigs kyi gtso bo'i thugs rang byung gi ye shes yul 'byed par byeda~X pa~X po~X gnyis su med pa'i tshul rdo~X rje~X yida~X yul du ma la 'jug pas kuna~X tu~X ngo bo dbyings las ma g.yos pas bza~Xng po ༵phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i sangs rgyas thama~Xs cada~X kyi dgongs pa ma ༵lusa~X pa 'dus pa'i~X ranga~X bzhina~X gyi~X sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i tshula~X dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rdo~X rje~Xs/ yul gyi rang bzhin ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i phyir btsuna~X mo~X gtan la dbab par bya ༵ba~X mo~X snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chosa~X ma lus pa ku~Xn tu~X ste thams cad kyang ye nas dag pas bza~Xng mo ༵la~X 'byed pa'i blo 'ju~Xg para~X gyura~X to~X/ / blo zhugasa~X pa~Xs phyoga~Xs bcu~X dusa~X bzhi~X'i de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X ma~X lusa~X pa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd thugs rang byung gi ye shes kun tu bzang po gci~Xg gi~X ra~Xng bzhina~X du ngo bo dbyera~X me~Xd pa~Xs/ nyid las gzhan pa'i chos ma gzigs nas de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X nyi~Xd/ de~X bzhi~Xn gshega~Xs pa~X nyida~X la~X che~Xd du~X brjo~Xd pa~X'i tshul 'di~X skad ces brjo~Xd par mdzad do~X/ / gnyis pa ni chos thams cad gdod nas dag pas e~X ma~X ho~X ste ngo mtshar che ba'i don to/ / ji ltar na sangs rgyas dang sems can thams cad kyi rang bzhin ye nas skye ba med par sangs rgyas pas rdo~X rje~X ste chos nyid stong pa nyid dang chos can snang ba nyid kyi rang bzhin ni phunga~X po~X'o~X/ / de'i ya~Xn la~Xg ni~X rnam par shes pa la sogs pa'i phung po lnga ste/

mi bskyod pa la sogs pa yang dag par rdzoga~Xs pa'i~X sa~Xngs rgya~Xs lnga~X ru ༵graga~Xs pa'o/ / de bzhin du skye~X mche~Xd bcu gnyis dang khama~Xs bco brgyad po rnama~Xs kyi bye brag mnga~X po~X kuna~X kyang byanga~X chuba~X sema~Xs dpa'i~X yab yum ste 'khor gyi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr nyida~X du ye nas gnas so/ / skye mched ni gzugs la sogs pa'i yul drug la mig la sogs pa dbang po'i shes pa drug skye zhing skad cig phyir mar rgyun mched par byed pas de skad ces bya'o/ / dbye na gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos te yul drugamig rna ba sna lce lus yid de dbang po drug gi skye mched de bcu gnyis so/ / khams bco brgyad ni/ mig dang*/ gzugs dang*/ mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams dang zhes yul drugadabang po drugadabang shes drug rnams so/ / 'byung ba lnga yum lnga'i ngo bor sangs rgyas te sa~X dang chu~X ni sangs rgyas spyana~X ma dang mā~X ma~X kī~X'o/ / me~X dang rlunga~X ni go~Xs dkara~X mo dang dam tshig sgrola~X ma~X ste~X/ nama~X mkha~X' ni dbyinga~Xs kyi~X dba~Xng phyuga~X ma~X'o/ / de ltar phyi nang gi 'byung ba dang rtog tshogs kyis bsdus pa'i 'dod pa gzugs gzugs med pa'i srida~X pa gsu~Xm gyi ngo bo ma dag pa ltar snang ba 'di yang ye~X gdod ma nasa~X sangasa~X rgyasa~X kyi rang bzhin du gnas shinga~X*/ 'khor ba'i chos thama~Xs ca~Xd dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos ma~X lusa~X pa snang zhing srid pa'i cho~Xs so~X co~Xg thams cad sanga~Xs rgyasa~X nyida~X lasa~X gzha~Xn ma~X yina~X te/ sanga~Xs rgyasa~X nyida~X lasa~X gzha~Xn pa~X ma dag pa 'khor ba'i~X chosa~X zhes bya ba rang mtshan du grub pa ni/ btsal nas sanga~Xs rgya~Xs nyi~Xd kyi~Xs kyang rdul tsam zhig mi~X brnye~Xs so~X ste mi rnyed do/ / sangs rgyas kyis ma rnyed pa ni don la med par go bar byed pa yin te/ rnam nges las/ thams cad mkhyen pas gzigs pa log pa ni thams cad du med par go bar byed pa kho na yin no/

/ zhes so/ / ji skad du kun byed las/ chos kun ma skyes kun byed nyid kyi ngang*/ / ye nas sangs rgyas snying po kun byed la/ / yod med mi dmigs rang bzhin mnyam pa'i ngang*/ / gdod nas gzhi rtsa bral ba'i chos nyid do/ / zhes pa dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i mdo las/ chos kun ye nas sangs rgyas pas/ / byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid do/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / de ltar snang ba'i chos nyid ye nas sangs rgyas pa'o zhe~Xs brjoda~X pasa~X de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thama~Xs cada~X mnye~Xs para~X gyura~X to~X/ / gnyis pa yum gyi dgongs pa chos nyid stong pa'i gnas lugs gtso bor gleng bslang ba la'ang gnyis te/ dgongs pa gleng bslang ba la 'jug pa'i rgyu dang*/ gleng bslang ba dngos so/ / dang po ni/ blos yul gyi gnas lugs brjod pa de~X nasa~X blo la snang ba'i yul rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i btsu~Xn mo~X gtan la dbab par bya~X ba~X mo~X rang snang ba'i cho~Xs kuna~X tu~X bza~Xng mo~Xs/ yul can rig pa'i ye shes bco~Xm ldana~X 'da~Xs kuna~X tu~X bza~Xng po~X da~Xng yul yul can gnyi~Xs su~X me~Xd pa~Xr gyura~X na~Xs chos nyid stong pa nyid kyi gnas lugs 'di nyid cheda~X du~X brjoda~X pa'i~X ngo bor 'di~X skad ces brjoda~X do~X/ / gnyis pa ni/ chos nyid ngo mtshar bar bstan pa'i phyir kye~X ma~X ho~X/ / zhes so/ / ji ltar mtshar na rang snang gi zhing khams 'dis mtshon nas phyoga~Xs bcu~X'i sto~Xng gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khama~Xs thams cad ye~X gdod ma nasa~X stong pa nyid kyi phyir dbe~Xn pa ni snod kyi 'jig rten stong pa nyid du bstan pa'o/ / stong gsum ni/ gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa gcig lcags ri gnya' shing 'dzin dang mtho dman mnyam pas bskor ba 'dod pa dang gzugs kyi lha'i khang pas brgyan pa ni gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten no/ / de stong gi mthar sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas dang mtho dman mnyam pa'i lcags ris bskor ba ni stong dang po'i spyi phud kyi 'jig rten no/

/ de stong gi mthar gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi gnas dang mnyam pa'i lcags ris bskor ba ni stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten no/ / de stong gi mthar bsam gtan dang po'i gnas dang mnyam pa'i lcags ris bskor ba ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams so/ / 'dir ni des mtshon pa'i zhing dang 'jig rten thams cad stong pa nyid de gzugs brnyan bzhin no/ / de na gnas pa'i bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyang stong par bstan pa ni srida~X pa~X gsuma~X ni~X ye nas dga~X pa'i~X sangs rgyas kyi zhinga~X khams lhun stug po bkod pa'i rang bzhin du gnas shing*/ ye shes lnga'i rtsal gzung 'dzin du 'khrul dus dug lngar snang bas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i phyir snyiga~Xs ma~X lnga~X nyida~X kyang ngo bo rang byung gi ye shes bde~X ba chen po dang ldana~X pa'i gna~Xs las gzhan ma yin no/ / 'di la kha cig dus la sogs pa'i snyigs mar 'chad pa ni phyin ci log go / 'gro ba'i phunga~X po~X lnga~X nyi~Xd kyang snga ma bzhin ye nas mngo~Xn par sanga~Xs rgyasa~X pa'i phyir/ chos thama~Xs cada~X kyi gnas lugs la bzang ngan dang blang dor gang du'ang ma grub pas mchoga~X gi~X snyinga~X po~X mnyam pa nyid byang chub kyi rang bzhin yin pasa~X na/ de las gzhana~X du~X rgyala~X bsa~X cho~Xs mi~X btsa~Xl te/ thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin yin zhing*/ sangs rgyas nyida~X lasa~X gzhana~X ma dag pa zhesa~X bya~X ba'i~X chosa~X log pa zhig btsa~Xl kyanga~X rgyala~X bsa~X gzhan mi~X brnyesa~X so~X te mi rnyed do/ / zhesa~X yum gyis brjoda~X pasa~X chos thama~Xs cada~X ye~X nasa~X sangasa~X rgyasa~X para~X de~X bzhina~X gshe~Xgs pa~X btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa nyida~X kyisa~X mkhyena~X to~X/ / gsum pa gnyis su med pa'i dgongs pa la'ang gnyis te/ dgongs pa gleng ba la 'jug pa'i rgyu dang*/ gleng bslang ba dngos so/ / dang po yul nyid yul can gyi ngo bo dang rig pa'i ye shes su rnam par dag pa de~X na~Xs yab yum rig stong gnyi~Xs su~X me~Xd pa'i~X bdaga~X nyida~X che~Xn posa~X/

'khor 'das ye~X nasa~X mnyam pa nyid du~X sanga~Xs rgyasa~X pa~X'i phyir se~Xms kyang sangs rgyas pa'i chos nyid du shes par byed pa rang byung gi ye~X shesa~X su~X ye nas yin pa la yin pa'i bdag nyid du bskyeda~X pa~X 'di~X gsu~Xngs so~X/ / de skad du'ang rmad byung rgyal po'i rgyud las/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ / ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ / yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa ni chos thams cad ye nas skye 'gag spros pa'i yul las 'das shing*/ de rtogs pa'i blo yang ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du bstan pa'i phyir/ e~X ma~X ho~X chos rnams kyi gnas lugs ngo~X mtsha~Xr zhing gzhan las rmada~X du byung ba nyid kyi~X cho~Xs nyid 'di ni/ rdzo~Xgs pa~X'i sanga~Xs rgyasa~X kuna~X gyi~X gsa~Xng ba zab mo'i don to/ / gang zhe na chos nyid gdod ma nas skye~X ba~X me~Xd pa'i ngang la~Xs snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i cho~Xs thama~Xs ca~Xd skye~Xs par snang ba rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu ste/

skyesa~X pa~Xr snang dus nyida~X na~X don la skye~X ba~X me~Xd pa'i ngo bo ni chos kyi dbyings so| |de nyid rtogs pa'i blo ni chos dbyings ye shes so/ / de bzhin du tshig dang po gnyis 'og ma bzhi la yang sbyar nas/ ye nas 'ga~Xg pa~X me~Xd pa'i chos nyid gdangs sna tshogs su 'char ba me long gi ngos lta bu la~Xs/ chos can sna tshogs su gzugs brnyan ltar snang ba tha~Xms ca~Xd 'ga~Xg pa ltar snang yang*/ 'ga~Xg para~X snang dus de nyida~X na~X gnas lugs 'gaga~X pa~X me~Xd pa ni me long lta bu'o/ / de nyid rtogs pa'i blo ni me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ / chos thams cad ye nas gna~Xs pa~X me~Xd pa nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang lasa~X 'di ltar snang ba'i chos sna tshogs pa thama~Xs ca~Xd gna~Xs pa ltar snang yang*/ gna~Xs pa~Xr snang dus 'di nyida~X na~X don la gna~Xs pa~X me~Xd pa ni mnyam pa nyid do/ / de nyid rtogs pa'i blo ni mnyam nyid ye shes so/ / sems nyid rang bzhin gyis dag pa dmi~Xgs pa~X dang mtshan ma meda~X pa nam mkha' 'am rgya mtsho dngas pa'i dkyil lta bu'i ngang lasa~X rnam par rtogs pa sprin nam gzugs brnyan ltar sna tshogs su shar ba tha~Xms cada~X dgag sgrub la sogs par dmi~Xgs pa ltar snang yang rnam rtog sna tshogs su dmi~Xgs para~X snang dus nyid na~X gzhi med rtsa ba dang bral bas dmi~Xgs pa~X dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa rang bzhin gyis me~Xd pa ni so sor rtogs pa'o/ / de nyid rtogs pa'i blo la so sor rtog pa'i ye shes zhes bya'o/ / chos thams cad gdod nas 'gro~X 'o~Xng me~Xd pa sprul pa lta bu'i ngang lasa~X snang ba dang rig pa 'gro~X ba dnga~X 'onga~X ba sna tshogs su snang yang*/ 'gro~X 'onga~X du snang ba nyida~X na~X rang gi ngo bo 'gro 'ong me~Xd par gnas pa ni bya ba grub pa/ de nyid rtogs pa'i blo ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ / de dag gi don kha cig gis dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes so zhes sbyor ba yang skabs dang 'brel bar ma mthong ste snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs ston pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir ro/

/ de ltar chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ye nas dag pa'i tshul de skad ce~Xs brjo~Xd pa~Xs de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X yab snang ba tha~Xms ca~Xd da~Xng*/ yum btsu~Xn mo~X'i tsho~Xgs stong pa tha~Xms ca~Xd kya~Xng mnyam pa nyid du ye nas mnye~Xs pa~Xs khya~Xb pa~Xr gyu~Xr to~X/ / gnyis pa de nyid ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba la thugs rje g.yo ba'i tshul bstan pa la bzhi ste/ thugs rje 'jug pa'i yul sems can gyis ma rtogs par bstan pa dang*/ ma rtogs pa'i rang bzhin bdag tu bzung bas 'khor bar 'khrul tshul/ 'khrul par snang dus nyid nas bcing grol med pa'i don las ma 'das pa/ de nyid bstan pa'i phyir thugs rje'i rol pa 'gyed pa'i tshul brjod pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ thugs rje 'jug pa'i rgyu bstan pa dang*/ ji ltar 'jug pa'i yul bstan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs bstan pa de nas de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa tha~Xms cada~X btsu~Xn mo~X'i tsho~Xgs da~Xng bca~Xs pa~Xs don 'di nyid bstan pa'i phyir che~Xd du~X brjo~Xd pa~X 'di~X brjo~Xd do~X/ / gnyis pa ni/ ma rtogs pa'i sems can gyi tshogs la skyo ba'i tshul gyis e~X ma~X ho~X zhes bos te chos thams cad rang bzhin gdod ma nas sangs rgyas pa'i don thog ma nyid nas ma rtogs par ye~X na~Xs 'gro ba thams cad la gsa~Xng ba'i~X cho~Xs so/ / snang srid sna~X tsho~Xgs su snanga~X ba 'di dag sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i chos nyid du ye nas gnas pa la~X ma dag 'khrul pa'i chos su snang bas ra~Xng bzhi~Xn gyis gsa~Xng ba'o/ / de lta bu'i don de nyid gzhan gyi sbas pa lta bu ma yin par snang stong 'du 'bral med pa'i chos nyid ma rtogs pas chos rnams kyi rang bzhin ngo~X bo~X nyi~Xd kyi~Xs ra~Xb tu gsa~Xng ba'o/ / don de nyid rang gi sems nyid las gzha~Xn du~X mi~Xn kyang rang la~X yod par ma mthong bsa~X shi~Xn tu~X gsa~Xng ba'o/ / kha cig snod min la gsang bar 'dod pa ni gzhi'i gsang ba ston pa'i skabs yin pas mi 'thad do/

/ ye nas gsang ba'i don de skad ce~Xs brjo~Xd pa~X la~Xs slar yang ston pa'i thugs rje skyes so/ / gnyis pa 'khrul tshul la'ang gnyis te/ thugs rje'i rgyu bstan pa dang*/ 'khrul tshul dngos so/ / dang po ni/ dag pa de ༵bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X'i chos sku dang zhing khams su snang ba tha~Xms ca~Xd da~Xng*/ ma dag pa 'khor ba'i cho~Xs snod bcud srid gsum du snang ba tha~Xms ca~Xd ye~X na~Xs sa~Xngs rgya~Xs pa'i~X ngo~X bo~X nyi~Xd du~X gci~Xg pa~X'i mtsha~Xn nyida~X yi~Xn pa~Xs dbye~Xr me~Xd pas rnam par dag pa yin na~X'anga~X*/ 'gro~X ba'i~X rna~Xm pa~Xr rto~Xg pa~X gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i ma~X ri~Xg pa~X gnyis su 'dzin pa la~Xs skyes pa'i 'bras bu ngan song gsum dang lha mi gnyis te 'gro~X ba~X lnga~X'i bde sdug gi ri~Xgs bsa~Xm gyi~Xs mi~X khya~Xb pa~Xr smina~X pa~X la~X/ rang byung gi thuga~Xs rjai~X che~Xn po~X lhun gyis grub pa sa~Xngs rgyasa~X kyi~X ye~X shesa~X che~Xn po~Xr skyesa~X na~Xs slar yang che~Xd du~X brjo~Xd pa~X 'di~X skad ces brjo~Xd do~X/ / gnyis pa brtse ba'i rang bzhin gyis e~X ma~X ho~X zhes brjod nas/ gdod ma'i gnas lugs sems nyid 'od gsal ba bde~X gshe~Xgs snyinga~X po~X'i ngang lasa~X 'khrul lo/ / de'ang bde gshegs snying po ni sems nyid 'od gsal ba sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i ngo bor gnas pa de nyid yin te/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ dag pa dwangs pa 'od gsal ba/ / mi 'khrugs 'dus ma byas pa nyid/ / bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po ste/ / ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid do/ / zhes pa dang*/ sgyu 'phrul rgyas pa las/ rnam rtog kun gzhi ma yin pa/ / rang bzhin med pa don gyi gzhi/ / de ni chos kyi dbyings zhes bya/ / de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes so/ / zhes pa dang*/ 'dus ma byas don gyi kun gzhi'i don nyid/ rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ sa rnams sna tshogs kun gzhi ste/ / bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po'ang de/ / snying po de la kun gzhi'i sgras/

/ bde bar gshegs pa bstan par mdzad/ / ces so/ / de nyid kyis 'gro ba kun la khyab pa yin te/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro ba yongs la khyab/ / ces pa dang*/ rgyud bla ma las kyang*/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*/ / de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang*/ / rigs yod phyir na sems can kun/ / rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ / zhes so/ / rkyen gang gis 'khrul na sems can ranga~X rang gi~X rnama~X par rtoga~X pa rang shar du byung bas rgyu byas pa'i lasa~X kyisa~X 'khor ba'i grong khyer chen po 'di rang snang rmi lam ltar sprula~X lo/ / de'ang lha la sogs pa'i 'gro ba sna~X tshoga~Xs pa'i lu~Xs dnga~X de dag gi 'dod pa'i lo~Xngs spyoda~X dnga~X*/ mtho ris la sogs pa'i gna~Xs dnga~X rang rang gi bde ba dang sduga~X bsnga~Xl la~X so~Xgs pa~X du mar snang ba la/ 'gro ba rnams nga zhes bda~Xg tu 'dzin pa dnga~X nga'i yo byad ces pa la sogs pa bda~Xg gi~Xr byed pas so~X so~Xr gzung 'dzi~Xn gnyis su 'dzin pas nam yang 'khor ba las mi grol bar 'gyur ro/ / gsum pa 'khrul par snang dus nyid nas bcing grol med par bstan pa ni/ de ltar 'khor bar bde sdug du mas gdungs kyang gnas lugs la nam mkha' bzhin du 'ching byed susa~X kya~Xng 'gro ba kun ma~X bci~Xngs shing*/ bci~Xngs pa ltar snang ba'i nyon mongs kyang don la me~Xd de~X/ bci~Xng b.ra~X bya~X ba'i 'gro ba~X dang 'gro ba'i sems nyid kyang don la yo~Xd pa ma~X yi~Xn pa'i phyir ro/ / 'o na 'di ltar bcings pa ltar snang ba gang las byung zhe na/ glo bur ba'i rnama~X rtoga~X bda~Xg tu~X 'dzi~Xn pa~X yi~Xs don med par 'khrul pa bzos pa yin te/ dper na 'ga' zhig nana~X nam ched kyis mdun gya ༵ ི nam mkha~X' la~X thag pa cig byung ba blos bzos nas/ de la mdu~Xd pa~X bcing grol du ma 'do~Xr zhing byed pa ltar/ rang gi sems nyid gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' lta bu la/ dgag sgrub gzung 'dzin du mar byas pas 'khor ba'i 'khrul pa ltar snang ba'o/

/ nam mkha'i mdud pa yang ji srid blo yi rtsol ba ma bzhag ring la bden bden che che ltar yod kyang don la bcings pa med pa ltar/ 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'di yang gzung 'dzin du zhen pa ma btang ring la grub grub bzhin yod kyang*/ don la grub pa gang yang med pa'i dpe'o/ / bzhi pa de nyid bstan pa'i phyir thugs rje 'phro tshul ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sus kyang bci~Xngs pa me~Xd cing rna~Xm pa~Xr bkro~Xl ba me~Xd pa~X'i sems nyid ye~X na~Xs sku dang ye shes kyi zhing khams chen por lhuna~X gyis grub cing yongs su rdzo~Xgs pa'i rang bzhin sa~Xngs rgyasa~X kyi gsang ba zab mo'i cho~Xs 'di nyid 'gro ba la bsta~Xn pa'i phyi~Xr thabs kyi rol pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa spro~X ba~X rnam pa sna~X tsho~Xgs pa mdza~Xd do~X/ / zhe~Xs rang snang dag pa'i de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X nyida~X de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X nyida~X la~X cheda~X du~X glenga~X ngo~X*/ / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsa~Xng ba~X'i snyinga~X po~X de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X nge~Xs pa~X la~Xs/ mya ngan las 'das pa dona~X dma~X pa spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rnam par dag pa dnga~X 'khor ba kuna~X rdzoba~X pa'i~X byanga~X chuba~X kyi~X se~Xms gnyis ka yang gdod ma nas sangs rgyas pas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye~X shesa~X su~X bskyeda~X pa ste dbyer med pa'i gnas lugs bstan pa dang*/ ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba la rang byung gi thugs rjes dbyings nas 'phro ba'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa~X'i le~X'u ste~X gnyisa~X pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / // ༈ don gsum pa thugs rje'i rang bzhin chos nyid las ma g.yos bzhin 'jig rten du sgron ma bkod pas chos thams cad gtan la phab pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ spyi don dang*/ gzhung gi don no/ / dang po la gnyis te/ theg pa thun mong pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs so/ / dang po la gsum ste/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku gcig gi dbang du byas te dang po byang chub mchog tu sems ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul/

bar du grangs med gsum du tshogs ji ltar bsags pa'i tshul/ tha mar mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis 'tshang ji ltar rgya ba'i tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ bskal pa grangs med pa'i sngon rol tu sangs rgyas shākya thub pa chen po 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'di nyid rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed ces bya bar gyur pas/ gdugs gcigamachil lham zung gcig mgron bu lnga brgya me tog gi tshul du phul te sems bskyed pa/ bde gshegs khyod kyi sku ni ci 'dra dang*/ / 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang*/ / khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba/ / de 'drar bdag kyang de bzhin 'grub par shog/ ces pa dang*/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas dkon cog yan lag 'jig rten du byon pa de'i tshe/ tshong dpon shes rab bzang po zhes bya bar gyur nas sems bskyed pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'od mdzes 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe/ rgyal po dge bar gyur nas sems bskyed do/ / gnyis pa ni/ de nas grangs med dang po la sangs rgyas yul 'khor skyong la sogs pa lnga khri lnga stong gi bdag rkyen las tshogs gnyis goms pa phul du phyin nas tshogs lam dang sbyor ba'i lam mngon du mdzad de/ lung gzhi las/ grangs med dang por gyur pa'i tshe/ / 'dren pa yul 'khor skyong nas ni/ / dbang po rgyal mtshan thub pa'i bar/ / lnga khri lnga stong tshang ba yi/ / sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod de/ / de tshe nga la skyo sems med/ / ces so/ / gnyis pa la sangs rgyas legs mdzad la sogs pa drug khri drug stong mchod de sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar du rdzogs par mdzad pa ni/ yang de nyid las/ sangs rgyas legs mdzad nas bzung ste/ / 'dren pa rnam par gzigs kyi bar/ / drug khri drug stong tshang ba yi/ / sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod de/ / de tshe nga la skyo sems med/ / ces so/ / gsum pa la sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas 'od srungs kyi bar bdun khri bdun stong las|

dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun cing dag pa sa gsum mngon du mdzad par/ de nyid las/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas ni/ / rgyal ba 'od srungs bar dag tu/ / bdun khri bdun stong tshang ba yi/ / sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod de/ / de tshe nga la skyo sems med/ / ces so/ / de dag tu bslab pa gsum gyi dbang du mdzad de pha rol tu phyin pa drug tshogs gnyis kyis rdzogs par mdzad de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bslab gsum dbang du mdzad nas ni/ / rgyal bas pha rol phyin pa drug/ yang dag bshad do dang po gsum/ / tha ma gnyis ni re re'o/ / gcig ni gsum char la yang gtogs/ / zhes pas/ sbyin pa/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa gsum ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i rgyu dang ngo bo yan lag gsum du 'dus so/ / bsam gtan ni sems/ shes rab ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa yin la/ brtson 'grus ni gsum ga'i grogs su ldan no/ / de'ang sbyin pa nas bsam gtan gyi bar lnga ni thabs dang*/ shes rab ni gnyis su med pa'i shes rab ye shes kyi tshogs dam pa'o/ / de gnyis kyis nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis sbyong bar byed do/ / don gsum pa ni nyan thos pas so so skye bo 'ching ba mtha' dag gis bcings pa/ srid pa tha ma pa/ dbang po rnon po kha cig 'tshang rgya bar 'dod de/ 'phags pa gnas brtan pa'i gzhung las/ 'phags pa min yang pha ma dang*/ / nad pa dang ni chos smra dang*/ / skye mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ / yon ni gzhal du med par gsungs/ / zhes 'don la/ theg pa chen po rgyu lam du byed pas gtsang ma'i 'og min nam dbang phyug chen po'i gnas su thog mar sangs rgyas nas/ gdod 'dzam bu'i gling du sangs rgyas par bstan te/ chos dang longs spyod mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i mdo las/ rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pa yi/ / 'og min gnas mchog nyams dga' ba/ / gtsang ma'i gnas kyi steng bzhugs te/ / yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ / sprul pa po gcig 'dir 'tshang rgya/

/ zhes so/ / tshul ji ltar ston pa ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ snying rje'i dbang du gyur pa rnams/ / gshegs dang bltams dang rol ba dang*/ / khab nas 'byung dang dka' ba spyod/ / byang chub che dang bdud sde 'joms/ / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ / de bzhin du ni mya ngan las/ / 'das pa ston par mdzad pa yin/ / zhes pas/ 'dir mdzad pa bcu gnyis las/ dang po lnga dang phyi ma ni 'jig rten pa'i snang ba dang mthun par ston pas 'jig rten pa'i mdzad pa zhes btags shing*/ gzhan drug 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mdzad par bshad kyang*/ don la thams cad 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mdzad pa kho nar snang bas 'dir de brjod do/ / de yang dang po dga' ldan nas 'pho ba'i mdzad pa ni/ de ltar grangs med gsum rdzogs pa'i mthar dga' ldan gyi gnas su lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar por skye ba bzung ba na/

lha'i rol mo'i sgra las/ bsod nams brgya yis tshogs mang dran stobs ldan/ / blo gros mtha' yas shes rab 'od mdzad pa/ / mtshungs med stobs mnga' sgyu rtsal rgya che ba*/ / mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan dgongs par mdzod/ / ces pas bskul ba na/ de'i tshe chos kyi mtho ba'i khang bzang du seng ge'i khri la 'dug ste/ lha'i bu skal ba mtshungs pa rnams la bos te/ grogs po dag da ste lo bcu gnyis na kho bo 'dzam bu'i gling du 'gro bas/ khyed cag spro ba de dag 'dzam bu'i gling du skye ba long la rig byed klogs shigaces bsgo ba na/ lha'i bu kha cig na re/ de ni mi bzang ste da lta 'dzam bu'i gling ni mu stegs kyi ston pa drug gis dkrugs pas byon yang don du mi 'gyur ba dang*/ dga' ldan gyi gnas kyang mi mdzes par 'gyur ba'i phyir zer ro/ / de'i tshe byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ rol mo rnams dkrol cig ces brjod de/ byang chub sems dpas dung bus pa lhag par sgra che bas zil gyis gnon pa ltar gyur pa'i dpes mu stegs pa rnams 'dul bar gsungs te/ nyid kyi rgyal tshab tu byams pa bskos te gzigs pa lnga la gzigs nas gshegs par bzhed do/ / lnga ni gling la gzigs pa 'dzam bu'i gling las kyi sa pa'o/ / dus la gzigs pa tshe lo brgya pa ste yan chad du skyo ba shas chung bas chos bstan yang mi rtogs shing*/ man chad du log par lta ba shas che bas bstan kyang don du mi 'gyur pa'o/ / rigs la gzigs pa skye bo rnams rigs gang la mchog tu 'dzin pa rgyal po dang bram ze gnyis las/ de'i tshe rgyal rigs la mchog tu byed pas bu ram shing pa'i rigs so/ / yab la gzigs pa rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang*/ yum la gzigs pa sgyu ma lha mdzes te bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yab dang yum du gyur pa de gnyis grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir skye ba bzung ba gzigs nas/ 'chi 'pho rnam par sbyang ba zhes bya ba'i chos snang ba'i sgo brgya rtsa brgyad pa bstan par mdzad de/

de la dad pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste sems rnyog pa can dngas par 'gyur ba'o/ / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa na/ lha'i bu kha cig ni byang chub tu sems skyes so/ / kha cig gis mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/ / la las ni chos kyi mig dri ma dang bral ba rnyed de/ de'i tshe me tog gi char pus nub tsam du babs te/ byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ gang gi tshe na dga' ldan gnas mchog nas/ / 'dren pa seng ge'i skyes bu 'chi 'pho tshe/ / lha rnams dag la tshig tu smra ba ni/ / bag med mtha' dag rnam par spong zhes smra/ / lha yi dga' ba rnam mang ji snyed pa/ / yid kyis bsams pa las byung dpal ldan kun/ / thams cad las dge'i rgyu las 'byung ba ste/ / de ni dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu yin/ / de lta bas na byas pa gzo bar gyis/ / sngon gyi dge ba 'di ni zad 'gyur te/ / gang du mi dge'i sdug bsngal myong gyur nas/ / ngan song dag tu ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ / zhes brjod de/ lhums su zhugs pa ni 'di chad snyam grogs po dag cha lugs ji lta bus 'dzam bu'i gling du 'gro bar bya/ zhes gsungs pa na/ kha cig ni tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pas 'gro bar rigs zer ro/ / der lha'i bu gzi brjid dam pa na re/ de ni mi bzang ste phyogs char lhung ba'i phyir ro/ / bram ze'i rig byed las/ glang chen dam pa lus chen mchog gyur pa/ / mche ba drug ldan gser gyi drwa bas g.yogs/ / mgo bo rab tu dmar zhing shin tu mdzes/ / 'gram bzang zag cing gzugs bzang ldan pa'o/ / zhes par sprul nas 'gro bar rigs so/ / zhes pa dang bstun nas dpyid zla tha chung skar ma sa gas nya ba'i bco lnga la/ yum gso sbyong la gnas pa'i glo g.yas pa nas lhums su zhugs pa yum gyi rmi lam du byung nas yab la smras pa/ glang po kha ba dngul mdog mche ba drug/ rkang lag rab mdzes mgo bo dmar sdug cing*/ / 'gros bzang lus rdzogs rdo rje bzhin brtan pa/

/ glang po'i mchog cig khong du song snyam byed/ / ces brjod do/ / der yang lhums gzhal yas khang du sprul te 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i don mdzad do/ / sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa ni/ de nas zla ba bcu na lum pa'i tshal du yum gyi rtsib logs g.yas nas rang byon pa la/ lha dang klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis khrus gsol zhing*/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis dar dkar gyi lcib mos len par brtsams pa las/ khyed lha rnams gtsang sbra che bas phyir dengs shig ces gsungs te len pa med par rang byon te phyogs bzhir gom pa bdun bdun dor te/ nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog yin no/ / zhes pa la sogs pa brjod pa na/ lhas bstod pa/ gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyed bltams tshe/ / sa chen 'di la gom pa bdun bzhud de/ /nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs/ / de tshe mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes so/ / de'i tshe nags tshal du me tog kha 'bus pa dang*/ 'jig rten thams cad snang ba chen pos khyab pa dang*/ kun dga' bo la sogs pa shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya yang btsas/ rngog ldan la sogs pa rte'u lnga brgya yang btsas/ khams kyi rgyal phran bzhi la yang bu bzhi btsas te/ ma ga nghār rgyal po pad+ma chen po'i bu gzugs can snying po/ ko sa lar rgyal po a nan+da tshangs byin gyi bu gsal rgyal/ grong khyer rdo 'jog tu rgyal po mu khyud mtha' yas kyi bu rab snang*/ bad sa lar rgyal po dmag brgya ba'i bu shar pa'o/ / de nas bram ze la mtshan bstan pas/ rab tu ma byung na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ byung na sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar lung bstan to/ / de'i tshe rgyal bu don thams cad grub pa zhes mtshan gsol zhing*/ shākya gzhon nu rnams thub pa ltar snang bas shākya thub pa zhes kyang btags so/ / de'i tshe ri rab kyi ngos la drang srong mdog nag gam nyon mongs med ces bya ba zhig gnas pas/ des ltas khyad par can rnams mthong nas mngon shes kyis bltas pa las/

rgyal bu don thams cad grub pa'i ltas su shes nas/ pho brang du rdzu 'phrul gyis 'ong ste mtshan bltas pa las/ rgyal pos dris pa na/ drang srong gis smras pa/ sngar mtshan mkhan gzhan la bstan nam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bstan te 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung bstan to/ / drang srong gis smras pa/ sa bdag rtog pa po rnams blo 'khrul te/ / rtsod pa'i dus su 'khor los sgyur mi 'byung*/ / nyes las rnam par rgyal ba'i mchog 'di ni/ / 'gro ba'i don du rang byung sangs rgyas 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / de ltar bltams nas zhag bdun na yum 'das te skye rgu'i bdag mo la sogs pa ma ma sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis cher bskyed de/ mtsho chen po la gnas pa'i pad+ma ltar gyur to/ / bzo'i gnas la mkhas pa ni/ de nas yig dpon kun gyi bshes gnyen dang*/ srin bu go cha la sogs pa'i drung du phyin te yi ge dang*/ 'phong dang sgyu rtsal la mthar phyin to/ / de'i tshe shākya gzhon nu rnams stobs 'gran pa las/ lhas byin gyis glang po che thal mos bsnun nas bsad pa'i ro gcung dga' bos grong khyer gyi phyir bor ba'i mjug ma nas byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs mthe'u chung gis blangs te grong khyer gyi ra ba bdun dang 'obs bdun dang shing ta la'i phreng ba bdun la sogs pa'i phyi rol tu dor ba'i gshongs la glang po che'i gshongs zhes grags so/ / de'i tshe lha rnams kyis bstod pa/ glang po'i dbang po rdo ba bzhin bzhud pa/ / zhabs kyi mthe bos glang po'i dbang po blangs/ / ra ba bdun dang 'obs bdun yang 'das te/ / grong khyer 'di yi phyi rol rgyang ring 'phangs/ / mkhyen pa mchog mnga' 'di ni gdon mi za/ / nga rgyal stobs kyi thob pa'i lus can rnams/ / 'khor ba'i grong las phyi rol rgyang ring du/ / shes rab stobs kyis 'dis ni 'phen par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / de bzhin rtsal 'gran pa las kyang lcags kyi sla nga bdun/ shing ljon pa'i phreng ba bdun lcags kyi pha gu bdun las/

lhas byin gyis gcigagacung dga' bos gnyis/ byang chub sems dpas thams cad phigs te mda'i shul las chu yan lag brgyad ldan skyes pa la mda' chu khron pa skyes zhes grags so/ / de nas btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol pa ni/ shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho ma 'khor nyi khri/ ri dwags skyes 'khor nyi khri/ grags 'dzin ma 'khor nyi khri ste/ btsun mo drug khri khab tu bzhes nas pho brang du gnas pa'i tshe lha'i sil snyan gyi sgra las tshigs su bcad pa/ sdug bsngal gyis gang sems can mthong nas ni/ / 'gro ba'i mgon dang skyabs dang gnas gyur pa/ / phan byed mchog dang dpung gnyen gyur cig ces/ / khyod kyis sngon gyi smon lam de skad btab/ / dge ba dang po sngon gyi spyod pa dang*/ / 'gro phan zhes bya'i smon lam dran byas nas/ / grong khyer dam pa 'di nas myur du phyung*/ / zhes so/ / mngon par byung ba ni grong khyer gyi phyogs bzhir byon te skye ba dang*/ rga ba dang*/ na ba dang*/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal la gzigs shing*/ thar pa'i yon tan la dgongs te rab tu 'byung bar bzhed pa las/ pho brang gi sgo bzhi dmag gis bsrungs nas/ phyir gshegs su mi ster ba las/ rngog ldan la chibs te rgyal po bzhis rta rmig nas btegs nas mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du gshegs te nyid kyi dbu skra nyid kyis bzhar nas rab tu byung ngo*/ / de nas rgyal po'i khab tu rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod kyi drung du ci yang med pa dang*/ yangs pa can du sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur gy-i drung du srid rtse man chad kyi ting nge 'dzin mngon du mdzad pa'i tshul bstan to/ / dka' ba spyad pa ni de nas chu klung nai rañdzā na'i 'gram du byon te lo drug tu dka' ba spyad de/ de yang lo dang po gnyis la 'bras nyag ma re/ bar pa gnyis la til nyag ma re/ tha ma gnyis la chu thigs pa re gsol lo/ / de'i tshe lhas bskul ba/ mi yi dbang po shākya'i sras po 'di/

/ brnag pa ma rdzogs don yang ma mdzad cing*/ / 'jig rten gsum po sdug bsngal mgon med par/ / mdzad nas mgon 'di 'drongs par mi 'gyur grang*/ / zhes brjod pa na/ de las bzhengs te rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas tshol du gshegs pa'i lam du/ tshong dpon gyi bu mo legs skyes mas ba men lnga brgya las bzhos pa'i 'o ma rim gyis brgyad la blud pa bskol ba drangs pas sku mdog gser gyi mdangs su gyur cing bsngo ba mdzad pa/ bsod pa phul ba'i bsod nams ci mchis pa/ / grags dang ldan pa'i don kun 'grub 'gyur bar/ / mi yi dbang po blo mchog ldan pa de'i/ / don rnams thams cad de ring 'grub gyur cig/ ces so/ / de nas byang chub snying por gshegs pa ni/ lam du rtswa 'tshong bkra shis ldan gyis rtswa rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bu phul ba bzhes te byon pa las/ byang chub snying pobargyan pa'i lha rnams kyis rdo rje'i gdan dang byang chub kyi shing dag tshad med par brgyan pa ga la ba der gshegs nas rtswa'i stan la bzhugs te dam bca' ba brtan po mdzad pa/ stan 'dir bdag gi lus 'di skams kyang rung*/ / pags pa rus pa'i tshogs rnams zhig kyang rung*/ / bskal mang rnyed dka' byang chub ma thob par/ / stan 'di las ni lus bskyod mi bya'o/ / zhes so/ / de nas bdud kyi sde bcom pa ni/ mdzod spu nas bdud kyi sde rab tu 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer bkye bas/ bdud kyi gnas thams cad dpa' bkong bar byas nas/ bdud kyi rgyal po'i rmi lam du bkra shis kyi bum pa lhung ba dang*/ rgyal mtshan chag pa la sogs pa brgya rtsa brgyad rmis te bltas pas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'tshang rgya bar shes te rdo rje'i gdan du 'ongs te smras pa/ khyod 'tshang rgya ba'i dus la ma babs zhes smras so/ / der byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ ngas bskal pa grangs med par tshogs gnyis rdzogs pas 'tshang rgya ba'i dus la babs te khyod mchod sbyin gcig tsam byas pas kyang bdud kyi rgyal por gyur pa la ltos zhes brjod pas/

bdud kyis smras pa/ ngas ni 'di na mchod sbyin gtan pa med/ / byas pa la ni khyod nyid dpang yin te/ / khyod la 'di na dpang 'ga' yod min pas/ / smras kyang dpang med de ni ye pham yin/ / zhes so/ / sems dpas smras pa/ sa 'di 'gro ba kun gyi rten yin te/ / rgyu dang mi rgyu nye ring med pas na/ / sa 'di de ring bdag gi dpang mdzod cig/ ces gsungs ma thag tu sa'i lha mos rigs kyi bu 'dis tshogs du ma zhig rdzogs pa'i phyir rigs te/ ngas sa'i dkyil 'khor rdul phra ba snyed du bgrang bar nus kyi/ 'dis mgo dang yan lag sems can la byin pa'i grangs ni bgrang bar mi nus so/ / zhes brjod pas/ bdud skyengs te rang gi gnas su log nas dmag bye ba dung phyir drangs te byang chub sems dpa' la mtshon cha'i char chen po dbab par byas so/ / de skad du mngon par 'byung ba las/ mgo gcig pa dang mgo gnyis mgo gsum dang*/ / mgo stong ldan pa'i bar du rab tu mang*/ / zhes so/ / de'i tshe byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas mtshon cha'i tshogs rnams me tog gi char dang*/ mi snyan pa'i sgra rnams glu dbyangs snyan par gyur nas/ lhas smras pa/ byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud kyi sgyu btul te/ / mtshon cha 'phangs pa me tog nyid du gyur/ / ces pa dang*/ shākya'i rgyal pos rten cing 'brel 'byung chos/ / rang gi ngo bo med par mthong nas ni/ / nam mkha' lta bu'i sems dang rab ldan pas/ / g.yon can dpung bcas tshogs kyis brdzi ba med/ / ces so/ / gzhan yang bdud kyi bu mo rnams kyis bslu bar byas kyang slar rgan mo nyid du gyur nas byang chub sems dpa' la bzod par gsol lo/ / byang chub pa ni/ de nas rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas tho rangs rnga brdung du nye ba na zad pa shes pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du mdzad de sangs rgyas byang chub rig pa gsum brnyes pa'i tshe/
