lhas bstod pa/ skyes bu seng ge de yis bdud btul te/ / ston pa'i bsam gtan mngon du mdzad nas ni/ / stobs bcu rig pa gsum po brnyes gyur tshe/ / phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams thams cad g.yos par gyur/ / ces so/ / de nas zhag bdun phrag bdun chos mi gsung bar bzhugs pa las/ bdun phrag dang po la skyil krung ma bshig par bzhugs/ gnyis pa la 'dzam gling nye bar bcags/ gsum pa la stong gsum ring du bcags/ bzhi pa la spyan mi 'dzum par shing de nyid la gzigs/ lnga pa la klu'i rgyal po btang bzung gi gnas su gshegs/ drug pa la kun tu rgyu btul/ bdun pa la shing sgrol rgyu'i tshal du tshong pa ga gon dang bzang skyong gis sbrang rtsi phul ba'i tshe rgyal po bzhis lhung bzed phul ba bzhes par gsol te/

tshong pa dag ni don gnyer ba/ / rnyed pa chen po rnyed gyur cig/ ces pa la sogs pa shis pa brjod nas/ chos mi gsung bar bzhugs te/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ / bdud rtsi lta bus chos shig kho bos rnyed/ / su la bstan kyang go bar mi 'gyur bas/ / mi smra gcig pur nags su gnas par bya/ / zhes pa na/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni tshangs pas 'ongs nas zhus pa/ ye shes chen po mchog gi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas ni/ / phyogs bcu dag tu 'od zer rnam par 'gyed mdzad de/ / ye shes zer gyis blo yi pad+mo kha 'byed pa/ / smra ba'i nyi ma ci slad de ring btang snyoms bzhugs/ / dam pa chos kyi rnga bo che ni brdung du gsol/ / dam pa'i chos kyi dung ni myur du 'bud du gsol/ / dam pa chos kyi sdong po sgreng bar mdzad du gsol/ / dam pa chos kyi mar me sbar bar mdzad du gsol/ / zhes zhus pas cang mi gsung ba dang*/ yang brgya byin sbran te drung du 'ongs nas tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul te zhus pa/ g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba bzhengs su gsol/ / 'jig rten mun par shes rab 'od dbyung gsol/ / kun nas 'tsham par gyur pa mchis lags kyi/ / thub pa khyod kyis chos ni bstan du gsol/ / zhes pa dang*/ brgya byin gyis rin po che phul nas zhus pa/ zla ba nya ba gza' las thar ba ltar/ / thub pa khyod kyi thugs ni rnam par grol/ / g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba bzhengs su gsol/ / 'jig rten mun par shes rab 'od dbyung gsol/ / zhes zhus pa'i tshe/ bka' stsal pa/ tshangs pa nga yi tha ba kun/ / bcom nas tshegs chen gyis rtogs pa'i/ / chos 'di srid pa'i 'dod chags kyis/ / dkris pas bde blag rtogs ma yin/ / zhes so/ / yang zhus pa/ ma ga dhā yi yul 'dir sngon chad chos/ / ma dag dri ma rjes su 'brel ba byung*/ / bdud rtsi'i sgo mo dbye bar mdzod cig chos/ / rdul bral dri ma med par bshad du gsol/

/ zhus pa dang*/ bka' stsal pa/ tshangs pa ma ga dhā yi sems can gang*/ / rna bar ldan zhing dad dang ldan gyur pa/ / mi 'tshe 'du shes rtag tu chos nyan pa/ / de dag la ni bdud rtsi'i sgo dbye'o/ / zhes gnang bas/ skad cig de la 'og min gyi bar du de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gnang ngo zhes thos nas lhags so/ / lha srid mchog gis chos kyi 'khor lo gang du bskor zhus pas/ wā ra ṇa sīr ro/ / der ni nga yis mchod sbyin stong phrag khrag khrig drug cu mchod/ / wā ra ṇa sī dam pa de ni sngon gyi drang srong rnams kyi gnas/ / de phyir drang srong zhes bya'i gnas mchog der ni 'khor lo dam pa bskor/ / zhes bka' stsal nas gshegs pa las/ sa phyogs der ni rin po che'i khri stong byung ste/ gsum la bskor ba mdzad nas bzhi pa'i steng du bzhugs te/ lnga sde bzang po lha brgyad khri dang bcas pa la bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas bden pa mngon par rtogs shing lnga sde bzang pos dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ / de nas bya rgod phung po la mtshan nyid med pa'i 'khor lo byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos chen po la sogs pa la bskor ro/ / de nas lha dang klu'i gnas la sogs par tha ma don dam rnam par nges pa'i 'khor lo bskor ro/ / de yang bka' dang po ni las dang po pa lam la 'jug pa'i rim pa shes pa dang bstun nas gtso bor spang gnyen gyi sgo nas 'khor ba las nges par 'byin pa'o/ / bar ba ni 'khor ba spong byed kyi gnyen por lam la sogs pa'i chos la zhen pa bkag pa'i phyir yin no/ / mtha' ma ni shes bya'i gshis la ji ltar gnas pa de nyid drang por brjod pa'o/ / yang sde snod gsum dang*/ bslab pa gsum dang*/ theg pa che chung gi sgo nas kyang gsungs pa'o/ / tha ma'i mdzad pa ni/ de ltar dgung lo brgyad cu'am brgyad cu rtsa gnyis na grong khyer rtswa can shing sā la zung gi drung du mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed/

de'ang brgyad cu yin par bye brag tu bshad pa'i mdzod chen mo las/ chos 'khor gnas dang yangs pa can/ / sa dkar can dang lha yi gnas/ / 'brog gnas mchod rten ri dang ni/ / 'od ma'i tshal dang dgrar bcas dang*/ / byis pa gsod dang kau sham bhi/ / ser skya yi ni grong khyer te/ / 'di rnams su ni thub pa yis/ / skyes mchog lo re lo re bzhugs/ / 'bar ba'i phug gi gnas su gnyis/ / sman gyi nags su lo gsum dang*/ / rgyal po'i khab kyi grong du lnga/ / dka' ba spyad pa lo drug dang*/ / mnyan du yod par nyi shu bzhi/ / nyi shu rtsa dgu khab gnas te/ / de ltar rgyal ba brgyad cu la/ / skyes mchog dam pa mya ngan 'das/ / thams cad mkhyen pas bzhugs pa yi/ / bsod nams gnas ni de dag la/ / rtag tu lus dang ngag dang yid/ / gus pas btud de phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes so/ / de yang gdul bya rtag par 'dzin pa shas che ba rnams gdul ba'i phyir nam gyi cha smad zla ba ri la nub pa'i tshe dgongs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das te/ pur bzhu nas sku gdung cha brgyad du bgos shing tshems mche ba bzhi so so'i dbang pos gdan drangs par bshad de/ 'dul ba lung du gsungs pa/ spyan ldan sku gdung bre bo brgyad dag las/ / bdun ni 'dzam bu'i gl̥ng pas mchod par thob/ / skyes mchog de yi bre po gang zhig ni/ / grong khyer sgra sgrogs klu yi rgyal pos mchod/ / skyes mchog de yi mche ba bzhi dag las/ / gcig ni rtsa gsum lha yul 'jig rten mchod/ / gnyis pa tshig 'dzin yid 'ong grong khyer na*/ / gsum pa ka ling rgyal po'i yul na ste/ / skyes mchog de yi mche ba bzhi pa ni/ / grong khyer sgra sgrogs klu yi rgyal pos mchod/ / mya ngan med rgyal skya nar bu gnas pa*/ / mchod rten bdun po rgya cher spel byas te/ / de yi mthu yis dbyig dzin 'dir yang ni/ / smon lam dngos po mngon par brgyan gyur te/ / de ltar spyan ldan sku gdung de la ni/

/ lha dang klu dang mi yi dbang po dang*/ / mi dang klu dang gnod sbyin bdag po yis/ / rab tu bkur nas bkur sti mchod pa byas/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang du byas na/ ston pa kun tu bzang po nyid chos sku las ma g.yos par longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i thugs rje'i ngang las phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa snang zhing 'gro ba drug gam rgyud lnga 'dul la/ khyad par mi mjed kyi 'jig rten du sangs rgyas stong la sogs pa gdul bya'i snang ba gang gis 'dul ba de'i skur snang ba yin te/ ye shes nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ kun bzang longs spyod rdzogs pa las/ / 'dul ba'i sprul pa grangs med cing*/ / khyad par mi mjed 'jig rten du/ / stong rtsa gnyis kyi skur snang ngo*/ / zhes so/ / gnyis po ni 'jam dpal dang*/ phyag na rdo rje'o/ / de dang rjes su mthun par chos sku'i ngang las rang shar du byung ba nyid/ rgyud bla mar yang*/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ / 'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ / chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ / sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ / skye ba mngon par skyai ba dang*/ / dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang*/ / lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang*/ / bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang*/ / btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol pa dang*/ / nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang*/ / byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*/ /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni/ / byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ / mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ / yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ / srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ / zhes dang*/ phal po che las/ ji ltar zla ba shar gyur pa/ / tshad med pa yi gzugs brnyan rnams/ / chu yi snod du snang gyur kyang*/ / zla ba gnyis su gyur pa med/ / de bzhin chags med mkhyen ldan rnams/ / chags med rnam par 'tshang rgya ba/ / zhing rnams kun na rab tu snang*/

/ sangs rgyas la ni gnyis snang med/ / 'di la gcig kyang yod ma yin/ / sku ni gnyis sam gsum du med/ / ji ltar sems can bsam pa bzhin/ / tshad med par ni rab tu snang*/ /sku ni 'das pa ma yin te/ /ma 'ongs pa yang sku ma yin/ / skyes dang byang chub mya ngan 'das/ / skad cig gis ni rab tu snang*/ / ji ltar sgyu mar gyur pa'i gzugs/ / skyes pa ma yin 'ongs pa min/ / de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ / skye ba med las shin tu bstan/ / ces pa dang*/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na zla ba yar gyi ngo'i dkyil 'khor nam phyed kyi dus na 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad kyi so so'i mdun na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dug par shes kyang*/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni sems can de dag gis bdag ci'i phyir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du shes par 'gyur bar bdag gis sems can de dag gi mdun na 'dug par bya'o snyam du mi rtog rnam par mi rtog mod kyis/ 'on kyang 'jam dpal/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pas/ lhun gyis grub c-ing rnam par mi rtog pa de lta bu'i bya ba 'di 'byung ngo*/ / 'jam dpal/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ 'khor dpag tu med bsam gyis mi khyab mtshungs pa med gzhal du med brjod pa'i sgras brjod du med pa'i dbus na/ de thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs par mthong mod kyi/ 'jam dpal/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa mdun na bzhugs par shes par 'gyur bar nga sems can de dag gi mdun na 'dug par bya'o snyam du mi rtog rnam par mi rtog ste/ 'on kyang sems can rnams kyis mthong ba de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa mdun na bzhugs so/ / 'jam dpal/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gser gyi kha dog tu mthong bas gdul bar bya ba yin na/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yang gser gyi kha dog tu snang ngo*/ / de bzhin du bai ḍūr+ya dang*/ an dha rnyil dang*/ spug dang*/ mu tig dmar po'i kha dog gis 'dul bar bya ba yin na/ de dag gi kha dog tu bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ mi dang*/ dud 'gro dang*/ dmyal ba dang*/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten pas gdul bar bya ba yin na de dag gi gzugs su bzhugs nas chos ston to/ / zhes so/ / de dag gis spyi'i don bshad zin to/ / gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel dgod pa/ tshig gi don bshad pa/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ / dang po ni gleng bslang ba'i tshul bshad pa de~X na~Xs rang snang bkod pa'i de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd la~Xs rang byung gi thugs rje chen po'i byi~Xn gyisa~X rla~Xbs las rang shar ba zhe~Xs bya~X ba'i~X rnam par 'phrul pa sangs rgyas kyi ye shes nyid yin pas riga~X pa'i~X skyesa~X bu~X las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad bcom pas thu~Xb pa~X 'jig rten drug gi 'gro ba drug so sor 'dul bas shākya thub pa la sogs pa druga~X ni rang snang bkod pa'i de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X'i sku~X da~Xng ga~Xsung dnga~X thuga~Xs rdo~X rje~X la~Xs 'tho~Xn to~X/ / gnyis pa la gsum ste/ 'dul ba bzhis rnam par 'phrul pa'i tshul spyir bstan pa/ 'dul yul 'gro ba dang chos kyi rang bzhin bye brag tu bshad pa/ 'khor 'das sems dang ye shes kyi rang snang du don bsdu ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ de ltar thub pa drug 'tho~Xn nasa~X kyanga~X 'gro ba'i lasa~X so sor bsags tshul gyi dba~Xng gi~Xs 'jig rten gyi khams kyang tha dad du snang ste/ de'ang bsdu na mgo 'phred la bstan nas 'gro ba snrela~X gzhi~X da~Xng gyen dang thur la bstan nas 'gro ba yasa~X ma~Xn gyi~X 'ji~Xg rtena~X zlu~Xm po dang gru bzhi dang zla gam dang gru gsum gzhi phyal ba dang steng g.yogs med pa ste snod kyi bye brag rnam pa mi 'dra ba druga~X gi~X rang bzhin gyis phyoga~Xs bcu~X kun tu khyab cing de dag gi rnam grangs dang dbye ba'i tshad ni mtha'a~X yasa~X shing bde sdug dang longs spyod la sogs pa'i rnam pa mu~X me~Xd pas khyab pa'i~X stonga~X gsu~Xm gyi~X stonga~X chen po~X'i 'jig rten gyi khams re~X re~Xr rang rang gi 'dul byed thuba~X pa~X che~Xn po~X bco~Xm lda~Xn 'da~Xs re~X re~Xs 'dula~X ba~X rnama~X pa~X bzhi bzhi~Xs 'gro~X ba~X lnga~X'i do~Xn mdza~Xd de~X/

de yang bsod nams kyis 'dul ba dang*/ don thams cad mngon sum du gyur pas 'dul ba dang*/ rdzu 'phrul chen pos 'dul ba dang*/ rigs pas 'dul ba'o/ / de yang phal po che las/ las kyi bye brag bsam mi khyab/ / dmyal ba'i 'jig rten thur 'phyang zhing*/ / gshin rje'i 'jig rten snrel gzhi ste/ / byol song lha mi gyen du 'gro/ / zhes so/ / de'ang dud 'gro rnams kyang snrel gzhi nyid du gtogs pa snyam mo/ / de ltar stong gsum gcig gi 'jig rten la'ang snrel gzhi dang yas man gsum du sbyar ba nyid de rigs lngas bsdus pa'i snod bcud ni sprul pa sku'i 'dul zhing ngo*/ / 'dir kha cig snrel gzhi phyogs bzhi dang yas man steng 'og ste 'jig rten drug tu 'dod pa de dag gis ni gzhung gi don phyogs tsam yang ma mthong ngo*// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ sku bsod nams chen pos mdzad pa phun sum tshogs pas 'dul ba/ thugs mngon shes chen pos mngon sum pas 'dul ba/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa rdzu 'phrul chen pos 'dul ba/ gsung theg pa lngar ston pa rigs pas 'dul ba'o/ / dang po ni sku bltama~Xs pa~X dnga~X*/ khyim spangs te ra~Xb tu ༵byunga~X ba~X dnga~X*/ nai ran+dzā na'i 'gram la sogs par dka~X' thuba~X mdza~Xd pa~X da~Xng*/ rdo rje gdan la sanga~Xs rgyasa~X pa~X dnga~X*/ bduda~X kyi sde btu~Xl ba~X da~Xng*/ wā ra ṇā sīr cho~Xs kyi~X 'kho~Xr lo~X bsko~Xr ba~X dang ༵/ gnyan yod du cho~X 'phru~Xl che~Xn po~X bstana~X pa~X dnga~X*/ grong khyer rtswa mchog tu mya~X nga~Xn la~Xs 'da~Xs pa~X/ de ltar yongs su bstan pa brgyad dang la~X so~Xgs pa'i khongs nas dga' ldan nas 'pho ba dang*/ bzo'i gnas la mkhas pa dang*/ btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol ba dang*/ byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*/ rgyal po'i khab tu glang chen smyon pa btul ba dang*/ dga' ldan du yum la chos gsungs pa dang*/ 'brog gnas su gnod sbyin chen po btul ba la sogs pa rnams te/ sku'i rnam par 'phrul ba chen pos 'gro ba tshad med pa smin pa~Xr mdzad pa'i cho 'phrul chen po stona~X pa~X'i thuba~X pa~Xs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'o/
kha cig ni mdzad pa bcu gnyis su 'dod pa ni der ma nges te/

cho 'phrul bstan pa gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / de'i zhar la gzhan rnams 'phangs shing*/ sogs pa'i khongs nas bsdus pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis mtshon pa ste mdor na sku'i cho 'phrul chen pos 'gro ba 'dul ba thams cad 'dir bsdu'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ 'das pa la sogs pa'i dusa~X bzhi~X kuna~X tu~X mkhye~Xn pas shes bya thams cad mngon sum du gzigs pa~X ni sngon gyi gnas shes pa'i mngon par shes pa ste tshe rabs du ma rjes su dran pa la dbang bsgyur bas 'gro ba 'dul ba'o/ / dus bzhi mkhyen lugs ni pra phab pa'i rnam pa me long du shar ba ltar mkhyen to/ / gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs lnga'am drug la sogs pa'i gdul bya ma lus pa thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi~X rang rang gi sema~Xs kyi~X nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin dang sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi dgongs rgyud ༵ gnyis dus dang gnas skabs ku~Xn tu~X tha mi dad par mkhye~Xn pa'i gnad kyis pha rol gyi sems shes pa'i mngon shes mnga' ba~X dang ༵/ ye shes gzigs pa sgrib pa med pa'i rdzu~X 'phru~Xl gyi~X spyana~X gyisa~X dag pa'i zhing dang ma dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi 'gro ba 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba dang rnam par 'phrul pa la sogs pa tha~Xms ca~Xd kuna~X tu~X gzi~Xgs pa~X ni mngon par 'du byed pa las byung ba lha'i mig gi mngon par shes pas 'dul ba'o/ / rdzu~X 'phru~Xl gyi~X snyana~X gyi~Xs 'jig rten gyi khams tha~Xms ca~Xd kyi sgra skad che chung thams cad kuna~X tu~X gsa~Xn pa~X ni lha'i rna ba'i mngon par shes pa ste des sems can rnams 'dul ba'o/ / sems can gang la gang 'dul ston pa'i rdzu~X 'phru~Xl gyi~X tsho~Xgs kyi~Xs 'gro ba'i mos pa dang mthun par kuna~X tu~X do~Xn spyoda~X pa~X ni rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon par shes pas 'dul ba'o/ / sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus pa dbyings su dag pa'i ye shes za~Xg pa~X me~Xd pa~Xs mthar phyin kuna~X tu~X bza~Xng po~X'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i spyoda~X pa~X yongs su rdzo~Xgs pa'i~X rang bzhin zag pa zad pa'i mngo~Xn pa~Xr she~Xs pa~Xs 'dul ba ste/

de ltar na drug po de shes bya thams cad mngon sum du dbang sgyur bas mngon par shes pa chen po drug ༵ ste thugs kyis 'dul ba'o/ / gsum pa ni/ gdul bya mtha' yas pa kuna~X tu~X de'i snang ba dang mthun pa'i sku~X tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang 'khor los sgyur ba la sogs pa bsa~Xm gyi~Xs mi~X khyaba~X pa~X ston pa da~Xng*/ 'gro ba'i rgyud tshad med pa kuna~X tu~X de dag gi mos pa dang mthun par 'jug pa'i thuga~Xs ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen nas don mdzad tshul bsa~Xm gyi~Xs mi~X khya~Xb pa~X da~Xng*/ gdul bya'i khams dang mos pa mi 'dra ba'i spyod yul kuna~X tu ༵sku dang sku'i cha lugs dang zhala~X gyi dkyil 'khor mi 'dra ba zhi ba dang khro bo la sogs pa tha dad pa du mar snang zhing skad cig skad cig la rang rang gi snang ba dang mthun par zhal bsama~X gyisa~X mi~X khyaba~X pa~X bstan nas bdag kho na la thugs brtse ba'i phyir bdag gi mdun na bzhugs so snyam pa ste/ yum chen mo las/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can de dag ni bdag cag kho na'i mdun na bzhugs nas thugs brtse ba'i phyir chos ston to snyam mo/ / zhes pas/ lus 'phags gling dang*/ ba lang spyod nas 'og min gyi bar du gsungs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ res 'ga' zhi la res 'ga' drag/ res 'ga' gdon chen bgegs mdzad de/ / de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog/ ri dang skye bo thams cad do/ / zhes pa dang*/ dpung pa bzang po'i rgyud las/ gang gi rang bzhin chags sdang rnam bral yang*/ / chags pa can la chags bcas ltar ston cing*/ / gdug pa 'dul phyir khro la khror ston pa/ / thabs kyi rnam 'dren de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / de bzhin du sku gcig la'ang zhal bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston pa rnams so/ / 'gro ba'i skal ba ji ltar yod pa kuna~X tu~X sems can so so'i skad dang mthun par chos kyi gsu~Xng bsa~Xm gyisa~X mi~X khyaba~X pa~X sgrog par snang ba da ༵ nga lda~Xn pa~X ni nam mkha'i mtha' klas par rnam par 'phrul pa bsa~Xm gyi~Xs mi~X khyaba~X pa~X sna tshogs su 'phro bas granga~Xs me~Xd pa~X dag gis/

phyoga~Xs bcu~Xr gang la gang 'dul du snanga~X ba~Xr gyura~X to~X/ / bzhi pa gsung rig pas 'dul ba la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung gi don no/ / dang po la gnyis te/ sgra don dang dbye ba'o/ / dang po ni/ yā na'i sgra las theg pa ste gang la brten nas bgrod pas 'dod par phyin cing skyel ba zhes te/ sdud pa las/ theg pa 'di ni mkha' 'dra gzhal med khang chen te/ / dga' skyid bde ba mngon par thob byed theg pa'i mchog/ de gang zhon nas sems can thams cad mya ngan 'da'/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa la gnyis te/ spyir dbye ba dang*/ bye brag tu dbye ba'o/ / dang po ni/ spyir sems can gyi rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa 'dul ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi thugs rjes gang la gang 'dul du bstan pas theg pa'i rnam grangs kyang 'di nyid kho nar nges so zhes chad pa med de/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ sems can rnams ni yongs drang phyir/ / theg pa mtha' dag ngas bshad de/ / 'di zhes dmigs su yod ma yin/ / zhes so/ / de'ang re zhig bsdu na 'bras bu la dgongs te gcig tu gsungs pa ni/ dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las/ theg pa gcig ste gnyis su yod ma yin/ / zhes pa dang*/ kun byed las/ yod ni gcig las med pa la/ / zhes so/ / yang rgyu dang 'bras bu la dgongs nas gnyis dang*/ chen po dang chung ngu la dgongs nas gnyis su gsungs te/ dpal 'byung bzhi zad pa'i rgyud las/ rgyu chos rnams dang 'bras bu'i phyir/ / theg pa de yang rnam pa gnyis/ / zhes pa dang*/ ye sgron las/ che chung rim pa'i blo yod phyir/ / theg pa'i grangs kyang de bzhin te/ / bsdu na che chung rnam gnyis so/ / zhes so/ / yang che 'bring gi dbye bas nyan rang theg pa chen po ste gsum du yang gsungs te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sbyor ba dang ni tshogs dag dang*/ / bsam pa dang ni bshad nyid dang*/ / sgrub pa'i rab tu dbye ba yis/ / theg pa rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ / ces pa dang*/ gsang ba thig le nor bu'i rgyud las/

phyi nang gi rim pas kyang gsum du bshad de/ phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ / dam pa'i chos kyang rab tu gzung*/ / zhes so/ / yang rgyu'i theg pa gsum 'bras bu dang bzhir yang bshad de/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ / theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ / zhes pa dang*/ bam brgyad las/ bsam gyis mi khyab bstan pa 'di/ / brgyad khri bzhi stong rnam grangs kyang*/ / theg pa'i sgo ni gsum du gsungs/ / gsang nyid theg par bsdus dang bzhi/ / zhes so/ / yang rnam grangs bsdu bas lngar yang bshad de/ 'di nyid las/ theg pa bzhi yi nges 'byung la/ / theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ / zhes pa dang*/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ lha yi theg dang tshangs pa'i theg/ de bzhin du ni nyan thos dang*/ / de bzhin gshegs dang rang rgyal gyis/ / theg pa tha dad pa bshad do/ / zhes so/ / yang rgyu 'bras kyi gong 'og dbye bas drug tu yang bshad de/ kun byed las/ nges pa thob pa'i theg pa drug/ ces so/ / yang bdun du yang bshad de/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba las/ lha dang mi dang nyan thos dang*/ / rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ / gsang ba phyi dang nang gnyis te/ / de ltar theg pa bdun du bshad/ / ces so/ / brgyad du yang bshad de/ nam mkha' che las/ de ltar theg brgyad las 'das pa'i/ / zhes so/ / dgur yang bshad de/ kun byed las/ byung ni theg pa dgu ru byung*/ / zhes so/ / yang sor bzhag lha mi'i theg pa gnyis/ phyi rol pa'i sde lnga/ nang pa'i rim pa dgu/ 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i theg pa dang bcu drug tu yang bshad de/ snying po nyi ma rab tu snang byed kyi rgyud las/ theg pa'i dang po bcu drug mgon/ / zhes so/ / yang bsam gyis mi khyab par yang bshad de/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ ji srid sems ni 'jug pa'i bar/ / theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ / ces so/ / yang gnas lugs la theg pa zhes btags pa tsam las grub pa med de/ de nyid las/ sems ni nam zhig gyur pa na/

/ theg pa med cing 'gro ba'ang med/ / ces so/ / mdor na thams cad blo'i rim pa la snang ba tsam las/ blo ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la ni/ theg pa zhes pa'ang gzhi nas med pas/ nam mkha' bzhin du shes par bya'o/ / gnyis pa bye brag tu dbye ba la lnga ste/ lha mi'i theg pa/ nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas/ byang chub sems dpa'/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ nges tshig dang*/ dbye ba'o/ / dang po ni/ ma nu sha yā na zhes pa'i sgra las mi'i theg pa dang*/ dhe ba yā na las lha'i theg pa'o/ / dbye ba la gnyis las/ mi'i theg pa ni mi dge ba bcu spangs te dge ba bcu spyad pas mtho ris kyi mir skye'o/ / de la dge ba bcu ni mi dge bcu spangs pa'i dge ba'i cha nas btags so/ / de yang srog gcod/ ma byin len/ 'dod log gsum ni lus dang*/ rdzun/ phra ma/ ngag 'khyal/ tshig rtsub bzhi ni ngag dang*/ brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta gsum ni yid kyi mi dge ba ste de dag spang ba'o/ / lha'i theg pa ni dge ba bcu nyid cher goms pas 'dod lha rigs drug dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi las gzugs khams gnas ris bcu bdun dang*/ gzugs med bzhis gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir skye ba ste/ le lag las/ dge bcu spyod cing mi dge spong byed pa/ / 'dod pa'i lha dang mi ru skye ba'i rgyu/ / tshad med bzhi spyod mi g.yo sgom byed pa/ / tshangs gnas la sogs skye ba'i rgyu yin no/ / zhes so/ / de'ang gzhi dge sdig blang dor shes pa la 'jug cing bsam gtan gzugs med kyi rang bzhin shes pa/ lam dge ba bcu la spyod pa/ 'bras bu so so'i gnas su skyes pa'o/ / gnyis pa nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang gnyis las/ nges tshig ni shra ba ka'i sgra las thos sgrogs zhes pas ston pa la chos nyan pa gzhan la brjod par mtshon pa'o/ / dbye ba la gsum las/ gzhi phung po dang gzhan la gang zag gi bdag dang nga yir 'dzin pa med pa dang*/

dngos po gzung ba rags pa kun rdzob dang*/ rdul phran cha med don dam dang*/ sems kyi rgyun kun rdzob dang*/ skad cig don dam pa'i bden par gtan la phab nas bslab pa gsum la gnas pa'o/ / lam ni tshogs lam chung ngu 'bring chen por dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ yang dag spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi sgom zhing*/ sbyor lam drod dang rtse mo gnyis su/ dad pa/ brtson 'grus/ dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab kyi dbang po lnga dang*/ bzod pa chos mchog gnyis su dad pa la sogs pa'i stobs lnga sgom zhing*/ mthong lam du dran pa dang*/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ sbyongs pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bsgom pa'o/ / de nas sgom lam du yang dag pa'i lta ba/ rtog pa/ ngagalas kyi mtha'/ 'tsho ba/ rtsol ba/ dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin yang dag pa'i 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad bsgom pa'o/ / 'bras bu ni lhag bcas lhag med thob nas zhi ba'i dbyings su gnas pa'o/ / de yang gtso bor bden pa bzhi la blang dor du byed pas/ mthong lam skad cig bcu drug la sogs pa sa gong ma thob cing rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu mngon du byed pa ste/ le lag las/ bden bzhi'i don rtogs rab tu spong ba yi/ / ye shes bcu drug cha sbyangs rab zhi ba'i/ / rgyun zhugs la sogs rim pas sbyangs nas ni/ / nyon mongs dgra rnams zhi ba'i sa ru 'gro/ / zhes so/ / gsum pa rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la yang gnyis las/ nges tshig ni pra t+ya ka bud+dha zhes pa ste/ pra t+ya ka so so rang rang bud+dha sangs rgyas te srid pa tha ma'i tshe slob dpon gyis gdams ngag ston pa la mi ltos par lam gyi rtogs pa rang byung du rgyud la skyes nas byang chub mngon du byed pa'o/ / de'ang tshogs na spyod pa che ba/ chung ba/ bse ru ltar gcig pur gnas pa gsum yod pa'o/

/ de'i theg pa la dbye na gsum las/ gzhi phyi dang nang gi chos rnams rten 'brel lugs su 'jug pas 'khor ba dang*/ lugs las ldog pas mya ngan las 'das pa thob par shes nas gang zag gi bdag dang*/ phyi gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ gzung don rtog pa spang phyir dang*/ / 'dzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni/ / rten gyi bse ru lta bu'i lam/ / yang dag bsdus par shes par bya/ / zhes so/ / lam ni byang chub kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun nyan thos ltar bsgom pa'i steng du rten 'brel bsgoms pas khyad par du 'phags so/ / 'bras bu ni nam zhig byang chub thob nas sems can la sgras chos mi ston zhing brdas bstan pas go bar byed cing mya ngan las 'da' ba ste/ le lag las/ phyi nang rten 'brel mig yor tshul shes shing*/ / dngos po gzugs la thog med rab tu 'jug/ dge bshes mi slob rang gi rig pas rtogs/ / byang chub sar 'gro yid bzhin bde ba'i mchog/ ces so/ / de'i dgra bcom gyi sa la 'bras bu yid bzhin bde ba mchog gi sa zhes bya'o/ / bzhi pa byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la'ang gnyis las/ nges tshig ni bo dhi sa twa zhes pa'i sgras byang chub sems dpa' ste/ sangs rgyas 'dod pa la rten dman pa zil gyis gnon zhing snying stobs chen pos 'gro ba sgrol ba'i go cha bgos pa ste/ sdud pa las/ blo che ba dang gtong ba che dang sems pa che/ / go cha chen po bgos shing bdud kyi sgyu 'dul ba/ / rgyu de yis ni byang chub sems dpa' zhes brjod do/ / zhes so/ / dbye na gsum las/ gzhi snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar rtogs shing*/ gang zag gi bdag dang*/ phyi gzung ba dang*/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems te chos kyi bdag gis stong bas bdag gnyis ky-is stong pa'i tshul khong du chud nas/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i ngo bo byang chub kyi sems gnyis skyed par byed pa'o/

/ lam ni chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug gam bcu la slob cing sa bcu sbyong ba'o/ / bcu ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi steng du thabs/ stobs/ smon lam/ ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i nang du 'du'o/ / 'bras bu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa la bzhugs nas don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa ste/ le lag las/ bdag med gnyis rtogs pha rol phyin rdzogs pa'i/ / sa bcu rim gyis bgrod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/

/ sangs rgyas sar 'gro go 'phang thob pa'i lam/ / bden pa gnyis kyis rab tu thob par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / de la bden pa gnyis ni/ don dam pa dang*/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa'o/ / kun rdzob kyi bden pa ni snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos sna tshogs su snang ba yin la/ don dam pa'i bden pa ni sems nyid dang chos nyid spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing blos bsam pa'i yul las 'das pa ste/ spyod 'jug las/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ / blo ni kun rdzob yin par 'dod/ / ces so/ / de'ang dbu ma rang rgyud pa ni chos thams cad kun rdzob tu snang la/ de yang brtags na don dam par rang bzhin med par 'dod de/ dbu ma bden gnyis las/ kun rdzob 'di ltar snang ba 'di/ / rig pas brtags na 'ga' mi rnyed/ / ma rnyed pa ni don dam ste/ / ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid do/ / zhes so/ / dbu ma thal 'gyur ba ni dpyad rung ma dpyad rung dus gtan du chos thams cad spros pa nye bar zhi ba khas len thams cad dang bral bar 'dod de/ 'jug pa las/ ji ltar khyod kyis gzhan dbang dngos 'dod ltar/ / kun rdzob kyang ni bdag gis khas ma blangs/ / zhes pa dang*/ rtsa ba shes rab las/ spros pa rnams kyis ma spros pa/ / de ni de yi mtshan nyid do/ / zhes pa dang*/ gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*/ / 'gag pa med pa skye med pa/ / chad pa med pa rtag med pa/ / 'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa/ / tha dad don min don gcig min/ / spros pa nyer zhi zhi bstan pa/ / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi/ / dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes so/ / kun rdzob la dbye na snang la don byed mi nus pa chu zla lta bu log pa'i kun rdzob dang snang la don byed nus pa yang dag kun rdzob nam mkha'i zla ba lta bu ste/ bden gnyis las/ snang du 'dra yang don byed dag/ nus pa'i phyir dang mi nus phyir/ / yang dag yang dag ma yin pa'i/ / kun rdzob kyi ni dbye ba'ang byas/

/ zhes so/ / dpyad na yang dag dang log pa gnyis ka yang snang bar mnyam zhing*/ gzhigs na don la ma grub pas mnyam pa'i phyir 'khor 'das snang srid thams cad da lta nyid nas rnam dbye med par mnyam pa nyid du gnas so/ / don dam blo las 'das pas ngo bo la dbye ba med kyang blos cung zad dbye na/ chos rnams rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa de ni gshis kyi don dam yin te/ mdo las/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na nam mkha'i khams la 'ga' zhig gis bsngags pa brjod cing*/ 'ga' zhig gis bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod na gang ba'am bri ba med do/ / de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid don dam pa gcig pu zhi ba'i rang bzhin brjod cing*/ gzhan mu stegs byed kun tu rgyu rnams kyis rtag pa ther zug pa'i chos su bstan yang*/ yang dag pa'i de bzhin nyid la gnyis su gyur pa med do/ / zhes so/ / rnal 'byor pas don de nyid bsgoms pas spros pa dang bral ba'i blo skyes pa ni rnam grangs pa'i don dam zhes bya ste/ bden gnyis las/ skye la sogs pa bkag pa yang*/ / yang dag pa dang mthun nyid bzhed/ / skye med spros kun zhi ba la/ / don dam pa yi brda' mdzad do/ / zhes so/ / 'di nyid blo'i yul yin pas kun rdzob bden pa mtshan nyid pa/ don dam bden pa btags pa bar bshad do/ / lnga pa gsang sngags kyi theg pa la gnyis te/ phyi pa dang*/ nang pa'o/ / phyi pa la gsum las/ bya ba'i rgyud la gnyis las/ nges tshig ni krī ya ste khrus dang gtsang sbra gtso bor ston pas bya ba'i rgyud ces so/ / dbye na gsum las/ gzhi chos rnams ngo bo nyid med par rtogs nas lha ye shes sems dpa' rgyal po lta bur lta ba las dngos grub 'dod pa'i gzhi byed do/ / lam ni lha bskyed nas mchod pa 'bul ba'i de kho na nyid la sogs pas dka' spyad gtsang sbra'i rang bzhin la brten no/ / 'bras bu ni mi tshe bcu drug na sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob par 'dod de/

kun byed las/ krī yas bdag dang lha gnyis rje khol tshul/ / mi tshe bcu drug 'bad pas grol bar 'dod/ / ces so/ / spyod pa'i rgyud la'ang gnyis las/ nges tshig u pa ya ste spyod pa krī ya dang mthun zhing sgom pa yo ga dang mthun pas gnyis bcas kyi theg pa zhes bya'o/ / dbye na gsum las gzhi ngo bo nyid med pa'i shes rab dang bdag dang lha gnyis dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa'i tshul du mnyam por 'dod pa'i thabs las dngos grub 'dod pa rtogs pa'o/ / lam ni de ltar bsgom zhing kṝ ya ltar gtsang sbra spyod pas mi tshe bdun na grol bar 'dod pa ni 'bras bu ste/ snga ma las/ u pas bdag dang lha gnyis mnyam por mthong*/ / grogs po'i tshul gyis dngos grub ster re ba/ / mi tshe bdun na grol ba'i 'bras bu 'dod/ / ces so/ / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la'ang gnyis las/ nges tshig ni yo ga ste/ sems kyi sgom pa gtso la spyod pa grogs su 'dod pa'o/ / dbye na gsum las/ gzhi ni ngo bo nyid med pa'i shes rab dang*/ bdag lhar gsal ba la ye shes pa chu la chu bzhag pa ltar gnas pas gzhi byed pa'o/ / lam ni de ltar bsgom zhing gtsang sbra kun tu spyod pa grogs su ldan pas/ 'bras bu mi tshe gsum na stug po bkod pa'i sar grol bar 'dod de/ snga ma las/ yo ga stug po bkod 'dod pa/ / mi tshe gsum na grol bar 'dod/ / ces so/ / gsang sngags nang pa la yang gsum las/ rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud la'ang gnyis las/ nges tshig ni ma hā yo ga'i sgra las thabs shes kyi rnal 'byor bskyed pa dang rlung gtso bas grol bar 'dod do/ / dbye na gsum las/ gzhi ye nas dag pas lha'i dkyil 'khor dang rlung gi byed pa la sogs pa'o/ / lam ni de dag bsgom pa'o/ / 'bras bu ni tshe 'di nyid du grol bar 'dod pa ste/ ye shes rol pa las/ bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa las/ / ye shes rlung gi las byed cing*/ / nam mkha'i 'jo ba rab rdzogs pas/

/ tshe gcig gis ni rab grol lo/ / zhes so/ / shes rab ma'i rgyud la'ang gnyis las/ nges tshig ni a nu yo ga ste shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med du 'dod pa'o/ / dbye na gsum las/ gzhi ye nas dag pa lha'i rang bzhin dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'o/ / lam de nyid bsgom pa'o/ / 'bras bu tshe 'dir bde ba chen po'i sku mngon du byed pa ste/ thig le mchog gi rgyud las/ 'od gsal ba yi sems nyid ni/ / dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med par/ / bde ba che de su sgom pa/ / 'bras bu tshe 'dir rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / zhes so/ / gnyis su med pa'i rgyud la'ang gnyis las/ nges tshig ni a ti'i sgra las skye ba med pa'i ngo bo nyid dam kun gyi snying po la 'jug pas chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i don to/ / dbye na gsum las/ gzhi snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos so cog ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin no/ / lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis su med pa blang dor re dog las 'das par byed pa'o/ / 'bras bu lhun rdzogs kun tu bzang po'i sa la da lta nyid nas gnas pa mthar phyin par byed pa ste theg pa 'dir thams cad rdzogs pa nyid/ le lag las/ mnyam nyid don rtogs rang rig rgyal po dang*/ / bla med don rtogs thabs chen 'di dag tu/ / rgya mtsho chen por chu klung kun 'bab ltar/ / rnam thar theg pa bsam yas ma lus 'dus/ / zhes so/ / de dag gis spyi'i don bshad zin to/ / ༈ gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum ste/ theg pa'i dbye ba/ gang gi gnyen por gsungs tshul/ de dag gi don bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ sprul pa sku'i gsung rab phun sum tshogs pa tha~Xms ca~Xd kya~Xng theg pa lngar bstan pa 'di~X lta~X ste~X/ sems can rnams 'du~Xl ba'i~X dba~Xng gi~Xs bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med pa bzhi dang*/ dge ba bcu bstan pa gzugs med dang gzugs dang 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha'i~X theg pa dnga~X dge ba bcu nyid mi'i~X thega~X pa~X dnga~X*/

bden pa bzhi'i rang bzhin spong len du byed pa'i dmigs yul chos dang chos sum cu rtsa bdun bsgoms pas dgra bcom mngon du byed pa nyana~X thosa~X kyi~X thega~X pa~X dnga~X*/ rten 'brel dang lam lnga bsgoms pas yid bzhin bde ba mchog gi sar bgrod pa ranga~X sa~Xngs rgyasa~X kyi~X thega~X pa~X dnga~X*/ bdag med gnyis dang pha rol tu phyin pa bcus sangs rgyas mngon sum du byed pa byanga~X chuba~X se~Xms dpa'i~X thega~X pa~X dnga~X*/ chos thams cad dkyil 'khor gsum du shes shing lam zab mo bsgoms pas tshe 'dir grol ba gsa~Xng sngaga~Xs bla~X na~X me~Xd pa~X'i the~Xg pa~Xs zhes so/ / gnyis pa ni/ 'gro ba'i rgyud kyi ma~X ri~Xg pa~X'i rna~Xm pa~Xr rtoga~X pa~Xs bskye~Xd pa'i~X nyona~X mo~Xngs pa ༵ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug cha mnyam pa nyi khri chig stong ste nyon mongs pa sto~Xng phraga~X brgyada~X cu~X rtsa~X bzhi~X'i gnyena~X po~Xr/ 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa sde snod gsum cha mnyam pa sngags kyi sde snod nyi khri chig stong chig stong ste cho~Xs kyi sgo mo stonga~X phraga~X brgya~Xd cu~X rtsa~X bzhi~X rang byung gi ye shes las 'phros pa'i ston pa rnams kyis gdul bya'i snang ba dang mthun par sngar yang gsu~Xngs so~X/ / da ltar yang phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i 'jig rten na gsung ngo*/ / ma 'ongs pa na'ang gsunga~X ba~Xr 'gyu~Xr ro~X/ / gsum pa ni/ chos kyi rnam grangs theg pa lngar gsungs pa de~X da ༵ ga tha~Xms ca~Xd kya~Xng*/ phyi gzung ba rags par 'dod pa tha mal pa'i blo las khyad par du 'phags pas rdul phran cha med don dam pa'i bden par shes pa gzu ༵ nga ba ༵ bdag med pa dnga~X nang gi sems kyang skad cig ma ste/ de yang bdag med par shes pas phung po la bdag tu 'dzi~Xn pa~X'i gnyen po byed pa nyan thos kyi theg pa dang*/ phyi~X snang ba'i yul rdul phran cha med du'ang don dam par ma grub cing kun rdzob tu rdzing bur shar ba'i gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar rtogs pas phyi'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rdzun par shes shing*/

ma rig pa yod na 'du byed nas rga shi'i bar du 'byung zhing*/ ma rig pa log na rga shi'i bar du 'khor ba'i 'khor lo ldog par shes nas/ gang zag gi bdag dang*/ phyi snang ba chos kyi bdag byed po med par rtogs pa ni na~Xng gi~X rtena~X ci~Xng 'brela~X ba~Xr 'byu~Xng ba~X bsgoms pas chos kyi phyed phyi yul la bdag tu 'dza ༵ ིna pa'i gnyen po byed pa rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang*/ de ltar bdag med phyed dang gnyis kyi steng du sgom byed gnyen po'i blo nang chos kyi bdag tu 'dzi~Xn pa~X sems 'khru~Xl pa yul du byed pa~X la~Xs/ byang chub sems dpas de yang ma grub par rtogs pa'i cha nas khyad par du 'phags par 'dod pa bdag med gnyis mngon sum du byed pa byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa dang*/ rgyu la~Xs dkar nag dnga~X la~Xs kyi~X 'bra~Xs bu~X so sor smin pa chuda~X mi~X za~X ba~Xr ston pa lha dnga~X mi'i theg pa ste/ las brgya pa las/ las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ / chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ / rnyed nas lus can rnams la ni/ / 'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / de ni phyi rol pa las 'bras med par 'dod pa las khyad par du 'phags so/ / de'ang mi dang lha'i theg pa la brten nas thar pa bsgrub dgos par/ rin cen 'phreng ba las/ mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ / lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring*/ / lha yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ / rim gyis thar pa gam na 'dug/ ces pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa yi yang dag lta/ / chen po su la yod gyur na/ / de ni tshe rabs stong du yang*/ / ngan 'gror 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i la~Xs da~Xng la~Xs kyi~X 'bra~Xs bu~Xs lus la mi~X go~Xs/ nga~Xg la~X go~Xs pa~Xr mi~X 'gyu~Xr/ sems la go~Xs su~X me~Xd pa~X sgo gsum ye nas dkyil 'khor gsum du shes pas tha mal gyi snang ba med de/ gnas lugs stonga~Xs pa~X'i mtha~Xr thu~Xg pa rtogs pa ni bla na med pa gsang sngags kyi theg pa mchog go~X

/ gnyis pa gdul yul 'gro ba dang chos kyi rang bzhin bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin chos nyid du bstan pa dang*/ chos kyi rang bzhin brjod du med par bstan pa'o/ / dang po la drug ste/ don gyi 'brel dgod pa/ ma rig pas 'khor bar snang tshul/ snang dus nyid nas rang bzhin chos nyid du bstan pa/ 'khrul snang sems kyi cho 'phrul du bstan pa/ 'khrul rtog gzhi med rtsa ba dang bral ba/ rnam rtog ye shes kyi rol par bstan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ 'dul ba bzhi'i cho 'phrul du bstan pa de~X na~Xs rang snang gi de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi~Xs che~Xd du~X brjo~Xd pa~X 'di~X brjo~Xd do~X/ / gnyis pa ni phyi nang gi chos ma dag pa snod bcud kyi rnam par snang ba ji~X snyeda~X pas bsdus pa'i 'jiga~X rtena~X 'khru~Xl pa~X'i cho~Xs 'di thams cad rmi lam dang 'dra ste/ gnas lugs ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i ngo bor ma~X riga~X pas gnyid 'thibs po ches non de/ gnyis su rtoga~X pa~X'i gzunga~X 'dzi~Xn gyisa~X rkyen byas pas/ phyi~X rol dkar dmar sna tshogs kyi yul dang na~Xng 'gro ba'i rnam pa tshad med pa snang ste/ 'khrul pa'i rgyu las 'khrul snang gi 'bras bu shing rta'i 'phang lo ltar byung ba'i rte+e~Xn 'bre~Xl phyi nang gnyi~Xs su~X sems can 'kho~Xr te/ yul dang snang ba mi~X mthu~Xn pa'i bye brag bde~X ba dang sdu~Xg bsngal sna tshogs myonga~X zhing gtan tu 'khor ba'i grong khyer gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing sna~Xng ba~Xr 'gyu~Xr ro/ / gsum pa ni/ de ltar snang yang 'khor ba'i ra~Xng bzhi~Xn ye nas grol ba'i chos nyida~X mnyam rdzogs chen po la~Xs nyama~Xs pa~X me~Xd de/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de skad du yang ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ rgyal ba'i sras po dngos po rnam par 'jig/ srid pa thams cad yong ye stong pa ste/ / nyi tshe'i stong pa mu stegs can rnams dang*/ / mkhas pa byis pa dag dang rtsod mi byed/

/ ces so/ / de'ang 'khor bar snang dus nyid nas don la ma grub pas yanga~X da~Xg pa'i gnas lugs yin la/ kun rdzob sgyu~X ma~X'i tshula~X tsam du gnyi~Xs su~X snang ba nyid dpyad na rmi lam gyi snang ba dang rmi ba po rang gi sems gnyis tha dad du ma grub pa bzhin du/ 'khor mkhan bda~Xg da~Xng 'khor 'das bda~Xg gi~Xr gzung ba'i yul gzha~Xn me~Xd de~X/ sems nyid de ltar snang ba'i phyir ro/ / de skad du'ang lang kar gshegs pa las/ don yod ma yin sems nyid ni/ / phyi rol don mthong log pa yin/ / bag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems/ / don du snang ba rab tu 'byung*/ / zhes so/ / des na 'khor ba snang dus rnama~X par dga~X cing rang snang dbyi~Xngs su rnam par dag pa'i chos nyi~Xd du ye nas tshu~Xl gci~Xg pas chos sku lhun rdzogs kyi dgongs pa 'khor 'das thams cad la ye khyab chen por phyam gcig go~X /

de skad du'ang rtsa ba shes rab las/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ / khyad par cung zad yod ma yin/ / 'di gnyis kyi ni khyad par dag/ shin tu phra ba'ang yod ma yin/ / zhes pa dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan las| srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid ngang*/ / zhes so/ / bzhi pa ni/ bda~Xg da~Xng bda~Xg gi~Xr 'dzin pas rang dang gzha~Xn tha dad pa rnama~Xs su blos gzung ba ni~X rang gi lo~Xg par ༵rtog pa tsama~X nyida~X lasa~X don la grub pa med de/ log par rtog pa de nyid btsal na phra~X zhi~Xng phra ba'i chos su'ang med pas/ de las tha dad pa'i chos nyid za~Xb pa~X'a~Xng logs su yo~Xd pa ma~X yi~Xn te/ log rtog nyid chos nyid du gnas pa'i phyir ro/ / de skad du'ang slob dpon pad+ma'i sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ rtog pa chos nyid yin shes na/ / chos dbyings gzhan nas bsgom rgyu med/ / ces pa dang bskyed rdzogs las kyang*/ rnam par rtog pa bgegs nyid de/ / bgegs ni rang gi sems las byung*/ / ye nas sems nyid dag shes na/ / bgegs zhes bya ba gzhan na med/ / ces pa dang mthun no/ / de'ang 'khor ba'i gzung 'dzin du snang ba 'di dag yul log rtog gi snang ba rmi lam lta bu nyida~X la~X yul can rang gi log rtog nyida~X spyoda~X de~X 'khrul par snang yang*/ don la sems nyid de bzhin nyid gnas lugs las gzha~Xn du~X g.yo~X ba~X ci~X ya~Xng me~Xd de/ 'byung bzhi'i 'pho 'gyur nam mkha'i ngang las ma g.yos pa'am dgag sgrub kyi rnam rtog sems nyid kyi ngang las ma g.yos pa bzhin no/ / de skad du yang kun byed las/ ji ltar snang ba de bzhin nyid du gcig/ 'di la su yang 'chos par ma byed cig/ ma bcos mnyam pa'i rgyal po de las ni/ / mi rtog chos sku'i dgongs pa lhun gyis grub/ / ces so/ / lnga pa ni/ de ltar gzung 'dzin 'khrul par snang ba'i lo~Xg rtoga~X gi rgyu~X dang des bskyed pa'i 'bra~Xs bu skad cig snga phyi rim can du 'brel bar snang ba'i rgyuna~X nyida~X kyanga~X brtags na med de/

rig pa'i ngo bo la gzhi~X dang rtsa~X ba me~Xd pa'i chos dbyi~Xngs gdod nas dag pa'i gnas lugs su gnas shing*/ sna tshogs su 'char dus nyid na'ang rgyun du med de ska~Xd ci~Xg ma~X sil bu'i rang bzhin no/ / de'ang 'das pa'i skad cig ma 'gags/ ma 'ongs pa ma rnyed/ da lta'i skad cig ma yang brtags na phyi nang bar gsum na med pas skad cig ma tsam du yang med pa'i phyir rig pa ye nas rna~Xm pa~Xr da~Xg pa~X'i chos dbyi~Xngs nam mkha' lta bu'i ngo bo nyida~X du gnas pa'i tshula~X te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ 'od srungs sems de ni kun tu btsal na nang na yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong*/ phyi rol na yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong*/ de gnyis ka'i bar na yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste nam mkha' lta bu'o/ / zhes so/ / drug pa ni/ snang sems thams cad kyi ngo bo ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i yul gdod nas dag pa'i chos nyi~Xd la ༵yul can blo'i rol pa sna tshogs su 'char zhing dbanga~X bsgyura~X ba thams cad rang snang ba'i ye shes nyi~Xd ye shes nyi ༵ da la spyoda~X pa'i phyira~X na/ bda~Xg da~Xng gzha~Xn du~X 'dzin par byed pa dang dgag sgrub dug lngar shar ba'i rtoga~X pa'i~X rgyuna~X thams cad ye shes kyi rol pa yin pas ye nas rna~Xm par da~Xg pa bla~X na me~Xd pa'i the~Xg pa'i~X mcho~Xg yin te/ kun byed las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug kyang*/ / byang chub chen po'i lam las byung*/ / kun spyod yon tan rnam lnga yang*/ / chos nyid dbyings kyi rgyan zhes gsungs/ / zhes pa dang*/ ma bsams ma sbyong chos bzhin du*/ / rnam rtog nyid las ye shes skye/ / zhes pa dang*/ ji ltar dran rig rtog pa thams cad kun/ / ma bcos kun byed nyid kyi don du rig/ ces so/ / gnyis pa chos kyi rang bzhin brjod du med par bstan pa la drug ste/ theg pa bzhis nges par 'byung ba'i 'bras bu bla na med pa'i theg par bstan pa/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i cho 'phrul du bstan pa/

ston pa dang bstan pa 'pho 'gyur med kyang gdul bya'i don du gang la gang 'dul du bstan pa/ rang bzhin gsang ba'i snying po theg pa kun gyi 'phro gzhir bstan pa/ de nyid mdo rgyud kun gyi spyi 'grel du bstan pa/ de thams cad ming tshig btags pa tsam las gnas lugs gang du yang ma grub par bstan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ sngar bstan pa'i the~Xg pa~X bzhi~X yi~Xs rang rang gi mi mthun phyogs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang theg pa dman pa la sogs pa las nges par 'byuXng bar byed la/ de dag gis nges par 'byung ba'i mthar bla na med pa'i the~Xg pa~X rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po dang 'phrad de blang dor rtsol sgrub las 'das pa'i chos nyid rtogs pa'i rang bzhin gci~Xg gi~X 'bra~Xs bu ༵ ༵ sangs rgyas kyi sara~X gna~Xs par byed de/ kun byed las/ ston pa'i theg pa rang bzhin dgu po yang*/ / rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen por bgrod pa'i lam/ / blang dor med pa'i chos nyid 'di rtogs nas/ / ji bzhin pa la rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ / 'gro dang 'ong med kun tu khyab par brdal/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa ni/ gnas lugs kyi don ya~Xng dga~X par rtoga~Xs pa'i rnal 'byor pasa~X snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams la rig pas ra~Xb tu brtaga~Xs na~X gnas lugs rang ༵bzhi~Xn me~Xd pa'i ngang la~Xs snang lugs rkyen gyi 'char tshul ci~Xr ya~Xng gruba~X pa ni nam mkha'i cho 'phrul dang sgyu ma dang gzugs brnyan la sogs pa'i dpes shes par bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ ji ltar bar snang cung zad sprin med las/ / skad cig tu ni sprin gyi 'khor lo dag/ byung nas zhig ste sprin gyi 'khor lo med/ / thog ma gang las byung ba blta bar gyis/ / chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ / ji ltar skye bo mang po'i dbus dag na/ / sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te/ / rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas/ / de la ji ltar mi bden snang ba gang yang med/

/ chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ / ji ltar nam mkha' dngas la zla shar ba/ / de yi gzugs brnyan dngas pa'i mtshor snang yang*/ / chu zla stong pa gsogs te snying po med/ / chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ / ji ltar sos ka'i nyi ma phyed dus na/ / skyes bu skom pas gdungs shing 'gro ba dag/ smig rgyu 'gyu ba chu yi phung por snang*/ / de la brtags na chu ni gang yang med/ / chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ / zhes pa dang*/ ljon pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar me long ngos dag la/ / bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor snang ba ltar/ / de ltar rang bzhin ma grub pa/ / chos rnams ljon pas shes par gyis/ / zhes pa ltar chos thams cad rang bzhin med bzhin du snang la snang dus nyid nas ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub pa'i cho 'phrul du shes par bya'o/ / gsum pa ni/ don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i sa~Xngs rgya~Xs mthar thug gi bgrod byar gyur pa kun tu bzang po lta bu ni dus thams cad du sku gsum 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pas mya~X nga~Xn las yo~Xngs su mi~X 'da~X' ba yin zhing*/ de'i bstan pa phun sum tshogs pa'i cho~Xs thams cad kyanga~X nuba~X pa~Xr mi~X 'gyu~Xr te~X/ dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'i phyir ro/ / de skad du'ang gser 'od dam pa las/ sangs rgyas mya ngan yongs mi 'da'/ / chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te/ / zhes so/ / sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi rang bzhin rtag pa ste rgyun du gnas pa ni/ sku gsum bstan pa'i mdo las/ chos kyi sku ni ngo bo nyid kyi rtag pa'o/ / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni rgyun gyi rtag pa'o/ / sprul pa'i sku ni rgyun mi 'chad pa'i rtag pa'o/ / zhes pa dang*/ rgyud bla ma las/ chos kyi dbang phyug 'chi ba'i bdud bcom dang*/ / ngo bo med phyir 'jig rten mgon po rtag/ ces pa dang*/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ zhi sku dpag bsam shing ltar gsal gyur c-ing*/

/ yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin rnam mi rtog/ 'gro grol bar du 'jig rten 'byor slad rtag/ ces so/ / de'ang chos sku dang longs sku ni gzhung phal pa las rtag par 'dod cing*/ sprul pa'i sku ni 'di las chu zla ltar 'gro ba la snang gis rang mtshan du gdul bya'i ngor ma grub pas rtag mi rtag las 'das pa'i chos nyid kho na la rtag pa zhes 'dod do/ / de ltar sku gsum 'du 'bral med pas ngo bo 'pho 'gyur med na yang*/ de'i ngang las lhun gyis grub pa'i sprul pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis lta bur 'phros te gnas lugs ma~X ṛ~Xg pa'i sems can rnams smi~Xn cing grol bar mdza~Xd pas gdu~Xl ba'i phyira~X so so'i snang ba dang mthun pa'i sprul pa'i sku rang byung du byunga~X nasa~X don mdzad pa'i mthar mya~X nga~Xn las 'da~X' ba~Xr stona~X te/ rgyud bla ma las/ gdul bya'i khams dang gdul ba'i thabs dang ni/ / gdul bya'i khams kyi 'dul ba'i bya ba dang*/ de yi yul dang dus su gshegs pa la/ / khyab bdag rtag tu lhun gyis grub par 'jug/ ces pa dang*/ gser 'od dam pa las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan bsam mi khyab/ / de bzhin gshegs pa rtag pa'i sku/ / sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ / bkod pa rnam pa sna tshogs ston/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / bzhi pa ni/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa 'du~Xl ba~X ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ ltung dang 'byung dang ldang ba dang*/ / nges par 'byung dang gang zag dang*/ / bcas pa dang ni rab dbye dang*/ / rnam par nges phyir 'dul ba nyid/ / ces so/ / lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa mdo~X sde~X ste/ de nyid las/ gnas rnams dang ni mtshan nyid dang*/ / chos don smos phyir mdo sde nyid/ / ces so/ / lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa chosa~X mngo~Xn pa'i sde snod de/ de nyid las/ mngon du'i phyir dang yang yang dang*/ / zil gnon rtogs phyir mngon pa'i chos/ / zhes so/ / khrus dang gtsang sbra la sogs lus ngag gi dma~X tshi~Xg gtso bor ston pa kṝ ya dang*/

spyod pa bya ba dang lta ba rnal 'byor ltar byed pas sangs rgyas sgru~Xb pa u pa dnga~X*/ lus ngag gi spyod pa grogs tsam las sems kyi sgom pa gtso bor ston pas mchog gruba~X pa~X yo ga dnga~X*/ thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa gtso bor ston pa sku'i~X rgyud gshin rje dgra nag la sogs pa dnga~X*/ shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa gtso bo ston pa gsu~Xng gi rgyud rta mchog rol pa la sogs pa da~Xng*/ rang bzhin gnyis su med par ston pa thu~Xgs kyi~X rgyu~Xd gsang ba 'dus pa dang dpal yang dag la sogs pa ste/ phyoga~Xs bcu'i~X sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams tshad med pa rnama~Xs su~X dam pa'i chos ra~Xb tu graga~Xs pa~X thams cad gsa~Xng ba~X'i snyinga~X po ༵gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po'i rang bzhin la~Xs 'phrosa~X te~X/ grub pa'i mtha' dang snying po'i don thams cad kyi mthar thug pa rdzogs pa chen por 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ / de skad du yang kun byed las/ spyi 'dus sgos 'dus thams cad 'dus/ / rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen por 'dus// 'di nyid kun gyi snying po ste/ / 'di ru ma 'dus gang yang med/ / ces so/ / lnga pa ni/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs ranga~X bzhi~Xn ga~Xsang ba~X'i snyinga~X po~X 'di~X nyida~X sde~X snoda~X gsum po kuna~X dnga~X rgyuda~X sde drug po kuna~X gyi~X 'phro gzhir gyur pas 'byu~Xng gna~Xs kyang yin la/ don gyi snying po 'dus pas gtana~X la~X nge~Xs pa~Xr 'be~Xbs pa'i gzhi dang dbab bya'i yul du gnas shing*/ 'di nyid de thams cad kyi gtan la 'bebs byed kyang yin te/ kun byed las/ sde snod kun dang rgyud kun gyi/ / rang bzhin snying po 'dir 'dus shing*/ / mdo rgyud kun gyi spyi 'grel yin/ / zhes so/ / drug pa de ltar theg pa lngas gtan la 'bebs byed du bstan pa dang*/ dbab bya'i yul snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i cho~Xs rna~Xms thams cad don la grub pa med pas mi~Xng du~X bta~Xgs pa~X tsa~Xm ste/ mdo las/

rab 'byor chos thams cad ni brda tsam btags pa tsam ste ngo bo nyid kyis yongs su grub pa med do/ / zhes so/ / sus btags na lha mi'i stona~X pa~X sangs rgyas kyis snang tsam ma 'gags pa kun rdzob kyi bden pa~X'i do~Xn dnga~X re zhig mthu~Xn pa'i phyoga~Xs su~X mdzad de/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa phung po dang khams dang skye mched ces pa la sogs pa'i mi~Xng da~Xng tshi~Xg tu~X bta~Xgs na~Xs bsta~Xn to/ / dgos pa ni don gyi gnas lugs blos rtogs par bya ba'i phyir ro/ / de ltar ming tshig tu btags nas stona~X pa'i dus nyid na mi~Xng tshi~Xg la~X dngo~Xs po~X me~Xd de/ nam mkha' zhes brjod dus na ming tshig de nyid nam mkha'i khams la ni grub pa med cing*/ lus dang sems la nam mkha'i ming tshig kyang med de/ gang nas kyang nam mkha'i ming tshig mi rnyed pas dngos po dang ngos gzung med de/ / de nyid nam mkha'i don dang dbyer med pas chos thams cad blos ming tshig tu btags kyang ming don gang du'ang grub pa med pa'i rang bzhin du shes par bya ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ ji ltar la la zhig la bu btsas nas/ / de yi ming ni tha dad der btags kyang*/ / nang dang phyi rol kun tu btsal na med/ / chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / de ltar chos thams cad brjod du med pa'o zhe~Xs ched du brjo~Xd do~X/ / gsum pa 'khor 'das sems dang ye shes kyi rang snang du don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ rang snang du ston pa'i rgyu brjod pa dang*/ ji ltar bstan pa dngos so/ / dang po ni/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin brjod pa/ de~X na~Xs de ༵bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr thabs dang shes rab gnyi~Xs su ༵me~Xd pa~X de~X nyida~X kyi~X gsa~Xng ba~X sems dang ye shes rang snang bar ston pa 'di~X nyida~X sku~X da~Xng gsu~Xng da~Xng thuga~Xs da~Xng yo~Xn tana~X da~Xng 'phri~Xn la~Xs rdo~X rje~X la~Xs 'di skad ces phyu~Xng ngo~X*/ / gnyis pa la gnyis te/

sems can gyi 'khrul snang sems kyi rang snang du bstan pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing snang ye shes kyi rang snang du bstan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ thams cad rang snang yin pas ngo mtshar bar bstan pa'i phyir a~X ho ༵zhes so/ / nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga dang des rgyu byas te 'khor ba'i gnas skabs na 'khrul snang sna tshogs srida~X pa khams gsum gyi rtsa~X bar gyur pa~X'i nyesa~X dmi~Xgs thams cad ni nga dang bda~Xg tu~X rtoga~Xs pa la~Xs 'phro~Xs te/ 'khor bar 'khrul dus na lha la sogs pa'i 'gro ba rgyuda~X druga~X so so'i snang ba la skye~X ba dang*/ srog gi dbang po 'ga~Xgs pas 'chi ba dang*/ rang rang gi lusa~X sna tshogs dnga~X bdud rtsi dang bu ram shing la sogs pa'i lo~Xngs spyoda~X sna tshogs da~Xng lha'i gna~Xs la sogs pa so so'i yul du snang ba sna tshogs pa dnga~X*/ 'chi 'pho ltung ba la sogs pa sduga~X bsnga~Xl gyi 'khru~Xl 'kho~Xr dang*/ la~X so~Xgs pa'i khongs nas bde ba dang bar ma'i snang ba dkar dmar sna tshogs su snang ba~X 'di thams cad 'gro ba de dag gi ma rig pas bskyed pa'i lo~Xg rtoga~X bag chags 'khrul pa'i sems kyi rang snang rmi lam lta bu nyida~X la~Xs phyi rol don gzha~Xn tha dad du ༵grub pa ci~X ya~Xng me~Xd do/

/ de skad du yang dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sna tshogs las dang longs spyod dang*/ / bde sdug nyid du snang ba ni/ / sems kyis sprul cing sems kyis byas/ / sems las gzhan du cung zad med/ / dper na rmi lam ji bzhin no/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / gnyis pa ni/ chos thams cad rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stonga~X pa~X nyida~X 'khor 'das ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin gang zag dang chos kyi bda~Xg me~Xd ye~X nas mkhye~Xn pa so so ra~Xng gi ri~Xg pa la mnga' brnyes pa'i thuga~Xs rang byung gi ye shes te/ de la snang ba'i chos rnams la phyi gzung ba'i yul gzhan du dmi~Xgs par bya~X ba dang*/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems bdag tu dmi~Xgs par byeda~X pa gnyis su me~Xd pa~Xr ye shes kyi drana~X pas dba~Xng sgyu~Xr bar byed do/ / de ltar dbang sgyur ba'i chos gzhan las 'phags pas ngo~X mtsha~Xr zhing rmad du byung ba'i sku~X gsum dang ye shes chen po'i gsu~Xng theg par snang ba dang thugs mkhyen pa gnyis dang*/ yo~Xn tana~X tshad med pa dang 'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa dang zhi~Xng kha~Xms bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa yang*/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi ye shes kyi rang snang la~Xs phyogs gzha~Xn na~X rang mtshan du grub pa me~Xd de~X/ ye shes de~X nyida~X sku dang zhing khams dang 'phrin las la sogs par snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa de~X ltara~X snang ba yi~Xn te/ rmad byung rgyal po las/ sangs rgyas sku dang ye shes zhing khams dang*/ / ye shes yon tan 'phrin las ji snyed pa/ / ye shes de nyid de ltar snang ba yin/ / gzhan nas ma yin de ltar lhun gyis grub/ / ces so/ / de ltar thams cad rang snang chen por bkod pa las gzhan ma yin no zhe~Xs rang bzhin rdo~X rje~X gsanga~X ba'i~X rgyud kyi tshi~Xg tu~X'o~X/ / gsum pa skabs kyi don bsdu ba ni zhesa~X brjoda~X pasa~X/ de ltar thugs rje chen po las 'phros pa'i thu~Xb pa~X druga~X gi~X sprula~X pa~X granga~Xs me~Xd pa~X snang bas theg pa du mar bstan pa dnga~X*/

rang snang bkod pa'i de~X bzhina~X gshe~Xgs pa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi~Xs gsu~Xngs pa~X ya~Xng*/ rang bzhin brjod du med kyang sems dang ye shes kyi snang par bstan pa de~X dga~X tu~X 'du~Xs pa~Xr gtso bo gdod ma'i de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X nyida~X kyisa~X mkhyena~X to~X/ / rang bzhin gsa~Xng ba~X'i snyinga~X po~X brjod du med pa'i don de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X nge~Xs pa~X la~Xs/ 'khor 'das kyi cho~Xs thama~Xs ca~Xd snang la rang bzhin med pa'i ngo bo gdod ma nyid nas dag pa'i chos nyid du gtana~X la~X pha~Xb pa~X'i le~X'u~X ste ༵gsu~Xm pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / / / ༈ spyi don gnyis pa de las zhi khro gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor ji ltar 'phros tshul bstan pa la gnyis te/ zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa dang*/ khro bo mngon par 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ gzhi dkyil 'khor bskyed cing dbang bskur ba/ lam bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa/ 'bras bu sku dang ye shes kyi rang bzhin la bstod pa'o/ / dang po la'ang gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rang bzhin spyir bstan pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i thabs bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ rgyu'i yi ge sprin gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa/ de las byung ba ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa/ de gsal bar byed pa gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ yi ge sprin gyi dkyil 'khor dgod pa dang*/ de ltar bsgrub pa'i rim pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung gi don no/ / dang po la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ yi ge'i sgra don/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba'o/ / dang po ni/ ak+ṣa ra'i sgra las/ a ni dgag pa dang*/ k+ṣa ra ni 'gyur ba la 'jug pas/ ngo bo 'gyur ba med cing don gsal bar ston pa'i rten du rung ba'o/ / de la 'dir sgra pa rnams ni yi ge dang*/

yi ge phyi mo gnyis su 'dod pa las/ yi ge ni sgra spyi'i rnam pa ste/ 'chad pa po dang nyan pa po gang rung la rnam spyi der snang ba'o/ / phyi mo ni gzugs su bris pa la 'dod de/ de nyid bklags pa las sgra don gyi rnam spyi'i yi ge bskyed cing snang bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ / mtshan nyid ni mi ldan pa'i 'du byed kyis bsdus pa gang zag gi sgra don gyi rnam pa spyir shar ba'o/ / dbye na dbyangs yig bcu drug dang*/ gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi ste/ de yang thung ngu dang*/ ring po dang*/ shin tu ring po'o/ / thung ngu ni yi ge gcig brjod pa'i tshad de ka zhes pa lta bu'o/ / ring po ni gnyis kyi tshad de kā zhes pa lta bu'o/ / shin tu ring po ni gsum gyi tshad de ai dang au la sogs pa lci ba rnams so/ / de dag la'ang pho mo ma ning gi dbye bas rnam pa gsum mo/ / 'di dag gang las byung zhe na/ mchu dang*/ lce dang*/ rkan dang*/ khong nas 'byung ba ste/ pa/ tsa/ ya/ a zhes pa lta bu'o/ / de dag 'byung ba'i rgyu ni/ smra sgo las/ gnas rnams dang ni byed pa dang*/ / rnam par rtog dang rlung gnyis dang*/ / nga ro gsal byed snang cha yis/ / ngag du 'du byed kun tu bskyed/ / ces pas rgyu bdun po dag las skye ste so sor bshad na/ yang de nyid las/ gnas rnams gzhi yi rgyu yin te/ / byed pa 'byin par byed pa'i rgyu/ / de bzhin rnam rtog bskul ba'i rgyu/ / ji ltar shing la rlung bzhin du/ / byed pa bskyod rgyu pā ya ta*/ / skyes bu dang ni bzhon pa bzhin/ / lhan cig 'byung ba ni shwa swa/ /nga ro rnams dang gsal byed ni/ /kun tu khyab par 'gro ba'i rgyu/ / snang cha 'dra bar 'byung ba ni/ / skal ba mnyam pa'i rgyu zhes bya/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum ste/ yi ge'i ngo bo/ dbye ba/ dgos ched do/ / dang po ni/ sems nyid gdod nas dag pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i rnam par snang ba la sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rten byed

pa'o/ / gang la gnas na sangs rgyas dang sems can so so'i 'khor lo bzhi na rtsa'i nang gi thig le la brten nas so sor gnas te/ de yang kha dog dang yon tan gsal bas 'gro ba'i rnam shes dngas shing dbang po rno la dpal che ba'o/ / yi ge'i gzugs mi gsal bas blun zhing skyon dang ldan pa'o/ / snying ga la sogs par bsgoms pas de'i kha dog dang yon tan 'phel te dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyu byed pa yang de yin no/ / dbye na lus gnas rtsa'i yi ge phro brang lha'i yi ge cho 'phrul sprul pa'i yi ge mtshon byed sgra'i yi ge'o/ / dang por rgyud sde so sor rtsa 'dab 'khor lor yi ge gnas tshul du ma gsungs shing*/ 'dir ni spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum dang*/ snying gar zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi yi ge dang*/ spyi bor khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi yi ge ste rigs brgya'i sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge dang bcas pas brgya dang gsum du gsungs so/ / gnas skabs su 'gro ba drug gi sa bon gyi yi ge ma dag pa drug ni sbyang gzhir bstan te/ lha de dag gi yi ges gnas su dag pa'i thabs su bshad pa'o/ / de'ang spyi bor ram smin mtshams su a dang*/ mgrin par tri/ snying gar nri/ lte bar su/ gsang gnas su pre/ rkang mthil du du rnams 'gro ba drug gi yi ge ste/ de dag la 'gro drug so sor skye ba'i las dang bag chags brten par bshad do/ / sbyang gzhi'i drugasbyong byed brgya dang gsum ni lus la gnas so/ / pho brang lha'i yi ge ni lha bsgom pa'i tshe dkyil 'khor gyi gnas so sor bskyed pa'o/ / sprul pa'i yi ge ni sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje las yi ge sprin 'thon te sprul pa du ma 'phro bas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'o/ / sgra'i yi ge ni sngags su zlos pa ste sgra so sor brjod pa'o/ / dgos pa ni so so'i don bsgrub pa ste/

de'ang rtsa'i yi ges sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i rten byed pa'o/ / lha'i yi ges lha so so'i 'phro gzhi byed pas bskyed rdzogs dag pa'i don byed pa'o/ / sprul pa'i yi ges sems can tshad med pa'i don byed pa'o/ / sgra'i yi ges gsang sngags 'grub pa'i rgyu byed pa'o/ / de'ang skabs 'di'i a'i khongs nas yi ge gzhan rnams 'phro ba yin te/ kun 'dus las/ dbyings las a byung a las ni/ / yi ge'i tshogs rnams ma lus 'phro/ / zhes so/ / 'dir gsal byed rnams tshang yang dbyangs ma tshang ba ni bsdus te/ lha'i rnam grangs dang mthun par sbyar ba yin no/ / de'ang ā ring po ni shad du bsdus/ mtha' ma'i aḥrnam par bcad pa ni tsheg tu bsdus/ ring po'i gong gi a dang am̐ sna dang ldan pa ni o la sbyar nas a dang am̐ gnyis ka ā+om̐ du bsdus/ ma ning gi yi ge ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ bzhi ni gsal byed kyi ra dang lar bsdus pas bzhi bcu zhe gnyis so/ / thog ma'i a lhag pa ni yi ge rnams kyi 'phro gzhi ste/ yi ge bsdus pa'i dbang du gsungs pas o grogs su sbyar ba ste ā+om̐ gyi khongs su gtogs so/ / de ltar yi ge'i 'phreng ba dag ni gnas gang las byung zhe na/ kun 'dus rin po che'i rgyud las/ ka la sogs pa rnam pa lnga/ / mgul gyi gsung gi rang bzhin yin/ / gnyis pa tsa la sogs pa lnga/ / zla gam ljags kyi rang bzhin yin/ / gsum pa ṭa la sogs pa bcu/ / ljags kyi rtse mo'i rang bzhin yin/ / bzhi pa pa la sogs pa ste/ / zhal gyi sgros las 'byung bar bshad/ / skyes bu chen po'i smin ma las/ / 'khor bar gnas pa'i yig 'bru ya/ / skyes bu chen po'i dku skabs las/ / gti mug sel ba'i yig 'bru wa/ / skyes bu chen po'i sta zur las/ / 'dod chags bsreg pa'i yig 'bru ra/ / skyes bu chen po'i dpung pa las/ / rtog pa 'joms pa'i yi ge la/ / thugs las 'khyil pa'i dpal be las/ / mtshan ma dag pa'i yi ge sha

/ phyag gi 'khor lo'i 'od zer las/ / cho 'phrul ston pa'i yi ge ṣa/ / sku yi khru tshad lte ba nas/ / 'dod pa 'byung ba'i yi ge sa/ / zhabs kyi 'khor lo'i 'od zer las/ / sgrib pa bsreg pa'i yig 'bru ha/ / gsang ba mkha' yi rang bzhin nas/ / cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i yi ge k+ṣaḥ/ skyes bu chen po'i spyan gnyis las/ / rang bzhin yi ge i gnyis shar/ / skyes bu chen po'i snyan gnyis las/ / rang bzhin yi ge u gnyis shar/ / skyes bu chen po'i zhabs shangs gnyis las/ / rang bzhin yi ge e gnyis shar/ / skyes bu chen po'i spyi gtsug las/ / rgyal ba'i yi ge ā+oṃ du shar/ / zhes so/ / de'ang yi ge 'di dag sangs rgyas kyi sku las yi ge sprin du 'phro zhing dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i sa bon du byung la/ / sems can gyi rtsa gnas na rang bzhin gyis gnas so/ / de ltar bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi steng du i glang po che'i sna lta bu dang*/ ā ring po mda' lta bu dang*/ tsheg ste aḥdabang phyug chen po'i mig lta bu gsum yi ge rnams kyi khongs na yod pa de so sor bgrangs pas bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'o zhes rong pa gsung la/ kha cig sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge gsum du bzhed de/ yi ge ltar na snga ma ltar gnas kyang*/ lha'i dbang gis phyi ma nyid rigs so zhes pa'ang 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir yi ge'i mgo glang po che'i sna lta bu/ thig le tsheg drag mig lta bu/ shad mda' lta bu nyid la ngos bzung ngo*/ / spyi'i don to/ / gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel dgod/ tshig gi don bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ / dang po ni/ gzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang las thugs rje 'phros te chos thams cad gtan la phab pa'i don gsungs pa de~X na~Xs phyogs bcu dus bzh-i'i de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd yi ge sgyu 'phrul gyi rang bzhin ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i don gyi dgo~Xngs pa~X gci~Xg tu~X gyu~Xr na~Xs chos thams cad dbyer med pa'i mnya~Xm pa~X che~Xn po~X'i tshu~Xl sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las chen po'i rang bzhin rdo~X rje~X'i dbyi~Xngs su~X snang srid 'khor 'das kyi cho~Xs tha~Xms ca~Xd yi ge'i ngo bor ye~X na~Xs sanga~Xs rgya~Xs pa~X'i tinga~X nge~X 'dzi~Xn la~Xs dgongs pa mi~X g.yo~X ba~Xr chos nyid mnyam rdzogs chen po'i don bstan pa'i phyir/

chosa~X tha~Xms ca~Xd don la grub pa med pas mi~Xng tsa~Xm du~X gdod ma nyid nas gna~Xs pa~X'i rang bzhin yi~X ge~X'i phre~Xng ba~X'i 'kho~Xr lo~X zhe~Xs bya~X ba~X 'di~X de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi sku~X da~Xng ga~Xsung da~Xng thu~Xgs rdo~X rje~X la~Xs phyu~Xng ngo~X*/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa la gsum ste/ yi ge 'khor lo'i rang bzhin spyir bstan pa/ lha dang sbyar te bye brag so sor bshad pa/ de gnyis ka'i don bsdu ba'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ yi ge ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul/ yi ge'i sprin ji ltar spros pa'i tshul yi ge'i rang bzhin ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul lo/ / dang po la gnyis te/ bsgom tshul dngos dang*/ de'i phan yon bstan pa'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang*/ de'i las tshogs dang sbyar te ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa dang stong pa nyid du bsam pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du a~Xḥrab ༵tu~X brta~Xn zhing g.yo bar ma gyura~X pa'i rang bzhin du dri ma med pa'i a~X dka~Xr po dngas shing 'tsher ba lasa~X yungs 'bru brgyar gshags pa'i tshad tsam gyi shina~X tu~X phra~X ba'i~X a~X dkar po grangs med pa rna~Xms spro~Xs pas/ phyo~Xgs bcu~X'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yongs su ga~Xng ba~Xr byas pa'i 'od zer gyis snang srid thams cad a'i rnam par gsa~Xl bar gyu~Xr na~Xs/ de thams cad slar rtsa ba'i a nyid la bsdu~Xs shing thim par gyur kya~Xng a de nyid sngon las cher 'phe~Xl ba'am chung du 'griba~X pa me~Xd pa~Xr brtana~X pa'i ngang la dar gcig mnyam par bzhag go / des nas rtsa ba'i a de~X nyid lasa~X minga~X gi yi ge ka la sogs pa sum cu rtsa bzhi'i tsho~Xgs dang sgra'i yi ge dbyangs yig rnams phyogs bcur spros pa'i 'od kyis sems can thams cad yi ge'i rnam par gsala~X zhing 'od zer gyi phung po gcig tu 'ba~Xr bar gyur pa kuna~X slar 'dus a la thim/

yang 'phros pa la sogs pa'i spro~X zhinga~X bsdu~X ba~X'a~Xnga~X snga ma de~X kho na bzhi~Xn no~X/ / de nas slar yang pad+ma'i dbus su nyi ma dang zla ba'i steng na a dang k+ṣa'i mthar rim pa bzhin sa bon rnams bkod la lhar bskyed pa'o/ / de ni bskyed pa'i rim pa rgyu'i yi ge sprin no// gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng na a rab tu brtan pa dkar po las a grangs med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad gang nas/

sems can thams cad a'i rnam par gyur pa slar 'dus snying gi'i a la thim pas 'phel 'grib med pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go / de nas yang mtha' skor gyi yi ge dang a las ming gi yi ge'i tshogs de kho na bzhin 'phros pa slar 'dus 'khor 'das gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid 'phel 'grib med pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go / de ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i yi ge sprin no/ / gsum pa las tshogs dang sbyar ba ni zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang dang drag po la a dang ming gi yi ge rnams dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang mthing nag tu spros te/ nad gdon zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa dang*/ bsgrub bya dgug cing dbang du bya ba dang*/ gdug pa can tshar bcad pa'i las byas nas/ mthar 'phel 'grib med pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go / rgyas par ni le'u lnga pa'i skabs bzhin no/ / de ni las tshogs sgrub pa'i yi ge sprin no/ / gnyis pa de'i phan yon bstan pa ni de lta bu'i bsgom tshul 'di~X ni~X sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las rdo~X rje~X kun tu bzang po'i dngo~Xs gruba~X phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi~X rang bzhin ji ltar 'dod pa thams cad brtana~X par 'byu~Xng ba'i ye~X she~Xs kyi rgyu~X yi~Xn no~X/ / de'i phyir mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'grub pa'o/ / kha cig a rab tu brtan gyur nas 'phel 'grib med par brtan gyi bar yi ge gcig la bslab pa dang*/ de las ming tshogs la sogs pas mang po la bslab pa ste chos sku dang gzugs sku'i rten 'brel lam du byed par 'dod de phyogs tsam las ji lta ba bzhin ma yin te/ yi ge sprin thams cad kyi gzhir 'chad dgos pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa yi ge'i sprin ji ltar spros pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ yi ge spros pa dang*/ ngo mtshar gyi ltas khyad par can snang ba'o/ / dang po ni a~Xḥyi ge rnams kyi 'byung gnas te 'phro gzhi yin pas khongs nas 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du spros te/

de'ang 'byung ba las gyur pa'i gzugs thams cad 'byung ba chen po'i rnam par skye ba bzhin/ yi ge thams cad kyang a'i rnam par skye ste/ 'di ltar ngag gi gzhi ma ni a'o/ / de yang ngag gi 'du byed kyi dbang gis a nyid bkug pa ni i/ smad pa ni u ste rtsa ba gsum mo/ / de las a dang i sbyar bas e/ a dang u sbyar bas o/ bsgrims pas ṛ/ glod pas l̥/ de re re la'ang ring thung gi dbye bas sgra'i yi ge bcu bzhi dang*/ sna dang ldan pa aṃ/ rnam par bcad pa aḥste bcu drug tu 'gyur ro/ / de'ang a'i sgra de nyid mgul pa'i gnas dang phrad pa las ka~X de nyid cung zad zhum zhing spyi bo'i gnas dang phrad pa las kha~X/ de cung zad zhum pas ga~X de khog sbubs kyi gnas dang phrad pas gha~X/ de sna dang phrad pas nga~X ste sangs rgyas kyi mgul gyi bum pa las 'thon pa'o/ / rim pa de nyid las dpags te gzhan la'ang shes par bya'o/ / de la tsa~X tsha~X dza~X dzha~X nya~X rnams ni a de nyid rkan gyi dbus dang lce'i dkyil du phrad pa las byung bas ljags las byung ba'o/ / ṭa~X ṭha~X ḍa~X ḍha~X ṇa~X rnams ni a de nyid lce'i rtse mor nye ba rkan gyi mthar phrad pa las spyi bo'i sgra 'byung bas ljags kyi rtse mo las 'thon no/ / ta~X tha~X da~X ngha~X na~X rnams ni a de nyid lce'i rtse mo dang so phrad pa las byung bas ljags kyi rtse mo dang tshems las 'thon to/ / pa~X pha~X ba~X bha~X ma~X rnams ni a de nyid mchu dang phrad pa las byung bas mchu las 'thon to/ / de dag gi nang tshan gyi bye brag ni ka la sogs pa bzhin no/ / yi ge'i lhag ma dgu ni sde tshan gyi gnas la ya ༵ dang sha ༵ rkan gyi sde'o/ / wa ni mchu'o/ / ra dang ṣa spyi bo'o/ / la dang sa so'i sde'o/ / ha mgul pa'i sde'o/ / k+ṣa mgul pa dang spyi bo'i char gtogs pas de nas 'byung yang*/ gdul bya'i don du 'phro tshul gyi dbang du byas nas/ smin ma las ya~X/ dku'i skabs las wa~X/ sta zur las ra~X/

dpung pa las la~X/ thugs ka las sha~X phyag gi 'khor lo las ṣa~X/ lte ba las sa~X/ zhabs kyi 'khor lo las ha~X/ gsang gnas las k+ṣa~X rnams 'thon to/ / yi ge de dag la a'i sgras khyab pa ni pi wang gi sgra snyan des pi wang gi sgra mtho dman dang drag zhan thams cad la khyab pa bzhin no/ / yang spyan gnyis las i~X ī~X/ snyan gnyis las u ༵ū~X/ shangs gnyis las e~X ai~X/ dbu'i gtsug tor las ā+om̐~X rnams 'thon to/ / gnyis pa ngo mtshar gyi ltas khyad par can snang ba ni yi ge de~X dga~X sku gsung thugs las phyunga~X ba~Xs 'ji~Xg rtena~X druga~X gi~X phyoga~Xs bcu~X mtha~X' ya~Xs pa~X thams cad du yi ge sprin gyi snang ba chen pos shar mtho na nub mda'/ nub mtho na shar dma'/ lho mtho na byang dma'/ byang mtho na lho dma'/ mtha' mtho na dbus dma'/ dbus mtho na mtha' dma' ba'i tshul gyis rnam par 'gyur ba rna~Xm pa~X druga~X tu~X chu~Xng ngur g.yo~Xs pas snang ba thams cad gzugs brnyan gyi rang bzhin du dag par byas/ 'bring du ra~Xb tu ༵g.yo~Xs pas stong pa thams cad ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gsal bar byas/ chen po'i tshul gyis kuna~X tu~X rab tu g.yo~Xs nasa~X gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'khor 'das kyi cho~Xs tha~Xms ca~Xd gang du'ang ma grub pas mi~Xng gi~X mtsha~Xn nyida~X btags pa tsama~X du~X gyura~X to~X/ / de nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa nyid mchog tu dgyes pas ho~X zhes mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du bzhag pa'o/ / gsum pa yi ge'i rang bzhin ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul la drug ste/ yi ge gsungs pa'i rgyu brjod pa/ skye ba med pa yi ge'i 'khor lor sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa thams cad 'dus pas chos kyi skur bstan pa/ yi ge bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis a'i rang bzhin du 'dus pas yi ge mngon rdzogs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgyas par bstan pa/ yi ge nyid kun gyi 'byung gnas su gyur pas rol pa sna tshogs su 'char ba'i phyir sprul pa'i skur bstan pa/

de nyid du rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'dus pas dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i rdzogs tshul bstan pa/ sems nyid snang stong gnyis su med par yi ge'i sgra don bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ yi ge'i sprin spros pa de~X na~Xs de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi~Xs yi ge sprin gyi che~Xd du~X brjo~Xd pa~X 'di~X skad ces brjo~Xd do~X/ / gnyis pa ni/ yi ge a~X ni~X yi ge rnams kyi 'byung gnas snang ba'i cha tsam ma dor bas stonga~X pa'i mthar yang ma grub pa dnga~X*/ de nyid dngos po mtshan mar med pas mi~X sto~Xng ba zhes kyang dmigs su med pa gang gi~X tshe/ de gnyis kyi rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'o zhes pa'i dbu~X ma~X'anga~X dmi~Xgs su~X yo~Xd pa ma~X yi~Xn te/ ltos sa snang ba dang stong pa'i rang bzhin las 'das pa'i phyir ro/ / de ltar chos thama~Xs ca~Xd mi~Xng tsama~X las smra bsam spros brjod kyi ngo bor ma grub pa ni sa~Xngs rgya~Xs kuna~X gyi dgongs pa ste/ de nyid yi~X ge~X'i phrenga~X ba~X nyida~X kyi ngang la~X gna~Xs so/ / de'i gnas lugs ni chos sku lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin no/ / gsum pa ni/ yi ge thams cad kyi 'byung khungs a~X nyida~X rkyen gyis yi ge'i rnam pa sna~X tshoga~Xs para~X snanga~X ba'i~X rang bzhin yin te/ sngar bstan pa ltar rtsa ba'i a las bkug pas i/ smad pa u gsum gyi khongs nas/ a dang i las e/ a dang u la o ste dbyangs lnga/ bsgrims pas ṛ/ glod pas l̥/ de dag kyang thabs dang shes rab gnyis su phye bas bcu bzhi/ thabs gsal bor ston pa aṃ/ shes rab gsal bor ston pa aḥste ā li zhes bya'o/ / a nyid mgrin pa/ rkan/ lce rtse/ so/ mchu rnams la brten te brjod pas/ ka tsa ṭa ta pa/ de rnams sgra drag tu bos pa las/ kha tsha ṭha tha pha/ zhan du bos pa las/ ka dza ḍa da ba/ de dag cher bos pa las/ gha dzha ḍha dha bha/ de dag sna dang ldan par brjod pas/ nga nya ṇa na ma ste sde tshan lnga 'byung ngo*/ / de dag dang mthun par ya dang sha ni rkan las/

ra dang ṣa ni lce rtse bsgyur ba las/ la dang sa ni so las/ wa ni mchu las/ ha ni mgrin pa las/ k+ṣa ni spyi bo las so/ / a'i sgra de nyid mgul pa'i gnas sogs dang phrad pas ka~X la~X so~Xgs pa~X bzhi~X bcu~X rtsa gnyi~Xs su kā li dang ā li'i sgra'i~X mi~Xng gi~Xs brjod pa thama~Xs ca~Xd bsdusa~X pa ni ye nas mngo~Xn par rdzoga~Xs par byang chub pa'i rgyala~X po~X a skye ba med pa chos kyi skur sangs rgyas pas na/ a sangs rgyas pa bzhin du a'i ngang las 'phros pa'i yi ge bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis po de~X nyida~X kyang sangs rgyas par nge~Xs te ngo bo gcig gi rol pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / don la a ni kun tu bzang mo'i dbyings so/ / yi ge bcu bzhi rtsa gnyis ni de'i ngang las 'phros pa'i sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis so/ / de'i rang bzhin ni yi ge longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bstan pa yin no/ / bzhi pa la gnyis te/ yi ge tshig gi 'byung khungs su bstan pa dang*/ yi ge'i rol pa sna tshogs su 'char tshul bstan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ ngo bo chos skur gnas pas e~X ma~X ho~X rang bzhin longs skur snang bas ngo~X mtsha~Xr thugs rje sprul skur shar bas ya~X mtsha~Xn pa'i don gyi~X yi ge sprin gyi 'khor lo ni rdzu 'phrula~X chena~X po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin bzhi~X bcu~X rtsa~X gnyis kyi steng du mgo tsheg shad gsum bsnan pas bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i~X tshogs rnams ni minga~X dang tshi~Xg rna~Xms ma~X lus ༵pa 'dzi~Xn pa ༵ 'i gna~Xs yin no/ / ji ltar 'dzin na dper na gzugs kyi mtha' rdul phran/ rdul phran 'dus pa las gong bu ste/ rdul phran ni gong bu 'dzin pa'i gnas yin pa bzhin du/ ming gi mthar thug pa ni yi ge yin no/ / yi ge 'dus pa las dbyangs a gcig gis bcings pa'i yi ge ka lta bu de dpyad 'grub bo/ / de 'dus pas ka ba dang bum pa la sogs pa dngos po rnams kyi ming 'grub bo/ / de 'dus pas tshig gi tshogs ma lus pa 'grub pas na/

yi ge rnams ni ming tshig gi gnas so/ / de las theg pa'i chos sna~X tshoga~Xs pa'i dona~X che~Xn po ngag tu smra~X zhi~Xng gzhan la stona~X pa'i phyir yi ge tshig don ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas su ye nas grub pa yin no/ / gnyis pa ni/ rags pa'i dngo~Xs por grub pa me~Xd pa yi~X ge~X'i ra~Xng bzhi~Xn rang gi se~Xms nyid 'od gsal ba ste/ gang zag dang chos kyi bda~Xg me~Xd cing spros pa'i mtha~X' thams cad dang brala~X ba'i chos nyid ye gdod ma nyid nas dngos po dang mtshan ma'i chos su mi~X dm-i~Xgs kyanga~X*/ snang ba'i rang bzhin chu zla ltar gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyi sku dang sems can gyi rtsa gnas 'khor lo rnams na yi ge de dag gi dbyi~Xbs snang la rang bzhin med par gnas te/ a seng ge bsgyings pa lta bu dnga~X*/ ka ba dan brtsegs pa lta bu la sogs par gnas shing*/ kha~X do~Xg kyang ā li rnams dmar po dang*/ kā li rnams dkar po'i rang bzhin du gnas so/ / de dag bsgoms pa las rnal 'byor ba'i lam dang 'bras bu'i don yang rdzogs par byed pa ni nang don gyi yi ge'i mdzad pa'o/ / sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs na yi ge'i sprin kha dog dang dbyibs dang ming dang tshig rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i rol pa cir yang sprul cing 'gro ba'i skal ba dang mthun par chos kyi rnam grangs dpag tu med pa ston par mdzad pa'o/ / 'di ltar snang ba gzugs brnyan gyi yi ge'i glegs bam gyi kha dog dang dbyibs dang m-i~Xng tshig gi tsho~Xgs kyi~Xs kyang 'gro ba'i don mthun par sgrub pa ni yi ge 'khor lo'i mdzad pa yin zhing*/ lha'i sa bon bsgoms pa'i yi ge las kyang gsang sngags 'grub pa ni yi ge 'khor lo'i sprul pa ste/ de ltar na yi ge sprin sprul pa nyid du'ang gnas so/ / lnga pa dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa lnga rdzogs par bstan pa ni phyo~Xgs bcu~X du~Xs bzhi~Xr snga phyi da lta 'gro ba'i don la gshe~Xgs pa~X'i~X sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba rang byung gi ye ༵she~Xs se~Xms dpa~X'i sku~X'i dkyil 'khor ni sku'i sku/

sku'i gsung*/ sku'i thugs re re la'ang yon tan 'phrin las gnyis bsnan nas lnga lngar phye bas bco lnga/ de bzhin du gsu~Xng dang thu~Xgs la'ang bco lnga bco lnga ste rigs lnga'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr bzhi~X bcu~X rtsa~X lnga ༵po de nyi~Xd yi~X ge~X'i mgo~X a na~Xs mjug k+ṣa~X'i bar la~X rdzo~Xgs pas rigs kyi dkyil 'khor ji snyed pa'i dbye ba yang yi ge 'khor lo nyid la tshang zhing 'dus pas dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin no/ / 'di la kha cig yi ge bzhi bcu rtsa lnga nyid du 'chad pa de dag gis ni yi ge 'khor lo la dkyil 'khor rigs 'dus par bshad pa'i phyogs tsam yang ma mthong bar zad do/ / drug pa sems nyid yi ger snang pa'i nges tshig bshad pa la gsum ste/ sems nyid skye ba med pa yi ge'i don du bstan pa/ skye ba med pa nyid kyi ngang las yi ger snang bas yon tan lhun gyis grub tshul/ snang stong gnyis su med pa'i yi ge gang gis bris shing bkod tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ se~Xms kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba de nyida~X ranga~X bzhina~X lhun gyis grub pa'i yi~X ge~X ste~X/ yi~X ge~X de nyid la dngo~Xs po~X dang mtshan mar grub pa yo~Xd pa ma~X yi~Xn te/ mtshan brjod las/ a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchogakhong nas 'byung ba skye ba med/ / don chen yi ge dam pa ste/ / brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog/ tshig kun rab tu gsal bar byed/ / ces pa dang*/ mdo las/ rab 'byor yi ge ni don dam par ma skyes pa ste a'i ngo bo nyid do/ / a'i ngo bo nyid gang yin pa de ni sems kyi rang bzhin te dngos po dang dngos po med pa thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa'o/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / gnyis pa ni/ sems nyid dmi~Xgs su me~Xd pa don dam pa'i yi ge de~X nyida~X 'od gsal pa'i khams sna~X tsho~Xgs pa'i~X phyir/ rten byed pa'i sku'i~X 'khor lo chen po go brda sprod pa'i gsu~Xng gi 'kho~Xr lo~X che~Xn po mnyam par 'jog pa thu
