chos nyid de~X bzhi~Xn nyid kyi dbyi~Xngs la~Xs ma~X g.yo~Xs kyanga~X sku gzhan gyi 'char gzhi byed pa'o/ / de'i ngang las sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa las ya~Xng dga~X par thara~X pa'i gzu~Xgs sku~X mtshan dang dpe byad phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang ༵/ de'i thugs rje las 'phros pas 'gro~X ba~X ma~X lusa~X pa~X so~X so~X'i rgyud ji ltar 'dula~X ba~X'i phyira~X de dag gi bsam pa dang mthuna~X par byasa~X pa'i sku~X ni~X 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ smad 'tshong dang*/ nyan rang dang bem po nya pa dang gdol pa la sogs pa'i gzugs rnam pa sna~X tsho~Xgs su stona~X pa'o/ / gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du 'phrin las snang ba'i dpe/ gdul bya'i don du 'phrin las snang ba'i tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ de ltar sprul pa sna tshogs pa gdul bya la stona~X pa de nyida~X kun rdzob tu sgyu~X ma~X dang m-iga~X yo~Xr te grib ma ltar snang dus nyid nas ngos gzung med pa'i tshula~X ni don dam par ma skyes shing gdod nas dag pa'i ngang tshula~X can spros pa dang bral ba nyid ༵kyis chos kyi dbyi~Xngs lasa~X g.yo~Xs pa~X meda~X pa'o/ / de ltar ma~X g.yo~Xs bzhi~Xn du~X 'gro ba'i snang ngor sprul pa'i sku sna~X tsho~Xgs pa~X'i rnam pa so sor snang ba de'i~X tshe~X rgyal po dang bram ze la sogs pa dang zhi ba dang khro bo la sogs pa rnam pa mi~X mthu~Xn pa'i sku sna~X tsho~Xgs pa~X dag gdul bya so~X so~X'i rigs dang 'dra~X ba~Xr snanga~X ba~X ni~X/ chos sku de~X bzhi~Xn nyida~X kyi~X dbyings las ma~X g.yo~Xs kyanga~X 'gro ba rang rang gi skal ba dang sngon gyi la~Xs 'phro~X'i dba~Xng gi~Xs sar gnas la rang bzhin sprul pa dang*/ 'gro ba kha cig la 'gro 'dul sprul pa dang*/ kha cig la ma dag sprul pa dang*/ kha cig la sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku la sogs pa so~X so~Xr sna~Xng ba ste/ dpe~Xr na~X me~X lo~Xng gi ngos la byad ma 'phos kyang de'i rnam pa snang ba dang*/

chu snod du nam mkha'i zla ba ma 'phos kyang chu~X zla~X snang ba bzhi~Xn no/ / de skad du'ang phal po che las/ zla ba dbyings las ma 'phos kyang*/ / chu yi snod du snang ba ltar/ / de bzhin nyid las ma g.yos par/ / sprul pa bye ba bsam mi khyab/ / la lar sangs rgyas nyung ba dang*/ / la lar mang zhing rgya che la/ / la lar zhing rnams stong par ston/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / gnyis pa la bzhi las/ 'gro drug tha mal la snang tshul ni lhun stug po bkod par sku gsum 'du 'bral med par sangs rgyas pa de'i~X tshe~X lha la sogs pa'i 'gro~X druga~X tha mal pa thama~Xs ca~Xd la~X de dag gi rgyud kyi sdi~Xg pa spo~Xng ba'i gzu~Xgs brgya byin la sogs pa'i thub pa rnams su~X rnama~X pa~Xr bstana~X nas lha dang mi'i sgrib pa sbyong ba la sogs pa'i chos ston to/

/ nyan thos la snang tshul ni dge~X sbyong gi tshula~X tu snang bas gdul ba'i 'gro ba nyan thos kyi rigs can rnama~Xs la~X nyan thos dgra~X bco~Xm pa'i gzu~Xgs su bstan nas bden pa bzhi'i don rtogs pa la 'god par mdzad de/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang dag nyan thos kyis gdul bar bya ba rnams la ni nyan thos kyi gzugs su 'dug ste chos ston to/ / zhes so/ / rang rgyal la snang ba'i tshul ni ranga~X rgyala~X gyi gzugs kyis gdul bar rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnamasa~X la~X bse~X ru~X lta bu'i~X tshu~Xl gyis rten 'brel gyi chos brdas ston par/ de nyid las/ gang dag rang sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis gdul bar bya ba de dag la ni rang sangs rgyas kyi gzugs su 'dug ste rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang ldan pa'i chos brdas yang dag par ston to/ / zhes so/ / theg pa chen po la snang tshul ni tshul de dag las gzha~Xn ya~Xng the~Xg pa mcho~Xg gi dbang po'i ri~Xm pa~X bzhi~Xn/ sa bcu pa'i sems dpa' la so sor snang tshul ni/ gnas phun sum tshogs dbang phyug chen po'i 'o~Xg mi~Xn bla~X na med pa'i gna~Xs gzugs khams las khyad par du 'phags pa'i mcho~Xg tu~X/ ston pa nyid sku~X ni~X rnama~X para~X snanga~X mdza~Xd kyi tshula~X tu bzhugs pa la/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa sa bcu'i byanga~X chuba~X se~Xms dpa'i~X 'kho~Xr rnama~Xs la~X chos phun sum tshogs pa theg pa chen po/ dus phun sum tshogs pa mnyam pa nyid 'pho 'gyur med pa'i tshe ston pa'o/ / de'ang sngar 'gro ba tha dad la snang ba sprul pa'i sku'i chos rnams tshig tu ston par snang ba de~X bzhi~Xn du longs sku'i ston pa nyid chos rnams gsunga~X du~X mi~X smra~X ste/ sku~X snang ba de nyid kyi ngo bo yisa~X theg pa chen po'i cho~Xs rnama~Xs 'khor gyi blo la mja~Xl ba~Xr stona~X to/ / gsum pa de las 'gro ba grol tshul la gnyis te/ rgyu lam gyi sgrib pa sbyang ba/

'bras bu sku dang sa mchog thob tshul lo/ / dang po la gnyis las/ dpe ni gdong la me~X lo~Xng bstana~X pa~X'i tshe rang gi byad snang ba'i tshula~X gyis dri ma mthong ba bzhi~Xn du~X/ slar byad dngo~Xs kyi~X dri mas gos pa'i mdo~Xg nga~Xn pa thama~Xs ca~Xd 'khru zhing se~Xl ba ltar/ don ni sa bcu'i sems dpa'i 'kho~Xr gyi~Xs dpe de~X bzhi~Xn du ston pa longs sku'i sku~X la blta~Xs pa na~X/ bya~Xng chuba~X la sgṛba~X pa~X'i dri ma che 'bring phra ba dang bcas pa gtinga~X dpa~Xg dka' zhing tshad me~Xd pa rnams/ me~X lo~Xng nang gi dri ma snang ba bzhi~Xn du~X longs sku'i sku~X la~X snanga~X ngo*/ / de~X na~Xs sems dpa' de dag sa de'i dri ma sbyong ba la brtson par byed do/ / de yang sa dang por ser sna/ gnyis par tshul khrims 'chal ba/ gsum par khong khro/ bzhi par le lo/ lnga par rnam g.yeng*/ drug par shes rab 'chal ba/ bdun par thabs mi mkhas pa/ brgyad par sems can gyi don mi 'grub pas stobs la sgrib pa/ dgu par smon pa'i don mi 'grub pa/ bcu par mi shes pa phra mo'i sa bon dang bcas pa pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang sa'i yongs su sbyong bas sbyangs pas/ sa~X bcu'i~X dri ma rnams ri~Xm gyi~Xs sbyanga~Xs shing*/ bla~X me~Xd byanga~X chuba~X ya~Xng da~Xg par tho~Xb ste| sa bcu'i rgyun gyi tha mar 'od zer chen po'i dbang skur bar byed de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sgom pa tha ma thob nas ni/ / 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur ro/ / zhes pas/ sems dpa' des sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa na/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi smin mtshams nas 'od zer chen po byung nas sems dpa' de'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu nub pas rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob ste 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'o/ / gnyis pa la gsum ste/ lhun stug po bkod par sku dang ye shes rdzogs tshul spyir bstan/ de la sa'i rdzogs tshul bye brag tu bshad/ sku lnga lhun gy-is grub tshul du don bsdu ba'o/

/ dang po la gnyis las/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i thob tshul ni/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin cho~Xs kyi sku~X ni blos dpa~Xg tu me~Xd cing tshig gis brjo~Xd du~X me~Xd pa'i ngo bo nyid do/ / de nyid kyi ngang las lo~Xngs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku~X ni rtag tu lhun gyis grub par bzhugs pas za~Xd pa me~Xd pa'i yi~Xd bzhi~Xn gyi nor bu rin cen gyi gtera~X du bzhugs so/ / de'i ngang las gdul bya'i don du sprula~X pa~X'i sku bye~X ba~X khrag khrig dpag tu med cing bsa~Xm gyisa~X mi~X khyaba~X pa 'phro bar byed do/ / gnyis pa rang snang lhun grub chen por bzhugs tshul ni/ de ltar snang ba'i longs sku de yang mtsha~Xn da~Xng dpe~X bya~Xd thama~Xs ca~Xd rdzoga~Xs shing*/ dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rang snang ba'i spyoda~X yula~X kuna~X tu~X sku dang ye shes kyi ma~Xṇ+ḍala~X te dkyil 'khor du snang ba nyid las bzang ngan med pa'i rang bzhin du lhun gyis grub cing*/ de ltar phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rang snang bas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ gang du'ang 'dzin pa mi mnga' bas ye shes kyi tshogs te tsho~Xgs che~Xn gnyisa~X kyanga~X rang snang de nyid du lhun rdzoga~Xs chen po~Xr ro~Xl pa'o/ / gnyis pa sa'i rdzogs tshul ni thaba~Xs sprul pa sku'i sa kun tu 'od da~Xng*/ she~Xs ra~Xb rang snang dag pa longs spyod rdzogs pa pad+ma can gyi sa dang*/ gnyis su med pa sa~X yi~X mcho~Xg 'khor lo tshogs chen chos kyi sku'i sa'o/ / sa'i rnam grangs dang yon tan gyi chos de~X dag la~X so~Xgs te~X tshad med cing bsa~Xm ya~Xs kyi mcho~Xg rnams yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ / de la 'dir sa'i ngo bo mi shes pa kha cig kun tu 'od chos sku/ pad+ma can longs sku/ 'khor lo tshogs chen sprul skur 'dod pa de ni dbyings ma go ba'i rnam 'gyur te gong nas gong gi yon tan gyi cha la btags pa ma mthong ba'o/ / de'ang sprul pa kun tu tshad med pas kun tu 'od dang*/

snang ba tshad med pas pad+ma can dang*/ ye shes tshad med pas 'khor lo tshogs chen te/ dbyings skye ba med pa na rang byung 'gags pa med pa yi ge'i sa bon ltar 'phro gzhir gnas pas yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen zhes bshad do/ / yi ge sprin ni ma yin te/ gnyis su med pa'i chos sku yin pa'i phyir ro/ / gzhan dag yi ge 'khor lo'i sgras sprul pa'i rang bzhin yi ge sprin dang 'khrul pa yin no/ / 'dir thabs zhags las/ kun tu 'od kyi sa las 'das/ / pad+ma can du gyur pa na/ / zhes pas sa gong 'og tu don la khyad zhugs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ don la gcig kyang yon tan dang snang ba 'char tshul gong 'og gi khyad kyis de skad btags pa yin no/ / zhes bshad zin to/ / gsum pa sku lnga lhun gyis grub tshul du don bsdu ba ni/ de ltar sa de dag thob pa'i tshe sku lnga yang lhun grub tu thob pas na dang po chos kyi sku spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba ni 'gyur ba med pa'i yongs grub ste skye~X shi~X me~Xd pa~X'i chos nyid g.yunga~X drunga~X ste rtag pa'i sku~X lhun gyis grub pa'o/ / de nyid kyi ngang las longs skur shar ba'i byin rlabs las rang byung ba nyona~X mo~Xngs pa'i sems can kun gyi~X gdul zhinga~X du~X gang la gang 'tsham pa'i sprul sku gna~Xs te don mdzad pa'o/ / sprul sku'i 'char gzhi de nyid yon tan gyi tshogs za~Xd mi~X she~Xs pa~X'i rang bzhin lhun stug po bkod pa'i longs spyod kun gyi gtera~X du~X 'gyura~X ba ni longs sku'o/ / de ltar sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rang bzhin ni gnyis su med pa'i rdo~X rje~X dang ri~Xg pa~X'i ye shes chen po 'dzi~Xn pa~Xs mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku'o~X/ / chos thama~Xs ca~Xd ye nas rdzogs pa chen po'i rang bzhin du dbye~Xr me~Xd ci~Xng mnyama~X pa nyid du mngon par byang chub pa~X'i sku~X ni ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang*/ chos can thama~Xs ca~Xd kyang ma 'dres par mkhye~Xn pa~X'i ye~X she~Xs ni ji snyed pa mngon par byang chub pa'i sku~X ste mngon par byang chub kyi sku'o/

/ de dag kyang rigs lnga ye shes lnga'i sku ste/ g.yung drung gi sku ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi sku'o/ / longs sku zad mi shes pa'i chos nyid rdo rje rig pa 'dzin pa'i sku ni rdo rje'i rigs te me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi sku'o/ / thams cad dbyer med mnyam pa'i sku ni rin cen rigs te mnyam nyid ye shes kyi sku'o/ / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi sku ni pad+ma'i rigs te so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi sku'o/ / nyon mongs kun gyi zhing du gnas pa ni sprul pa ste las kyi rigs bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi sku'o/ / sa thob pa de~X'i tshe~X sku~X lnga~X po kuna~X kya~Xng rdzo~Xgs par thob pa yin te/ 'bras bu'i sa dang sku dang ye shes rnams chas dbye ba las snga phyi med do/ / de'ang yon tan gyi rten du gyur pas sa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi lus su gyur pas sku dang*/ rang byung gi rig par gnas pas ye shes dang*/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad pas 'phrin las zhes so sor btags kyang ngo bo gcig ste/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pas dngos po dang*/ 'jig pas mi rtag pa dang*/ chu skyor bas bum par btags pa rnams ngo bo gcig pa bzhin no/ / bzhi pa ngo mtshar gyi ltas kyi snang tshul ni/ de skad ce~Xs brjo~Xd pa~Xs/ gdul bya'i 'ji~Xg rtena~X druga~X gi~X phyoga~Xs bcu~X re re zhing grangs mtha~X' ya~Xs shi~Xng mu~X me~Xd pa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd du~X rnam par 'phrul pa'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr bsam gyis mi khyab brjo~Xd kyi~Xs mi~X la~Xng ba~X phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhinga~X gi~X rdula~X phra rab kyi grangs ji snyeda~X dang mnyam pa de tsam du~X gsa~Xl cing snang ba~Xr gyura~X to~X/ / gsum pa 'bras bu ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ tshul ji ltar gsungs pa dang*/ ngo bo gang gsungs pa'o/ / dang po ni/ thams cad dkyil 'khor du gsal ba de~X na~Xs rang snang gi de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X btsu~Xn mo~X'i tsho~Xgs dnga~X rang bzhin gnyi~Xs su~X me~Xd pa~X'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr de~X da~Xg las de bzhin gshegs pa nyida~X kyi~X gsa~Xng ba ༵'di~X nyida~X sku~X da~Xng gsu~Xng dang thuga~Xs dang yo~Xn tana~X dang 'phri~Xn la~Xs rdo~X rje~X la~Xs 'di skad ces byunga~X ngo~X*/

/ gnyis pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin rang snang ba'i dkyil 'khor ngo mtshar ba'i rol pa dbyings las ma g.yos par bstan pa'i phyir a~X ho~X zhes pa'o/ / de'ang dmi~Xgs par bya~X ba'i yul chos rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa dang*/ dmi~Xgs par byeda~X pa'i blo glo bur kun brtags kyis rnam par dag pa dang*/ de gnyis ka'i ngo bo gnyis su med pa'i ye shes tsam du'ang mi~X dmi~Xgs pa ni/ don dam pa'i rang bzhin blos dpa~Xg tu me~Xd cing bsa~Xm gyis mi~X khyaba~X pa gzhi rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor ro/ / ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum sngon du 'gro bas bskyed pa'i lha'i rang bzhin chu'i zla ba ltar bsgom pa'i ye~X she~Xs ra~Xng ri~Xg pa'i dkyila~X 'khora~X rnam pa sna~X tsho~Xgs brjoda~X kyi~Xs mi~X la~Xng ba bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin chos nyid du mnyama~X pa nyid dnga~X mya ngan las 'das pa dmigs pa nye bar zhu bas mi~X mnyama~X pa'i ngo bo kuna~X la ye nas dag pa'i de bzhin nyid kyis khya~Xb bya khya~Xb byed me~Xd pa'i rang bzhin te/ chos nyid rdzogs pa chen pos khyaba~X pa~X'i dbyi~Xngs de bzhin nyid bskyed rdzogs tsam du'ang 'dzin pa med par mnyam par bzhag pa ni lam bskyed rdzogs bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ / de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i mthar 'bras bu gzhi thog tu phyin pa de'i tshe ye~X na~Xs snang ba kuna~X tu 'od gsa~Xl ba'i longs sku 'gag pa med pa'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr las/ sna tshogs sprul pa sku'i dkyil 'khor rnama~X par 'phro~X bas 'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzad do/ / de ltar sku de gnyis ni rnam par 'phro ba dang mi 'phro bar gnas pa ltar snang ba nyid nas rang bzhin sprosa~X pa~X me~Xd pa ni chos kyi sku ste nam mkha' lta bu'i chos nyid ngo mtshar bar bstan pas ho~X zhe~Xs rdo~X rje~X gsa~Xng ba~X'i tshi~Xg 'di nyid du~X gsungs pa'o~X/ / de bzhin du gzhi lam 'bras bu re re zhing yang gnas te/

gzhi ltar na dmigs bya yul dmigs byed blo de gnyis ka'i rang bzhin ye nas dmigs pa med pa'i sems nyid dpag tu med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'od gsal gyi ngang na/ ye shes rang rig gi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs brjod kyis mi lang ba ye nas gnas pa de yang*/ chos nyid mnyam pa dang chos can tha dad mi mnyam pa kun la khyab pa'i rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid ni khyab med khyab pa chen po'i dbyings te/ ye nas kun gsal gyi dkyil 'khor lhun grub chen po 'gro ba kun la 'phro yang spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin ngo mtshar to zhes so/ / de'ang de bzhin nyid ni kun la khyab pa'i ngo bo yin te/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ / nam mkha' dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa'i/ / dngos po thams cad de yin te/ / nam mkha' kun gyi dbyings na dpal/ / rdo rje sems dpa' rtag tu bzhugs/ / zhes so/ / lam ltar na dmigs bya ting nge 'dzin dmigs byed rang gi blo de gnyis ka'i ngo bo mi dmigs pa de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ kun tu snang gi ting nge 'dzin snying rje dpag tu med pa dang*/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin snying rje'i ngang las sems nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi ge'i rang bzhin a la sogs pa'i ngo bo las/ ye shes rang rig gi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs brjod kyis mi lang ba bsgoms nas/ de thams cad sems nyid du mnyam pas stong pa dang*/ rnam pa tha dad pa bskyed pa mi mnyam pa snang ba dang*/ de nyid kyi ngo bo ma skyes pas kun khyab khyab med khyab pa'i dbyings ye nas kun gsal gyi ngang las/ dkyil 'khor gyi spro bsdu mang po rnam par 'phro yang*/ don la spros pa med pa'i ngang du shes pa ste/ zla gsang thig le las/ sems dpa' kun gyi dngos po ni/ / rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog / de nyid dngos po thams cad kyi/ /thams cad du ni yan lag bzhugs/ / zhes so/ / 'bras bu ltar bshad na/

dbyings dmigs bya dmigs byed dmigs pa med cing dpag med bsam gyis mi khyab pa chos sku'i ngang las/ rang snang ye shes rig pa'i dkyil 'khor sna tshogs brjod kyis mi lang bar gsal ba rnams kyi ngo bo mnyam pa nyid dang*/ bkod pa dang rnam pa mi mnyam pa kun la khyab pa'i chos nyid khyab bya khyab byed khyab pa med pa'i dbyings ye nas kun gsal longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku las/ sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor 'phro yang chu zla ltar ma 'phos par dbyings de nyid las spros pa med pas sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i chos nyid ngo mtshar bar bstan pa'o/ / de ltar snang ba'i sangs rgyas dang sems can yang don la ma skyes par mnyam pa nyid de/ sdong po bkod pa las/ gang zhig bdag dang sangs rgyas rnams/ / rang bzhin mnyam par rab gnas shing*/ / mi gnas len pa med pa ste/

/ de dag de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / ting nge 'dzin gsa~Xng ba'i~X snyinga~X po~X rang snang ba'i de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X nge~Xs pa~X lasa~X/ rang bzhin ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr sprosa~X pa'i~X le~X'u~X ste~X druga~X pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / / / ༈ don gnyis pa de'i yan lag sngags dang phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sku phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ gsung gi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba'i rgyu brjod/ gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor dngos bstan/ rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa'o/ / dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa de~X nasa~X de'i~X ya~Xn la~Xg sngags kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i phyir/ de~X bzhina~X gshe~Xgs pa~X btsu~Xn mo'i~X tshoga~Xs da~Xng ba~Xcas pa~X tha~Xms ca~Xd kyi~X sku~X dnga~X gsu~Xng dnga~X thuga~Xs rdo~X rje~X la~Xs gsang sngags 'di~X dga~X phyunga~X ngo~X*/ / gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i sngags dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i sngags so/ / dang po la bzhi ste/ rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i sngags dang*/ brten pa lha bskyed pa'i sngags dang*/ 'phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i sngags dang*/ ngo mtshar gyi ltas ji ltar snang ba'i tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ bh+rūm̐ bi~X shwa~X bi~X shu~Xd+dhe~X zhes pas te/ bh+rūm̐ ni rnam snang dang*/ bum pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i sa bon du gyur pa las/ 'dir ni gzhi tshad med pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i steng du gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang pa yang rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo yin pa dang*/ bum pa yang gzhal yas khang pa yin pas na bh+rūm̐ las bskyed pa'o/ / sngon sangs rgyas gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur bas sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi don du gzhal yas khang pa'i smon lam btab pas na de nyid mtshon pa'o/ / de'ang 'grel chung las/

gtsug tor 'khor los smon lam rang gi sngags/ / zhes so/ / 'od rim las/ dkyil 'khor sna tshogs bh+rūm̐ du 'phro/ /yongs gyur ye shes gzhal yas khang*/ / zhes pa'i don to/ / de'ang phyi lha'i khang pa/ nang lha'i sa bon/ gsang ba yum gyi bha ga ste/ thal ba'i rgyud las/ bh+rūm̐ dbyings bha gar sna tshogs 'dus/ / las dang ngo bo dag pa nyid*/ / sangs rgyas rin cen za ma tog/ ces so/ / bi shwa ni sna tshogs te 'khor 'das kyi chos su snang ba thams cad bi shud+dhe rang bzhin gyis dag pa ste/ chos dbyings spros pa dang bral ba de nyid sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs gnas su bstan pas/ 'dir de mtshon par byed pas gzhal yas khang pa'o/ / gnyis pa lha bskyed pa'i sngags la drug las/ dang po rigs lnga yab yum gyi sngags ni hūm̐ badz+ra dh+rik la sogs pa lnga tshan gnyis te/ de yang yab kyi sngags so so'i dang po hūm̐~X ā+o~Xṃ swā ā~Xṃ hā~X lnga ni rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags te skyed par byed pa'i sa bon no/ / de nyid sku lnga ye shes lnga la sogs pa'i rang bzhin yin te/ gsang 'dus las/ rdo rje 'dzin dang rgyal ba'i rgyal/ / rin cen 'dzin dang chags chen mtshon/ / shes rab 'dzin pa zhes bya ste/ / zhes pa dang*/ dgongs 'dus las/ sku mtshon par byed pa la ni oṃ zhes tha snyad du byas so/ / zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ / ba~Xdz+ra~X dh+ri~Xk la sogs pa ni de dag gi rang bzhin mtshon pa ngo bo'i sngags so/ / badz+ra ni snang stong gnyis su med pas rdo rje ste dh+rig ni de nyid 'dzin par byed pas na mi bskyod pa'o/ / dzi~X na~X dzig~Xde bzhin du/ ra~Xt+na~X rin po che/ dh+ri~Xg ni 'dzin pa ste 'gro ba la 'dod dgu sbyin pas rin cen 'byung ldan no/ / a~X ro~X li~Xg ni gdul bya la rjes su chags pas 'od dpag med do/ / pra~Xdz+nya~X dh+ri~Xg ni gdul bya'i don du shes rab sna tshogs 'chang bas don yod grub pa'o/ / yum gyi sngags so so'i dang po mū~Xm̐ lā~Xm̐ mā~Xm̐ pyā~Xm̐ tā~Xm̐ lnga ni yum lnga'i rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags te bskyed pa'i sa bon

no/ / de'i rang bzhin gyi ngo bo ni mū~Xm̐ dhā~X tu~X shwa~X ri~X ni rang bzhin gyis dag pa dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'o/ / lā~Xm̐ te~X ṣa ra~X ti~X sangs rgyas thams cad kyi blon mo ste sangs rgyas spyan no/ / mā~Xm̐ mo~X ha~X ra~X te sems can bdag gir byed pas mā ma kī'o/ / pyā~Xm̐ rā~X ga~X ra~X ti~X nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos pas gos dkar mo'o/ / tā~Xm̐ badz+ra~X ra~X ti~X sems can 'khor ba las sgrol bas sgrol ma'o/ / gnyis pa thugs kyi sems dpa' yab yum gyi sngags la'ang gnyis las/ yab kyi k+ṣi~X traṃ~X hri~X dz+riṃ ༵bzhi ni rtsa ba'i sngags dang bskyed pa'i sa bon yin la/ hi~X rā~X dza~X yaḥs dang mig ltar sems can gyi don byed pas rgyal po'o/ / ā~X ga~Xr+bha~X ya~Xḥdagos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i snying por gyur pa'o/ / ha~X hūm̐ ༵pa~Xd+ma~X ba da ma chags pa med cing gdul bya'i yid 'phrog pas pad+ma lta bu'i zhal mnga' ba'o/ / ku~X ru ༵p+naX hri rdo rje lta bus sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ / yum bzhi'i hūm̐~X trā~Xm̐ hrī~X āḥ~Xrtsa sngags dang sa bon no/ / lā~X s+ye~X sa~X ma~X ya~X stā~Xṃ ni sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dam tshig la nos shig pa'o/ / mā~X le~X sa~X ma~X ya~X ho~X ni gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dam tshig la gnas par bya'o zhes so/ / gī~Xrti~X rā~X go~X ha~Xṃ ni glu dbyings snyan po lta bus sems can la rjes su chags pa ni nga yin no zhes pa'o/ / ni~Xrti~X rā~X ga~X yā~X mi~X ni gar sgyur ba lta bu'i 'phrin las kyis sems can la rjes su chags par bya'o/ / zhes pa'o/ / gsum pa gsung gi sems dpa' yab yum gyi sngags la gnyis las/ yab kyi mai~X th+l+hiṃ hū~Xm̐ mu~Xm̐ ni rtsa sngags dang sa bon no/ / dha~X ra~X ṇi~X byams pas sems can rjes su 'dzin pa ste/ swā~X hā~X ni gzhi tshugs shig pa'o/ / ni~X swa~X ra~Xm̐ bha~X re~X ya~X swa~X hā ni 'thug pa'am sbyang dka' ba'i sgrib pa sel ba'o/

/ swa~X ra~X dza~X ya swā~X hā~X ni 'khor 'das gnyis la mi gnas pa'i rang bzhin kun tu bzang po'i rgyal po'o/ / shrī~X āṃ~X rā~X ga~X ya~X swā~X hā~X ni gnyis su mi gnas pa'i dpal sems can la rjes su chags pa'o/ / yum bzhi'i dza~Xḥ hū~Xm̐ ba~Xm̐ ho~Xḥni rtsa sngags dang sa bon no/ / dhu~X pe~X pra~X be~X sha~X ni tshul khrims kyi bdug spos gdul bya'i rgyud la 'jug pa'o/ / pu~Xṣ+pe~X ā~X be~X sha~X ni byang chub sems kyi me tog rgyas pa'i char gdul bya'i rgyud la 'bebs pa'o/ / dī~X pa~X su~X khi~X ni~X ye shes kyis sgron mes ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'o/ / ga~Xn+dhe~X tsi~Xt+ta~X ho~Xḥni bdud rtsi'i chu rgyan gyis gdul bya'i rgyud tshim par byed pa'o/ / bzhi pa sgo ba yab yum gyi sngags la gnyis las/ yab kyi hūm̐~X hūm̐~X hūm̐~X hūm̐~X bzhi sa bon te/ de'i sgras saṃ ha ra ṇa sdud par byed pa ste gdugs pa can dbang du sdud pa'am gdul bya'i rgyud la che ba'i yon tan 'jog pa'o/ / mjug gi phaṭa~X rnams kyi sgras a s+pha ra ṇa spro ba'am gtor ba ste/ gdug pa can 'thor ba'o/ / ya~X mā~Xn ta~X kṛ~Xta ni 'chi bdag gshin rje'i gzugs 'dzin pa'o/ / bi~Xg nā~Xn+ta~X kṛ~Xta~X ni bgegs mthar byed pa'o/ / pa~Xd+ma~X na~X ta kṛ~Xta~X ni 'khor ba'i 'dam gyis ma gos pa'o/ / pra~Xdz+nyā~Xn ༵ta~X kṛ~Xta ni nyon mongs pa'i bdud 'joms pa'o/ / yum gyi ā+o~Xṃ dang phaṭa~X ni sngar dang 'dra'o/ / ma~X hā~X ba~Xdz+ra~X dha~X ro ma~X hā~X kro~X dhe shwa~X rī~X dz+wa~X la~X ni~X hūm̐~X zhes pa/ rdo rje'i gzungs ma chen mo khro mo dbang phyug 'bar ma chen mo zhes pa'o/ / de bzhin du ra~Xt+na~X rin po che/ pa~Xd+ma~X ni skad sor bzhag ste pad+ma/ ka~Xrma~X ni 'phrin las kyi khro mo'o/ / lnga pa kun tu bzang po yab yum gyi yab kyi sngags la hūm̐~X hūm̐~X hūm̐~X gsum ni khams gsum gyi sems rgyud dag pa ye shes gsum mo/ / ba~Xdz+ra~X tsi~Xt+ta~X hūm̐~X

oṃ yin snyam/ ni de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin can no/ / yum gyi a~X a~X a~X gsum ni sgo gsum dus gsum dbyings gsum skye ba med pa'o/ / ba~Xdz+ri bha~X dra~X sa~X ma~Xn+ta~X a~X ni de nyid kun tu bzang mo'i rang bzhin du dag pa'o/ / drug pa thub pa drug gi sngags ni/ ā+o~Xṃ ni sngags kyi tshogs byin gyis rlob pa ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin no/ / mu~X ne~X ni thub pa'o/ / kṛṃ ni srin po la sogs pa rnam par ma zhi ba ste 'dir lha ma yin no/ / swā~X hā~X gzhi tshugs shig pa'o/ / de bzhin du sbyar te/ trūm̐~X ni sred pas bcings pas te mi'i snying po'o/ / srum̐~X ni blo gros rtul ba ste dud 'gro'o/ / bra ཾ ni bkres skom gyis gdungs pa ste yi dwags so/ / k+ṣa~Xm̐ ni bzod ldan te lha'i snying po'o/ / ye~X ni thur du lhung ba ste dmyal ba'i snying po'o/ / gsum pa 'phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i sngags la gsum las/ dang po spyan drang zhing bst-im pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ~X e~X h+ye~X hi~X bha~X ga~X wāna~X ma~X hā~X kā ru~X ṇi~Xkā~X dṛ~X sh+ya~X ho~X sa~X ma~X ya~X s+t+wa~Xṃḥ zhes pa ni tshur byon tshur byon/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ thugs rjes gzugs la dam tshig la nos shig pa'o/ / dza~Xḥhūm̐~X bam̐~X ho~Xḥni lcags kyus dgug zhags pas bcings lcags sgrog gis bsdams dril bus dbang du byed pa'o/ / gnyis pa rig pa'i me tog gtor ba'i sngags ni oṃ~X am̐ ām̐ḥhūm̐ swāḥhā ni rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga'o/ / ba dang dz+ra dang sa dang ma dang ya rnams so sor sbrengs pa ni yi ge bkram pa ste gong 'og gi yi ge lnga dang sbyar la yi ge btu bar bya ste/ oṃ ba~Xdz+ra~X sa~X ma~X ya~X oṃ~X ni sku'i dam tshig gis skur bsgrub pa'o/ / āḥba~Xdz+ra~X sa~X ma~X ya~X ā~Xḥgasung gi dam tshig gis gsung du bsgrub pa'o/ / hūm̐ ba~Xdz+ra~X sa~X ma~X ya~X hūm̐~X thugs kyi dam tshig gis thugs su bsgrub pa'o/

/ swā ba~Xdz+ra~X sa~X ma~X ya~X swā~X yon tan gyi dam tshig gis yon tan du bsgrub pa'o/ / hā ba~Xdz+ra~X sa~X ma~X ya~X hā~X 'phrin las kyi dam tshig gis 'phrin las su bsgrub pa'o/ / gsum pa dngos grub kyi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ oṃ~X ye~X she~Xs rgyala~X po~X zhes bcom ldan 'das la bos te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku~X gsu~Xng thuga~Xs yo~Xn tana~X 'phri~Xn la~Xs rma~Xd du~X byunga~X ba~X chen po'i dngos grub la da~X lta~X nyida~X du~X mnya~Xm par sbyo~Xr ba~X'i bdag po~Xs/ lha'i sku gsung thugs phyaga~X rgya~X che~Xn po~Xr da lta nyid du bda~Xg sbyora~X ci~Xg ces pa dang*/ oṃ~X ba~Xdz+ra sa~X ma~X ya~X hūm̐~X gis sku'i dam tshig dus la babs par bskul ba'o/ / oṃ~X ba~Xdz+ra sa~X ma~X ya~X s+t+waṃ~Xḥgyis gsung gi oṃ~X ba~Xdz+ra sa~X ma~X ya~X ho~Xḥzhes pas thugs kyi dam tshig la bskul ba'o/ / dza~Xḥhūm̐~X ba~Xm̐ ho~Xḥyis gnyis su med par bsre zhing brtan par byed pa'o/ / bzhi pa ngo mtshar gyi ltas ji ltar snang ba'i tshul ni de skad cesa~X brjo~Xd pa~Xs gsu~Xng gsang sngags kyi~X dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr de~X dga~X gi~Xs 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad du sngags kyi sgra chen pos khyab par grags so/ / des sems can gyi rgyud kun smin par byas pas ra~Xb tu~X graga~Xs so~X/ / grol bar byas pas kuna~X tu ༵graga~Xs so~X/ / yang sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang sngags kyi sgra dang sgra las thon pa'i zer dang zer kun tu 'phros pa'i snang ba chen po la yang shes par bya'o/ / gnyis pa dbang bskur ba'i sngags la gnyis las/ ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul ni bskyed pa'i sngags bstan pa de~X na~Xs bco~Xm lda~Xn 'da~Xs yid byeda~X pa~X po~X rdo~X rje~X kun tu bzang po dnga~X chos bya~X ba~X mo~X rdo~X rje~X kun tu bzang mo gnyisa~X su~X me~Xd pa~X'i gsung gi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr la~X thi~Xm pa~Xr mdza~Xd do~X/ / thim par mdzad pa de~X na~Xs phyoga~Xs bcu~X dusa~X bzhi~X'i de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X thams cad kyi bda~Xg nyida~X chena~X po~X kun tu bzang posa~X/

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las chen po'i bda~Xg nyida~X kyi dngos grub che~Xn po'i~X ye~X she~Xs dnga~X gzi byina~X phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdu~X ba~X zhesa~X bya~X ba~X'i gsang sngags 'di~X nyid/ ston pa yab yum gyi sku~X dnga~X gsunga~X thuga~Xs gnyis su med pa rdo~X rje~X'i rang bzhin thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel ba'i sgyu~X 'phru~Xl drwa~X ba~X la~Xs byin gyi rlabs kyis rang shar du byunga~X ngo*/ / gnyis pa sngags dngos la gsum las/ dang po dri ma 'khrud pa ye shes lngas dbang bskur ba ni/ oṃ~X ma~X hā~X shū~X n+ya~X tā~X dz+nyā~X na~X badz+ra~X swa~X bhā~X wā~X.ā~Xt+ma~X ko~X3haṃ~X ni stong pa nyid kyi ye shes chen po rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid kyi bdag nyid ni nga'o zhes pa'o/ / de bzhin du sbyar te/ ā~X da~Xr sha~X me long lta bu/ pra~Xt+ya~X be~X k+ṣa~X ṇā~X so sor rtog pa/ sa~X ma~X tā~X mnyam pa nyid/ kṛ~X t+yā ༵nuṣ+ṭhā~X na bya ba nan tan/ dz+nyā~X na~X ba~Xdz+ra swa~X bhā~X wa~X ā~Xt+ma~X ko~X3haṃ~X ye shes rdo rje'i bdag nyid nga yin no zhes pa'o/ / de ltar dbang bskur ba'i don ni skabs 'dir rang rang gi rigs bdag gang yin pa tshon gang ba res dbu brgyan pa ste/ thal ba las/ mi bskyod byed po yum dang bcas*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phyag rgyar bstan/ byams pa sa snying de bzhin no/ / gzhan dag rang gi phyag rgya ste/ / gshin rje gshed la rtag par bshad/ / thub chen rdo rje 'dzin 'chang ba/ / zla dang bral bas dpa' bo che/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / 'o na 'dir gtso bo la rnam snang gis brgyan par rigs so zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs su mtshon pas mi bskyod pa nyid rigs so/ / mi bskyod pa la ni rnam snang ste skabs 'dir sku mtshon pa'i phyir ro/ / 'dir lha thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa lngas dbu brgyan pa'o/ / gnyis pa nus pa 'jug pa rigs lngas byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ~X sa~Xrba~X ta~X thā~X ga~X ta~X ma~X hā~X kā~X ya~X badz+ra~X swā~X bhā~X ā~Xt+ma~X ko~X3ha~Xṃ ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin chen po nga yin no zhes pa'o/

/ de bzhin du/ wā~Xka~X ba~Xdz+ra~X gsung rdo rje/ tsi~Xt+ta~X ba~Xdz+ra~X thugs rdo rje'o/ / a~X nu~X rā~X ga~X ba~Xdz+ra~X yon tan rdo rje/ pū~X dza~X ba~Xdz+ra~X 'phrin las rdo rje'o/ / de dag gis lha thams cad kyi gnas lngar de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bskyed do/ / de ltar snang 'byed kyi ting nge 'dzin la sangs rgyas nyi khri chig stong bas kyang lhag par gnas te/ gnas lngar gsal btab pa'i phyir ro/ / nyi khri chig stong ni sku gsung thugs gsum byin gyis rlob pa'i dbang du byas te/ thal ba las/ gnas gsum khyab pa'i yi ge las/ / 'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs chen pos/ khams gsum byin brlabs gzi byin bsdus/ / rang bzhin rdo rje'i gnas gsum la/

/ rgyu gnyis tshul du rang snang ba'o/ / zhes so/ / de'i steng du lte ba dang gsang bar swā dang hā las yon tan dang 'phrin las gnyis ni/ de las/ lte ba rnam gnyis zla ba la/ / sngo ljang yi ge swā hā gnyis/ / rjes mthun 'od zer 'phro 'du las/ / yon tan rdzogs pa'i gzi brjid ldan/ / zhes so/ / de ltar na sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rigs lngas brgyan pa'o/ / gsum pa de las byung ba'i byin rlabs kyi snang tshul ni/ dbang bskur ba dang byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags de skad ce~Xs brjo~Xd pa~Xs lha de dag gi dbang gis byin rlabs gdul bya'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnyis su med par thima~X para~X gyura~X/ des nyon mongs pa dug lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gsa~Xl ba~Xr gyura~X/ des phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor du 'od 'ba~Xr ba~Xr gyura~X to~X/ / gsum pa rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa la lnga ste/ gsung gi ngo bo brjod du med pa/ rang bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gnas lugs gdod nas dag pa/ snang lugs mchog tu gyur pa/ yin lugs dbyings las ma g.yos pa'o/ / dang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don ni khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ e~X ma~X ho~X ngo~X mtsha~Xr te ya mtshan rma~Xd du byung ba nyid kyi~X chosa~X ni yang dag par rdzo~Xgs pa~X'i sanga~Xs rgyasa~X kuna~X gyi~X gsu~Xng mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo dam pa'o/ / ji ltar ngo mtshar na gsung gi ngo bo de nyid brjod pa'i sgra~X da~Xng chos kyi mi~Xng tshi~Xg kuna~X la~Xs 'da~Xs bzhin du 'gro ba'i snang ba dang mthun par gsung dbyangs phun sum tshogs pa sna~X tsho~Xgs pa'i sgra~X skad tshad med pa rnama~Xs gsa~Xl ba~Xr 'byu~Xng bas ngo mtshar ba'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi gsunga~X gci~Xg dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cus brgyan pas na dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr dam pa'o/ / de'i ya~Xn la~Xg drug cu ni~X tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang*/

sil snyan dang*/ glu gar dang*/ ka la ping ka dang 'brug sgra dang*/ sgra brnyan te rnam grangs drug po de dag re re la'ang*/ 'du shes bskyed pa dang*/ rnam par rig pa dang*/ mnyan par 'os pa dang*/ mi mthun pa med pa dang*/ shin tu zab pa dang*/ rjes su 'byung ba dang*/ gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa dang*/ rna bar snyan pa dang*/ rnam par ma 'khrugs pa dang*/ shin tu gsal ba ste bcu bcur 'gyur bas drug cu'o/ / yang na gdangs che ba/ yongs su khyab pa/ go bar myur ba/ the tshom gcod pa/ gcig la gzigs pa snyam byed pa/ nyi tsher ston pa/ kun nas 'jug pa/ 'dun pa bskyed pa/ khyad du zhugs pa/ thams cad 'dul ba ste/ rang bzhin bcu la gnas skabs drug tu 'gyur bas drug cu'o/ / de ltar bsgres pas dbyangs kyi yan lag drug brgyar 'gyur zhing*/ phyogs bcu dus bzhis phye bas drug stong dang*/ nyi khri bzhi stong du 'gyur ro/ / de'ang 'jig rten drug gis phye bas rnam grangs bsama~X gyi~Xs mi~X khyaba~X pas zhing khams kuna~X tu~X khyaba~X cing*/ sems can so so'i sgra~X skad dnga~X mi~Xng tshi~Xg so~X so~Xr snang ba dang mthun par gra~Xgs shing go bar mdzad de/ sgra skad de dag tha~Xms ca~Xd kyang gsu~Xng gi ༵phyaga~X rgya'i~X mcho~Xg brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin du 'dus par bstan to/ / gsum pa ni rgyuda~X thams cad kyi mcho~Xg sgyu~X 'phru~Xl drwa~X ba~X le'u stong phrag brgya pa la~Xs/ 'gro ba la phan bde~X dpag tu med pa dang ldana~X pa'i rgyu chos kyi sgra dbyangs yin pas gsu~Xng gi~X do~Xn 'byunga~X ba de ya~Xng*/ chos thama~Xs cada~X gdod nas dri mas ma gos pa'i chos nyid pa~Xd+ma~X lta bu'i~X nga~Xng du ye nas gyura~X pas na~X/ / sgra skad kyi ngo bo yang rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i chos nyid stong pa'i ngo bor bstan to/ / de'i phyir rnam par grola~X ba tha~Xr pa'i la~Xm ston pa theg pa'i sgra skad dnga~X*/ 'dod chags la sogs pa srid par sbyor ba 'kho~Xr ba'i~X sgra~X skad sna tshogs pa ji~X skada~X brjoda~X pa thams cad kyanga~X don la grags stong skye ba med pa'i chos nyid las ma 'das pas/

gsunga~X gi mcho~Xg brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin te~X ye nas dag pa'i ngo bo nyid do/ / de'ang thar lam thega~X pa~X mtho~X dma~Xn gyi sgra skad thama~Xs ca~Xd da~Xng phyin ci loga~X ngan 'gro~X gsum la sogs pa sems can ma~X lu~Xs pa tha~Xms ca~Xd kyi sgra ska~Xd kyang*/ don la grags stong skye ba med pa'i ngo bo ye nas byanga~X chuba~X pa'i gnas lugs bzang ngan gnyis su med pa'i rdo~X rje~X ste sangs rgyas kyi gsu~Xng brjo~Xd du med par bsdusa~X pa'o/ / bzhi pa ni/ gsung gi ngo bo brjod du med par bsdusa~X pa de~X nyi~Xd kyi ngang las phyoga~Xs bcu~Xr sprul pa du mas chos kyi rnam grangs dpag tu med pa'i tshogs rnama~X pa~Xr graga~Xs shing go bar mdzad do/ / chos kyi sgra~X grags pa de nyida~X ye nas ma~X cha~Xgs pa'i nganga~X du~X gdu~Xl bya'i snang ba dang mthun par gsungs kyang gsu~Xngs pa'i dus de nyida~X na~X gsung gi ngo bo brjo~Xd du~X me~Xd par gnas so/ / brjoda~X du meda~X pa'i gnas lugs de~X nyida~X brjod pa sna~X tshoga~Xs pa'i sgra~X yi 'byung gnas su gyur pas/ gdul bya kuna~X la tshig gcig tu mthun par graga~Xs shi~Xng don so~X so~Xr mja~Xl ba nyid dpe~Xr na~X sgra'i dbyings nyid rjod byed gcig gi de~X bzhi~Xn nyid sbrida~X sanga~Xs zhes pa las/ la las dug gi sbrid pa sangs bar go / la las 'dug stangs nyes pas sbrid pa sangs par go / la las rigs sngags kyis sbrid pa las sangs par go ba la sogs pa bzhi~Xn du de bzhin gshegs pa'i yang gsu~Xng gci~Xg gi sgra~X yi~Xs sems can so~X so~X'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i chos thams cad so~X so~Xr go~X ba'i snang ba de~X ni~X gsu~Xng mcho~Xg dam pa'i rang bzhin sgra skad du snang ba thams cad kyi rgyala~X po~X yi~Xn no/ / de skad du'ang dkon cog brtsegs pa las/ 'gro ba'i bsod nams las dag las/ / rgyal ba'i gsung dbyangs gcig snang ba/ / mos pa'i dbang gis so sor thos/ / 'di yang gsung gi gsang ba'o/

/ zhes so/ / sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs kyang thugs rje'i dbang gis de ltar snang ba ni rang bzhin gyi byin gyis rlabs kyi rten 'brel zab mo'o/ / gzhung 'di la kha cig de bzhin gshegs pas grong khyer gyi sgor sbrid pa sangs pa gcig bton pas/ nad pa nad g.yog sman pa gsum gyis so sor go ba la sbyor ba de dag gis sgra'i byings dang don la 'jal ma shes par zad do/ / lnga pa la gsum las/ dang po theg pa so sor snang yang ngo bo gsungs pa med par bstan pa ni/ thega~X pa~X mtho~X dma~Xn bsa~Xm ya~Xs gsungs par snang ba de dag kyang chos nyid de~X bzhi~Xn nyida~X las gzhan zhig ma~X gsunga~Xs te~X/ dkon brtsegs las/ nga mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa de srid du chos gang yang bstan pa med kyang*/ de bzhin nyid las 'gro ba'i mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du so sor snang ba 'di yang sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ / zhes pa dang mthun no/ / don la ma gsungs kyang gdula~X bya'i~X snang ngor 'dul ba'i tha~Xbs la mkhas pas chos kyi rnam grangs su~X sems can gyis so~X so~Xr tho~Xs pa de yang*/ sngar theg pa lnga'i sgron ma bkod pa ji~X lta~X ba~Xr de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsunga~X raba~X yan lag bcu gnyis la sogs pa kuna~X brjo~Xd pa ltar snang kya~Xng chos nyid de~X bzhi~Xn nyida~X kyi~X gnas lugs kyis gzhal na/ sangs rgyas mthar thug chos sku yin la des chos kyi rnam grangs cung zad kyang gsunga~Xs pa~X me~Xd de/ rdo rje gcod pa las/ gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong*/ / gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa/ / log pa'i lam du zhugs pa ste/ / skye bo des ni nga mi mthong*/ / sangs rgyas rnams ni chos nyid lta/ / 'dren pa rnams ni chos kyi sku/ / chos nyid shes bya ma yin te/ / de ni shes par nus ma yin/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / gnyis pa thugs rje'i ngang las gsung gi rdo rje 'gro ba la snang tshul ni brjod bya'i don yi~X ge~X me~Xd pa'i gnas lugs da~Xng rjod byed kyi tshig gsung du snang ba bde bar gshegs pa'i riga~X pa~X'i gsu~Xng 'gro bas thos pa de yang thos dus nyid nas sangs rgyas kyi ljaga~Xs kyi~X rtse~X mo~Xr sgra tshig rang mtshan pa ma~X byunga~X ya~Xng*/

rgyal ba'i thuga~Xs rje'i~X gsunga~X rang byung ye shes kyi~X byina~X rlaba~Xs kyi~Xs gdul ba'i 'gro~X ba la tshig dona~X sna~X tsho~Xgs mos pa dang mthun par so~X so~Xr gsa~Xl zhing thos pa ni gsung gi rdo rje'o/ / gsum pa gsungs pa med kyi gsungs bar snang ba'i dpe ni de ltar sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje dang sems can gyi mos pa las snang ba'i chos kyi tshig don gdul bya'i rna ba la gsa~Xl ba de nyida~X gdod nas ma skyes pas gsu~Xng gi~X rdo~X rje~X mcho~Xg dam pa'o/ / brjod pa med pa la gdul bya la snang ba'i chos kyi de~X bzhi~Xn nyid gsunga~X gi~X 'gro~X ba'i dona~X 'byung ba rnama~Xs ni dbyings de~X bzhi~Xn nyid kyi nga~Xng lasa~X ma~X g.yo~Xs kya~Xng rang snang ba ste/ dpe~Xr na~X braga~X ca~X'i sgra~X de nyid skyes bu dang*/ brag dang*/ de dag gi bar gang na'ang med bzhi~Xn du rkyen gyis ji skad brjod pa'i rnam pa 'byung ba bzhin gdul bya las dag pa'i rkyen dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje'i rgyus chos su snang ba yin no~X/ / de skad du'ang rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar sgra brnyan gyi ni sgra/ / gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba/ / de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung*/ / phyi dang nang na'ang gnas ma yin/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / gsung gsa~Xng ba~X'i snyinga~X po~X brjod du med pa las mos pa dang mthun par snang ba 'byung ba'i de kho~X na~X nyida~X nge~Xs pa~X la~Xs/ gsung gi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr bsdusa~X pa dnga~X lha so so'i gsa~Xng sngaga~Xs kyi~X rang bzhin bstan pa'i le~X'u~X ste~X bdu~Xn pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / / / ༈ don gnyis pa sku phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor dgod pa la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor spro ba'i tshul mdor bstan pa/ de'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ gsung sngags kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa/ de~X na~Xs de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi~Xs lus kyi ya~Xn la~Xg mgo la sogs pa tha~Xms ca~Xd lha'i dkyila~X 'kho~Xr du~X rang bzhin lhuna~X gyi~Xs gruba~X pa~Xr byina~X gyi~Xs rloba~Xs pa~X zhe~Xs bya~X ba~X 'di~X nyid che~Xd du~X brjoda~X do~X/

/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gzhi lhun gyis grub pa phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor spyir bstan/ lam mngon par bsgrub pa'i phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bye brag tu bshad/ 'bras bu ye shes mchog gi phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor du don bsdu ba'o/ / dang po ni/ phung po khams dang skye mched kyis bsdus pa snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa sgyu~X 'phru~Xl drwa~X ba~X'i ngo bo ye nas mngo~Xn par rdzoga~Xs pa~Xr sangs rgyas pa'i bdag nyid me dang me'i rang bzhin tsha ba ltar gnas pas/ chos thama~Xs ca~Xd la kun tu bzang po byanga~X chuba~X mcho~Xg gi~X phyag rgyasa~X ye nas btab pa zhes bya ste/ gnas lugs rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de nyid la gsa~Xng ba'i snying po de~X kho na nyida~X ngesa~X pa~X yi~X rgyal po chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i snyinga~X po~X'i phya~Xg rgyasa~X btab pa na/ rang bzhin mnyam rdzogs chen po de nyid las mi 'da' zhing*/ nam yang 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang las gzhan du 'dar med pa'i phyir 'da~X' dka~X' 'o~X zhes pa ste/ yum bar ma las/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' ni 'ga' zhig gis bsngags pa brjod kyang 'phel bar mi 'gyur/ 'ga' zhig gis bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod kyang 'grib par mi 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du chos rnams kyi chos nyid de bzhin nyid 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'jig rten du byon kyang rung*/ ma byon kyang rung ste 'phel ba'am 'grib par mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ / gnyis pa la gsum ste/ phyag rgya 'byung ba'i rgyu/ de las byung ba spyi'i phyag rgya/ de las 'phros pa lha so so'i phyag rgya'o/ / dang po ni/ spyir mgo ni de bzhin gshegs pa/ lag pa g.yas mi bskyod pa/ g.yon rin cen 'byung ldan/ rkang pa g.yon 'od dpag med/ g.yas don yod grub pa'i ngo bor brjod cing*/ nying lag gi sor mo'ang gung mo rdo rje'i rigs/

mdzub mo de bzhin gshegs pa/ mthe bong rin po che/ srin lag pad+ma/ mthe'u chung las kyi rigs so/ / skabs 'dir rdo rje'i thal mo phyag rgya'i rgyu yin pas de nyid brjod pa ni/ lag pa g.yas mi~X bskyoda~X pa'i sor mo lnga'i rtse la nyi~X ma'i~X dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr sran zlum tsam lnga'i steng du yi~X ge~X hūm̐ ā+oṃ swā āṃ hā ste thabs yab kyi yi ge lnga dang*/ lag pa g.yon ri~Xn cen 'byunga~X ldan gyi sor mo lnga la zla~X ba~X'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr sran ma'i ga'u tsam lnga'i steng du shes rab yum gyi yi~X ge~X mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pyām̐ tām̐ lnga bkod de/ lag pa g.yas kyi sor mo lnga dang g.yon gyi sor mo lnga~X po gnyi~Xs zu~Xng du~X sbyar te so sor sprad pa~X la~Xs rdo rje thal mo sbyara~X ba~X bsgyur ba ni lha so so'i phya~Xg rgya~X 'byunga~X ba~X'i rgyu~X yin no/ / 'dir bla ma rong pas dam tshig dang las kyi phyag rgya gnyis su bzhed cing*/ sangs rgyas gsang bas dam tshig dang yig 'bru bsgom pa chos dang*/ bsgyur ba las dang gsum du bzhed kyang*/ don la phyag rgya chen po/ chos kyi phyag rgya/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ las kyi phyag rgya bzhi ka tshang ste/ rang nyid lhar sgom pa sgyu ma'am 'ja' tshon lta bu ni phyag rgya chen po'o/ / phyag gi sor mo la yig 'bru bsgom pa chos kyi phyag rgya/ de las rdo rje la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan bsgom pa dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ de las phyag g.yas g.yon bsgyur ba dang 'khyud pa las kyi phyag rgya'o/ / 'dir ni de dag rdzogs par 'chad pa'o/ / gnyis pa de las byung ba spyi'i phyag rgya ni g.yas kyi mdzub mo'i oṃ~X bsam pa de dnga~X g.yon gyi gung mo mū~Xm̐ bsam pa de gnyisa~X thad kar rtse~X sbyara~X te~X lhag ma g.yas g.yon gyi hūm̐ dang lām̐/ swā dang mām̐/ āḥdang pyām̐/ hā dang tām̐ stai yi ge 'bru~X brgya~Xd so sor bsno~Xl te~X rtse~X mo sprada~X pa~X ni rigs lnga'i rgyala~X ba~X kuna~X dnga~X ngo bo mnya~Xm pa nyid du sbyora~X ba~X'i dngos grub bde~X ba~X che~Xn po~X tshe 'di nyid la sbyina~X par byed pa'i~X phyag rgya'o~X/

/ de skad du'ang thabs zhags las/ sor mo nang du bsnol te bkan/ / gung mdzub mthe bong che chung rnams/ / so sor rtse sprad phyir bskyed de/ / srin lag gshibs bsgreng dam tshig rgya/ / zhes so/ / 'di la sangs rgyas gsang ba ni rdo rje bsdam pa las gung mo gnyis gshibs te brkyangs pa thugs ye shes rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya ste rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig gi rgyar 'dod do/ kha cig rdo rje thal mo las g.yas pa'i sdig mdzub dang g.yon ma'i gung mo gnyis rtse sprad de lhag ma rnams so sor sbyar bar 'dod de/

de'ang rnam pa ni thabs zhags ltar lhongs shigaphyi ma gnyis la'ang 'gal ba med de sor mo rnams rigs lngar snang ba nyid ji skad gsungs ba bzhin bsnol ba'i phyir ro/ / gsum pa de las 'phros pa lha so so'i phyag rgya la lnga las/ dang po rigs lnga yab yum gyi phyag rgya la'ang lnga las/ gtso bo yab yum gyi phyag rgya ni/ bdag nyid gtso bo'i skur bsgom pa phyag rgya chen po/ de'i ngang las g.yas rdo rje khu tshur gyi hūm̐ las gzhan pa'i yig 'bru~X gzhan bzhi~X nang du sbasa~X nasa~X gung mo bsgreng ba'i rgyab thuga~Xs ka~Xr bka~Xn pa ni bcing ba dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ / gung mo hūm̐~X gi ngo bo bsgreng ba'i rtse mo zla ba'i nyi ma dbus su hūm̐ bsam pa ni chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ / hūm̐ de nyid 'od du zhu ba las rdo~X rje~X rtse lnga pa 'od 'bara~X ba gcig tu gyur pa ni bsam pa dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ / g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur du byas nas zla~X ba'i steng gi yi ge'i nang du brtula~X zhing dpa' mo 'bru~X lnga sbasa~X te rdo rje khu tshur gyis drila~X bu 'dzin pa bsila~X zhi~Xng yum la 'khyud de 'khrila~X ba~X'i tshula~X gyi~Xs yum gyi chosa~X brla g.yon pa snang ba mtha' yas kyi steng du dril bu bzhag pas dku la~X brte~Xn pa ni yab kyis yum la mchod pa ste yab kyi phyag rgya'o/ / de nyid bca' ba las kyi phyag rgyar bshad do/ / de nas phyag rgya g.yon phyogs su dkrol te phyag mtshan yum gyi thugs kar thim pas mnyes par bsam zhing hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛg brjod pa ni chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ / de ltar bdun yang bzhi po nyid du 'dus te/ bsam pa dam tshig dang bcing pa dam tshig gi phyag rgya gnyis ka dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ / bsam pa chos dang brjod pa chos kyi phyag rgya gnyis ka chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ / gzhan la'ang de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ / yum gyi phyag rgya las bdag nyid rdo rje dbyings phyug mar bsgom pa ni phyag rgya chen po'o/

/ de'i ngang las g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyi zla ba'i mūm̐ las gzhan pa'i yi ge 'bru~X bzhi~X nang du sba~Xs nasa~X gung mo thuga~Xs kara~X bka~Xn pa ni dam tshig go gung mo nyid mūm̐ ༵gyi sgrasa~X brjod pa bsgreng pa'i rtse~X mo~Xr zla ba'i steng du mūm̐ las drila~X bu gsila~X zhing 'od 'ba~Xr bar bsam pa ni dam tshig go / phyag g.yas nyi~X ma~X'i steng na dpa' bo 'bru~X lnga~X yab kyi brla g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag pa ni lasa~X su~X 'khri~Xl ba ste 'khyud nas/ yum gyi dbu yab la cung zad btuda~X de~X zhal 'dzu~Xm pa~X'i mda~Xngs kyi~Xs yab kyi zhal la blta~X ba ni bca' ba las kyi phyag rgya'o/ / de nas phyag rgya g.yas phyogs su bkrol te mūm̐ dhā ti shwa ri brjod nas phyag mtshan yab kyi thugs kar thim par bsam pa ni brjod pa chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ / de'ang don rtags ni ye shes lnga'i mtshon byed du rdo rje dang 'khor lo la sogs pa'o/ / rnam pa de kho na bzhin gzhan rnams la'ang rgyas par sbyar ro/ / mi bskyod pa yab yum ni rang nyid der gsal ba'i ngang las/ g.yas rdo rje khu tshur gyi nyi ma'i oṃ las gzhan pa'i yi ge 'bru~X bzhi~X nang du sba~Xs na~Xs mdzub mo bsgreng ba'i rgyab thuga~Xs ka~Xr bka~Xn cing*/ mdzub mo oṃ gyi rtse mor oṃ zhu ba las 'kho~Xr lo~X 'od 'ba~Xr ba rtsibs bzhi bsam zhing*/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyi zla~X ba'i steng gi yi ge nang du brtula~X te dpa' mo 'bru~X lnga sbasa~X pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis dri~Xl bu 'dzin pa gsi~Xl zhi~Xng yum la 'khyuda~X cing 'khri~Xl ba'i~X tshula~X gyi~Xs brla g.yon pa'i steng du gzhag pa ni cho~Xs la~X brtena~X pa'o/ / yang g.yon pa'i yi ge 'bru~X bzhi~X nang du sba~Xs nasa~X mdzub mo'i rgyab thuga~Xs ka~Xr bka~Xn pa'i mdzub mo lā~Xm̐ gyi~X rtse~X mora~X lām̐ zhu ba las drila~X bu gsi~Xl zhing 'od 'ba~Xr ba thugs kar bkan la/ g.yas pa nyi~X ma~X la gnas pa'i yi ge 'bru~X lnga nang du bsdus nas la~Xs su~X 'khri~Xl ba ste yab kyi brla g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag cing yab la cung zad zhal phyogs par btuda~X de~X 'dzu~Xm pa~X'i mda~Xngs kyi~Xs blta~X ba'o/

/ rin cen 'byung ldan yab yum ni/ rang nyid der gsal ba'i yab kyi g.yas pa'i yig 'bru~X bzhi~X nang du sba~Xs na~Xs mthe bong thuga~Xs ka~Xr bka~Xn pa'i mthe bong swā~X bsgreng rtser swā zhu ba las 'od 'bar ba'i rin po che thugs kar 'dzin par bsam zhing*/ g.yon pa'i zla~X ba la gnas pa'i yi ge brtu~Xl zhing 'bru~X lnga nang du sbasa~X pa'i khu tshur gyis drila~X bu gsi~Xl ba 'dzin zhi~Xng yum la 'khyud nas/ yab yum gnyis su med par 'khri~Xl ba~X'i tshula~X gyi~Xs brla g.yon pa cho~Xs snang ba mtha' yas kyi steng du dril bu dku la~X brtena~X pa'o/ / yang g.yon pa'i yi ge 'bru~X bzhi~X nang du sba~Xs na~Xs mthe bong thuga~Xs ka~Xr bka~Xn cing*/ mthe bong mā~Xm̐ bsgre~Xng rtse~X mo~Xr mām̐ las drila~X gsi~Xl 'od 'ba~Xr ba bskyed de thugs kar bzung la/ g.yas kyi nyi~X ma~X'i steng gi yi ge 'bru~X lnga~X nang du bsdus nas yab kyi brla g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag pa ni la~Xs su~X 'khri~Xl ba'o/ / rnam 'gyur de nyid kyis yab la btuda~X de~X 'dzu~Xm pa~X'i mda~Xngs kyi~Xs blta~X ba ni yum gyi phyag rgya'o/ / 'od dpag med yab yum ni der gsal ba'i ngang las yab kyi g.yas pa'i yi ge 'bru~X bzhi~X nang du sba~Xs na~Xs srin lag bsgreng ba'i rgyab thuga~Xs ka~Xr bka~Xn cing srin lag ā~Xm̐ bsgre~Xng rtse~X mo~Xr ām̐ zhu ba las pa~Xd+ma~X 'od 'ba~Xr ba bsams te thugs kar phyag rgya bcas la/ g.yon pa'i zla~X ba'i yi ge brtula~X zhing 'bru~X lnga nang du sba~Xs pa'i khu tshur gyis drila~X bu gsi~Xl ba 'dzin zhi~Xng yum la 'khrula~X ba~X'i tshula~X gyi~Xs brla g.yon pa cho~Xs snang ba mtha' yas kyi steng du dril bu dku la~X brtena~X pa'o/ / yang g.yon pa'i yi ge 'bru~X bzhi~X nang du sba~Xs na~Xs srin lag gi rgyab thuga~Xs ka~Xr bka~Xn cing*/ srin lag pyām̐~X bsgrenga~X ba'i rtse~X mora~X pyām̐ las drila~X gsi~Xl 'ba~Xr bar bsam pa thugs kar bzung la/ g.yas kyi nyi~X ma~X'i yig 'bru~X lnga~X nang du bsdus te sor mo brla g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag pa ni lasa~X su~X 'khrula~X bas/

yab la btuda~X de~X 'dzu~Xm pa~X'i mda~Xngs kyi~Xs ba~Xlta ba'o/ / don grub yab yum gyi phyag rgya ni/ der gsal bas g.yas pa'i yi ge 'bru~X bzhi~X sba~Xs na~Xs mthe'u chung gi rgyab thuga~Xs ka~Xr bka~Xn cing*/ mthe'u chung hā~X bsgrenga~X rtse~X mo~Xr ha las ra~Xl gri~X 'ba~Xr ba bsam ste thugs kar bzung la/ g.yon gyi zla~X ba'i yi ge brtula~X cing 'bru~X lnga nang du sbasa~X nas drila~X bu gsi~Xl zhi~Xng yum la 'khri~Xl ba~X'i tshula~X gyisa~X brla g.yon pa'i steng du dril bu gzhag pa ni cho~Xs la brtena~X pa'o/ / yang g.yon pa'i yi ge 'bru~X bzhi~X sbasa~X na~Xs mthe'u chung gi rgyab thuga~Xs ka~Xr bka~Xn cing*/ mthe'u chung tā~Xm̐ bsgre~Xng rtse~X mo~Xr tām̐ las dri~Xl gsi~Xl 'ba~Xr ba thugs kar bzung la/ g.yas kyi nyi~X ma~X'i yig 'bru~X lnga~X nang du bsdus nas yab kyi brla g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag pa ni la~Xs su~X 'khri~Xl bas/ yab la btuda~X de~X 'dzu~Xm pa~X'i mda~Xngs kyi~Xs blta~X ba'o/ / gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa' yab yum gyi phyag rgya ni gong dang mtshungs pa las/ khyad par du rang rang gi sa bon las phyag mtshan du gyur ba'i tshul gyis yab kyi phyag g.yas kyis thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ yum gyi phyag g.yon gyis thugs kar 'dzin la/ yab kyi g.yon pas yum gyi brla g.yon pa'i chos la brten cing*/ yum gyis g.yas pas yab kyi brla g.yas la 'khril bar bya'o/ / de'ang mām̐ las u~Xt+pa~Xl mai las klu~X shi~Xng la~X soga~Xs pa'i phyag mtsha~Xn k+ṣaṃ las ri~Xn ce~Xn gyi myu~X gu~X trām̐ las ra~Xl gri~X 'od 'ba~Xr ba hrīḥlas pa~Xd+ma~X dka~Xr po~X dzhiṃ las rdo~X rje~X 'ba~Xr ba th+l+hiṃ las cho~Xs kyi~X 'kho~Xr lo hūm̐ las ri~Xn ce~Xn snye~X ma ste yab kyi phyag mtshan no/ / hūm̐ las gzu~Xgs mdze~Xs pa mtshon pa me long dang*/ trām̐ las ri~Xn ce~Xn phrenga~X ba~X dang hrīḥlas pi~X wa~Xṃ dang a las gara~X mkha~Xn mcho~Xg nyida~X de~X/ rdo rje rtse gsum pa khyer nas spyi bo gar byed pa mtshon pa dang*/

hūm̐ las me~X to~Xg gi phre~Xng ba dnga~X dza las spo~Xs mcho~Xg ma~X spos kyi khang bu dang*/ bam̐ las ma~Xr me~X dang*/ ho las byuga~X pa~X la~X so~Xgs pa~X'i dung chos te yum gyi phyag mtshan no/ / yum rnams kyi tshe yum gyi g.yas kyis yab kyi lasa~X te brla g.yas pa la~X 'khrila~X zhinga~X yab kyi tshe g.yon pas yum gyi brla g.yon pa cho~Xs la~X brtena~X pa ste 'khyud pa/ yab rnams kyi dbu~X rnamasa~X yum la cung zad 'byo~X zhi~Xng yum rnams yab la 'duda~X pa~X'i tshula~X du gnas pa ni gonga~X gi~X phyaga~X rgya~X chena~X po bzhin du yab yum thabs shes gnyi~Xs su me~Xd pa'i chos kyi dbyinga~Xs spros bral bde ba chen po nyid kyi~X nga~Xng du~X 'khri~Xl ba'o/ / gsum pa sgo ba yab yum gyi phyag rgya ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo~X bzhi~X la khro~X bo~X yab yum brgyad las/ yab bzhi'i phya~Xg rgya~X ni~X hūm̐ las nṛ~X mgo~X'i dbyug pa gdenga~Xs pa dang*/ rdo~X rje~X rtse lnga pas gno~Xn pa'i tshul dang*/ tho~Xd pa sbrula~X gyi chuna~X po~Xs dkris pas gno~Xn pa~X da~Xng*/ rdo~X rje~X rgya~X gra~Xm lasa~X kyisa~X gnona~X pa ste g.yas pa bzhis 'phyar zhing g.yon pa bzhis yum la sdig mdzub kyi tshul du 'khyud pa dang*/ yum gyi phyag rgya ni phaṭa bzhi las lcaga~Xs kyu~X zhaga~Xs pa~X lcaga~Xs sgroga~X drila~X bu g.yon gyis bzung nas g.yas pa khu tshur gyis yab la 'khyud pa ste/ sgo~X bzhi~Xr gna~Xs pa'i~X sgo ba yab yum de~X da~Xg kyanga~X yum gyis yab la 'duda~X cing yab kyis yum la cung zad dbu 'byo ba'i tshula~X gyis yab yum gnyis su med pa chos nyid kyi ngang du 'khri~Xl ba~X gonga~X du bstana~X pa bzhina~X no/ / bzhi pa thuba~X pa druga~X gi phya~Xg rgya~X ni gdul bya'i dbang gis sna~X tshoga~Xs pa ste~X gcig tu nges pa dang grangs dang tshad med kyang*/ de dag gi rigs mdora~X bsdusa~X na phyaga~X rgya~X druga~X tu~X 'du~X ba yin no/ / gang zhe na rdo rje las/ pi wang go cha bseg spar sgrom/

/ po ti me chur shes par bya/ / zhes pa ste sa bon drug las phyag rgya de dag thugs kar 'dzin pa'o/ / de dag la yum med pas thabs dang shes rab zung du ma 'bral lam snyam na/ dmigs bcas snang ba'i yum med kyang dmigs med dbyings kyi yum bstan pa'i phyir yuma~X ni gang du'ang dmi~Xgs pa meda~X pa cho~Xs kyi~X dbyi~Xngs spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'o/ / kha cig thub drug gi g.yon phyogs na kun tu bzang mo drug 'dod pa ni lha'i grangs nges dang 'gal lo/ / kun tu bzang mor sdud zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ bsgom dus na'ang dmigs pa'i lha dang dag pa'i grangs 'dzol ba'i phyir ro/ / kha cig mu stegs rnams la phan don du/ / sangs rgyas btsun mor rab tu gsang*/ / zhes pas thub drug la yum med par 'dod pa'ang rnal 'byor rgyud kyi skabs te 'dir skabs ma yin pa dang*/ mi'i thub pa 'dod yon spangs kyang gzhan rnams 'dod yon spangs par ma gsungs te/ sprul sku gang la gang 'dul du snang ba'i phyir ro/ / des na dngos kyi yum med pa ni sprul pa dang lha'i grangs kyi dbang du byas pa'o/ / lnga pa kun bzang yab yum gyi phyag rgya ni/ kuna~X tu bzanga~X po phyag gnyis mnya~Xm gzha~Xg gi mthil las gdangs kyi 'char gzhir bstan pa'i phyir ye~X shesa~X lnga so sor gsal ba kha dog lnga'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro~X zhing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil drung mdzad pa'o/ / de'i yuma~X du gyura~X pa kun tu bzang mo ni phyag rgya mnyama~X rdzoga~Xs te yab dang mtshungs shing zhabs gnyis pa~Xd+mo~X'i skyila~X krung du bzhugs pa'o/ / da ni de thams cad kyi rnams grangs bsdus te bstan pa ni/ de ltar so so'i phyag rgya bstan pa las gzhana~X yanga~X phyaga~X rgya~X sna~X tshoga~Xs pa yod de~X/ rigs so sor bsgrubs pa na lha de dag gi phyag rgya yang phyogs gcig tu rdo rje la sogs pa rigs de'i phyag mtshan du bstan pa dang*/ ya~Xng na~X de~X bzhina~X gshe~Xgs pa lnga po'i phyag rgya nyida~X de sngar bstan pa dag gama~X/

yanga~X na~X rdo~X rje~X thala~X mo~X sbyar ba nyida~X tsam yang bcing bar bya'o/ / kha cig rkang pa gsum po 'di kun tu bzang po yab yum gyi phyag rgya sna tshogs su ston te/ rdo rje las/ kun bzang yab yum nam mkha'i mdog/ phyag rgya ma nges sna tshogs te/ / mnyam gzhag ye shes 'phro ba'i steng*/ / rdo rje dril bus mtshan pa'o/ / zhes 'don to/ / de ni gtso bo kun tu bzang po'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dgod pa'i skabs yin gyi/ gdangs 'char ba'i kun bzang yab yum gyi phyag rgya ni mnyam gzhag kho nar gsungs te/ phyogs su ma lhung ba'i phyir ro/ / gsum pa 'bras bu ye shes kyi phyag rgyar don bsdu ba la gsum ste/ rang bzhin gnas lugs kyi phyag rgya spyir bstan/ gnas skabs snang byed kyi phyag rgya bye brag tu bshad/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i phyag rgyas 'gro don mdzad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ sems nyid gdod nas dag pa'i ngo bo ni phyaga~X rgya~X che~Xn po~X'i ngang las/ gang shar gyi rtog tshogs ye shes kyi tshoga~Xs mcho~Xg tu ye nas gnas pa ni~X don gyi 'dug tshul lo/ / de nyid bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs nas tha~Xbs gang snang gi yul dnga~X shesa~X raba~X 'dzin med du shar ba'i rig pa rang grol phyogs gcig phyogs med du tu ldana~X pa rgyud la 'byora~X na~X lus ma~X bskyoda~X yan lag ma~X bsgula~X yang*/ 'gro 'dug dang spyod lam thama~Xs cada~X kuna~X phyaga~X rgya~X chena~X po'i~X nganga~X du~X gnasa~X shing 'dus pas/ bcos ma'i phyag rgya bcing du med pa'o/ / gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dang po sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor spro ba ni sngar phyag rgya spros pa'i ting nge 'dzin goms pa las/ de'i rtsal gong nas gong du sbyor ba'i phyir lus kyi yana~X la~Xg la lha~X bzhi~X bcu~X rtsa~X gnyisa~X dang ldana~X par byas nas rtogs pa bogs dbyung ba ste/ de yang bdag nyid rnam snang yab yum du gsal ba las/ yab kyi spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga lte ba gsang gnas rnams su mi bskyod pa 'od dpag med rnam snang rin cen 'byung ldan don grub ste yab lnga'o/

/ mig dang rna ba dang sna bug dang lce zur g.yas pa bzhi la sa'i snying po/ phyag na rdo rje nam mkha'i snying po spyan ras gzigs te thugs kyi sems dpa' bzhi'o/ / de bzhin du g.yon pa bzhi la/ byams pa sgrib sel kun bzang 'jam dpal te gsung gi sems dpa' bzhi'o/ / lag pa g.yas la gshin rje mthar byed/ g.yon la shes rab mthar byed/ rkang pa g.yon la pad+ma mthar byed/ g.yas la bgegs mthar byed de sgo ba bzhi'o/ / spyi gtsug mgrin par ro stod lte ba gsang ba rkang mthil drug tu thub pa drug ste lha nyi shu rtsa gsum mo/ / yum gyi spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga lte ba gsang gnas lngar/ sangs rgyas spyan gos dkar mo dbyings phyug mā ma kī sgrol ma ste yum lnga'o/ / mig rna ba sna bug lce zur g.yon la rim pa bzhin/ sgeg mo 'phreng ba glu ma gar ma ste yul gyi lha mo bzhi'o/

/ de bzhin du g.yas bzhi la/ bdug spos me tog mar me dri chab ma ste dus kyi lha mo bzhi'o/ / lag pa g.yon la lcags kyu g.yas la zhags pa rkang pa g.yas la lcags sgrog g.yon la dril bu ma ste sgo ma bzhi'o/ / de ltar yum la lha bcu bdun te/ bsdoms pas bzhi bcu ni thabs kyi lha ste rags pa dang phyi na gnas pas de skad ces btags so/ / de'i steng du rtsa ba'i lha yab yum gnyis te bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis po de rnams la bslab bo/ / yab yum grangs mi mnyam pa ni thub pa rnams la yum med pas yin la/ kun bzang yab yum ni rtsa ba'i lha nyid du bsdus so/ / de legs par dmigs pa gsal nas/ gnyis pa sangs rgyas stong gi dkyil 'khor spro ba ni/ bzhi bcu po de~X nyida~X kyi thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' re re gnas pa ni yana~X laga~X sprosa~X pa'i bdaga~X nyid nang na gnas pa dang phra ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi lha ste~X bzhi bcu'o/ / thabs kyi lha bzhi~X bcu~X rtsa~X gnyisa~X smos kyang*/ rtsa ba'i yab yum gnyis las gzhan bzhi bcu po la/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha gsu~Xm gsum 'phro~X bas brgya nyi shur 'gyura~X zhing*/ de re re la dbu rgyan gyi lha lnga lnga yod pas drug brgya/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha gsum gsum yod pas sum brgya drug cu/ shes rab kyi lha bzhi bcu po bsnan pas sangs rgyas stong gi dkyil 'khor te de la bslab bo/ / de'ang kha cig gi bzhed pa ltar na/ thabs kyi lha bzhi bcu/ shes rab kyi lha bzhi bcu/ sku'i lha bzhi bcu/ gsung gi lha bzhi bcu/ thugs kyi lha bzhi bcu ste nyis brgya po la dbu rgyan lnga lnga yod pas stong gi dkyil 'khor du gnas so zhes gsungs te don la 'dra'o/ / de yang legs par gsal ba dang*/ gsum pa sangs rgyas nyi khri chig stong gi dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni/ sangs rgyas stong po de~X ltara~X ldana~X pa~X'i gtso~X mcho~Xg rnam snang yab yum gyisa~X mtshon pa/

rgyala~X ba~X rigs bzhi dang rgyala~X mcho~Xg kun tu bzang po la yang de~X bzhina~X du~X brtsis pas stong stong ste stong phrag drug go / de bzhin du sems dpa' yab yum cha brgyad dang*/ sgo ba yab yum cha bzhi ste bcu~X gnyisa~X la stong phrag bcu gnyis so/ / druga~X gi~X 'o~Xd 'phro~X 'ba~Xr ba ni thub pa drug ste/ yum med pas nyi khri chig stong sum brgya dang bcu gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor la bslab par bya'o/ / nyi khri bzhi stong du 'dod pa ni thub pa drug la yum yod par rlom pa yin no/ / de la goms nas/ bzhi pa sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dkyil 'khor la bslab pa ni/ tshul de~X la~X so~Xgs te ༵sangs rgyas re re la'ang sangs rgyas nyi khri chig stong du bskyed pa lta bu bsama~X gyis mi~X khyaba~X pa'i dkyil 'khor la bslab par bya'o/ / de'ang bla ma rong pa ni lha'i sku gcig la yan lag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ldan zhing*/ de re re'ang sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlobs pa'i lha gsum dang ldan pas/ de nyid yan lag spros bdag ste~X/ / bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis gsum 'phror 'gyur/ / zhes sbyor zhing*/ gtso bo la ji ltar ldan pa bzhin yan lag gi lha rnams la yang de ltar brtsis pas brgya nyi shu re 'byung bas bcu gnyis drug gi 'od 'phro 'bar zhes 'chad do/ / snang byed kyi lha 'di rnams rnal 'byor snga ma goms stobs kyi 'bras bur bzhag la/ tshogs sgrub tu tshe dbang thob par byed pa'i rgyu yin pas lam du'ang bzhag go / gsum pa mthar thug gi phyag rgyas 'gro don mdzad pa'i tshul la lnga las/ dang po gdul bya'i don la sna tshogs su ston pa'i tshul ni/ lam gyi gnas skabs su de ltar bsgoms pas mthar thug sangs rgyas pa na phyoga~Xs bcu~X dang dusa~X bzhisa~X bsdus pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bsa~Xm yasa~X su~X gdul bya dpag tu med pa 'dula~X ba'i~X phyag rgya'i do~Xn rnama~Xs sems can so so'i snang ba dang mthun par sangs rgyas dang 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i sku so~X so~X ston cinga~X 'gro don mdzad dau/

/ gnyis pa bstan pa bzhin snang ba'i tshul ni thega~X pa~X mtho~X ba sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa dma~Xn pa nyan rang la sogs pa thama~Xs cada~X dang ༵/ lta spyod phyina~X ci~X lo~Xg rtog mu stegs byed rnama~Xs dang*/ so so skye bo bsa~Xm ya~Xs da~Xng*/ gdul bya zhi~X ba lha la sogs pa dang*/ khro~X bo bdud dang gshin rje la sogs pa'i~X tsho~Xgs chena~X po thama~Xs cada~X la gang la gang 'dul so~X so~Xr snang zhing mos pa dang mthuna~X par bya~Xs te kuna~X tu snanga~X ngo*/ / gsum pa sna tshogs su snang yang gcig las ma g.yos pa'i dpe ni dpe~Xr na ༵zlos gara~X mkha~Xn nyida~X gcig po de las g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums dang zhi khro du mar snang ba dang 'dra~X ba~Xr ye shes kyi lusa~X ye nas dag pa'i rang bzhin gcig las 'di la~X 'di bstan no zhes dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ched du ma~X bko~Xd kyang 'gro ba'i snang ba dang mthun par zhi ba dang khro bo la sogs pa sna~X tsho~Xgs lhun grub tu thugs rjes stona~X par byed do// bzhi pa gdul bya'i dbang gis phyag rgya'i grangs ma nges par bstan pa ni/ mdora~X na~X byang chub mchog dang bdud 'dul ba la sogs pa'i phya~Xg rgya~X thama~Xs ca~Xd ni~X 'di~X kho na'o zhe~Xs mtha' gci~Xg tu~X brjo~Xd du~X me~Xd de/ thabs dang shes rab kyi dbang gis gnyisa~X dnga~X sku gsung thugs kyis gsuma~X du~X 'gyur zhing*/ phrin las bzhi la sogs par yang rnama~X para~X 'phro~X bar byed de/ lus bskyoda~X pa dnga~X yan lag phyag rgyar spro~X ba~X thams cad lha'i phyag rgya'i de~X bzhina~X nyida~X du gnas pa'i phyir ro/ / lnga pa gnas lugs phyag rgya chen por thams cad 'du ba ni/ mdo~Xr na~X yan lag bskyoda~X cing lus bsgula~X ba thama~Xs ca~Xd kuna~X phyaga~X rgya~X che~Xn po~X'i nga~Xng du~X ga~Xnas te/ thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i chos nyid du gnasa~X pa nyida~X kyis/ 'di ni ma dag pa'i phyag rgya dang chos so zhes pa rdul tsam yang mi~X gna~Xs shing gna~Xs pa'a~Xng mi~Xn te/

lus lha sngags sems chos nyid kyi phyag rgya'am dkyil 'khor du gnas pa'i phyir ro zhes pa'i tshul de~X skada~X sgrib gnyis ma lus pa dga~X cing mkhyen rabs phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba'i mchoga~X sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po nyida~X kyisa~X bshada~X pa yin no/ / de nyid yid ches pa'i gnas te/ ye shes dam pa las/ nyes pa zad pa rdzun gyi tshig/ smra bar mi 'gyur rgyu med phyir/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / ye shes kyi phyag rgya mchog tu gsanga~X ba'i~X snyinga~X po~X chos nyid don gyi gnas lugs de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X nge~Xs pa~X la~Xs/ lus dang rtog pa'i ya~Xn la~Xg tha~Xms ca~Xd ye nas dag pa'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr du~X byina~X gyi~Xs brlaba~Xs na~Xs rang bzhin gyi phyaga~X rgya~X sprosa~X pa~X'i le~X'u ste~X brgyada~X pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / / / ༈ don gsum pa de nyid gsal bar byed pa gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung gi don no/ / dang po la gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor bri zhing phan yon bstan pa/ lha bskyed cing ji ltar mchod pa/ dbang bskur zhing 'bras bu bstan pa'o/ / dang po la bzhi ste/ sa'i cho gathig tshon gyi cho gabri zhing rgyan dgram pa/ mchod pa bsham zhing phan yon bstan pa'o/ / dang po la bdun las/ sa gzhi brtags pa ni mnyam zhing yid du 'ong ba dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir 'os pa ste/ las rim las/ zur brgyad la sogs rtse mang dang*/ / chu bo bzhin du ma bo yang*/ / mnyam zhing yid 'ong 'o kha'i chu/ / nyi ma shin tu gnas pa ni/ / nam mkha'i mtshan nyid shes par bya/ / mtho dang 'dud pa nub byang yin/ / shar lho gzhol zhing 'jam pa la/ / tho sgro grog mdo chu sna sogs/ / dal dbang dgra yi mtshams brtag bya/ / lhun stug ri bo nags tshal ldan/ / rab tu mnyam zhing snum bag can/ / chu bo dbang gi phyogs yin te/ / cung zad kyis ni rlung nyung zhing*/ / me tog shing tshal bya skad brtag/ lo rgyus shes pa'ang mchog tu gsungs/ / bdag nyid brtags shing nyams dga' dang*/

/ bsam gtan dgra las ring gyur pa/ / rang khyim la sogs de bzhin te/ / nan tan nus mthu ldan phyir yin/ / zhes pa'i sa phyogs su/ khru gang khri bzhir brkos pa na/ / gram pa thal ba shing sol dang*/ / gyo mo rus pa la sogs pa/ / zhes pa'i ma dag pa bsal te chus bkang nas goms pa brgya phyir song te chu de nyid la brtag pa ni/ chus bkang goms pa brgya blta bya/ / zhes pas/ bri ba med na rab*/ phyed na 'bring*/ bskams na ngan pa'o/ / gnyis pa sa bslang ba ni mi dang mi ma yin la dkyil 'khor gyi phyir slong ba ste/ mngon dang mi mngon bdag po la/ / rtsod pa nye bar zhi bya'i phyir/ / ser sna spangs pa'i sems kyis ni/ / rin dang bden pa bsgo la bslang*/ / zhes so/ / de nas 'bru dang rin po che'i sa gter sbas la sa gzhi mnyam te dri'i thig le byas la/ sa'i lha mo'i cho ga bya'o/ / de'ang sngon sangs rgyas rdo rje gdan la 'tshang rgya ba'i tshe sa bslangs te bdud las rgyal ba bzhin du rnal 'byor ba yang nag po'i phyogs las rgyal ba'i dgos pa yod do/ / de'ang lha mo ser mo bum pa 'dzin pa phag gi steng na chibs pa bskyed la spyan drangs te/ mchod bstod byas la bdag rdo rje che ge mo sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor bzheng pas gnang bar mdzod cig ces so/ / gsum pa dbang du bya ba ni phur pa dmar po he ru kar gsal ba btab pas de'i 'od zer gyi sa gzhi khengs par bsgom pa ni bgegs zhi ba'i dgos pa yod do/ / bzhi pa sbyang ba ni thog mar sa bdag lto 'phye'i phyogs nas bslang bar bya ste/ bam brgyad kyi 'grel pa las/ lto 'phye gnas pa'i mtshan nyin ni/ / ston zla gsum gyi zla ba la/ / nyi ma 'gro ba'i rim pa yis/ / mgo shar kha lho g.yon gyis nyal/ / dgun zla gsum gyi zla ba la/ / nub tu kha bltas mgo bo lho/ / dpyid zla gsum gyi zla ba la/ / byang du kha bltas nub tu mgo / dbyar zla gsum gyi zla ba la/ / shar du kha bltas byang du mgo

/ sa bdag lto 'phye de ltar gnas/ / skyes bu chen po lto 'phye brko/ / zhes pa ltar bslang ngo*/ / de'ang mgo la phog na slob dpon 'chi zhing*/ mjug ma la phog na slob ma 'chi bas lto ba nas brkaus te bya'o/ / de nas stegs bu ji ltar rigs par bya ste/ byang shar gzhol cing gzhan gnyis mnyam dbus cung zad mtho ba byas la/ ba byung lnga dang 'bru lnga la sogs pa'i byug pa yang*/ rngam glog las/ sa zhag spos chen rnam lnga yi*/ / khu ba bsres nas kun tu ni/ / gru bzhi'i dbus su legs bya ste/ / ba ko tsam du skyang nul bya/ / zhes so/ / de nas mes sbyang ba yang*/ kun nas mtshan ma ngan gyur na/ / gzhan du bgrod dam zhi ba yi/ / me yis rab tu dag par bya/ / zhes so/ / de nas bdag nyid khro bor gsal ba'i lag mthil las 'od zer byung bas sa phyogs rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rang bzhin dang ma dag pa sbyangs shing stong pa nyid du'ang mos par bya'o/ / lnga pa byin gyis brlab pa ni slob dpon gtso bor bskyed de sa phyogs de nyid lha'i gzhal yas khang du gsal bar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mang po dmigs te/ bdag nyid chen po nga nyid kyi/ / thams cad bka' las ma 'da' zhig/ ces pa dang sum+bha ni brjod cing rdo rje'i 'gros kyis bskor ro/ / drug pa bsrung ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bcu byung bas phyogs der bsrungs te bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar bar bsgom mo/ / bdun pa gzung ba ni/ thig btab bam thig le bkod pa lhar bskyed de mchod bstod cung zad kyis mchod nas thim pas lha'i gzhal yas khang gi gzhir bsam mo/ / 'di tsam gyis sa'i cho ga tshang ba'o/ / gnyis pa thugs tshon byin gyis rlob pa ni/ kha dog lnga'am nyi shu rtsa lnga'i snal ma bu mo lo bcu drug lon pas bkal ba ste/ rdo rje las rim las/ pad+ma'i rgyu las kha dog bsgyur/ / bcu drug phyag rgyas legs bkal te/ / snal ma gcig kyang lnga lngar ldan*/ / ye shes rang bzhin brtan par bya/

kha dog gsum ldan snal ma dgu / ras bal las btags sku gsung thugs/ / gtsang ma'i snod du legs bkol te/ / zhes so/ / de nyid dang tshon rnams ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi nyis ldab tsam du byas pa mtshan ldan mas bzung ste rdo rje'i gnam thig thog mar gdab pa ni rngam glog las/ thig g.yog las kyi sems ma ste/ / mtshan ldan by-in gyis brlabs nas ni/ / phyag rgya gar dang bcas pa yis/ / rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gnam thig gdab/ / de nas sa thig gdab pa yang*/ / 'dul ba'i dbang gis bye brag las/ / maṇ+ḍal tshad ni nges pa med/ / sor bzhi pa nas brtsam nas ni/ / ji srid dpag tshad thug par ro/ / zhes pa ste/ sor bzhi pa nas tshad ma nges pa'i bar du gsungs so/ / byin gyis brlab pa yang*/ thig tshon lhar gsal ba la mchod bstod byas te ye shes su gyur pas bya ba ste/ las rim las/ snod rim ma 'dres dag byas la/ / hūm̐ sogs yig 'bru gcig kyang lnga/ / kha dog rjes su mthun byas te/ / yongs gyur nyi shu rtsa lnga'i lha/ / thabs dang shes rab ldan par bsgoms/ / phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i sku gsung thugs/ / yon tan 'phrin las ye shes lnga/ / bstims pas yongs gyur dngos po lnga/ / sku gsung yon tan 'phrin las thugs/ / ye shes rgyu las grub pa yi/ / dkyil 'khor rjes su brtag par bya/ / zhes so/ / de'ang sa tshon la yig 'bru bris pa'ang spungs shing mi mngon par bya ste/ spungs shing bsnun pa ltar byas la/ / rdul tshon sbyong ba'i sngags phyag rgya/ / zhes so/ / de ltar rdul tshon gyi kha dog so sor phye ba'i don ni/ rgyus pa'i rgyud las/ sems can ma lus thams cad la/ / ye shes lnga yis kun khyab cing*/ / rang gi rnam rtog bsgribs byas nas/ / ye shes lnga yi don ma mthong*/ / de ltar rmongs pa thams cad la/ / ye shes mtshan nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ / dkar dang dmar dang ser ba dang*/ / ljang gu la sogs nag po

mthing ga bstan/ / zhes so/ / tshon de dag gi rgyu yang rab rin po che la bya bar las rim las/ rin cen lnga las byas pa'i tshon/ / in+d+ra nī la zla 'od dang*/ / pu sha rā ga byu ru bzang zangs / / margad ta las byas pa dgye/ / de bzhin 'byor bas gzhan dag bsdu/ / mtshams sems khro bo la sogs phyir/ / kha dog nyi shu rtsa lngar gsungs/ / zhes so/ / 'bring dang tha mas tshon rtsi ci 'byor ba'o/ / gsum pa bri shing rgyan dgram pa la gnyis las/ dang po thig gis bri ba ni ye shes kyi gnam thig bteg pa'i 'og tu 'dzul nas gdab ste/ de nas bri ba'i cho ga ni/ / chas ldan dbang phyug thig bteg la/ / dang po dbang ldan phyogs nas bskor*/ / de nas zhal dbang thob pa rnams/ / 'bru ldan rdo rje thal khu tshur/

/ phyag rgya ting 'dzin ldan par bri/ / zhes pas tshangs zur la sogs mthong ba brgyud pa ltar sgo gnyis brtsegs su gdab bo/ / de'ang man ngag gis cung zad phye na/ cha chen bcu drug nang ma gsum/ / phyed du bgos te drug tu bya/ / dang po phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ / gnyis pa cha bzhir bsgo bar bya/ / gsum pa bzhi pa mi gdab gzhag/ lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ / drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ / de ni nang gi sgo yin no/ / cha chen bzhi pa phyi yi khyams/ / lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ / drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ / bdun pa cha bzhir bgo bar bya/ / brgyad pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ / ces pa ltar ro/ / de nas 'gying phur gdab pa'i nang du ye shes lnga'i tshon gyis dgang zhing rim gyis dgye ba ni/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ tshon ni nang nas dgye bar bya/ / phyi rol nas ni tshon mi dgye/ / dang po byang shar nas brtsams te/ / thog mar slob dpon nyid kyis dgye/ / de nas slob mas bya bar bshad/ / ces pa dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ tshon ni nang nas dgye bar bya/ / phyi rol nas ni tshon mi dgye/ / dkar po thog mar gtang bar bya/ / de yi 'og tu dmar po ste/ / de nas ser po gtang bar bya/ / de yi 'og tu ljang khu gtang*/ / kun gyi nang rol nag po ste/ / tshon gyi cho ga de ltar bshad/ / ces pa ltar ro/ / de'ang rgyas pa la sgo nyis brtsegs kyi dbus kyi lte ba la 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus dang lngar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa mu khyud dang bcas pa ste lha'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i rim pa'o/ / de nas gru chad nang ma dang phyi ma bzhi ni phyogs tshon no/ / de nas rtsig pa lnga ni nang nas rim pa bzhin/ mthing galjang gu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'o/ / spyir na rtsig rim gnyis te/ ye shes dang*/ sku'i rim pa'o/ / 'dir nang ma ye shes kyi rim pa yin la/ phyi ma sku'i rim pa ste/ nang nas mthing gdakar po/ ser po/

dmar po/ ljang gu'o/ / khyams ljang gu dang*/ rta babs mdzes tshon la/ gzhan rnams phyogs dang mdzes tshon ci rigs su bya'o/ / kha cig rta babs kyi gzhi'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhi mtshon par 'dod cing*/ phal ni gzhan dang mthun par sbyor bas rdo rje'i ra bzhi yang 'dod do/ / gang ltar yang 'gal ba med do/ / 'bring po la ni 'og nas 'byung ba'i dkyus bzhin no/ / bsdus pa la ni bar khyams med pa'i gru chad bzhi la sgo khyud ldan par bzhed do/ / gnas de dag tu mtshan ma dgod pa ni grub na sku dang yig 'bru dang phyag mtshan gang rung dgod cing*/ ma grub na brda mtshon tshon spungs kyi sku mdog mtshon pa tsam re bya'o/ / yang rngam glog las/ gtso bo gzugs su rdzogs par bri/ / 'khor rnams phyag rgya dag tu bya/ / phal pa dag la yig 'brus so/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / bzhi pa mchod pa bsham zhing phan yon bstan pa la gsum las/ dang po mchod pa bsham pa ni phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ rgyan dang gos la sogs pa dang*/ rol mo dang sil snyan la sogs dang*/ kha zas mang pos brgyan par bya'o/ / gnyis pa rab tu gnas pa ni dkyil 'khor du skad cig gis bskyed cing ye shes pa bcug nas rten 'brel snying po'am yi ge 'bru gsum gyis brtan par byas te gzugs brnyan lta bur bsgom pa'o/ / de skad du rngam glog las/ dkyil 'khor la sogs gang byas kyang*/ / rab gnas ye shes mi ldan na/ / tshogs dang 'bri ba'i nus pa med/ / ces so/ / gsum pa phan yon ni de ltar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bris pa'i bsod nams ni dpag tu med de/ ye shes rgyas pa las/ gang gis rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog/ thig dang tshon gyis 'bri byed pa/ / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing rnams kun/ / rin cen bdun byin bsod nams las/ / de yi phung po dpag tu med/ / las rnams 'grub cing rgyal bas dgongs/ / dkyil 'khor bsam yas thob par 'gyur/ / zhes pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las kyang*/

gang gis mchod rten rdo las byas pa dang*/ / gang gis a ka ru dang tsan+dan nam/ / gang gis sman shing mchod rten byas pa dang*/ / la las shing ngam gzhan la byas pa dang*/ / sa dang so phag la ni sogs pa yis/ / rgyal ba'i mchod rten dga' zhing byas pa dang*/ / de bzhin sa rdul phung po dag las kyang*/ / mya ngam dgon pa dag tu byas pa dang*/ / byis pa'i rtsed mor de dang de dag tu/ / gang gis rgyal ba de phyir mchod rten dag/ bye ma las ni phung por byas pa dang*/ / gzhan dag gzugs brnyan dag tu 'dri byed pa/ / de rnams kyis ni byang chub thob par 'gyur/ / la las de bzhin rin cen gzugs byas la/ / sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang ldan pa'i gzugs/ / gang gis de phyir byas pa de dag kyang*/ / de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ / la las de ni rin cen sna bdun dang*/ / la las de bzhin zangs dang 'khar ba las/ / bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi gzugs byas pa/ / de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ / ro nye dang ni lcags sam sa yang rung*/ / bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi gzugs byas te/ / lta na sdug pa 'jim pa la byed bcug/ de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ / gang gis rtsig ngos gzugs kyi ri mo dang*/ / bsod nams rgya chen yon tan rdzogs pa'i sku/ / gang gis bris sam 'dri ru bcug kyang rung*/ / de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ / skyes bu rgan nam 'on te gzhon yang rung*/ / gang dag la la de na slob pa'i tshe/ / rtsed mo dag dang gsang ba byed pa na/ / rtsig ngos sen mo shing bus gzugs bris pa/ / de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / gnyis pa lha bskyed cing ji ltar mchod pa la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor bskyed cing gsal gdab pa dang*/ ji ltar mchod pa'o/ / dang po ni/ mtshams dang dam bca' brtan par byas la/ gnas de nyid du stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ dang po sems bskyed pa ni/ e ma hoḥ ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/

/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*/ / skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ / skyes pa nyid nas skye ba med/ / la sogs pa brjod pas chos thams cad spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang nas ting nge 'dzin gsum bsgom par bya ste/ lus ngag sems dang chos thams cad/ /gang na mi gnas mi dmigs pa/ / mig yor tshul du sbyor ba yis/ / nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' bsgom/ / zhes brjod pas thams cad mi dmigs pa de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang las/ sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i snying rje chen po kun tu snang gi ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya'o/ / de'i ngang las rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ rtsa ba med pa'i sems nyid ni/ / chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ / sems nyid yi ge'i rang bzhin te/ / yi ge yid bzhin rin cen sprin/ / a zhes brjod pas/ sems kyi rang bzhin a dkar por gsal ba'i ngang las/ a/ rab tu brtan gyur a dkar las/ / shin tu phra ba'i a rnams spro/ / phyogs bcu gang bar gsal gyur nas/ / bsdus kyang 'phel 'grib med par brtan/ / zhes brjod pas/ a las zla ba dang nyi ma 'idakyil 'khor gyi dbus su a las 'phros pas mtshan gyi sa bon ā li dang*/ dpe byad kyi sa bon kā lis rim pa gnyis su bskor ba'i rang bzhin/ a dang k+ṣa'i ngo bo 'od du zhu ba las hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ de nyid kyang yongs su gyur pa las rang bzhin gzhi'i kun tu bzang po mthing ga rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i sku 'od zer gyi phung po 'bar ba las nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par bsgom mo/ / de'ang de bzhin nyid dang kun tu snang ba ni stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs so/ / nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor ni me long lta bu'i ye shes dang rdo rje'i rigs so/ / 'od kyi gong ni bu mnyam pa nyid dang rin po che'i rigs so/ / rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa ni so sor rtog pa dang pad+ma'i rigs so/

/ sku ni bya ba grub pa dang las kyi rigs te/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i chos kun yongs su rdzogs par bsgom pa nyid do*/ / de nas bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe zhes pas gzhi tshad med pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po sgo bzhi gru bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ / rtsig pa lnga'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu la rin po che'i drwa ba drwa phyed 'phyang zhing*/ mda' yab dang pu shus mdzes pa/ bum pa zlum po kun tu 'khyil pas nam mkha'i dbyings khyab pa/ phyi nang dag cing ye shes kyi 'od gsal ba/ sgo phyi nang gnyis dang*/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang rol mo'i sprin phung 'khrigs shing*/ 'dod yon gyi lha mo dpag tu med pas mchod pa'i sprin gtibs te/ ye shes phyogs bzhi dbus brtags te/ /zhes pa nas/ nyi zla pad+ma rin po che/ / zhes brjod pas gzhal yas khang shin tu gsal bar bskyed do/ / de nas/ a ni skye med de bzhin nyid/ / k+ṣa ni ye shes thugs kyi thugs/ / zhes brjod pas rang gi g.yon du yum kun tu bzang mo mthing ga yab dang 'dra ba bskyed nas/ thabs dang shes rab dgyes sprin byang chub sems tshogs rgyu 'khor lo/ / 'bras bu rgyal ba smin grub ngo mtshar ming tshogs bzhi bcu gnyis/ / 'dus ma byas nyid 'dus byas rdo rje dkyil 'khor 'byin pa'i dam/ / 'da' bar mi mdzad dbang med rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i mthu chen yin ho/ / zhes pas yab yum gnyis su med par 'khril ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge sprin 'phros te*/ lha'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsgrub slar 'dus dkyil 'khor du byon par bsam zhing*/ ṭha ni sgyu 'phrul rdo rje nyid/ / ces pa nas/ oṃ ni thams cad zhig pa yin gyi bar brjod pas/ rnam snang yab yum ni kun tu bzang po yab yum la thim par gyur/ lha gzhan rnams ni rang rang gi gnas su bzhugs par bsam mo/ / de nas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rig pa'i kun tu bzang po rkang pa'i long bu sprad cing lag pa thal mo sbyar te 'greng ba sems dpa'i rgyan dang ldan pa gcig 'thon nas/
