dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la lan gsum bskor ba byas te nub sgo nas me tog gtor zhing*/ oṃ sngon gyi thugs dam chen po ni/ / 'jig rten ma lus thams cad kun/ / rgyal ba'i zhing du sbyor bas na/ / phyag rgya chen po bdag sbyor cig/ ces brjod pas/ lha rnams kyis gnang ste thabs dang shes rab kyi 'od zer bdag la spros te/ sems kyi rtog pa dang de las gyur pa'i lus ngag sbyangs te/ gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i rang bzhin 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu gyur pa la/ lha rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi rnam par 'phros pa phog cing thim pas/ 'od kyi gong bu de nyid sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin yi ge hūm̐ du gyur nas/ gtso bo'i thugs kar thim pas gtso bo'i sku gzi byin dang ldan par bsam mo/ / de nas gtso bo yab yum gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems su gyur te yum gyi mkha' la gnas pa las/ lha thams cad kyang rang rang gi gsang sngags kyi sgra dang bcas nas byang chub kyi sems la thim par gyur nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus seng ge dang nyi zla'i steng na de thams cad gcig tu gyur pa byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin 'od kyi gong bu tsam zhig dmigs pa las/ slar yang hūm̐ dang mūm̐ du gyur te 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du las rdo rje dang dril bur gyur cing*/ de yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi skur bsam mo/ / de nas oṃ ma hā shūn+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ad+ma ko3haṃ zhes pa la sogs pas ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur zhing sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lngas byin gyis brlab bo/ / de nas gtso bo yab yum gyi mkha' gsang rdo rje dang pad+mar byin gyis brlabs nas/ sa ma ya hos sbyor ba'i brdas bskul nas gnyis su med par snyoms par zhugs pa'i yab kyi byang sems yum gyi mkha' la spros pas mkha' gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang na/

lha rnams kyi snying po hūm̐ dang oṃ la sogs pa so so'i sa bon rnams gsal btab la/ lha so so'i gsang sngags brjod pa tsam gyis lha so so'i skur gyur te/ dzaḥzhes brjod pa tsam gyis yum gyi mkha' nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la skad cig gis bton te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdus sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsgrubs te/ rang rang gi gnas su bzhugs par bsam zhing*/ sngar bstan pa'i lha so so'i sngags rnams brjod cing gsal bar bskyed do/ / de'ang kun tu bzang po yab yum ni gtso bo'i thugs kar bsam zhing*/ thub drug ni phyi'i khyams la bzhugs par bya'o/ / gzhan ni ji skad smros pa bzhin no/ / dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'o/ / de nas spyan drang ba ni/ phyogs dus dkyil 'khor bdag nyid che/ / mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las/ / dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drang ngo*/ / rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor la/ / 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid mnyam sbyor bas/ / phyogs dus kun nas gshegs pa yi/ / bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rdzogs/ / nye bar 'gyur ba'i dam tshig mchog/ oṃ e h+ye he bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi kā tṛ sha hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod pas/ 'og min nas dkyil 'khor chen po ji ltar bskyed pa lta bu mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la/ yid kyis mchod de/ rig pa'i me tog dor ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya oṃḥ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya aḥ hūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ḥ swā badz+ra sa ma ya swāḥ hā badz+ra sa ma ya hāḥ zhes brjod pas/ rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las rnams dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las rnams rang bzhin dbyer med par rtogs par bya ste/ thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul ye nas dag pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / 'di ni rig pa'i me tog dor ba zhes kyang bya/ so so ma yin pa rig pa 'dun pa'i phyag ces kyang bya/

rang snang gi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i tshul zhes kyang bya'o/ / de nas lha'i sku rnams dbyer med du bstim pa'i phyir/ oṃ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ / yon tan 'phrin las rmad po che/ / de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor ba/ / phyag rgya chen por bdag sbyor cig/ ces pas lha rnams dngos grub stsol ba la phyogs pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ gis ye shes pa dam tshig pa la chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin dbyer med du thim/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ gyis rang nyid lha'i dkyil 'khor du 'tshang ma rgyas kyi bar la brtan par bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hos dbang du gyur cing dgyes par bsam mo/

/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs brtan zhing gsal bar gyur pa nyid/ shin tu gsal bar gyur pa nyid/ / gdan la rdzogs dang sems dpa'i tshul/ / zhes pa nas/ dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun gyis grub/ / ces pa'i bar brjod pas/ lha rnams gsal gdab bo/ / gnyis pa ji ltar mchod pa la gsum las/ dang po thun mong gi mchod pa ni sngags phyi pa rnams dang tshul mthun par/ lha'i dkyil 'khor la bdag nyid gtso bo'i thugs ka nas las kyi sems dpa'i tshul du byung ste/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ bshags pa dang*/ dngos grub blang ba dang*/ smon lam 'debs pa la sogs bya'o/ / de'ang sems kyi rol pa tsam yin pa'i phyir na gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor shes par bya'o/ / gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod pa ni 'phrul dga'i lha rnams rang gi sprul pa'i longs spyod la spyod pa'i tshul gyis/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'dod yon gy-i lha mo rnams spros te de dag gis mchod par bsam pa dang*/ phyogs bcu thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dag par bsam zhing*/ longs spyod chen po rgyan gyis rol pa glu tshig rol mo'i sprin la sogs 'dod dgu phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod pa chen po rgyun mi 'chad par lhun gyis grub pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul te/ lha la lha rol pa'i tshul gyis mchod par bya'o/ / gsum pa bla na med pa'i mchod pa la yang*/ sbyor sgrol gnyis su med pa'i mchod pa/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa/ glu ye shes phyag rgya'i mchod pa/ dgyes pa chen po bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams gong 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin 'dir mchod cing*/ khyad par du bdud rtsi'i rjes la yum mtshan dang ldan pa dngos sam yid kyis bsam pa la sbyor ba'i brdas bskul ba'i pad+ma'i khyams su yungs 'bru tsam gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa la/ 'og min nas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la bstim la/

rol pa'i bde ba'i mchod par bya'o/ / de nyid yul sangs rgyas bde ba chen po la/ mchod rdzas bde ba chen pos mchod pas/ 'bras bu ye shes bde ba chen po sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa da lta nyid la mngon du gyur pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ / de nas bzlas brjod kyi rim pa ni/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i yi ge las 'od 'phros pa nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa'i sems can la phog pas/ sgrib pa thams cad sbyang ba la sogs pa las bzhi'i rim pas dmigs te/ sems can rnams yi ger gyur thugs kar thim pa'i tshul gyis gtso bo nas sgo ba'i bar lha so so'i sngags brjod par bya'o/ / yang na sngags ky-i phreng ba lha so so'i sku'i dbyibs brgyud cing mkha' gsang nas 'khor ba'i 'od zer bde ba chen po 'phros pa sems can la phog pas/ sgrib pa sbyangs te lha'i rang bzhin du gyur pa slar 'dus snying gar thim pa'i tshul gyis rtsa ba'i sngags dang*/ 'khor gyi sa bon tsam phyogs gcig tu bzlas pa la brtson par bya'o/ / grangs ni 'dir mtha' gcig tu nges par ma gsungs te/ ji tsam grub par gyur pa de srid du bzlas par 'dod do/ / spyir gtso bo la bye ba/ 'khor rnams la khri khrag re res grangs kyi bsnyen pa grub par bzhed pas 'dir yang de'i rjes su 'brang bar bya'o/ / de'ang dus thams cad du lha'i dkyil 'khor las mi 'da' ba'i phyir thun rjes gsal btab pa'i ngang las phyag rgya bzhi'i don dang*/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs dran par byas te mnyam par bzhag nas/ sems can gyi don du bsngo ba byas la langs te snang srid thams cad lha dang gzhal yas khang dang zhing khams su mos pas spyod lam gyi bya ba ci bder bya'o/ / gsum pa dbang bskur zhing 'bras bu bstan pa la gsum ste/ thun mong gi sngon du 'gro ba sbyin sreg bstan pa/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba/

bskyed rdzogs bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ rdo rje las rim las/ sbyin sreg pa rnam pa bzhir gsungs te/ / sa dang rab gnas rnam gnyis dang*/ / bde ba sbyin pa'i dus nyid do/ / zhes pas/ sa chog gi tshe mtshan ma ngan na zhi ba/ dkyil 'khor rab tu gnas pa'i tshe rgyas pa/ dbang bskur ba'i tshe dbang*/ slob ma sta gon gyi tshe rmi lam ngan na drag po'o/ / de'ang thab khung ni zhi ba la dkar zhing zlum pa ste/ rtsig pa yin na zabs su khru gang yod pas kha khyer bang rim gsum la 'khor lo dang rdo rje ra ba dang mda' bzhi zhags pa dkar pos mtshan pa'o/ / bris pa yin na 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i mtha' ma oṃ dang seng mgo spel ma dang mda' bzhi zhags pa dkar pos mtshan pa'o/ / rgyas pa la gru bzhi ser po ste/ brtsig na gru bzhi khru gang ba bang rim gsum gyi nang ma la rin po che'i sgrom bu/ bar ma la rdo rje/ tha ma la zhags pa ser pos bskor ba'o/ / bris na rin po che zur brgyad pa rtse mo rin po ches mtshan pa'o/ / dbang la zla gam dmar po ste/ bris na pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ rtsig na mda' bzhi gru bzhi dmar po'o/ / drag po la gru gsum nag po ste/ bris na khro zhal gdengs pa/ rtsig na mda' bzhi zhags pa nag pos bskor ba'o/ / bud shing yang kha dog so so'i dbyibs dang mthun par brtsigs te/ sreg rdzas zhi ba la dkar gsum til dang kha zas dkar po'o/ / rgyas pa la mngar gsum zho dang 'bru sna tshogs ser po/ dbang la skyur dang me tog bza' btung sna tshogs dmar po/ drag po la tsha ba dug khrag liṅga sna tshogs nag pa'o/ / de nas thab dang bsreg rdzas bsang sbyangs byas te/ ye shes kyi me 'od las kyi kha dog can gyi dbus su oṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā las/ las gang byed kyi me lha rwa skyes kyi steng na bgrang phreng*/ sgrom bu*/ zhags pa/ tri shul bsnams shing*/ g.yon gun+de 'dzin pa so so'i mdog can du bskyed la/

hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ / tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ / me lha drang srong bram ze mchog/ 'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ / oṃ ag+na ye e h+ye hi sa ma ya dza dzas spyan drangs la dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs bstims pa la mar khu dgang blugs bdun gyis byon zan phul nas mchod bstod byas te/ me lha'i sngags des sreg rdzas lan bdun phul la bstod nas/ me lha'i lto bar zhi rgyas gnyis la zh-i ba'i lha/ dbang drag la khro bo bskyed pa'am/ ma bskyed kyang rung ste spyan drangs nas bzhugs par gyur pa la/ byon zan dgang blugs bdun bdun gyi rjes la mchod bstod byas la/ yam shing la sogs pa'i sreg rdzas so so'i rtsa sngags kyis phul ba'i rjes la/ shīn+taṃ/ puṣ+tiṃ/ wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ mā ra ya phaṭa btags la brgya'am stong la sogs pa phul nas 'dod don la gsol ba btab ste gshegs par gsol nas/ rigs mthun pa'i lha gzhan dang*/ yul lha gzhi bdag dang*/ me lha nyid gsal btab la ci 'byor pa phul te/ 'phrin las bcol nas/ bzod par gsol te gshegs nas*/ bkra shis kyi bar du bya'o/ / des ni las rnams 'grub cing bar chad zhi bar byed pa'o/ / gnyis pa slob ma gzhig cing dbang bskur ba la gsum ste/ slob ma gzhug pa sta gon gyi cho gdabang bskur ba dngos gzhi'i rim pa/ phan yon bsgrags shing dga' ston bya ba mjug gi las so/ / dang po ni/ las rim las/ dbang phyug 'jug dang bzod par gsol/ / khrus dgab dri dang lus dbul dang*/ / bgegs bskrad lhar rlob dam tshigasbyin/ / de nyid dbog dang chu nan dang*/ / bsgrag dang rin cen dor ba dang*/ / lha dbab pa dang nan tan dang*/ / mig dbye dkyil 'khor legs bstan dang*/ / tshogs mchod yon dang rnam bco brgyad/ / ces pas/ slob dpon 'jug pa'i chos gcig dang*/ / slob ma 'jug pa'i chos bcu bdun no/ / dang po ni/ rdo rje slob dpon chas gos dmar po dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'dug ste/

me tog bzung nas oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya oṃ la sogs pa'i sngags brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dbyer med par bsams la/ oṃ ye shes rgyal po zhes pa la sogs pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+wam̐ la sogs pas dngos grub bskul te bdag dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par bzhugs par bsam mo/ / re zhig bsdus pa ste/ rgyas par 'jug na slob ma 'jug pa bzhin byas la dbang len pa yin no/ / de nas slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu dri'i chus khrus byas te/ ras la sogs pa'i mig dar dmar pos gdong g.yogs la snyim pa me tog dang bcas te bzhag go/ nang du slob dpon gyis thal mo sbyar la/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i/ / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ / pho brang snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ / bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ / bzod par mdzad de dgongs su gsol/ / ces brjod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgyes nas 'dzum pa dang bcas pas slob ma chug par gnang ba thob par bsam mo/ / de nas bu rnams mig dar bkab pa de las kyi slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi drung ma yin pa'i sgo nang gi bla ma'i drung du khrid la/ rdo rje sems gtso khyed la 'dud/ / thar lam chen po bdag 'dod de/ / de nyid dbang dang dam tshig dang*/ / mgon po dpa' bor skyabs gsol cing*/ / theg chen khang par gzhug pa dang*/ / mkhyen rab ye shes bdag la stsol/ / zhes bla ma la zhu'o/ / bla mas bu khyod ci la dga' ba smros zhes dris pa'i lan du/ skal ba bzang la bdag dga' zhes so/ / bla mas/ bu khyod shog cig ci bde ba'i/ / las spyod rim par 'gro ba dang*/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gzung*/ / rdzogs pa'i ye shes bde chen la/ / dmigs pa med par gnas phyir du/ / ser sna spangs pa'i dang yid kyis/ / gtong zhing rang sems brtan por gzung*/ / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbang rdzogs sbyin/

/ zhes so/ / de nas las kyi slob dpon des rdo rje phyed lag tu gtad pa la slob mas bzung ba dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid la phyag 'tshal te/ oṃ sarba bud+dha pū tsa pa ta nā ma ā sma nan nir+ya ta yā mi/ zhes pas lus dbul lo/ / bla mas bi shwa badz+ra la sogs pas bgegs bskrad de/ lag sor lnga rigs lnga yab yum bskyed la bden pa bdar te/ sor mo bsnol bas sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer 'phros nas bu'i sgrib pa bral te 'od du zhu nas/ dngul chu ltar gnas pa la cho ga gsum gyis slob bu rnam snang du bskyed la go bgo zhing bsrung ba byas te gzhag go / de nas yang*/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ / ji ltar mchod pa mdzad pa ltar/ / zhes pa dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba/ / zhes pa la sogs pa zhus pa'i rjes la| bla mas/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ la sogs pa gnas gsum du 'bru gsum bzhag la 'phro 'du byas te/ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya sid+dhi oṃ la sogs pa brjod nas sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig sbyin no/ / de'ang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba 'di/ / dam nyams ma 'dres med pa la/ / nam yang smra bar ma byed cig/ theg pa chen po ston byed pa/ / nga la brnyas dang smad mi rung*/ / sku gsung thugs la rtag gnas shing*/ / ma lus sems can don gyis shig/ ces bu'i snying gar rdo rje gtad la dam tshig dbogade nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ / dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ / rdo rje khro bo chen por 'gyur/ / rdo rje'i chu 'di btung bar gyis/ / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes dam tshig gi chu blud nas yang*/ de lta bas na bu khyod kyis/ / dam tshig 'di dag bsrung bar gyis/ / dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub pas/ / rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig/ oṃ badz+ra u ka ta ya hūm̐ tha/ zhes pha yon gyi chu nan bya'o/ / de nas/ thabs dang shes rab sems nyid kyis/ / rtag tu dogs pa med gyis

la/ / 'dod pa lnga yi yon tan spyod/ / ces thob pa'i dam tshig go bar bsgrag go / de nas/ me tog la sogs rin chen 'phreng*/ / sngon tshe ye shes bsnyen pa'i lha/ / thugs rjes gzung bar dgongs nas kyang*/ / gang yin de la bab gyur cig/ oṃ pra ti dza badz+ra hos me tog gi cod pan dor la lha gang la las 'brel yod pa brtag go / de nas me tog blangs la spyi bor bzhag la/ me tog phog pa'i lha de nyid e h+ye his bu'i spyi bor spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs bstams la/ bden pa'i tshig gi rjes su/ lha de'i mtshan nas brjod nas slob ma 'di'i snying la zhugs te 'di phyir dngos grub phun sum tshogs pa 'grub par gyur cig ces brjod nas/ pra be shes bu'i khog pa kha phye bar bsams la/ ā be shas lha dang de nyid gnyis su med par bsam mo/ / de nas me tog phog pa'i lha'i rigs dang bstun la/ rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa'i gsang mtshan gdags shing*/ lha de'i sgom bzlas dbog go / de nas/ de ring dad pa'i shugs kyis ni/ / dkyil 'khor dam pa blta bar bya/ / sangs rgyas gsung gi rigs su 'khrungs/ / dngos grub mchog tu gyur par byed/ / badz+ra tsak+ṣuḥpra be sha phaṭaḥ ces pas gdong g.yogs dkrol nas mig phye bas ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mthong bar mos par bya'o/ / de nas chos rnams thams cad gnyis med pa'i/ / dbyings su thim pa'i 'od zer gsal/ / gcig dang spros pa thams cad med*/ / dkyil 'khor spros med zlum po'i tshul/ / zhes pa la sogs pas dkyil 'khor gyi don rtags rnams dang*/ thams cad rang bzhin rnam dag phyir/ / sgyu 'phrul bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyis*/ / thams cad lha nyid rtag tu sbyor/ / thams cad ma lus dkyil 'khor mchog/ mtshan nyid legs par shes par bya/ / zhes pas lha'i de kho na nyid rnams bstan to/ / de nas yon ci 'byor pa dngos sam med kyang khas blang ba dang yid kyis kyang dbul te/

hoḥmi gnas pa'i ye shes chen po'i bdag nyid gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa dgongs su gsol/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che ge mo'i zhal snga nas/ bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed nas shin tu phra ba'i chos nyid la thugs sbyangs pas/ da lta gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i mnga' bdag tu bzhugs pa hoḥzhing mchis lags/ de dag kun gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' zab mo sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbang 'di lta bu zhig zhus na/ snod dang mi ldan pa zhig mchis na'ang sems can rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor can la dgongs nas/ gnang ba hoḥzhing mchis lags/ bka' drin gyi lan zho sha ma skyud pa'i mtshan ma tsam 'di dag 'bul lags/ zhes yon khas blang ngo*/ / slob ma 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ / gnyis pa dbang bskur ba dngos gzhi'i rim pa la gnyis las/ dang po phan pa'i dbang bcu bskur ba ni dbu rgyan cod pan phreng ba dang*/

/ go cha rgyal mtshan phyag rgya dang*/ / gdugs dang bum pa bza' btung dang*/ / snying po lnga yi dbang bskur na/ / dus 'di phyin chad rgyal ba'i sras/ / ngan song thams cad med pa dang*/ / tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ / mtho ris thar ba'i bdag por 'gyur/ / zhes pas/ slob ma lhar gsal ba la/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan bcings pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur te phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshon byed du rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa'o/ / de'ang rnam par shes pa'i tshogs ye shes lngar gsal ba'i dgos pa yod do/ / cod pan bcings pas thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel ba'i dgos pa yod do/ / phreng bas lhag byang chub kyi yan lag thob cing gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i dgos pa yod do/ / de bzhin du go chas nyon mongs pa'i mtshon gyis mi tshugs shing rtsa gnas dra ba'i tshul du gnas pa sa ya phrag bcu gsum dag par byed pa'o/ / rgyal mtshan gyis mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba ste 'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'o/ / phyag rgyas ni rtog tshogs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis yi ge 'khor lo'i sa thob par byed do/ / gdugs kyis nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba las skyob cing thugs rje'i char 'bebs pa ste dung khang na rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis dag par byed pa'o/ / bum pas nyon mongs pa'i dri ma sbyong zhing zag pa med pa'i chu rgyun gyis rgyud brlan par byed pa'o/ / bza' btung ni 'dod yon rgyan du shar bas rgud pa sel zhing bsam gtan gyi bde bas tshim par byed pa'o/ / snying po lnga ni nyon mongs pa lnga dang phung po lnga/ ye shes lnga dang rigs lngar dag par byed pa'o/ / de ltar dbang bcu ni so so'i dbang rdzas kyis bskur bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam mo/ / de dag gi ngo bo ni thal pa las/ khams bcud bde ba'i lam gnyis dang*/

/ dbu ma bcud mdud sdud tshad mtshan ldan par/ / dra ba'i rtsa dang dbang po dang*/ / phung sogs ye shes bde 'khor lo/ / hūm̐ gis bde ba'i ye shes bcas/ / tshogs brgyad rang bzhin ye shes lnga/ / sngags rdzas dgongs pas gang blangs pa/ / kun nas ldang zhing skyob pa yis/ / sdug bsngal las grol rigs su nges/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa nus pa'i dbang lnga las/ nyan pa'i dbang ni/ bla ma yab yum gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams nas yi ge bh+rūm̐ dmar ser gcig 'phros pa slob bu'i rna ba'i nang du phog par bsam zhing*/ las kyi rdo rjes der bdud rtsi'i thig le re byas la/ bh+rūm̐ zhu ba las rna ba gnyis su 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi gru chad bzhi la sgo bzhi gtod par/ yi ge trāṃ zung lnga ya bcu hūm̐ bzhi dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥdang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba las/ rin cen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi phyogs bzhir/ rdo rje rin cen/ nyi ma*/ rgyal mtshan/ zhags pa bzhi/ yum mā le/ puṣ+pe/ pā sha rdo rje bde ba ste pho brang gi lha bcu/ sgo ba yab yum dang bcas te bco brgyad gsal btab la/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas phyag rgya'i lha mo bzhi spros la 'og min nas ye shes pa de 'dra ba spyan drangs te bstims pas/ spyir sgrib pa mtha' dag dag cing sgos su chos nyan pa la sgrib pa thams cad dag ste/ slob ma lha dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba rin cen 'byung ldan du bskyed pa la gsang ba'i snying po'i po ti gtad de/ trām̐ gsang ba gsang chen gsang mchog gang*/ / gsang ba kun las mnyan par bya/ / gsang ba'i don nyid brtag pa las/ / gzhan du smra bar bya ba min/ / zhes bsgrag go / de bzhin du 'og ma la'ang bsgres la/ gnyis pa sgom pa'i dbang ni me tog phog pa'i lha gang yin gyi rigs lnga'i sa bon las de'i dkyil 'khor bskyed de zhu ba las/ yang lha de nyid du bskyed la/ dbang rdzas 'phreng ba gtad de/ oṃ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras chen po/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje bzung*/

/ rgyal ba thams cad mnyes mchod la/ / rgyal ba kun dang mnyam par sbyor/ / zhes brjod do/ / sangs rgyas gsang ba snying nang du hūm̐ las rdo rjer gyur pa mi bskyod par bsams pa las/ dbang rdzas rdo rje nyid du sbyor bar mdzad do/ / gsum pa 'chad pa'i dbang ni lce la bh+rūm̐ 'phros gzhal yas khang gi rnam par gyur pa'i nang du hrīḥdang hūm̐ bzhi dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥgyur pa las/ snang ba mtha' yas yab yum la/ rdo rje chos/ rnon po/ / 'khor lo/ smra ba bzhi/ yum glu ma/ mar me/ lcags sgrogagasal bkra ma dang bcas pa sngar bzhin no/ / dbang rdzas tshar rnon 'khor lo bris pa lag tu gtad de/ oṃ chos kyi bdud rtsi bla med kyis/ / dad ldan skyes bu ngom par byos/ / rab 'bring tha ma'i blo can la/ / mthun par gsang bsgrag gzhan du min/ / zhes brjod do/ / bzhi pa 'phrin las kyi dbang ni lag pa gnyis la sngar bzhin gzhal yas khang du hām̐ la sogs par gyur pas/ don yod grub pa yab yum la/ rdo rje las/ bsrung ba/ gnod sbyin/ khu tshur/ yum gar ma/ byug pa/ dril 'khrol/ 'bebs ma dang bcas pa'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin bsgres la/ dbang rdzas rdo rje rgya gram lag tu gtad de/ oṃ khyod ni rdo rje las yin gyi/ / las rnams ma lus kun gyis shig/ pho nya mang po'i 'phro 'du kun/ / khyod kyi dgos pa byed pa yin/ / zhes brjod do/ / lnga pa rdo rje rgyal po'i dbang ni mgo dang yan lag la dkyil 'khor lnga dang phyi rol tu khro 'phreng bsgom ste/ de'ang dpung mgo g.yas su mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi phyogs bzhir sems dpa' rdo rje/ rin cen rdo rje/ chos rdo rje/ las rdo rje/ yum ldan ma rdo rje/ 'bar ma rdo rje/ sdud ma rdo rje/ bskyod ma rdo rje'o/ / mgo la rnam snang yab yum/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rgyal po/ chags pa/ legs pa/ yum rdo rje sgeg mo/ bdug pa/ lcags kyu/ sgrol ma'o/ / g.yon gyi dpung mgor rin cen 'byung ldan gyi dkyil 'khor sngar smros pa bzhin no/

/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon la don grub dang*/ 'od dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor sngar bzhin no/ / phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams steng 'og bcur khro bo bcu'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms la ye shes pa bstims te/ dgyes nas sbyor ba mdzad pa 'od du zhu bas slob ma kun tu bzang por bskyed la/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bu lag tu gtad de/ oṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi thams cad kyi/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje che/ / dkyil 'khor kun gyi byed pa po/ / dkyil 'khor kun gyi sbyin pa spyod/ / ces rjes su gnang ba sbyin no/ / de nas zab dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma yab yum gtso bo yab yum du bskyed pa'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te/ sbyor ba mdzad pa'i byang chub kyi sems hūm̐ gi rnam pa'i rgyun yab kyi rdo rje nas byung ba/ yum gyi pad+ma'i rtser bskyil ba rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gsal ba slob ma'i lce thog tu bzhag na thabs kyi gsang dbang*/ de ma nus na yum gyi pad+ma'i sna rtse nas bus len pa ni shes rab kyi gsang dbang*/ de yang ma nus na yum gyi mkha' nas yab kyi lce yis blangs te bu'i lce thog tu ster ba thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i gsang dbang bskur ba'o/ / de ltar lce thog tu bzhag pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun snying gar babs te/ 'gro drug gi las dang gnyid kyi bag chags sbyangs bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang la blo gnas par bya'o/ / de nas shes rab ma nyid bu dang bcas pa gsang dbang bzhin byin gyis brlabs pa byas te/ snyoms par 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi sems pad+ma'i rtser babs pa las nus pas bzlog cing bde ba'i ngang der bla mas gsal gdab pa ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*/ / de nas bde ba'i ngang de nyid gang du'ang ma grub pa'i rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba rdzogs pa chen po'i ngo bor ngo sprad pa ni bde ba chen po'i dbang ste mthar thug gi lam mo/

/ 'dir bla mas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ma blangs par gzhan la gsang dbang bskur bar mi nus shing*/ slob mas kyang dbang yongs su rdzogs par ma byas par lam mi bgrod pas de ltar bskur zhing len par byed pa yin no/ / de ni slob ma blo stobs can chags pa dang ma bral ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ / blo'i stobs chung ba grol lam pa la ni ting nge 'dzin dang byang chub bdud rtsi'i ril bu tsam gyis byed pa'o/ / kha cig 'dir gsang dbang tsam du 'dod pas ni dngos dang shugs kyi don ma mthong ba yin no/ / de dag gi rim pa'ang*/ rdo rje las/ dang pos sa bon 'jog pa ste/ / gnyis pas nus pa bskyed pa yin/ / gsum pas nyams myong bskyed pa'o/ / bzhi pas de nyid brtan par byed/ / lnga pa brtan pas nyams blangs pas/ / mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dis 'grub/ / ces so/ / de'ang slob dpon snga ma kha cig gi phan dbang bcu/ nus dbang lnga/ zab dbang gsum ste bco brgyad du 'dod cing*/ kha cig zab dbang gsum gcig tu bsdus nas bcu drug tu 'dod kyang*/ 'dir phan pa'i dbang dang nus pa'i dbang zhes gnyis su bsdus pas/ zab dbang ni nus dbang gi khongs su 'du bas bco lnga kho na'o/ / gsum pa phan yon bsgrags shing dga' ston bya ba mjug gi las la lnga las/ dang po dbang bskur ba'i phan yon la rgyal ba'i sras su chud pa/ theg pa dman par mi ldog pa/ dus nye ba/ lung bstan thob pa bzhi las/ rgyal ba'i sras su chud pa ni dbang thob pa de nas bzung ste sangs rgyas kyi sras su dgongs shing*/ tshe 'di nyid la 'dod pa 'grub cing*/ phyi mar mtho ris dang thar pa 'grub la/ ngan song thams cad rgyun chad pa ste/ 'di nyid las/ dus 'di phyin chad rgyal pa'i sras/ / ngan song thams cad med pa dang*/ / tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ / mtho ris thar pa'i bdag por 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / theg pa dman par mi ldog pa ni rdo rje rtse mo las/ ji srid sa brgyad ma thob par/

/ de srid theg pa dman pas 'jigs/ / gsang chen theg pa 'di ru ni/ / zhugs pa gang dang gang yin pa/ / de ni rgyal sras sa pa yin/ / zhes so/ / dus nye ba ni de nyid las/ gzhan tshe bcu drug gis thob pa/ / tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ / rgyal ba'i sras kyi sa thob kyang*/ / dkyil 'khor gsang bar ma gyur na/ / ji ltar khyod ni de byung ba/ / de bzhin theg pa yid ches gyis/ / skye dang skye ba thams cad du/ / rdo rje can ni dngos brtson 'gyur/ / skye ba bcu drug mthar thug pas/ / zhi ba'i sangs rgyas nyid thob 'gyur/ / rgyal ba'i sras kyi sa thob kyang*/ / bskal pa grangs med gnyis ka spyod/ / gsang ba'i theg par ma zhugs pas/ / bcu drug gis ni 'gyur ma yin/ / zhes pa dang*/ yang rgyud gsang mdzod las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ / skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ / de yi skye ba bdun na ni/ / ma bsgrubs pa yang dngos grub 'thob/ / ces so/ / lung bstan thob pa ni/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud las/ slob ma dkyil 'khor btsud nas kyang*/ / yon gyi mchog dag blangs nas ni/ / rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas/ / de bzhin gshegs par de lung bstan/ / phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'di dag gis/ / byang chung snying po'i bar du ni/ / rdo rje'i ming du rab tu grags/ / de nas sangs rgyas su yang 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / de'ang sa thob pa'i yon tan dang dbang thob pa gnyis rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa mi 'dra yang*/ sangs rgyas thob pa la 'di nyid nye bas lam zab pa yin no/ / gnyis pa dbang ma thob pa'i skyon ni/ 'di las/ slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing*/ / dbang rnams thob par ma byas bar/ / nyan pa la sogs brtson pa rnams/ / 'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ / zhes pa dang*/ bya rgyud las kyang*/ gang zhig byang chub sems ni ma bskyed dang*/ / gang zhig dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs pas/ / nga yi gsang sngags bzlas na phung bar 'gyur/ / zhes

so/ / gsum pa bla ma mnyes par bya ba ni dgongs 'dus las/ dam pa bla ma bshes gnyen zhes/ / brjod pa'i thog mar zhe sa gzhug/ khyad par cis kyang mnyes par bya/ / zhes so/ / ji ltar mnyes par bya ba yang de las/ mnyes par bya ba'i yo byad brgyad/ / dam pa de la rdzogs par dbul/ / skyo dub med pa'i dad pa dang*/ / gyong khengs med pa'i mnyen lcug dang*/ / ser sna med pa'i zang zing dang*/ / som nyi med pa'i sri zhi dang*/ / g.yo sgyu med pa'i drang thad dang*/ kha gsags med pa'i rang rgyud dang*/ / rmongs pa med pa'i shes rab dang*/ / dri ma med pa'i lhag sems brgyad/ / dam pa de la rdzogs par dbul/ / zhes so/ / de'ang bla ma'i bka' mi bcag cing ci byed kyang zhus te bya ba yang*/ de las/ dkyil 'khor la sogs sbyin sreg dang*/ / slob ma gzung dang chos smra ba/ / lung ma byung bar mi brtsam ste/ / dam pa'i yul nas de mi rigs gang des gzhan gyi don byas/ / de yis yo byad mi spyad de/ / de kun dam pa de la dbul/ / dam pa'i slob ma slob mar yang*/ / dam pa'i mdun du mi rigs so/ / zhes so/ / bla ma'i yod byad rang dgar spyod na'ang skyon du 'gyur te de las/ dam pa'i yo byad mnga' dbul ba'i/ / phongs pa de yis gzhan bsgral na/ / de yang dbul po nyid du 'gyur/ / 'tsho ba dam pa dang bral bas/ / longs spyod chen pos phongs pa yi/ / mu ge'i dgon pa nyid du lhung*/ / zhes so/ / de'ang bla mar bzung nas gus par bya ste/ dam par bzung bar gyur phan chad/ / dam par nges dang ma nges kyang*/ / bka' bcag lung bor ba ga la srid/ / gal te de yis rgya nyams na/ / rdo rje dmyal bar de 'gro ste/ / mi bzad sdug bsngal chen por 'gyur/ / zhes pa dang*/ rngam glog las/ gal te yon tan mi ldan yang*/ / bla mar bzung nas spangs byas na/ / kun gyi slob dpon brnyas pa yin/ / dus gsum sangs rgyas skur ba yin/ / de yis nyes pa brjod mi lang*/ / zhes so/ / mdor na nyes pa tshad med de/

/ rdo rje las rim las/ dngos grub zhing gyur dbang phyug ni/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi mtshan nyid de/ / 'bad pas mnyes par mi byed pa/ / bskal par bsgribs nas mun nag sogs/ / bde bas rab tu brel gyur cing*/ / thabs dang shes rab la sogs lam/ / shin tu ring bar 'gyur ba yin/ / nus mthu byin ldan bde gshegs lung*/ / nor bu rgya mtsho mkha' lta bu/ / sa bcu'i sems dpa' chen pos kyang*/ / nus mthu gzu lums ma yin phyir/ / gus pa'i rim pas blang bar bya/ / zhes so/ / bzhi pa dam tshig bsrung ba ni/ kun 'dus las/ dbang rnams legs par rdzogs gyur pas/ / rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig kun/

/ ma nyams rab tu bsrung bar bya/ / des ni dngos grub mchog thob 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / lnga pa dga' ston bya ba ni/ 'di las/ de nas rigs kyi bu mchog des/ / rgyal srid dang ni rang gi lus/ / bu dang chung ma nor gyi dbyig/ rab tu gces dang yid 'thad 'bul/ / zhes so/ / gsum pa bskyed rdzogs gaums pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa la gnyis las/ gnas skabs su dbang thob pa des dam tshig la gnas shing bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgoms pas/ rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin las tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin 'thob ste/ zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam/ / bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis/ / dbang bsgyur rigs kyi dam pa 'grub/ / ces so/ / de'i rten la phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin yang grub nas/ gnyis pa mthar thug gi 'bras bu lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin 'thob ste/ de tshe bcu drug tshun chad kyis/ / sku lnga lhun gyis rdzogs pa ni/ / zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ tshe lo brgya pa'i tshe lo bcu drug tsam na mchog 'grub par grags kyang*/ rang rang gi rig 'dzin de dus kyi mi tshe gang yod la brtsis pa'i tshe bcu drug gi lo grangs na 'grub bo/ / de'ang rdo rje rtse mo las/ skye ba bcu drug mthar thug pas/ / zhi ba'i sangs rgyas nyid thob 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / spyi'i don bshad zin to/ / gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor gsungs tshul mdor bstan pa dang*/ de'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa de~X nasa~X de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyis 'gro ba'i don la dgye~Xs pa~X chena~X po~Xs kun tu bzang po nyid rdo~X rje~X gsa~Xng ba'i~X dma~X tshi~Xg gi dkyil 'khor bko~Xd de dbang bskur ba'i rim pa~X la~X snyomasa~X para~X zhuga~Xs pa ste yum dang lhan cig phyogs na~Xs che~Xd du~X brjoda~X pa~X 'di~X skad ces brjoda~X do~X/ / gnyis pa la gsum ste/

dbang po rab mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ dman pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ gang du dbang bskur ba'i don bsdu ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ yum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ yab kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor dgod cing sbyin sreg bya ba/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i mchod pa dbul ba/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor dgod pa dang*/ sbyin sreg bya ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa dang*/ mchod pa bsham pa'o/ / dang po la lnga las/ dang po gnas gang du dkyil 'khor dgod pa ni mchog tu gsang ba'i bde ba chen po ni shes shing rig par dka' bas shina~X tu~X phra~X ba~X'i don yin la/ de nyid tshe 'dir mchog sgrub pa'i med du mi rung ba'i da~Xm tshiga~X gi mchoga~X yin pas na/ de gang las skye zh-ing 'dzin pa phya~Xg rgya~X mtshan ldan bde ba che~Xn po~Xs lus rgyas pa'i~X phyaga~X mthila~X yum mkha' rnam par dag pa nyid du~X dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor gnas so/ / gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi tshad ni bde ba chen po gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thuga~Xs kyi~X dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr dma~X pa~X de~X nyid so~Xr gyi tshad ni~X dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba bzhi~X yi~X tsha~Xd du~X bya~X ba'o/ / de skad du'ang klong gsal las/ yum mkha' sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / gsang ba zab mo'i dkyil 'khor te/ / ye shes bzhi yi rang bzhin du/ / gnyis su med par dbang nyid bskur/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / gsum pa thig gdab pa ni/ gnas de'i rgyud sbyong ba ste/ de'ang 'bru~X lnga~X ni skye ba'i sa bon te dug lnga ye shes su gnas pa'o/ / spo~Xs lnga~X ni de nyid gnas su dag pa'i ye shes lnga'o/ / ri~Xn ce~Xn lnga~X ni phung po lnga'o/ / snyinga~X po~X lnga~X ni~X sku lnga'o/

/ smana~X lnga~X dnga~X ni rigs lnga'o/ / bdu~Xd rtsi~X lnga~X ni sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lnga dbyer mi phyed pa'i sems nyida~X rnam par dag cing 'od gsal ba'o/ / raba~X mnyama~X la zhes pa ni de ltar yin pa la yin par shes par byed pas chos thams cad sangs rgyas par mnyam pa nyid du ston pa'o/ / de ltar ri~Xg pa~Xs yum gyi rgyud ye shes chen por gsal ba'i tshangs thiga~X gi mchog rnam par dag pa ni~X gsal gda~Xb para~X bya'o~X/ / de'ang sngar gsang sngags la rgyud ma sbyangs pa'i phyag rgya yin na slob dpon des dge bsnyen nas rim gyis rgyud dag par gsal bar byed pa'i thig rnams gdab par bya'o/ / rgyud sbyangs zin la ni bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa dang*/ rtsa btsal ba la sogs pa'i cho ga byed pa la thig tu brjod pa yin no/ / 'dir kha cig ba so la sogs pa la dkyil 'khor sor bzhi bri ba ste/ de la thig gdab pa yang*/ phung po lnga dag pa sku lnga'i rang bzhin nas/ gro/ sran ma/ til/ 'bras te 'bru lnga/ dbang po lnga dag pa 'phrin las lnga'i rang bzhin ga bur gur gum/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ a ka ru ste spos lnga/ yul lnga dag pa yon tan lnga'i rang bzhin gser/ dngul/ byu ru/ mu tiganor bu ste rin cen lnga/ rnam shes lnga dag pa ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin lan tshwa/ sbrang*/ bu ram/ mar/ shing 'bras te snying po lnga/ 'dod yon lnga dag pa gsung lnga'i rang bzhin shu dag dkar po/ dbang po lag pa/ sle tres/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ a mra'i 'bras bu ste sman lnga/ khams lnga dag pa rigs lnga'i rang bzhin nyi ma/ zla ba chu sa sha chen gyi dwangs ma ste bdud rtsi lnga rnams cha mnyam pa'i chus srad bu spangs nas thig 'debs par 'dod cing*/ tshon bkye ba'i dkyil 'khor de slob dpon gyi phyag mthil du bzhag nas/ de'i phyaugs mtshams su mchod pas bskor nas dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i bar du byas te dbang bskur bar bzhed pa ni/ gzhung 'di'i dgongs pa ma yin te/

de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor bri bar yang mi nus shing*/ gal te nus na'ang der dbang bskur ba la yon tan lhag po med de/ chung bas yod na sku gzugs la sogs pa yang shin tu chung ba bsod nams che bar thal ba'i phyir dang*/ bcos ma ni dbang po rtul po'i rim pa ste/ bde mchog las/ ri mor gnas pa'i las dang ni/ / thig la tshon dgye'i rim pa dang*/ / 'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyis/ / grub pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ / bcos ma gnyis kyi ngo bo gang*/ / de ni bsgrub bya'i dkyil 'khor te/ / mkhas pa'i bsgrub byar de mi 'dod/ / ces gsungs pas/ 'dir yang tshul mthun te/ rang bzhin lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba yin no/ / bzhi pa ji ltar bri ba ni yum mkha'i rang bzhin gzhal yas khang gi rnam par gnas pa de nyid gsal bar byed pa ste/ dbus su lte~X ba~X rtsi~Xbs da~Xng lda~Xn pa~X yi~X ngo bo bha ga'i nang gi rtsa 'dab bzhi'o/ / de'i rtsi~Xbs bzhi~X pa'i 'kho~Xr lo~X mu~X khyuda~X dang bca~Xs pa de'i phyi rol gyi dbyibs gru~X cha~Xd bzhi~X dang ༵gru ༵ba~Xzhi pa~X yi~X rnam pa can gyi ba~Xr khyama~Xs pad+ma'i sgo~X khyuda~X ldana~X pa~X la de ltara~X gsal bar bya'o~X/ / lnga pa mtshan ma dgod pa ni lha'i gnas der snyigs ma dkar dmar gyi ngo bo mtshon pa se~Xn zluma~X tsa~Xm gyi~X nyi~X zla'i~X gdan la~X sran ma'i ga'u phyed pa tsa~X na~X'i 'bru~X tsa~Xm gyi pa~Xd+ma'i~X gda~Xn gyi steng du shin tu dwangs ma yunga~Xs 'bru~X tsa~Xm gyi~X ngo bo yi~X ge~X'i rnam pa hūm̐ du gsal ba la~Xs rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i phyaga~X rgya~X rdo rje tila~X 'bru~X tsa~Xm du~X bri~X pa ste gsal gdab bo/ / gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ phyag rgya'i g.yon phyogs su dmigs pa'i rten yod dam med kyang rung ste tshogs dang mchod pas brgyan par bya ba yang*/ kha dog bsgyur ba'i gos bco~Xs bu'i~X rnam pa dar dang rasa~X ni~X sna~X tsho~Xgs pa dnga~X*/ dbu rgyan mgul rgyana~X la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs dang*/

do shal dang drwa phyed la sogs pa'i 'phrenga~X ba sna tshogs dang*/ ja dang chang la sogs pa'i btunga~X ba sna tshogs dnga~X*/ sha dang thud dang phrum la sogs pa'i bro~X bsa~X bskora~X cing*/ shin tu snyan pa'i glu~X dang bstod pa'i tshiga~X mdzes par byed pa'i skye bos rkang pa'i bro~X dang lag pa'i gara~X bsgyur cing*/ dung dang cha lang dang pi wang dang gling bu dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i ro~Xl mo~X'i sprina~X phunga~X bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tsho~Xgs kyisa~X raba~X tu~X mcho~Xd cing*/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i rkyen du gyur pa'i yuma~X da~Xng yid 'jo~X bar byed pa'i dga' ma~X dang na tshod gzhon nur gyur pa'i se~Xms ma~X yi~Xs rol pa'i dga' ba bskyed pa dang*/ reg bya'i dga' ba bskyed pa dang*/ mig gi dga' ba bskyed pa ste rnam gsum po ji~X ltara~X 'doda~X pa'i~X la~Xs bzhi~Xn mcho~Xd pas brgyan par bya'o/ / skabs 'di'i mchod pa'i gtso bo ni bde ba ster bar byed pa'i yum phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi yul rnams yin par bzhed do/ / gnyis pa sbyin sreg gi las la gnyis las/ dang po las bzhi'i sbyin sreg spyir bstan pa ni/ las bzhi'i rim pas thab khung gi dbyi~Xbs kyang zlum po la sogs pa dnga~X*/ kha~X doga~X kyang dkar po la sogs pa so so'i mtsha~Xn nyid tshang ba dang lda~Xn pa~Xr me lha'i rang bzhin mchod sbyin gsol ba'i zhala~X du~X gyura~X pa'i~X lto bar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me~X lha bo~Xs te spyan drangs la~X zho zan dang mar khu la sogs pa bza~X' btunga~X bro~X ba~X'i tsho~Xgs rnama~Xs kyisa~X mchod cing*/ zhib la til/ rgyas pa la rin po che la sogs pa lasa~X bzhi'i~X mchoda~X pa~X so so'i sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis ra~Xb tu~X sbyina~X par bya'o/ / gnyis pa khro bo'i sbyin sreg bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ji lta bar khro~X bo~X'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr du yang thab dang lha'i mtshan nyid la sogs pa de~X bzhi~Xn du bya ste~X/

ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i gnad shi~Xn tu ༵phra~X zhing zab mo rnams la~X rab tu sbyanga~Xs pa~X yi~Xs rnal 'byor pas/ lha'i dkyil 'khor bsa~Xm ya~Xs da~Xg la~X'anga~X cho ga'i rim pa de~X kho na bzhi~Xn du sbyin sreg gis mnyes par bya'o~X/ / de'ang lha gang gi dkyil 'khor la las gang gis sbyin sreg ji ltar byed pa'i tshul rnams ni gnas skabs dang sbyar ba'i rang gi ri~Xg pa~Xs legs par dpa~Xgs pa~X de tsa~Xm du~X bya'o~X/ / gnyis pa snang la rang bzhin med pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba la gnyis te/ ting nge 'dzin yid kyi mchod pa dang*/ gsang ba bde ba chen po'i mchod pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ kun rdzob sgyu ma'i mchod pa dang*/ de'i rdzogs rim don dam pa ye shes kyi mchod pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis las/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod sprin bkod pa ni dkyil 'khor la yid sprul gyis ji ltar mcho~Xd pa~X'i phyaga~X rgya~X che~Xn po~X ni~X rang gi sema~Xs kyi~X bkod pa'i yi~Xd bzhi~Xn gyi nor bu'i sprina~X phung 'khrigs pa'i tshoga~Xs kyi~Xs phyoga~Xs bcu~X'i 'jig rten gyi khams thama~Xs ca~Xd sanga~Xs rgyasa~X kyi zhinga~X khams rnam par dag pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin rgyan stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams lta bur bh+rūm̐ gyis gsal gdab bo/ / de'ang rgyan dang bkod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab cing yid du 'ong bas mdzes par spras shing*/ mnye~Xn la 'ja~Xm zhing re~Xg na~X bde~X ba~X'i rang bzhin rgyu sna~X tsho~Xgs ri~Xn po~X che~X yi~X sa gzhi~X khod snyoms pa la/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis mig mang ris su mdze~Xs pa~Xr bri~Xs shi~Xng lha'i nor bu sna tshogs kyis tshom bu rab tu brgyan pas phyogs bcu kun tu 'khyil bar sprasa~X pa~X da~Xng trāṃ las 'dod dgu kuna~X 'byunga~X ba'i rina~X ce~Xn sna bdun gyi phunga~X po~X 'od zer gyi drwa ba 'ba~Xr ba'i ri bo lhun stug pa dang*/ kham̐ las mtsho dang ldeng ka la sogs kha dog mdzes shing dbyi~Xbs le~Xgs pa'i pad+ma'i rdzi~Xng bu~X ro bro~X ba'i mcho~Xg bsi~Xl ba la sogs pa yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chus yongs su gang ba me tog gis khebs shing bya skad snyan par sgrogs pa'o/

/ brgyad ldan ni 'dul ba lung las/ yang dang dro dang 'jam pa dang*/ / dngas dang bsil dang rnyog pa med/ / 'thung na lto la mi gnod dang*/ / mgrin pa la'ang mi gnod pa/ / 'di dag yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ / zhes so/ / bh+rām̐ las ri~Xn po che~X'i khanga~X pa~X dbyibs dang kha dog dang bkod pa'i bye brag sna~X tsho~Xgs pas brgyan pa rab tu mang po dnga~X*/ oṃ las skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir rin po che'i rgyana~X 'phreng dnga~X lha'i dpa~Xg bsa~Xm gyi shing ljona~X pa~X'i tsha~Xl gos dang nor bu sna tshogs kyi drwa bas dpyangs pa dang*/ hrīḥlas sgra skad thams cad glu~X dbya~Xngs snyan pa dang*/ bstod pa dang shis pa brjod pa la sogs pa'i tshiga~Xs su~X bca~Xd pa~X'i sgra~X rang 'byung ba dang*/ am̐ las gos kyi rnam pa dang mchod pa'-i yo byad bla~X re~X dang rgyala~X mtsha~Xn dang gdugs dang stod g.yogs smad g.yogs la sogs pa'i na~X bza~X' sna tshogs dnga~X*/ trām̐ las dbu rgyan dang mgul rgyan dang do~X shala~X dang dpunga~X rgyana~X dang se~X mo~X do~X la sogs pa rgyan gyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ oṃ las ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa'i bza~X' ba sna tshogs dnga~X*/ bdud rtsi'i btunga~X ba zhim po dang*/ gos zungs rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i~X bsgo ba sna tshoga~Xs pa rnama~Xs dnga~X*/ hūm̐ las sems can thams cad kyi lus dang rang ranga~X la~X ji ltar 'os pa'i gos dang rgyan la sogs pas mdze~Xs pa~Xr brgyana~X pa~X yi~X lha~X dang ༵lha~X mo~X'i rang bzhin rdula~X phra ba snyeda~X kyi~X grangs dang mnyam par gyur pa thams cad kyis rkang pa'i bro~X dang lag pa'i ga~Xr dang rol mo'i glu dbyangs la~X soga~Xs pa bsa~Xm ya~Xs kyisa~X mnyes par byas pa'o/ / de lta bu'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis phyoga~Xs bcu'i nama~X mkha'i~X khama~Xs ji snyed pa thams cad yongs su bka~Xng na~Xs 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings kyis bsdus pa'i gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr du gyur to cog kuna~X la~X mchod sprin de dag gis re re zhing rgyasa~X pa~Xr dbu~Xl ba'o/

/ gnyis pa tshul ji ltar dbul ba ni skala~X ldana~X rnal 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang gsa~Xl ba~X'i khyada~X pa~Xr gyi~Xs rima~X gyi~Xs sam/ yanga~X na~X ci~Xg gyura~X du~X gsal lam gyis rgya che ba cho~Xs kyi~X dbyinga~Xs da~Xng mnya~Xm par sbyora~X zhinga~X 'bul lo/ / gnyis pa de'i rdzogs rim don dam ye shes kyi mchod pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa la dngos zhen spong ba'i phyir mchod sprin de dag kyang rang gi sems tsam las gang du'ang grub pa med la sems de yang nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin gang na'ang mi gnas shing spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la mchod bya dang mchod byed dang mchod pa gsum ga'i ngo bo ma grub pa'i tshul gyis mcho~Xd pa~X'i phyaga~X rgya~X che~Xn po~Xr bsgo~Xm par bya'o/ / de'ang blo rab kyis mchod dus nyid nas de ltar bsgom zhing 'dzin zhen med par byas la/

dman pas rjes la mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag go / 'di ni mchod pa'i mchog ste/ dkon cog ta la la'i mdo las/ gang la mchod pa nam mkha' 'drar shes shing*/ / gang gis mi dmigs gang du'ang 'dzin pa med/ / de ni mchod pa kun gyi dam pa ste/ / ye shes gzhal med bsam yas rab 'thob 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa gsang ba bde ba chen po'i mchod pa la gnyis te/ thabs bde ba chen po'i mchod pa dang*/ shes rab mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i mchod pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ mchod pa dngos dang*/ de'i phan yon bstan pa'o/ / dang po ni/ las kyi phyag rgya shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin gsa~Xl bar ldana~X ma'am de dang mi ldan na rnal 'byor pas lhar bskyed cing mkha' gsang byina~X gyis brlaba~X pa la~X sogs pa'i cho gas byin gyis brlabs la/ pad+ma'i rtser yungs 'bru tsam gyi dngas ma dkar dmar dkyil 'khor du bskyed de/ stonga~X gsu~Xm gyi 'jig rten thams cad 'phags pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis yungs 'brura~X gzhuga~X cing tshud par byin gyis brlabs pas stong gsum chung du mi 'gro yungs 'bru cher mi 'gro ba'i tshula~X du~X pad+ma'i khyams rten gyi dkyil 'khor cher mi 'gro ye shes pa chung du mi 'gro ba'i chos kyi dbyinga~Xs nasa~X rgyal ba'i dkyila~X 'kho~Xr dpag tu med pa pad+ma'i khyams su spyana~X dranga~Xs shing bstim la/ sbyor ba'i brdas bskul te rol pa'i bde bas mchoda~X par bya'o/ / des dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mnye~Xs na~Xs dngos gruba~X chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa~X'i dma~X tshi~Xg mcho~Xg gi go 'phang thob par bsam mo/ / de ni sngar dkyil 'khor bkod pa sor bzhi la ye shes pa gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'i sngon du bsnyen bsgrub bya ba'i rim pa 'ang gsal bar bstan to/ / gnyis pa de'i phan yon la gnyis te/ gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug go / dang po la gnyis las sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes pa ni/ bde ba'i bda~Xg nyida~X che~Xn po~Xs yum mkha'i dkyil 'khor la mcho~Xd pa~X yi~Xs phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i sanga~Xs rgyasa~X kyi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr ma~X lusa~X pa thams cad mnyesa~X par 'gyur ro/

/ yang bdag nyid chen po rang rig pa'i ye shes la rol pa'i bde bas mchod pa yis khams dang skye mched ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa'i lha rnams mnyes par 'gyur ro/ / yang yab kyis yum/ yum gyis yab la bdag nyid chen po'i mchod rdzas des mchod pas thabs dang shes rab kyi lha rnams mnyes par 'gyur ba ste phyi nang gsang ba gsum du shes par bya'o/ / 'gro ba thams cad tshims pa ni/ de ltar bde ba'i rol pas lus snang ba'i grong khyer 'dod pa'i srid pa ngag phyed snang gi grong khyer gzugs kyi srid pa yid mi snang ba'i grong khyer gzugs med pa'i srida~X pa gsuma~X gyis bsdus pa'i tshor ba dang rtog tshogs kyi 'gro~X ba~X thama~Xs ca~Xd la~X ye shes chen po'i dga'a~X ba~X bzhi dang gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid bzhi dang spros pa dang bral ba'i 'od gsal che~Xn po~Xs khyaba~X pa~Xr 'gyura~X ro/ / chos nyid bzhi ni lus gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid yab dang yum du 'dzin pa med pas gzung 'dzin mtha' dag las grol ba dang*/ ngag gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid brjod du med pas spros pa dang zhen pa kun las grol ba dang*/ yid gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid rtog tshogs bde ba chen paur grol bas rang bzhin chos sku'i ngo bo mthong ba dang*/ ye shes gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid bde ba'i ngang la 'dzin med chen por gnas pas 'od gsal gyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad pa'o/ / 'od gsal bzhi ni de'i tshe bde ba'i 'od gsal sgo gsum dga' bas khyab pas snang srid dga' bder shar ba dang*/ gsal ba'i 'od gsal bde ba'i ngang las sems kyi ngo bo rang gsal thabs shes su snang ba ma 'gags pa dang*/ mi rtog pa'i 'od gsal phra rags su zhen pa'i byung tshor nub pas gang la'ang mi 'phro bar rtog med du gnas pa dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'od gsal chos nyid kyi ngang las rtags bcu'i snang ba shar ba'o/

/ rtags bcu ni rlung sems dbu mar tshud pas dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig tu gyur pa'i rtags su/ du ba dang*/ smig rgyu dang*/ sprin dang*/ me khyer dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ rin po che 'bar ba dang*/ sgra gcan dang*/ skar ma dang*/ 'od zer gyi snang ba lta bu 'byung ba'o/ / rgyud sde gzhan las kyang de dang cung zad mi 'dra ba'i rtags bcu bshad do/ / gnyis pa mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob pa ni sgyu~X 'phrula~X dra~X ba~X thabs dang shes rab kyi ting nge 'dzin rtags bcus mtshon pa de nyid goms pa rab tu brtana~X pa~X las byung ba de yi~Xs 'bras bu phyoga~Xs bcu~X dusa~X bzhi~Xr gshe~Xgs pa~X yi~X sanga~Xs rgyasa~X kyi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr ma~X lusa~X pa'i rang bzhin dnga~X*/ khamasa~X gsuma~X gyi 'gro~X ba rnams la thugs rjes gzigs pa'i ye shes dam pa mngo~Xn du~X 'gyura~X ro/ / yang na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor phung po khams dang skye mched lhar gsal ba mthar thug pa dang*/ sgo gsum sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor 'khor lo mngon du 'gyur ba zhes bya'o/ / gnyis pa shes rab mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i mchod pa ni/ de ltar yab yum gnyis su med par snyoms par zhugs pa'i nyon mongs pa'i 'dzin zhen dang tha mal gyi rnam rtog rang sar dag par bya ba'i phyir/ rang dang yum gyi lusa~X dang nga~Xg dang sema~Xs dnga~X bde bas mtshon pa'i phyi nang gi cho~Xs thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi rang bzhin gzung ba'i yul ganga~X na~X'ang mi~X gna~Xs shing 'dzin pa'i sems gang du'ang mi~X dmi~Xgs pa~X'i ngang las/ med bzhin du snang ba mi~Xg yo~Xr lta bu'i tshula~X du~X yab yum gnyis su med par sbyora~X ba~X yi~Xs thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i dbyings skye ba med pa'i nama~X mkha~X' la~X ni~X sems nyid 'gags pa med pa'i ye shes nama~X mkha~X' bsgo~Xm zhing dbyer med pa'i chos nyid don gyi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag cing rol bar bya'o/ / gsum pa 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i tshul la gnyis te/

'jug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o/ / dang po la gnyis las/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa nas bzung ste cho ga'i sngon du bya dgos pa kuna~X bya~Xs nas tshogs dang rnal 'byor gyi dbanga~X phyuga~X rdo rje slob dpon nyid ting nge 'dzin gyi riga~X pa~Xs dkyil 'khor du sngon la 'juga~X par bya'o/ / slob ma 'jug pa ni/ slob dpon zhugs pa de~X nasa~X sloba~X ma~X rnams 'jug pa'i chos bcu bdun gyis dkyil 'khor du gzhuga~X para~X bya'o~X/ / gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la gnyis te/ yon dbul ba dang*/ blo'i rim pa dang sbyar nas dbang bskur ba dngos so/ / dang po la gnyis las/ yon dbul ba dngos ni 'jug pa'i chos rnams tshar ba'i rjes de~X nasa~X riga~Xs kyi~X bu~X skal ba mchoga~X dang ldan pa de~Xs bla ma la/ rang gi 'byor pa thams cad kyis mchod par bya ste/ rgyala~X srida~X yul 'khor dang bcas pa dnga~X ni~X/ ranga~X gi~X lusa~X dang bu~X dnga~X chunga~X ma~X dang nora~X gyi~X dbyi~Xg gser dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs te/ de rnams kyi gnyis gnyis yod na raba~X tu~X gce~Xs shos de dang mdor na rang gi yi~Xd du 'ong zhing 'tha~Xd pa'i dngos po rnams dbula~X lo/ / gnyis pa phan yon ni rnal 'byor gyi dbanga~X phyuga~X rdo rje slob dpon la 'dod pa'i longa~Xs spyoda~X rnam pa lngasa~X mchoda~X na~X phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i sangs rgyas kyi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr thama~Xs ca~Xd mcho~Xd pa~X yi~Xn na/ nye~X ba~X'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr yi dam gyi lha mchod pa lta smosa~X kyang ci~X dgo~Xs te/ dam tshig rnam par bkod pa'i rgyud las/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin mchod na/ / dkyil 'khor thams cad mchod pa ste/ / nye ba'i dkyil 'khor smos ci dgos/ / nyes zad dngos grub mchog thob 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / des dam tshig dag sdom pa'i nyesa~X pa~X thama~Xs ca~Xd da~Xg pa~Xr 'gyura~X ba kho na'o/ / gnyis pa blo'i rim pa dang sbyar nas dbang bskur ba dngos ni/

dada~X pa dang brtsona~X pa'i brtula~X zhuga~Xs raba~X tu rtogs pa'i skal ba yod par shes na~X de la phana~X pa'i~X dbanga~X bcu~X dang nusa~X pa'i~X dbanga~X lnga po slob dpon gyis lhag pa'i snyinga~X rjesa~X slob ma'i rgyud chuda~X ma~X zo~Xs pa~Xr gzunga~X zhing sbyin no/ / gal te skal ba med na mi sbyin pa'am phan dbang tsam bskur gyi nus dbang mi sbyin te/ nyes pa chen por 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ / de'ang ye shes bkod pa chen po dam tshig mchog gi rgyud las/ snod dang mi ldan slob ma la/ / dbang bskur byas na gnyis ka phung*/ / zhes so/ / 'dir phyin ci log gi nags thibs po che log par lta ba'i mun pa mi bzad pas 'thibs shing*/ nyon mongs pa'i chom rkun rab tu rtsen pas dkrugs shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis 'phrin las 'jug pa'i go skabs med pa kha cig na re|rgyud gzhan las dbang bzhi dang*/ de las phye bas bcu bzhir gsungs pa dang*/ khyed kyi 'dir phan pa dang nus pa'i dbang gnyis las phye ba'i bco lnga po grangs mi mthun pas/ rgyud 'di yang dag pa ma yin no/ / zhes zer ro/ / kye ma/ ma la skal ba ngan pa khyed cag lta bus dbye bsdu dang don gyi rim pa'ang khong du ma chud cing rgyud sde tha dad kyi dgongs pa zab mo la blo kha ma phyogs par zad do/ / de lta bas na rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las bum pa dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang gsum du gsungs la/ ngan song sbyong ba nas dbang bcu gcig gam dbye na bcu dgur gsungs pa dang*/ de nyid 'dus pa dang zla gsang thig le'i rgyud las bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes gsum du gsungs pa dang*/ mnyam sbyor las/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i dbang gnyis su bsdus pa yod pas rgyud yang dag pa ma yin par 'gyur ro/ / de dag don la mtshungs pas skyon med do snyam na 'di yang don la mtshungs pas nyes pa ga la yod/ 'di ni rgyud thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas rgyud gzhan gyi dbang bskur tshul thams cad 'dir 'dus pa yin no/

/ de'ang bum pa'i dbang dngos su gsungs la/ de nyid mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang bskur ba yin no/ / dbu rgyan dang cod pan dang me tog ni rin cen 'byung ldan gyi dbang ngo*/ / phyag rgya ni rdo rje dang dril bu la sogs pa ste 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa'o/ / nus dbang gi skabs su khyod ni rdo rje las yin gyis zhes pa la sogs pas rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbang bskur ba yin la/ brtul zhugs dang lung bstan dbugs dbyung la sogs pa thams cad rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa nus pa'i dbang gis bstan pa yin no/ / gsang ba'i dbang ni dngos su bstan pas shes rab ye shes dang*/ tshig dbang rin po che ni de'i nang gses su zhar la bstan pa yin no/ / de bas na rgyud sde don mthun pa'i phyir na 'di la nyes pa ga la srid/ tshul 'di lta bu la smad pas mthong ba'i chos la lce lkog ma'i 'og la don pa dang 'chi khar me yi snang ba chen po 'bar bas dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rtags khyad par can rnams khyed las gzhan pa su la 'byung ba srid de bskal pa du mar snying rje'i 'os su gyur pa nyid do/ / gnyis pa yab kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba ni/ yum gyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba de las gzhan pa'i tshul yab kyi rdo rje'i rtse las dbang blang bar bstan pa ni/ yanga~X na~X yab kyi thala~X mo~X mnyam gzhag gi tshul gyis raba~X tu bsnola~X nasa~X lha'i sku phyaga~X rgya~X chena~X pora~X gsal ba'i~X dba~Xng mdzub mo'i bar du ni~X gu h+ya badz+ra gyi dkyila~X 'kho~Xr ring thung mdzuba~X ganga~X ba'i tshada~X du~X yanga~X bde ba'i thabs la mkha~Xs pasa~X dbang bskur ba'i cho~X ga~X bzhi~Xn du~X dngas mas bu la dbang bskur bar bya'o~X/ / de nas dbang rnams rdzogs par sbyin no/ / 'dir kha cig nus dbang sngon la bskur zhing phan dbang rjes gnang gi tshul du phyi la bskur te thams cad gsang dbang kho na'i bskur ba ni dbang po rnon po'i dbang du byas la/

rdo rje las rim nas gzhan bzhin rtul po'i dbang du byas so zhes pa'ang rigs par ma mthong ste/ 'di nyid las kyang*/ phan pa'i dbang dang nus pa'i dbang*/ / snying rjes chud ma zos par gzung*/ / zhes phan dbang sngon la gsungs shing*/ go rim kyang thog mar bum dbang dang de nas gsang dbang dang shes rab ye shes bzhi pa rnams 'byung ba yin no/ / gnyis pa dman pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i tshul la gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor bri ba/ bsgrub pa/ bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor chung ngu*/ 'bring*/ chen po/ bri ba'i cho ga'o/ / dang po la gnyis las/ sa'i cho ga ni rab mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba las tshul gzhan ya~Xng na ༵sa~X gzhi~X sa'i cho gas raba~X tu mnyama~X pa la~X bri'o/ / de'ang sngar ma dag pa'i sa gzhi phyis dag par byed pa ma yin te/ sa chu spyan dang mā ma kī/ / zhes pa la sogs pas shes la/ ye nas sa sbyangs zin pa'i phyis gsal 'debs pa'i tshul gyis sbyang ba yin no/ / gnyis pa 'dri ba dngos ni gzugs brnyan gyi dkyila~X 'kho~Xr chung ngu'i chung ngu khru~X ga~Xng gi~X tshada~X du~X bya~X'o/ / chung ngu'i 'bṛng yanga~X na~X lusa~X ganga~X gi~X tsha~Xd du~X ste~X 'dom gang ngo*/ / chung ngu'i chen po ya~Xng na~X lusa~X ni~X gsuma~X gyi~X tsha~Xd tsam la/ mi rus la sogs pa'i phura~X bu~X ni dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'gying phur sor bzhi la sogs pa dang bgegs bsrung ba'i don du sor bco brgyad pa la sogs pa'o/ / cha dbye ba'i don du ras bal lam pad+ma'i rgyus pa'am dur khrod kyi skra la sogs pa'i sra~Xd bu~X khrun du dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur yod pa rigs tha dad mtshon pa'i don du kha dog ma 'dres pa'i tshona~X gyi phye~X ma lnga la sogs pa dnga~X*/ las bsgrub pa'i don du gosa~X dnga~X rgyana~X bzang pos mdze~Xs pa~X yi~Xd du 'ong ba'i gro~Xgs las kyi phyag rgya lo bcu drug lon pa'o/

/ de nas srad bu'i sna nas grogs des bzung la/ ye shes kyi thiga~X dang las kyi thig gnyis gdaba~X pa'i cho~X ga~X phuna~X suma~X tsho~Xgs pa dkyil 'khor gyi las la mkha~Xs par ldana~X pa chena~X po rdo rje slob dpon gyisa~X lus sems ma g.yengs par rab tu bsgrima~Xs te bya~X'o/ / gnyis pa 'bring la gsum las 'bring gi chung ngu yanga~X na~X khru~X ni~X bcu~X druga~X pa dnga~X*/ 'bring gi 'bring khru nyi~X shu~X yod pa'ama~X/ 'bring gi chen po khru nyi~X shu~X rtsa~X lnga~Xr bya'o~X/ / de la snga ma bzhin du thig gdab par bya ste/ thig tshon la riga~Xs kyi~X dkyila~X 'khora~X rnam pa lnga~X po~X rnama~Xs bsgoma~X zhing zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes lnga'i thig tshon tu bsams te/ thig gdab cing tshon bkye nas lha'i gnas so sor sku~X tsa ka li'am 'bur sku'am par du gdab cing*/ gsunga~X yig 'bru'am snying po dang*/ thugasa~X phyag mtshan gyi mtshan mas lha'i rang bzhin mtshon par ldana~X pa rdo rje dang 'khor lo la sogs pa'i sku gsung thugs mtshon pa'i gzuga~Xs gang rung rnams kyanga~X lha so so'i gnas su dgo~Xd par bya'o/

/ gsum pa chen po la'ang gsum las/ chen po'i chung ngu ni ya~Xng na~X rgyanga~X graga~Xs gcig go / de'i don ni mdzod las/ sor mo nyi shu bzhi la khri/ / khri bzhi la ni gzhu gang ngo*/ / de dag lnga brgya dag la ni/ / rgyang grags de la dgon par 'dod/ / de brgyad dpag tshad ces bya'o/ / zhes so/ / chen po'i 'bring dpaga~X tshada~X dma~X/ chen po'i chen po nama~X mkha'a~X dbyinga~Xs kyi~X bsa~Xm yasa~X para~X/ rig 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dngos su sprul pa'am/ sangasa~X rgya~Xs kyi dkyi~Xl 'khora~X rigs sna~X tshogasa~X pa bsgoma~X ste dbang bskur ba yin no/ / de'i don yang nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab pa'i dkyil 'khor dngos su sprul te slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/ sngon mtsho ma pham gyi 'gram du mtsho la thig btab nas 'jam dpal grags pa la slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor dngos su bstan nas dbang bskur ba dang*/ slob dpon chen po pad+mas stag tshang seng ge phug tu rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' dang mnyam pa bstan nas mtsho rgyal la dbang bskur ba lta bu'o/ / de'ang sems can gyi rgyud la sku lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin ye gdod ma nas gnas kyang ma rig pas bsgribs nas ma~X mtho~Xng ba'i rmonga~Xs pa rnams la~X bstana~X pa'i phyira~X sa tshona~X gyi kha~X doga~X kyang dkar po lta bu re re la'ang dkar ser dkar dmar dkar ljang dkar sngo dkar po nyid dang lngar phye ba bzhin du gzhan bzhi la'ang phye bas nyi ༵shu~X rtsa~X lnga~X'ama~X ni ye shes nyi shu rtsa lnga dang mtshams sems la sogs pa mtshon pa'o/ / de tsam med na'ang dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga lnga~X yi~X tshona~X gyisa~X bri~X b.ra~X bya'o~X/ / de skad du'ang rgyas pa'i rgyud las/ sems can ma lus thams cad la/ / ye shes lnga yis kun khyab cing*/ / rang gi rnam rtog bsgribs byas nas/ / ye shes lnga yi don ma mthong*/ / de ltar rmongs pa thams cad la/ / ye shes mtshan nyid bstan pa'i phyir/

/ dkar dang dmar dang ser ba dang*/ / ljang gu la sogs nag por bstan/ / ces so/ / ji ltar bri ba ni mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len rnam par dag pas rgyas 'bring bsdus pa la sogs pa'i rnam par bzhag pa ni skabs 'dir 'dula~X ba'i~X cho~X ga~X ste de'i lugs bzhina~X du~X bri'o~X/ / de skad du'ang rngam glog las/ ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor ci 'dra ba/ / gzugs brnyan yang ni de ltar bri/ / zhes so/ / 'di la kha cig bya spyod kyi lugs su bzhed cing*/ la la gdul bya 'dul ba zhes sbyor ba'ang ma go bar snang ngo*/ / de'ang gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum ni gang zag gi blo dang 'byor pas phye ba ste/ 'khor los sgyur ba la sogs pa la ni dpag tshad la sogs pa yin zhing*/ phal ba'i 'byor ba mchog la 'bring po dang*/ chung ba la chung tshad du gsungs shing*/ chen po'i chen po ni slob ma mchog la 'phags pa'i bla mas dbang bskur ba'i blo yis rim pas phye ba yin no/ / gzhung gsum po'ang ma 'khrugs par bshad de/ chung ba'i skabs su thig gi rim pa gsungs shing*/ 'bring gi skabs su thig tshon byin gyis brlabs te bris pa la mtshan ma dgod thabs gsungs la/ rgyas pa'i skabs su tshon dgyai ba'-i rim pas bri thabs rdzogs par gsungs pa yin no/ / gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ spyan drang ba/ gnyis su med par bstim pa'o/ / dang po ni/ sems bskyed pa dang de bzhin nyid la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzi~Xn gyi ro~Xl mo~X mtha'a~X ya~Xs pa'i mchoga~X nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gtugs par dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i nang du/ lha so so'i gnas su rang rang gi yi~X ge~X ṭha la sogs pa'am lha mtshon pa'i brda~X tshon spungs kyi thig le sku mdog dang mthun pa~X'am/ snyinga~X po~X hūm̐ dang mūm̐ la sogs pa~X'am/ phyaga~X rgya~X rdo rje dang 'khor lo la sogs pa'ama~X gang yang rung ba las lha so so'i sku~X gsunga~X thuga~Xs yongs su rdzogs pa dang lda~Xn para~X bskyed pa ni rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ting nge 'dzin ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du byina~X gyis brla~Xbs pa zhes bya ste/

des grub don ya~X mtsha~Xn pa gnas skabs thun mong gi las bzhi dang*/ rmada~X po~X che~X mthar thugs lha'i dkyil 'khor 'gru~Xb par 'gyura~X ba ni sangasa~X rgyasa~X kuna~X gyisa~X dma~X bcas pa'i dam tshig chen po ste/ 'di ltar sa~X dang shing dang rdo la~X soga~Xs pa'i rgyu'i dngos po ngan pa phyi rol tu gyur pa de dag lasa~X sku gsung thugs kyi phyaga~X rgya'i~X gzugs bcasa~X pa yang*/ gdul bya'i skal ba dang mthun par rnama~X par grola~X ba'i rima~X pa~X byang chub gsum so sor thoba~X para~X 'gyura~X na/ rnam par dga~X pa'i~X ye~X she~Xs ting nge 'dzin gyisa~X sbyanga~Xs pa'i~X sems kyi dngos po ye nas 'od gsal ba sangs rgyas 'grub pa lta smosa~X kyang ci~X dgo~Xs te~X/ sems de~X nyida~X gdod ma nas sangs rgyas yina~X pa la gsal btab pa tsam gyis 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ / de skad du'ang 'da' ka ye shes las/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin pas/ sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi btsal ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o/ / zhes pa dang*/ kun byed las/ sems nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa spyan drang ba ni/ phyoga~Xs bcu dusa~X bzhi'i dkyila~X 'khora~X kun gyi bdaga~X nyida~X chena~X po gshis kyi gnas lugs gang du~X'ang mi~X dmiga~Xs shing spros pa dang bral ba ni thugasa~X kyi~X dkyila~X 'khora~X chos sku'i ngang lasa~X ye shes pa'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr ji ltar 'dod pa tha~Xms cad spyana~X dranga~X ngo~X*/ / de'ang blos byon par mos pa byed pa tsam la spyan drangs par brjod cing*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs rjes kyang byin gyis rlob pa yin la/ gtso bo rang gi sems kyi rnam 'phrul tsam goms par byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de'ang sems sangs rgyas yin pas de goms shing gsal bas dkyil 'khor 'grub pa ni 'thad pa'o/ / gsum pa gnyis su med par bstim pa ni/ bskyed pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ gzhi rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis po de ranga~X snanga~X gi ngo bor dbye~Xr meda~X du gnas te/

rang bzhin dam tshig gi dkyi~Xl 'khor la~X bskyed pa ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa de nyid 'juga~X cing bstim pa'i~X mtsha~Xn nyida~X kyis dkyil 'khor de gnyis chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin du mnyama~X par sbyora~X ba'i~X tshul gyis bstim pas/ phyoga~Xs bcu dusa~X bzhi kuna~X na~Xs 'gro ba'i don la gshe~Xgs pa~X yi~X/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sngon spyad pa spyod pa na gang la las de bzhin gshegs pa yid la byed pa de'i mdun du de bzhin gshegs pa nyid bzhugs par gyur cig ces smon lam gyi bsnyena~X pa mdzad pa'i~X 'bras bu grub nas de kho na bzhin don mdzad pa'i 'phrin las kyi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr de nyid thugs rjes byon nas dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor la rab tu rdzogs par 'jug cing nye~X bu'i sras su dgongs par gyur pas na spyan drangs te bstim pa ni dma~X tshi~Xg gi mcho~Xg yin no/ / gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu la gsum ste/ dngos grub sems las 'byung ba'i 'thad pa dgod pa/ de nyid ji ltar bsgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa/ thabs des grub pa'i 'bras bu brjod pa'o/ / dang po la gsum las/ dang po dpe ni lha'i dpaga~X bsama~X gyi shinga~X dnga~X yida~X bzhi~Xn gyi~X nora~X bu~X rina~X po~X che~X dnga~X gzhan yang phyi rol gyi dngos por snang ba las 'dod dgu 'byunga~X ba~X kuna~X la ya mtshan dang yon tan so sor snang yang*/ de~X da~Xg la phyi rol bden par grub pa'i rdzasa~X kyi dngos po 'ga' zhig yoda~X pa ma~X yina~X te~X gzhon nu me skyes kyi rin po che'i khang bzang ma skyes dgra'i khang pa dang brjes kyang kho rang gi phyi bzhin 'brang ba dang*/ khron pa skyes kyi khron pa las kho rang gis lag pa brkyangs na zas gos la sogs pa 'byung gis gzhan gyis ma yin pa dang*/ nor bu dang dpag bsam gyi shing la'ang lha dang sgra mi snyan pas blangs na 'dod dgu 'byung gis gzhan gyis ma yin no/ / 'o na de dag rgyu ci las de ltar gyur ce na/

sngon sbyin pa btang ba'i bag chags kyi sa bon ranga~X gi se~Xms kun gzhi la gnas pa'i bsoda~X namasa~X kyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu brtana~X pa nyid kyi snang ba der smin cing*/ rkyen de dag dang phrad nas dgos 'dod 'byung bar snang ba yi~Xn no/ / de bzhin du thog ma med pa nas kun gzhi la yul du snang ba'i bag chags kyis 'jig rten 'byung ba so so'i gzugs can dang*/ lus su snang ba'i bag chags kyis rang gi phung po dang*/ don du snang ba'i bag chags kyis phyi nang gi chos sems can gyi khams rang gi shes pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa du mar snang yang*/ don tha dad par grub pa med de rmi lam bzhin no/ / gnyis pa don ni de bzhin du sems nyid don gyi gnas lugs la sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor ngo~X mtsha~Xr ba'i cho~X 'phrula~X ya mtshan rmada~X kyi~X cho~Xs dang gnas skabs kyi dngos grub 'phrin las bzhi la sogs pa thob pa rnams kyang*/ bdag gis phar bgrod nas de'i steng du phyin pa'am/ phyogs gzha~Xn zhig na~X yoda~X pa de tshur bkug nas 'onga~X ba ma~X yi~Xn te~X/ 'di ltar phyi snod gzhal yas khang nang bcud lha dang lha mo rang nyid rgyal ba'i skur gsal ba la sogs pa'i thaba~Xs bskyed pa'i rim pa snying rje chen po la~X sems kyi goms pa rab tu brtana~X pa'i~X ngang nas/ shesa~X ra~Xb rdzogs pa'i rim pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba la goms pa'i dbang gis zung 'jug gnyis su med pa nyida~X la sbyangs pas/ bskyed rdzogs de~X lta~X bu~X yi~X nganga~X du~X sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub par rang byunga~X zhing snang ba yin no/ / de'ang rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba'i shesa~X raba~X chos kyi dbyingasa~X kyi de bzhi~Xn nyida~X chos sku'i ngang las/ thaba~Xs kyi~X phya~Xg rgya~X lhun stug po bkod par gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor rang snang du bkod pa ni lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes kyi rol para~X gyura~X pa'i~X phyira~X/

chos sku'i ye~X she~Xs la~X ni~X gzugs sku'i ye shes rola~X pa'i ngang las/ gdul bya'i 'jig rten du snang ba dang mthun par sprul pa'i sku'i ye~X she~Xs ro~Xl pa~X nyida~X kyanga~X de las ma 'phos bzhin du snang ba chu zla dang 'dra bas gso~Xg ces bya ste/ yum bar ma las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu chu zla lta bu mig yor lta bu/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu chu zla dang mig yor lta bu/ zhes pa ltar ro/ / kha cig sangs rgyas dang de'i ye shes gnyis la gsog ces rim pas sbyor ba ni longs sku'i de nyid dang ma 'brel lo/ / gsum pa des gzhan don 'byung ba'i tshul ni/ ye shes kyi rol pa gsog yin na des gzhan don byed pa mi 'thad do snyam na/ gsog nyid du snang bas don mdzad pa yin no/ / zhes pa ni/ sems can gyi mos pa dang mthun par rgyala~X ba~X thub pa drug la sogs pa mngona~X sum du 'byunga~X zhing 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal las skyoba~X pa~X mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pas don mdzad pa dnga~X*/ chos sku'i ngang las lhun stug po bkod pa'i rang snang longs skur snang ba'i byina~X rlaba~Xs las/ sa bcu'i sems dpa' la rang bzhin sprul sku rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur stona~X pa~X'anga~X ston pa'i thugs rje dang 'gro ba'i rang sems bsod nams goms pa'-i mthu las nor bu dpag bsam shing gi dpe de~X bzhi~Xn du snang ba yin te~X/ 'jug pa las/ zhi sku dpag bsam shing ltar gsal gyur cing*/ / yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin rnam mi rtog/ 'gro grol bar du 'jig rten 'byor slad rtag/ 'di ni spros dang bral la snang ba 'gyur/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / des na rang bzhin bden par ma grub bzhin du sprul pa'i skus 'gro don gyi bya~X ba byeda~X nusa~X pa~X'i tshul ni lhun gyis grub pa'i thugs rje'i gzi~X byina~X mnga' ba'i 'phrin las kyi~X rol pa rang byung du shar ba yin te/

nyi zla'i gzi 'od kyis gling bzhi snang zhing pad+ma'i kha 'byed pa rdzing bur gzugs brnyan ston pa bzhin no/ / de nyid ye shes kyi sgyu~X ma~X ste sku gsung thugs rdo~X rje~X'i rang bzhin can chos thams cad la mnga' sgyur bas che btsana~X dam pa'i~X mchoga~X yin te/ rdo rje las/ ye shes sgyu mar rang snang ba*/ / rdo rje btsan po dam tshig mchog/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub che/ / 'gro ba kun la rab snang ba'o/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa de nyid ji ltar bsgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa ni/ lam ma nor bar ston pa bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa/ de las zab mo'i dbang thob pa/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa/ sgrub pa'i man ngag la mkhas pa/ brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pas bsgrub nus pa ste/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i cho~X ga~X lnga~X ni~X rgyud la rdzoga~Xs par byasa~X shinga~X*/ sgrub pa'i gnas bar chad med cing yid dang mthun pa/ grogs mtshan nyid tshang zhing skal ba bzang ba/ 'tsho ba'i yod byad mtha' gnyis su ma lhung zhing log 'tsho med pa/ dngos grub kyi rdzas tshang zhing nyams pa med pa/ dam tshig gi rdzas tshogs shing rten du yod pa ste dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen gyi yo~X byada~X lnga~X ni~X yongs su rdzo~Xgs pa~Xr ldana~X zhing*/ bdag gi lha'i/ gsang sngags kyi/ bzlas brjod kyi/ 'phro 'du'i de kho na nyid de/ gsang sngaga~Xs kyi~X sgrub pa'i yana~X laga~X lnga~X rdzo~Xgs pa~Xs/ spyir lta ba dang dam tshig ma~X nyama~Xs shing bye brag tu sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen tshogs pa las ma nyams bsgrub pa la 'juga~X pa dang zhugs nas sgrub pa la~X nyin mtshan gnyid dang snyoms las spangs te raba~X tu brtso~Xn na~X myur du 'grub cing*/ mi brtson na mi 'grub ces pa'o/ / gzhung kha cig las brtson pas zhes kyang 'byung ngo*/ / de lta na spyi'i sgrar bshad kyi mi 'grub pa ma bstan to/ / de'ang kha cigade bzhin nyid kun tu snang dang*/ gsung yig 'bru thugs phyag mtshan sku rdzogs pa ste cho ga lnga dang*/

bza' btung*/ bro gar/ glu tshigagos rgyan/ ā li kā li'i 'byor pa ste yo byad lnga dang*/ yan lag la lha lnga bcu'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ rtog pa'i yan lag lha bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis su shes pa/ lha re re 'ang bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis su dbye ba| de dag gi sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa/ rigs lngas dbang bskur ba ste sngags kyi yan lag lngar 'dod pa ni bskyed rim 'ba' zhig gi phyogs su lhung bas rdzogs rim gyi de nyid dang*/ gnas dang rdzas kyi yo byad ma tshang ba'i phyir 'os pa ma yin no/ / gsum pa thabs des grub pa'i 'bras bu brjod pa la gnyis te/ gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu'o/ / dang po ni/ dbang po dang brtson pa rab kyis/ zhaga~X ni~X suma~X cu~X phraga~X druga~X ste zla ba drug gama~X/

'bring gis zla ba bcu~X gnyisa~X sam/ tha mas zla ba bcu~X bzhi~X'am/ shin tu rtul pos kyang zla ba bcu~X druga~X gi~Xs tshe la dba~Xng bsgyura~X ba'i ri~Xg 'dzin gyi~X dma~X pa~X 'gruba~X bo/ / de'ang phyag rgya dang lhun gyis grub pa 'di'i gong la yod pa la dam pa'i sgras mi smos par/ 'di la smos pa ci yin na/ rnam smin las 'phags shing lus de nyid kyis sangs rgyas thob pas de skad ces btags te/ sbyor lam chos mchog la/ chos kyi mchog ces btags pa bzhin no/ / de skad du yang lam rim las/ don mthong 'jug pa mthar phyin pa'i*/ / tshogs spyod sgrub pa'i dngos grub kyis/ / lus khams skye gnas zag pa zad/ / rdo rje'i lus gyur tshe yi rigs*/ / mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan 'da'/ / lus ma bor bar rgyal ba'i sa/ / zhes so/ / tshe dbang thob pa de~X nyid kyi rten la tshe~X bcu drug mthud pa'i lo grangs sam dus na 'tshang rgya ste/ skye ba bcu~X druga~X tshun ༵chada~X kyi~X sku~X lnga~X lhuna~X gyi~Xs rdzo~Xgs pa~Xr sangs rgyas ni~X thob par byed do/ / sngags kyi gzhung 'ga' las tshe gcig lus gcig pu des mkha' spyod bgrod de 'tshang rgya ba dang*/ skye ba bdun dang*/ bcu drug na ji ltar 'gor yang 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa yin mod/ 'dir tshe dbang thob pa des lo stong drug brgya'i bar du tshe gcig gis thub par byas te lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin thob par byed do/ / de'ang tshe'i 'du byed zad pa na thabs kyis tshe bsrengs te lo brgya brgya phyir snur ba de lta bu lan bcu drug lus gcig gis gnas pa yin te/ rgyas pa las/ tshe ni bcu dang drug pa yis/ / brgya brgya dag tu snur zhing gnas/ / lus ma bor bar sangs rgyas so/ / zag gsum zag pa de la med/ / ces pa dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ skye ba bcu drug mthar thug pa'i/ / zhi ba'i sangs rgyas nyid 'thob 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / kha cig tshe gcig yin yang lus lan bcu drug snur te grong 'jug gi tshul du byed ces pa'ang lus ma bor bar sangs rgyas so zhes pas bkag pa yin

no/ / de'ang 'dir tshe dbang dang lhun grub gnyis kyi zhar la/ rnam par smin pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin kyang bstan pa yin no/ / gnyis pa mthar thug gi 'bras bu lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin la gsum ste/ lhun stug po bkod par rang snang sku dang ye shes su grub tshul/ de nyid dbyings chos sku'i zhing nang gsal spros pa dang bral bar bzhugs tshul/ slar yang gdul bya'i 'jig rten du sprul sku 'char tshul lo/ / dang po la gnyis las/ dang po mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul ni dbyings rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i ye~X she~Xs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad bral ba thiga~X le~X nyag gcig grub bsal med pa'i chos de~X nyida~X la~X/ glo bur kun tu btags pa'i dri ma rang sar dag pas zad pa dang skye ba med pa'i ye~X she~Xs brnyes te/ dbyings der gnyis su med par 'dres pa chu la chu bzhag pa lta bu'i ye shes ro gcig tu gyur pa'i thi~Xg le~X nyida~X sna~Xng ba~X ni mngon par byang chub pa dang mi 'gyur rdo rje dang zhi ba chos sku dang*/ gsal ba longs sku dang ye shes sprul pa'i sku lngar lhun gyis grub pas bsa~Xm gyisa~X mi~X khyaba~X cing mtha~X' yas pa'i mcho~Xg phyoga~Xs bcu~X dusa~X bzhi~X'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang gnyis su med par mngo~Xn par rdzo~Xgs pa~Xr byang chub pas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa zhes bya'o/ / gnyis pa zhing khams ji ltar snang ba'i tshul ni/ de'i tshe lhun stug po bkod pa'i zhinga~X khama~Xs chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha'i mtha' klas par khyab pas bsama~X yasa~X pa'i ngang rang bzhin gyis rnama~X par dga~X cinga~X dri ma thams cad dang bral ba de na rgya~X phyogs bcur ma chad cing 'di tsam nges so zhes blos bsam pa dnga~X brala~X ba~X'i gzha~Xl ya~Xs kha~Xng gzhi tshad med pa ye shes kyi 'kho~Xr lo~X la brten pa'i rgyan gyi rnam pa yang 'khor lo rin po ches mtshan pa dnga~X*/

'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa phyogs bcur 'khrigs pa'i rola~X mo'i~X tsho~Xgs chen po dang rigs lnga'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr nam mkha'i mthas khyab par snang ba 'od gsal lhun gyis grub pa ma~X lusa~X pa bsa~Xm ya~Xs kuna~X gyi rang bzhin/ ye shes kyi gzigs pa dag pa'i yul du mthonga~X nasa~X longs spyod chen po'i gzhir mngon sum du nye~X ba~Xr mnga' brnyesa~X pa~X dang ༵/ brjod pa med cing ris su ma chad pas rgya~X che~Xn po'i gsunga~X yi ge tshogs chen lasa~X 'gro ba'i dona~X lhun gyis grub par 'byu~Xng ba~X ni/ gzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor ye nas sangs rgyas pa la/ lam ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor zab mos gsal btab pas/ 'bras bu gdod ma'i gnas lugs su byang chub pa gsum dbyer med pa ni de dag rang bzhin mthu~Xn pa'i~X ye~X she~Xs zhes bya ste/ yin pa la yin par shes pas yin thog tu slebs pa yin no/ / de lta bu'i zhing de yang phyogs gang shed na grub pa'i tshul gyis kun gyis bltar yod pa ma yin te/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi ye shes rang snanga~X ba~X'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ de ltar snang ba'i zhing khams kyang gnam gang gi zla ba ltar dbyings chos sku'i zhing du thim pas phyi rol tu snang char med la nang gsal du mkhyen char ma 'gags pa ni rang bzhin gci~Xg dnga~X du~X ma~X dang brala~X ba~X yi~X chos sku mtha~X' dnga~X dbu~Xs me~Xd pa'i de~X bzhi~Xn nyida~X spros pa thams cad zhi ba'i dbyings na/ phyir snang thim par bzhugs pa'i longs sku'i cha de nyid sanga~Xs rgya~Xs kyi~Xs kyanga~X phan tshun mi~X gzi~Xgs te~X shin tu phra ba'i ranga~X byunga~X gi ye~X shesa~X de nyid gang du'ang gna~Xs pa me~Xd par zhi ba'i dbyings na snanga~X ba ste gnas pa'i phyir ro/ / de skad du'ang rmad byung rgyal po las/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad gcig gis gcig mi gzigs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs te/ zhes so/

/ de'ang kha cig 'gro drug gis mi mthong la sangs rgyas kyis gzigs par 'dod pa ni gzhung gi dgongs pa ma yin no/ / 'dir snang ba bzhi mthar phyin pa'i skabs yin te/ tshe dbang de 'od gsal ba'i ye shes du ba la sogs pa dang por mthong dus chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang ba'o/ / de nyid gong nas gong du mched pa las phyi nang gi rtags mthong ba ni nyams gong du 'phel ba'i snang ba'o/ / de nas sangs rgyas longs sku'i zhing mthong ba ni rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba'o/ / de nas de yang nang du zhi bas 'dzin pa med pa ni chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba'o/ / de nas gdod ma'i ngang du longs sku'i zhing snang thim pa ni gzhi thog tu phyin pa ste lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs na gzigs pa med par bzhugs pa'o/ / gsum pa slar yang gdul bya'i 'jig rten du sprul sku'i 'char tshul ni de nas gdul bya'i 'jig rten du lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las kyis gang la gang 'dul du rig pa'i ye shes sprul pa'i sku mngon par snang ste/ de'ang thugs rje rig pa'i ye shes de nyid phyin ci log gi lo~Xg pa~Xr rtoga~X pas kun nas btaga~Xs pa'i ngo bo sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus pa thams cad rna~Xm par dga~X cinga~X ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i shes bya ma lus pa kun mkhyen pa'i ye~X shesa~X phyogs bcur rgyas te/ ye shes de nyid kyang dbyinga~Xs rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i chos sku yon tan gyi gter la~Xs mi~X gzha~Xn pa ste ngo bo gcig yin pa'i phyira~X rtog pa med bzhin du 'gro don lhun grub tu 'byung ste/ yul gdul bya'i 'jig rten dang yul can thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnyis ye nas lhun gyis grub pa'i thuga~Xs rje~X che~Xn po~Xs yul yul can du 'bre~Xl ba~Xs na~X ma dag pa 'gro~X ba rigs druga~X gi 'jig rten du 'das ma 'ongs da ltar ba'i dusa~X thams cad du ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs shing su ni 'dul ba'i dus la babs snyam du mkhyen pa 'jug pas/

mtho ris la sogs pa'i gna~Xs ris sems can gyis khyab pa ma~X lusa~X pa de dag tu thub pa drug la sogs pa'i sprul pa tshad med pa so so'i snang ba dang mthun par snanga~X zhing don mdzad pa yin no/ / de skad du'ang 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ bde gshegs thugs rje dus ring 'gro ba la/ / 'dul ba'i yul du mkhyen nas don mdzad pa/ / dus las mi yol skad cig so sor snang*/ / ye shes gzigs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes so/ / de'ang chos sku las ma g.yos par 'byung ste/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ / sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ / zhes so/ / de ltar snang ba'i sangs rgyas de yang pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyis grangs med pa gsum rdzogs pas 'grub ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ grangs med gsum ni rdzogs pa yis/ / bsgoms pa yi ni mthar phyin to/ / zhes so/ / de'i mgo yang tshogs kyi lam bsam pa nges pa tshun chad nas 'dzin te/ de las/ bzang dang smon pa'i stobs can gyis/ / zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ / gsang sngags phyi pa'i tshul las skal pa dang mos pa dang ting nge 'dzin rab tu gyur pas lung mnos te bsnyen pa'i mtshan ma gnas pas tshe 'dir sangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong ste/ de nas tshe gcig gam gnyis sam gsum la sogs pa na sangs rgyas thob par grags so/ / rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs las mos pa dang brtson 'grus dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi stobs kyis lus des tshe la dbang ba'i sa thob nas grol bar gsungs so/ / 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas zla ba drug la sogs pas tshe dbang bsgrubs nas/ rten des byang chub tshe gcig lus gcig la 'grub par bstan to/ / de dag kyang gang la zhugs pa de'i lugs ltar bden gyi/ 'di nyid kho na'i ltar yin no zhes nges bzung mi bya ste/ gnyen po dang lam dang brtson 'grus dang rkyen gyi stobs so so ba yin pa'i phyir te/ 'dag chal gyi stobs so sos dri ma dag pa mgyogs bul dang yul gcig tu bgrod pa'ang brtson 'grus dang stobs so sos mgyogs bul du snang yang yul la nye ring yod pa ma yin no/
