/ des na sems la dbang ma thob kyi bar du ni rkyen dang las kyi rjes su byed la/ de phan chad ni dus kyang ci dgar snang ste ring ba thung bar bsgyur cing thung ba ring bar 'phrul pa la sogs pa yod de/ dus kyang sems kyi snang ba tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de skad du'ang dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa'i mdo las/ dus thung bar 'dod pa rnams la bskal pa mang po zhag bdun gyis 'da' bar byin gyis rlob bo/ / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ / de'i phyir 'phags pa'i go 'phang thob pa tshun chad la lam zab mi zab la sogs pa nye ring du snang yang*/ de phan chad sems la dbang thob pas ji tsam gyi grol bar rang dbang yod de/ yum bar ma las/ rab 'byor gang gi tshe chos rnams la chos kyi mig dri ma med pa thob pa de'i tshe/ 'dod na zhag bdun gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya la/ 'dod na bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig rab tu mang pos kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ste/ 'di yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par dang po'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / gsum pa gang du dbang bskur ba'i don bsdu ba ni/ sngar bstan pa'i mchog dbang bde~X ba~X che~Xn po~X'i dkyila~X 'khora~X ni~X yab yum stangasa~X dpyala~X gnyi~Xs sa~Xm yanga~X na~X rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor kha dog lnga~X pa byasa~X te~X slob ma da~Xd ldana~X rnams raba~X tu zhuga~Xs na~X ji ltar 'doda~X pa'i~X dngos grub yida~X du 'onga~X ba sngon gzhan gyis thob pa dang mnya~Xm para~X 'thob pa~Xr 'gyu~Xr ro/ / de ltar skala~X ba~X mnyama~X pa~X'i ye~X shesa~X chen po de~X don du gnyera~X na~X tshe 'di nyid la dngos grub chen po nye~X b.ra~X 'byunga~X ba~X yi~X rang bzhin las bzhi dang tshe dbang thob pa'i rten des mchog gi dngos grub ya~X mtshana~X che~Xn po~X sangs rgyas nyid 'byung ༵zhing thob para~X nge~Xs so/ / de skad du'ang me long las/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs lha'i/

/ dkyil 'khor mngon du mthong zhugs pa/ / bsod nams bstan pa gang yin pa/ / phyis byas pa'ang de bzhin no/ / zhes so/ / de las gzhan du chos dang bla ma la dada~X pa me~Xd cing rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyama~Xs pas bsgrubs na~X tshe 'dir nad dang gnod pa la sogs pa mi 'dod pa sna tshogs 'byung zhing phyi mar ngan song du skye bas phu~Xng b.ra~X 'gyura~X te/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las/ byang chub sems ni ma bskyed dang*/ / the tshom yod pa nyid dang ni/ / bka' bzhin stsol ba mi byed pa/ / ma dad pas ni mi 'grub cing*/ / 'di phyir sdug bsngal nyid du 'gyur/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ / tshul de skad cesa~X de bzhin gshegs pa btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas pas cheda~X du~X brjoda~X do~X/ / ye nas lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gnas lugs gsanga~X ba'i~X snyinga~X po~X don gyi ye shes de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X ngesa~X pa~X lasa~X ye nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi ngo bo rdo~X rje'i~X mtshon byed gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor du bkoda~X pa~X mchog tu gsanga~X ba~X sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dma~X tshi~Xg gi~X le'u~X ste~X dgu~X pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / / / ༈ don gnyis pa dbang bskur ba'i thabs bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ dbang bskur ba la 'jug pa'i tshul mdor bstan pa dang*/ de'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa de~X nasa~X bcoma~X ldana~X 'dasa~X zag pa med pa'i bde bas dgyesa~X pa~X chena~X posa~X kun tu bzang po yab yum khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba slob ma'i rgyud la sbyi~Xn pa~X zhesa~X bya~X ba'i~X tinga~X nge~X 'dzi~Xn la~X snyoma~Xs para~X zhugasa~X nasa~X dbang bskur ba'i che~Xd du~X brjoda~X pa~X 'di~X skad ces brjo~Xd do/ / de'ang dbang gi don la abhi ṣe ka ta zhes zer zhing*/ de'i don yang nus pa 'jug par byed pa ste/ 'jig rten na rgyal sar 'don pa la rig byed kyi bum pas dbang bskur nas yul khams la dbang ba'i nus pa 'jug pa dang 'dra bar/

rang gzhan gyi don byed pa'i nus pa 'jug pa ste/ rgyal po sbyin pa zhes bya'o/ / yang a bhi ṣiñtsa'i sgras ye shes kyi bgos shing sgo gsum gyi dri ma 'khrud pas na dbang ngo*/ / gnyis pa la gsum ste/ nus pa'i dbang dang*/ phan pa'i dbang dang*/ phan yon no/ / dang po la gsum las/ zab dbang spyir bstan pa ni sngar bstan pa bzhin lha'i dkyil 'khor bskyed cing bdag nyid 'jug pa dang slob ma 'jug pa dang phan dbang dang nus dbang bskur la gzung ma byin gyis brlabs te/ yum shesa~X raba~X kyi phyag rgya la yab thabasa~X kyi~X phyaga~X rgya~X snyoms par zhugs pa lasa~X yab kyi byang sems bde~X ba'i~X rang bzhin yi ge hūm̐ gi 'bru~X tshogasa~X su gsala~X ba'i~X rgyuna~X gsang ba rdo~X rje~X'i lama~X nasa~X phyung ste yum gyi pa~Xd+mo~Xr 'khyila~X ba slob ma'i lce~X rtse~X nasa~X khong par bstima~X zhinga~X gtso bo'i dkyila~X 'kho~Xr gyi 'phro 'dus byin rlabs bsdus te slob ma'i snying gar bsgyura~X zhing gsang sngags brjod do/

/ gzhung 'di kha cig nus dbang lnga po thams cad cho ga 'dis bskur zhing so so'i dmigs pa dang rjes gnang sbyin par byed de/ gsang ba'i rgyun de trām̐ la sogs pa'i yig 'brur gyur pa slob ma'i khong du thim pas lha so so'i dkyil 'khor lnga po'i spro bsdu byed par bzhed do/ / de ni go rim log pa'i skyon yod do/ / gnyis pa nus dbang bye brag tu bshad pa la lnga las/ nyan pa'i dbang gi ting nge 'dzin ni slob ma rin cen 'byung ldan du gsal ba'i nyana~X byeda~X rna ba gnyis kyi nang du bh+rūm̐ las 'khora~X lo~X rtsibs bzhir trām̐ las lha'i~X gzhala~X yasa~X su~X gsala~X ba'i~X rna ba'i dbang po sgra la nyan nus su 'dzin pa'i thiga~X le~X shin tu dwangs pa'i ngo~X bo~X nyi~Xd du gnas pa de yi ge trām̐~X zung lnga ya bcu hūm̐ bzhi dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥdang bcas pa gsung chos kyi~X phyaga~X rgya'i~X tshogasa~X mchoga~X yi ge rnams 'od du zhu ba lasa~X/ ri~Xn ce~Xn 'byung ldan gyi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr gsa~Xl bar bskyed la bla mas ye shes pa de kho na 'dra ba sprosa~X te slob ma'i rna bar thima~X pas nyan pa'i sgrib pa dag nas lha dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba las rin cen 'byung ldan du bsams la dam tshig bsgrag cing rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/ trā~Xm̐ ni mgo 'dren pa ste gsanga~X ba~X ma hā gsa~Xng che~Xn a nu gsa~Xng mcho~Xg ganga~X yin pa rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga ste nang pa dang*/ krī ya u pa yo ga la sogs pa phyi thub pa rgyud kyi theg pa'i gsa~Xng ba~X kuna~X slob dpon la~Xs mnya~Xn pa~Xr bya~X zhing*/ rang gis slob dpon gyi dbang ma thob pa de srid du gsa~Xng ba~X'i dona~X nyida~X rang gi rgyud la goms 'dris su byed cing brtaga~X pa~Xr bya ba lasa~X gang zag gzhan dang yul dus gzhana~X du~X smra~X b.ra~X bya~X ba~X mina~X pas ma sgrogs shig ces so/ / gnyis pa bsgom pa'i dbang gi ting nge 'dzin ni gsala~X ba'i~X 'kho~Xr lo~X'i snying gzhala~X yasa~X khang du bskyed pa'i nanga~X du dran gzhi gsala~X ba'i~X rten byed pa'i dwangs ma'i thiga~X le~X yungs 'bru tsam gyi ngo~X bo~X nyida~X gtso bo'i sa bon yi~X ge~X hūm̐ gi phre~Xng ba~X'i tsho~Xgs mcho~Xg 'od du zhu ba lasa~X/

thugs kyi ri~Xgs kyi~X dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr du gsa~Xl btab ste ye shes pa spro~X zhing thima~X pas yid kyi sgrib pa sbyangs te 'od du zhu ba lhar gyur pas/ rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/ oṃ~X dusa~X gsuma~X gyi rgyala~X ba~X'i sra~Xs po che~Xn po~X zhes slob ma la bos nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku~X gsu~Xng thuga~Xs kyi~X rdo~X rje~X lus lha ngag sngags sems chos nyid zab mo'i don sgom la zunga~Xs shigade'i ngang las rgyala~X ba~X thama~Xs ca~Xd mnye~Xs pa'i mchod pa bsgrub pa dang phyi nang gsang ba bde ba chen pos mchod la~X 'bras bu rgyala~X ba~X kuna~X dnga~X mnya~Xm pa~Xr sbyora~X ba'i go 'phang 'thob par gyis shig ces pa'au/ /gsum pa 'phrin las kyi dbang gi ting nge 'dzin ni/ la~Xg pa~X'i 'kho~Xr lo~X'i gzha~Xl ya~Xs su re~Xg shes gsa~Xl ba~X'i rten byed pa'i thi~Xg le~X dwangs pa'i ngo~X bo~X nyida~X hā~Xm̐ gi~X phyaga~X rgya'i~X tshoga~Xs mcho~Xg yi ge'i rang bzhin du gyur pa la~Xs/ 'phrin lasa~X kyi~X dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr gsa~Xl bar bskyed la ye shes pa spro~X zhing thima~X pa zhu ba las don grub yab yum du gyur pa la/ rjes gnang sbyin pa ni oṃ~X rigs kyi bu khyo~Xd ni~X de ring nyid nas rdo~X rje~X la~Xs te don yod grub pa yi~Xn gyi~Xs/ sems can gyi don dang sangs rgyas mchod pa rang rang gi bsgrub pa'i la~Xs rnama~Xs ma~X lusa~X pa kuna~X gyisa~X shi~Xgades sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul gyi pho~X nya~X ma~Xng po~X'i tshogs tshur 'du~X bas dngos grub ster zhing phar 'phro~X bas 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa kuna~X gyis khyoda~X kyi~X dgo~Xs pa'i~X don thams cad sgrub par byeda~X pa~X yi~Xn zhes so/ / yang pho nya'i lam bsgoms pas dngos grub 'grub par byed pa'o/ / bzhi pa 'chad pa'i dbang gi ting nge 'dzin ni/ tshig smra~X bar byeda~X pa'i lce'i 'kho~Xr lo~X'i gzha~Xl ya~Xs su~X ro 'dzin lce'i dbang po dwangs shing gsa~Xl ba'i thiga~X le~X'i ngo~X bo~X nyida~X yi ge hrī~Xḥyi~X rang bzhin zung lnga'i phyaga~X rgya'i~X tsho~Xgs kyi mcho~Xg 'od du zhu ba lasa~X/

snang ba mtha' yas gsung cho~Xs kyi~X rigs kyi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr du gsa~Xl ba la ye shes pa spro~X zhing thima~X pa zhu ba las 'od dpag med du bskyed la/ rjes gnang sbyin pa ni oṃ~X phyi nang gsang ba'i chosa~X kyi~X bdu~Xd rtsi~X bla~X na me~Xd pa rnams kyi~Xs theg pa so so gang dang gang la dada~X pa dang lda~Xn pa'i skyesa~X bu~X de dang de chos bstan pas ngoma~Xs pa~Xr byosa~X la/ dbang po ra~Xb la gsang chen rmad du byung ba'i theg pa/ 'bringa~X la rgyu'i theg pa chen po/ tha~X ma~X'i blo~X ca~Xn la~X nyan rang dang lha ma'i theg pa dbang po'i rim pa dang mthuna~X para~X chos kyi gsa~Xng ba so sor bsgra~Xgs kyis/ dman pa'i gang zag la chen po'i chos dang chen po la dman pa la sogs pa 'chol bar bsgrag pa'i tshul gzhana~X du~X bya ba mi~Xn te/ don du mi 'gyur ba dang chos spong ba'i las gsog pa'i phyir ro/ / de skad du'ang spyod 'jug las/ dman la mchog gi chos mi bshad/ / ces pa dang*/ rgyan stug po bkod pa las/ rgya cher chos kyi snod gyur pa/ / snod ma yin la sbyar mi bya/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ / lnga pa rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang gi ting nge 'dzin ni mgo la sogs pa yan lag lnga ni 'gro 'dug dang phyag rgya dang yul la blta zhing sgul bskyod byed pas bskyo~Xd che~Xn 'kho~Xr lo~X'i gzha~Xl ya~Xs su~X lus kyi dbang po dwangs shing gsa~Xl ba~X'i thig le~X'i ngo~X bo~X nyida~X dang gnyis su med pa/ lag pa g.yas kyi dpung mgor hūm̐~X mgo la oṃ~X g.yon la swa~X rkang pa g.yon la ām̐~X g.yas la hā~X rnama~Xs 'od du zhu ba lasa~X/ rigs lnga so so'i dkyila~X 'kho~Xr lnga~X dang phyi rol tu bsrung ba'i 'khor lo khro~X bcu'i phre~Xng ba dang bcas pa bsgo~Xm zhing*/ rjes su gnang ba ni oṃ~X phyoga~Xs bcu~X dusa~X bzhi~X'i sangs rgyas thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi sku~X dang gsu~Xng dang thuga~Xs kyi~X rdo~X rje~X che~Xn po 'khor 'das thams cad la ye nas khyab pa'i rang bzhin rmad du byung ba'i dkyila~X 'kho~Xr kuna~X gyi~X byeda~X pa~X po~X dpal kun tu bzang po khyod yin pas/

rigs kyi bu 'di la mchog gi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr dngos grub kuna~X gyi~X sbyi~Xn pa~X dam pa spyoda~X pa ste stsol zhig ces pa'o/ / gsum pa dbang dang mi ldan pa'i nyes pa ni sgo gsum yo byad dang bcas pas gsang sngags kyi sloba~X dpo~Xn mnyesa~X pa~Xr ma~X bya~Xs shi~Xng phyi nang gsang ba'i dba~Xng rnama~Xs rgyud la tho~Xb pa~Xr ma~X byasa~X pa~Xr gsang sngags nyana~X pa~X dang*/ sgrub pa dang gzhan la 'chad pa la~X soga~Xs pa rtso~Xm par byed pa~X rnama~Xs la/ tshe 'dir bsgrubs pa'i 'bra~Xs bu~X dngos grub me~Xd cinga~X phyi ma ngan song du sdug bsngal myong bas brla~Xg pa~Xr 'gyura~X te/ chos zab mo la dbang zos pa'i phyir ro/ / las rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ dbang rnams thob par ma byas par/ / gsang sngags bsgrub pa logs par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa phan pa'i dbang ni slob ma lha'i bdag nyid du gsal ba la/ rin po che'i dbu~X rgyana~X bcings pa ni khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' dbang bskur te/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad ye shes lngar gsal zhing phyir mi ldog par mtshon pa'o/ / coda~X pana~X te dar dpyangs kyis sgrib pa gnyis dag cing thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel bar mtshon pa'o/ / me tog gi 'phrenga~X bsa~X ni las dang bag chags dag cing byang chub kyi yan lag gi tshogs thob pa'i mtshon byed do/ / de gsuma~X ga dbu rgyan gyi dbang ste sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab tu 'gyur ba'o/ / go~X cha~X ni nyon mongs pa'i mtshon gyis mi tshugs shing bdud kyi sgyu 'dul bar mtshon pa'o/ / rgyala~X mtshana~X ni 'khor ba'i rgyu kun nas ldang ba'i cha dang bcas pa dag cing mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba mtshon pa'o/ / rdo rje la sogs pa'i rigs lnga'i phyaga~X rgya~X ni nyon mongs pa lnga gnas su dag cing ye shes lnga thugs su chud par mtshon pa dnga~X*/ gduga~Xs ni nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba skyob cing thugs rjes 'gro ba skyob par mtshon pa dnga~X*/ 'di bzhi ni gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang ngo*/

/ buma~X pa~X ni nyon mongs pa'i dri ma 'khrud cing rigs lnga'i nus pa 'jog pa ste zag pa med pa'i chu rgyun mtshon pa'o/ / bza~X' ba dang btunga~X ba ni 'khor 'das kyi rgud pa dang bral nas bsam gtan gyi ros rgyas par mtshon pa'o/ / 'di gnyis ni rang don phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang ngo~X*/ / nyi ma zla ba chu sa sha chen gyi dwangs ma ste snyinga~X po~X lnga~X yi~X dba~Xng bskura~X ba~X ni/ phung po lnga yab lnga 'byung ba lnga yum lnga nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar dag cing dbyer med par mtshon pa'o/ / 'di ni 'khor 'das gnyis su med par ston pa'i dbang ngo*/ / gsum pa dbang thob pa'i phan yon ni de ltar nus pa dang phan pa'i dbang rnams rdzogs par thob pa'i dusa~X 'di~X phyina~X cha~Xd rigs kyi bu khyod rgyala~X ba~X kun tu bzang po~X'i sra~Xs su gyur pa yin te/ gsang rgyud las/ gsang ba'i dbang ni thob ma thag/ kun bzang don gyi sras su 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / de'ang phyi pha rol tu phyin pas kyang sems bskyed thob ma thag tu rgyal ba'i sras su brjod de/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur nas skad cig la/ / 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ / bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*/ / 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ / zhes pa dang mthun no/ / dbang thob nas skye ba phyi ma nga~Xn songa~X du lhung ba'i las dang bag chags kyis mtshams sbyor ba mngon gyur bsrabs shing zad pas ngan song gsum dang de'i sdug bsngal tha~Xms ca~Xd me~Xd pa~X dnga~X*/ tshe~X dbang gi rgyu mthun yod pas 'dir yang tshe ri~Xng zhing nor dang 'byor pa dang dbang phyug dam pa'i bde~X ba~X phuna~X suma~X tsho~Xgs pa thams cad dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal med pa dang*/ phyi ma la yang gnas skabs mtho~X ri~Xs kyi 'jig rten lha dang mi'i nang du skye zhing rtag tu dge ba'i chos la spyod pa dang mthar thug thara~X pa'i~X bdaga~X po~X chos sku dang gzugs sku phun sum tshogs pas 'gro ba'i don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa byed par 'gyura~X ro/

/ zhesa~X brjo~Xd do~X/ / de skad du'ang kha sbyor thig le'i rgyud las/ dbang thob bde ba phun sum tshogs/ / 'dir yang legs pa kun 'grub cing*/ / ngan song thams cad med pa dang*/ / phyi mar don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / thugs kyi ye shes mchog tu gsanga~X ba'i~X snyinga~X po~X phun sum tshogs pa zab mo de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X nge~Xs pa~X la~Xs sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab tu dba~Xng bskur ba'i ye shes sbyina~X pa~X'i le~X'u ste~X bcu~X pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / / / ༈ spyi don gnyis pa lam bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa la gnyis te/ tha mal gyi mngon zhen bzlog pa bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ snying po'i don la 'jug pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis te/ thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa dang*/ de'i yan lag bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ don gyi 'brel dgod/ tshig gi don bshad pa/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba'o/ / dang po ni/ gzhi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba de~X nasa~X lam bskyed pa'i rim pa thabs snang ba'i dngos po lam du bslang ba'i phyir/ de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X thabs kyis rol pas dgyesa~X pa~X chena~X posa~X kun tu bzang po nyid thabs snang ba'i sgyu~X 'phrula~X 'dod yon lnga la sogs pa 'khor ba'i chos nyon mongs pa'i rnam par snang ba rnams shes rab stong pa'i rang bzhin du gnas pas drwa~X ba'i~X ngo bo ste ye nas spang blang dang dgag sgrub gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid zung 'jug chen po ni ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs sam rgyala~X po~X zhes bya'o/ / de nyid shes par bya ba'i phyir 'dod yon dang nyon mongs pa ma spangs par ji ltar snang dus nyid nas ye shes chen por dbang sgyur ba zhesa~X bya~X ba~X'i tinga~X nge~X 'dzi~Xn dam pa la~X yab yum snyoma~Xs pa~Xr zhuga~Xs na~Xs thams cad thar lam du bstan pa'i cheda~X du~X brjoda~X pa~X 'di~X skad ces brjoda~X par mdzad do~X/

/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor shes par bya ba dang*/ lam thabs dang shes rab kyi dkyil 'khor nyams su blang ba'o/ / dang po ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ye nas stong pa'i ngang las byung bar rgyu~X gci~Xg pa~X yin te/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ ji ltar bar snang cung zad sprin med las/ / skad cig tu ni sprin gyi dkyil 'khor snang*/ / byung nas zhig ste sprin gyi dkyil 'khor med/ / thog ma gang las byung ba brtag par bya/ / chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ / zhes so/ / de ltar stong pa'i ngang las dang por byung bar ma zad/ da lta snang dus nyid nas kyang yi~Xg 'bru~X a'i~X tshula~X du rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'i ngo bo snang stong gnyis su med par gnas te/ lha'i bus zhus pa'i mdo las/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa a'i tshul du gnas so/ / zhes so/ / de'ang snang ba ni oṃ/ stong pa ni āḥganyis su med pa ni hūm̐ gi rang bzhin du gnas pas snang bzhin du stong stong bzhin du snang snang ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa ste/ rtsa ba shes rab las/ rmi lam ji bzhin sgyu ji bzhin/ / dri za'i grong khyer ji bzhin du/ / de bzhin skye dang de bzhin gnas/ / de bzhin du ni 'jig pa'ang gsungs/ / zhes pa dang*/ gang phyir stong pa ma gtogs pa'i/ / chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ / zhes so/ / me yi rang bzhin tsha bas byin gyis brlabs pa ltar chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ye nas dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin du sangs rgyas par byi~Xn gyisa~X brla~Xbs dnga~X ste ma dag pa med cing dag pa 'ba' zhig gi tshul du gnas te/ gsang rgyud las/ chos kun ye nas dkyil 'khor du/ / byin gyis brlabs pa rnam par dag/ ces so/ / de'ang stong pa chos sku snang ba longs sku sna tshogs su snang ba sprul pa sku'i rang bzhin ni/ gzugs thams cad sku'i dkyil 'khor/

sgra thams cad gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ chos nyid thams cad thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du gnas so/ / de ltar gnas 'i rang bzhin rnams kyang dus gzhan nam lkog tu gyur pa la sogs pa ma yin par snang dus 'di nyid nas phyi snang ba yum nang phung po yab rtog tshogs lha'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'i ngo bo mngo~Xn suma~X pa~Xr snang zhing snang dus nyid nas mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang las mi g.yo ba'i dgongs pa ston pa yin te/ kun byed las/ kun rgyu byang chub sems las ni/ / sems kyi ngo bo 'byung chen lnga/ / ston pa byang chub sems lnga byung*/ /

sku ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ / chos ni rang gi ngo bos 'chad/ / ston ni rang gi rang bzhin ston/ / ston pa longs spyod rdzogs sku ste/ / dgongs pa nyid la nyid mi rtog/ chos rnams gzhan la'ang rtog mi byed/ / byang chub sems kyi ston pa lngas/ / kun kyang chos nyid de bzhin ston/ / zhes so/ / de bzhin du ye shes yod par dug lngas ston pa dang*/ sku lnga sems kyis ston pa dang*/ yum lnga 'byung lngas ston pa ste/ bzhin dang gzugs brnyan las kyang gsal bar chos rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid sangs rgyas pa'i chos nyid dang snang la ngos gzung med pa'i chos can du mngon du ston pa'o/ / de ltar gnas pa'i don gzhi'i gnas lugs rang gi bsod nams dang bla ma dam pa'i thugs rjes byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas phyin ci ma log par raba~X tu~X rtoga~Xs pa~X rnama~X pa~X bzhi~X yi~Xs chos thama~Xs ca~Xd ye nas mngo~Xn par rdzoga~Xs par byang chub pa'i rgyala~X po~X che~Xn por rtogs pa na/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams la spong len med par phyam gcig ye shes kyi rol par 'char bas gsang chen don gyi gnas lugs so/ / de ni dbyings de bzhin nyid du bshad pa'o/ / bskyed rim ltar na/ rgyu gcig pa ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ yig 'bru lha so so'i snying po bskyed pa dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa lha'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed pa dang*/ mngon sum pa de'i ngang la lhan cig pa'i rdzogs pa bsgom par rab tu rtogs pa rnam pa bzhi yis chos thams cad shes par byed pa'o/ / rdzogs rim dang sbyar na/ rgyu gcig pa 'khor 'das sems su gcig pa'o/ / yig 'bru'i tshul skye ba med pa'i ngang du rtogs pa'o/ / byin gyis brlabs pa de ltar mnyam par 'jog pa thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor gnyis su med par gyur pa'o/ / mngon sum pa so so rang gi rig pa'i ye shes kyis bsgom pa las rtogs pa ste/ lam rim las/ rgya mtsho dwangs pa'i gzugs brnyan ltar/

/ sgra rten yid la byed min par/ / rang rig mngon sum dmigs bral bar/ / rang gsal gsum bral mi sgul pas/ / nges par gdeng du gang byas pa/ / thos bsam brten pa'i lta mthar phyin*/ / ces so/ / zung 'jug ltar na/ rgyu gcig pa bskyed rdzogs dang bden gnyis su gcig pa dang*/ de'i ngo bo rtag chad las 'das pa yi ge sprin du gnas pa dang*/ dbyings rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i ngang las bskyed rdzogs su rang snang bar byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ de nyid rig pas thag chod cing mi 'gal bar mngon du rtog nas nyin mtshan du brtson pa ste/ rngam glog las/ rtog pa yang ni rnam pa bzhir/ / rnal 'byor nang pa bzhed pa ste/ / rgyu gcig pa dang yi ge'i tshul/ / byin gyis brlabs dang mngon sum las/ / rdzogs chen don la 'jug 'gyur te/ / rgyu ni bden gnyis cig car du/ / gcig pas gcig pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ / sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ / chos kun rang bzhin rtogs pa dang*/ / skye med dbyings kyi byin rlabs las/ / chos kun snang bar shes pa dang*/ / de lta bu yi rang bzhin te/ / gzhan la ma brten mi 'gal bar/ / mngon sum rig pas thag chod na/ / rnal 'byor sa la slebs pa yin/ / zhes so/ / gzhung 'di lta bu ni phyogs gcig pu 'di kho na yin no zhes pa'ang mi rung ste/ rdo rje'i tshig brling zhing gang du'ang sbyar du yod pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa lam thabs dang shes rab kyi dkyil 'khor nyams su blang pa la gsum ste/ cir snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor/ rol pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor/ gang bsgrub thabs kyi yan lag go / dang po la gnyis te/ snang sems gnyis med kyi dkyil 'khor spyir bstan pa dang*/ sbyor sgrol gnyis med kyi dkyil 'khor bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ / dang po la gsum ste/ 'dzin byed yab kyi dkyil 'khor/ gzung yul yum gyi dkyil 'khor/ rol pa gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ / dang po la'ang gnyis las/

zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor du shes par bya ba ni lus kyi ya~Xn la~Xg lnga dang mig la sogs pa'i dba~Xng po~X dang de dag gi rna~Xm par she~Xs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa kuna~X tha mal gyi rnama~X pa rang mtshan pa mi~Xn par oṃ~X ste ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du~X she~Xs pa~Xr bya~X zhing de'i mtshon byed du yab lnga sems dpa' brgyad sgo ba bzhi thub pa drug dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar med bzhin snang ba'i rigs lnga longs spyod rdzoga~Xs pa~X'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr nyida~X du ༵bsgoma~X mo/ / gnyis pa khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du shes par bya ba ni yanga~X na~X gdul bya'i dbang ngam rang gi mos pa'i dbang gis phung po dang dbang shes kun ye shes lnga'i ngo bo rab tu khrosa~X pa~X'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr du~X bsgo~Xm par bya'o/ / gnyis pa yum gyi dkyil 'khor la'ang gnyis las/ dang po zhi ba'i yum du shes par bya ba ni snang srid skye 'gros bsdus pa'i gzugasa~X thams cad dang sgra~X dang dri~X dang ro~X dang rega~X bya la~X soga~Xs khongs nas chos dang 'byung ba lngar snang ba thams cad/ tha mal pa'i gzugs sgra la sogs pa'i rnama~X pa de dag tu mi~Xn par mūm̐ ste gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo nyid du~X she~Xs pa~Xr bya~X zhing*/ de'i mtshon byed sgo ma bzhi sems ma brgyad yum lnga'i rnam pa ste/ snang la ngos gzung med pa yuma~X gyi~X dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr nyida~X du~X bsgo~Xm par bya'o/ / gnyis pa khro bo'i yum du gsal ba ni yanga~X na~X gdul bya'am rang gi mos pa'i dbang gis khro~X mo~X'i dkyila~X 'kho~Xr bsgoma~X mo/ / gsum pa rol pa gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ lus la bgo ba'i go~Xs dang 'dogs pa'i rgyana~X dang bza~X' ba dang btunga~X ba ngag gi glu~X dang brjod pa'i tshiga~X dang lus kyi rnam 'gyur rkang ba'i bro~X dang lag pa'i gara~X dang nye bar spyad pa'i yo byad kyi tshoga~Xs ci dang ci spyod pa thams cad kyi~X sprina~X phunga~X chen po la~X tha mal gyi snang ba ma yin par/

snang stong ngam yab yum gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin hūm̐~X ste gnyis med bde ba chen po'i chos nyid du shesa~X pa~Xs chags zhen med la tshogs kyi yo byad rmi lam ltar bden med kyi ngang nas lha mo drug gi rang bzhin du raba~X tu longs spyada~X na~X 'bras bu mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ngo~X mtsha~Xr ba'i rang bzhin 'byu~Xng ba~X'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr phung po khams dang skye mched na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mnyesa~X pas myur du byang chub 'grub pa'i phan yon rlabs po che thob par byed do/ / gnyis pa sbyor sgrol gnyis med kyi dkyil 'khor la gsum ste/ sbyor ba gnas su dag pa bde chen byang chub mchog gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sgrol ba gnas su dag pa thabs chen gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor/ sbyor sgrol gyi nyes pas mi gos pas ye shes sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ / dang po la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung gi don no/ / dang po la gnyis te/ rten phyag rgya'i dbye ba dang*/ brten pa ye shes kyi rang bzhin no/ / dang po la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ / dang po la gsum las/ bcu gnyis ma ni mkha' pad 'dab brgyad dang ldan pas yab yum gnyis ka la bde bas khyab par byed pas lha mo ste/ 'jam dpal las/ bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan/ / zhes so/ / bcu drug ma ni 'dab ma bzhi dang ldan pas yab la bde ba sbyin pa'i phyir glu mo ste/ de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig/ ces so/ / nyi shu ma ni 'dab ma gnyis dang ldan pas yum la bde ba sbyin pa'i phyir rigs ngan mo ste/ rnam pa nyi shu'i byang chub pa'o/ / zhes so/ / de'ang bcu gnyis nas bco lnga'i bar lha mo/ bcu drug nas bcu dgu'i bar klu mo/ nyi shu phan chad rigs ngan mos bsdus pa yin no/ / de dag kyang gzugs bzang zhing chags pa che ba/ gzhan dang mi 'grogs shing gsang thub pa/ sbyor thabs la mkhas shing shes rab che ba/ sgrub pa po la gus shing snying nye ba/

dad brtson dang snying rje che ba/ bde ba'i rtsa khyad par can ldan pa ste/ de ltar na yum de gsum ni thugs gsung sku'i yum ste dngos grub myur du 'thob bo/ / 'dir kha cig lha klu'i bu mo dngos su 'gugs par 'dod pa dang*/ kha cig gzugs mdzes mi mdzes bar ma gsum la 'dod pa dang*/ las/ ye shes/ phyag rgya chen po gsum la 'dod pa ni gzhung gi dgongs pa ma mthong ba ste/ rim pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pa kun gyis bsten cing bdag gir bya ba'i yul du ma gyur ba dang*/ mi mdzes pa las bde ba'i 'os ma yin pa dang*/ las kyi las rgya dngos kyi rten la sbyor ba'i rim par gsungs pas gnod do/ / gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa la drug ste/ pad+ma can/ dung can ma/ ri mo can/ ri dwags can ma/ glang po can/ sna tshogs can ma'o/ / dang po la'ang gsum las/ pad+ma can rab ni lus ha cang ring ba ma yin thung ba ma yin/ byad gzur ba ma yin leb pa ma yin/ sha rtsi sngo ba ma yin ser ba ma yin/ mdzes shing dkar la dmar chags pa ste/ skyes pa bas rtsa sna bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi mang ba/ skra ser zhing li ba/ lus la tsan+dan gyi dri bro zhing kha nas ut+pa la'i ngad ldang pa/ lus rgyas kyang sked pa phra ba/ rkang lag bya ltar dmar zhing phra ba/ mchu skor cung zad che zhing mchu la pad+ma'i ri mo yod pa/ so legs shing mchu la bung ba 'du ba/ lte ba zab cing pad+ma'i ri mo yod pa sa la'ang pad+ma'i ri mo 'dri ba/ lte ba'i 'og nas ri mo 'greng bu gsum yod pa/ smin mtshams su ri mo gsum bsgreng ba/ skra mtshams dang mur gong nas dar thod lta bu'i ri mo yod pa/ lce la ral gri lta bu'i ri mo dang*/ phrag gong ngam sog phrag na g.yung drung 'khyil ba lta bu'i ri mo yod pa/ nu ma phra la 'bur ba/ bha ga rub cing spu med sha ldan mthon po rus sbal gyi rgyab dang 'dra ba yod pa ste/ byed pa sdug cing bcos dka' ba/ mthong ba tsam gyis bde ba bskyed cing*/

skad thos pa'am reg pas rtog pa mi rtog pa'i ye shes su bsgyur cing bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin ngang gis 'phel ba ste/ de lta bu yod pa'i yul phyogs tsam du'ang bkra shis shing*/ rnal 'byor pa'i bde ba rgyas par byed la/ de dang rtsa phrad na tshe 'di nyid la mchog gi go 'phang 'thob par nges so/ / pad+ma can 'bring ni sha dkar zhing rus khyim che la yan lag rags pa/ spyod lam rtsing zhing khong dal ba/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba mkhas shing bu tsha khye'u skye ba/ gzhan gyis bcos su mi btub cing snying nye ste/ de dang rtsa phrad na lo dus tshun chad kyi 'bras bu 'thob bo/ / pad+ma can tha ma ni mdog dkar zhing byad legs kyang snying du mi sdug pa/ gzugs 'chos shing byi dor la brtson pa/ kha yangs shing gsang mi thub pa/ mig phra zhing bslu kha na yang ba ste/ de ni dkar mo mig sgyu ma zhes bya ba ste mi bsten no/ / de ltar pad+ma can ni kun tu bzang po ye shes mchog gi yum mo/ / gnyis pa dung can ma la'ang gsum las/ rab ni mdog snum zhing skra rtse 'khyil ba/ sha ser la rtsa dmar ba/ spyod lam mkhas la 'dug tshugs legs pa/ tshig dal la zur mig lta ba/ shes rab che zhing zur tsam gyis go ba/ zug rngu rno zhing rnam rtog rags pa/ sha lus sbom zhing mnyen la 'bol ba/ skad gdangs che zhing dung bus pa 'dra ba/ lte ba na dung g.yas su 'khyil pa lta bu'i ri mo yod pa ste/ de dang rtsa phrad na tshe 'di nyid la mchog gi go 'phang thob bo/ / 'bring ni rgyab nas bltas na dgye ba snyam pa/ mdun nas bltas na dgur ba snyam pa/ lus mdzes la rdom chung ba/ brang dgye zhing ol ko legs pa/ byad kyi gzengs thung zhing rgyas pa/ khyim du byad bying bying tsug byed pa/ lus 'dres nas snying nye zhing brtse gdung che ba ste/ de dang phrad na lo dang zla bas dngos grub 'grub bo/ / tha ma ni sha ser la mig 'bor che ba/ blo rno la dran pa gsal ba/ 'dug mi tshugs shing 'gro la dga' ba/

lag 'tshub cing bya byed mang ba/ gzhung ngan zhing chad la mi btsan pa/ skyes pa mig la 'tsho zhing mig ser che ba ste/ bkra mi shis pas mi bsten no/ / de ltar dung can ma ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yum mo/ / gsum pa ri mo can la'ang gsum las/ rab ni sngo la byad dkyus dang yan lag ring ba/ mchu skor che zhing sha lus sbom pa/ ol ko nas pad+ma'i bar du gnyer chung yod pa/ mig dkyus ring zhing legs pa/ so ring thung med cing mnyam pa/ byad dang lus la rme ba chung ngu yod cing skad snyan pa/ zhi dal che zhing spyod lam 'jam pa/ gzugs bzang zhing zhe sa mkhas pa/ dbyibs phyed cing dbral bar ri mo gsum 'graing ba/ lha chos dang mi chos gang la'ang goms 'dris che ba/ skra mtshams na thod bcings pa lta bu'i ri mo gcig gam gsum yod pa ste/ de dang phrad na longs spyod dang ldan zhing dngos grub myur du 'thob bo/ / 'bring ni rtags de dag gi steng du dad pa dang shes rab che ba/ gsang thub cing snying nye ba'o/ / tha ma ni sha rtsi nag la dpral ba ser ba/ mig chung la gting mug tu yod pa/ kha yangs shing gtam mang ba/ nyon mongs che zhing gsang mi thub pa ste mi bsten no/ / de ltar ri mo can ni rin cen rigs kyi yum mo/ / bzhi pa ri dwags can ni/ ri dwags kyi lus 'dra ba ste/ sha rgyas shing nu ma che ba/ smad kyi sha rgyas shing bha ga rub pa/ dbugs dang skye gnas la gla rtsi bro ba/ sked pa phra zhing 'gros dal ba/ skyes pa la mig mi 'dzum par lta zhing skad snyan pa ste/ de dang phrad na'ang dngos grub myur du 'thob bo/ / 'di yi 'bring ni gzugs mdzes shing skad snyan pa/ gus shing gsang thub pa'o/ / tha ma ni de las ldog pa ste mi bsten no/ / de ltar ri dwags can ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi yum mo/ / lnga pa glang po can ma rab ni mig dkyus ring la smin dbrag yangs pa/ lus mi ring zhing khong dal ba/ gzhan gyi ngag mi phyogs shing sems chung ba/

rna ba che zhing ngo tsha chung ba/ spyod pa rigs ma rigs shes shing lhod chags pa/ kha dbang che zhing shogs che ba/ dri zhim zhing yan lag thung ba ste/ de nyid rtsa mang bas dngos grub myur du 'grub bo/ / 'bring ni byad sngo zhing gzengs mtho ba/ lus khyim legs shing shed che ba/ don mi 'chor zhing bslur mi btub pa/ mdo che la spro ring ba ste dpal gyi mtshan dang ldan pas bsten no/ / tha ma ni rnam 'gyur dang gtam mang ba/ rdzun che la khro 'dod pa/ dga' mi dga' gnyis ka sla ba/ 'dod che zhing ster la mi dga' ba ste/ bre mo rta ri ma'i rigs zhes bya ba yin pas mi bsten no/ / de ltar glang po can ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi yum mo/ / drug pa sna tshogs can ma rab ni/ gzugs mdzes shing sked pa phra ba/ skad snyan zhing gsang thub pa/ sha mdangs gsal zhing gting 'tsher ba/ cung zad thung zhing skra li ba/

'gros mgyogs zhing gtam brel ba/ bya bzhag mkhas shing stobs che ba/ dpral ba na gnyer ma rdo rje rgya gram ltar yod pa ste/ de dang phrad na dngos grub nye ba'o/ / 'bring ni de'i steng du dad pa dang ngo tsha shes shing spro thung bar mngon pa'o/ / tha ma ni de dag dang mi ldan zhing gom pa gya tshom du 'dor ba/ sha rtsub cing yan lag rags pa/ rdzun che zhing khro 'dod pa/ gtam mang zhing dgod ka yangs pa/ brtags shing mi mdzes la 'jigs par snang ba/ ngo tsha chung zhing 'thab la dga' ba/ kun dang mi mthun zhing yid du mi 'ong ba ste/ bkra mi shis pas mi bsten no/ / de ltar sna tshogs can ni las kyi rigs kyi yum mo/ / mtshan 'di dag ni lo nyi shu man chad du gsal zhing de nas cung zad mi gsal ba yin no/ / de ltar lus su rung ba'i phyag rgya ni/ khyad par du 'phags ste/ ma hā mā yā las/ sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las/ / bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags/ / zhes so/ / de lta bu'i phyag rgya mtshan dang ldan pa btsal nas/ dge bsnyen nas bzung ste/ gsang ba'i dbang gi bar gyis rgyud sbyangs shing dag par byas te gdod sgrub pa'i grogs su rung ba yin no/ / ji skad du he badz+ra las/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ / de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu nyid/ / ces gsungs pa dang mthun no/ / gnyis pa brten pa ye shes kyi rim pa la gsum ste/ sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba/ sgrub pa dang sgrub pa chen pos las la sbyar ba/ dngos gzhi ye shes kyi dbye ba'o/ / dang po ni/ rang nyid rlung sems las su rung bas/ nyi ma 'gar dal bar bya ste/ bcud can bza' ba dang*/ bsku mnye bya ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i gtam dang*/ blta ba dang*/ dgod pa la sogs pas lus kyi rtsa rnams bde bas rgyas par bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ de nas stan bde ba la lha'i dkyil 'khor yab yum du gsal ba'i mkha' gsang rdo rje dang pad+mar byin gyis brlabs shing*/ de'i rtser sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed cing spyan drangs pa la/

'khyud pa dang*/ 'o bya ba dang*/ sen mo gdab pa dang*/ nu ma mnye pa la sogs pas khams byang chub kyi sems g.yo bar byed pa ni bsgrub pa'o/ / de nas snyoms par zhugs pas yab yum gnyis su med pa'i rol pa ni sgrub pa chen po'o/ / gsum pa ni/ de'i tshe dwangs ma spyi bo nas mgrin par g.yo ba ni dga' ba'i ye shes/ mgrin pa nas snying gar babs pa ni mchog dga'i ye shes/ snying ga nas lte bar babs pa ni dga' bral gyi ye shes/ lte ba nas gsang bar babs pa ni lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes te/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i spros pa mtha' dag nye bar zhi zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po ni dgyes mnyam mchog gi mchod sbyin te/ mchod pa chen po 'dod chags cha/ / sems can thams cad dga' bar byed/ / ces so/ / de nas rdo rje'i lam nas thig le dkar dmar drangs te/ lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar gyi 'khor lo bzhi dang de'i rtsa 'dab rnams gang bas zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyas shing spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ye shes kyis khyab par bsam pa ni sgrub pa'i nyi zla'i snying po de/ dkyil 'khor rdo rje'i lce yis blang*/ / zhes pa'o/ / de nas rtsa rnams su 'khrul 'khor dang*/ dmigs pa dang*/ dmigs pa med pa'i gnad gsum gyis dgram zhing*/ rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang du la bzla ba ni chos nyid don gyi ye shes kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa'o/ / de'ang ye shes dang pos zhe sdang gi rtog pa gnas su dag pas bde bar gsal la rang bzhin med pa me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ / gnyis pa ni/ nga rgyal rlom sems dag cing yab yum gnyis su med pas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ / gsum pa ni/ 'dod chags rags pa'i 'dzin rtog nub pas bde ba'i rang bzhin stong par shes pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ / bzhi pa ni/ phrag dog dag cing bde stong gi bya ba mthar thugs pas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/

/ de nas yas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi mthar phyin te/ gang du'ang rtog pa med pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ sbyor ba thams cad ye shes su dag cing*/ ye shes bzhi chos kyi dbyings su dag pa ni/ lha sa bon la thim/ sa bon nā da la thim/ nā da bin dhu la thim/ bin dhu chos ky-i dbyings su thim pa ni rang bzhin lnga dang sbyar ba ste/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa kun bzang yab yum gyi dgongs pa mthar thug pa'o/ / de'ang le'u bcu gsum par/ snying po'i thig le mnyam sbyor bas/ / bde ba'i ye shes rol mo las/ / ye shes dgyes la mchod par 'bul/ / zhes pa'i don 'dir bstan pa yin no/ / gnyis pa gzhung gi don la lnga las/ yul gang la sbyar ba ni bcu gnyis ma thugs kyi gsang yum lha~X mo~X bcu drug ma gsung gi gsang yum klu~X mo~X nyi shu ma sku'i gsang yum ri~Xgs nga~Xn mo~X rnams kyi bzang ngan dang bye brag so sor dbye~X nas ngan pa dor bzang ba bsten pa'ama~X yanga~X na~X mi~X dbye~X b.ra~X gang rung yul du byed pa'o/ / tshul ji lta bus sbyar na ni lha gcig la'ang bsnyen sgrub bzhis bsten pa ltar 'dir yang phyag rgya'i rgyud sbyong zhing byang chub kyi sems rgyas par byed pas bsnyena~X pa~X dang ༵/ 'du shes dag pas blta ba dang reg pa la sogs pa ni nye~X ba'i bsnyena~X pa dnga~X*/ lhar gsal bas 'khyud pa la sogs pa ni sgruba~X pa~X dang ༵/ gnyis su med par rol pas 'khor lo bzhi nas gsang bar 'bebs pa ni~X sgruba~X pa che~Xn po'i~X rim pa bzhis ye shes la sbyor ba'o/ / ngo bo gang sbyor ba ni de nas yuma~X gyi~X pa~Xd+ma~X'i dkyila~X 'khora~X du~X gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems yungs 'bru tsam gyi rten bsam pa la/ bde~X ba~X chen po'i rang bzhin thuga~Xs kyi~X dkyila~X 'kho~Xr sangs rgyas kyi tshom bus brgyan pa spro~X zhing bskyed la ye shes pa dbyings nas spyan drangs shing bstim ste bzhugs pa'i/

sangasa~X rgyasa~X kyi dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr ma~X lu~Xs pa thams cad la~X/ rol pa'i mchod pa phul bas/ spyan drangs pa'i lha dang bdag gi lus kyi gnas su rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad dgye~Xs pa mnyama~X pa'i mchoga~X gi~X sbyina~X pa chen posa~X so sor bsti~Xm zhing tshim par phul bas gnyis med bde ba chen po'i dngos grub thob par bsam zhing byang chub kyi sems pad+mor 'khyil ba 'dzin par byed do/ / dngos grub ji ltar blang ba ni de ltar bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhis bsgruba~X pa byas pa'i~X mkha' gsang gi nyi~X ma dang zla~X ba'i~X snyinga~X po~X de~X rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i dkyi~Xl 'khora~X du gsang ba rdo~X rje'i~X lce~X yisa~X blanga~Xs te/ mas rim gyis dgang zhing lus kyi gnas thams cad du khyab par dgram zhing ye shes su la bzla'o/ / 'di la kha cig lhar gsal ba'i lce rdo rjer bsam pas blangs te khong du 'thung bar 'dod pa ni ma yin te/ sbyor ba'i don ma go ba yin no/ / bsgrub pa de'i 'bras bu ni rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha~X' la 'gro~X ba dang mngon par shes pas chos thams cad mngon sum du gsala~X bar rtogs pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes kyi 'od zer 'ba~Xr bas sa dang lam gyi khyad par gong mar bgrod pa dang*/ tshe~X nyi zla dang mnyam pas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub cing rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa dang*/ la~X soga~Xs pa'i khong nas ral gri dang*/ mig sman dang*/ ril bu dang*/ gser 'gyur dang*/ rkang mgyogs la sogs pa thun mong gi grub pa brgyad thob par bstan to/ / mthar thug kun tu bzang po'i sa mchog yi~Xd bzhi~Xn sprina~X gyi~X bda~Xg po~Xr 'gyura~X zhing sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pas 'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'o/ / gnyis pa sgrol ba gnas su dag pa thabs chen gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la gsum las/ gang bsgral ba'i yul ni snying rje'i zhinga~X du gyura~X pa ste/ rdo rje phur ba las/

snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ / bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te/ / phung po rdo rje gtams byas nas/ / rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ / zhes pa ste/ rang la zhe sdang gi sems rang mtshan pa med cing snying rjes 'drongs pa dgos so/ / de'ang zhi rgyas kyis mi 'dul zhing mngon spyod kyis 'dul bar bya ba'i sems can te/ mchoga~X mtho ris kyi lha mi dnga~X mcho~Xg phrana~X ngan song gi 'gro ba ste dbye na zhing rnam pa bcu po rnamasa~X sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang 'bras bu la gnas pas/ de dag rang rang gi sdug bsngal de dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir bsgral la/ de'ang dam tshig gsal bkra las/ dkon cog slob dpon sku dgra gnyis/ / dam las log dang 'khu ba dang*/ / 'du par 'ongs dang yongs la gnod/ / dam dgra ngan pa'i ngang tshul can/ / ngan song gsum dang bcu po 'di/ / rnal 'byor kun gyis dang du blang*/ / zhes so/ / de'ang gzhan don du 'gyur ba/ 'gyur bar shes pa/ snying rje chen po gsum yod pa la ni/ rgyu'i theg pa la'ang mi dge ba dang po bdun gnang ba'i skabs yod de/ sems dpa' che la mi dge bdun po gnang*/ / zhes pa dang*/ mi nag mdung thung can la bya ba bzhin no/ / ji ltar bsgral ba'i thabs ni rnal 'byor pa rab ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrol la/ 'bring ting nge 'dzin dang sngags dang phyag rgyas sgrol la/ tha mas de dag gi steng du 'brub khung dang liṅga la sogs pa rdzas dngos su bsags te gzugs brnyan dang bcas pas sgrol ba yin pas/ bca' gzhi ni dkyil 'khor gyi lho nub tu 'brub khung ro sol gyis byugs pa e gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du ma las nyi~X ma dang a las zla~X ba~X'i stenga~X du~X liṅga ming rus dang bcas pa sgrol ba'i las la mkhasa~X pa'i~X rnal 'byor pasa~X bzhaga~X ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyis dgug gzhug bya'o/ / de'ang mkhas tshul lnga ste/ rang bzhin gyis sgrol ba'i lta ba la mkhas pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrol ba'i sgom pa la mkhas pa/

dbang po yul dus kyis sgrol ba'i spyod pa la mkhas pa/ thabs chen gsang bas sgrol ba'i gdams ngag la mkhas pa/ mngon phyung zab mos sgrol ba'i mdzad spyod la mkhas pa'o/ / de nas bdag nyid dpa' bo chen po yab yum gyi ngo bor bskyed la gdug pa can bsgral bar bya'o snyam pa'i nga~X rgyala~X dang ldan pas/ laga~X pa'i~X sor mo bcu la dpa' bo 'bru lnga'am sgrol ging bcu'i sa bon hūm̐ bcu las ging pho bcur bskyed pa'i bar du zangs gri'am phur pa 'dril cing lag pa'i 'du~X byeda~X liṅga'i snying la gzir bas sha khrag dum bur gtibs te sgrol ging bcus gtso bo la bstabs shing dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsgoma~X mo/ / yang sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs te/ rnam par shes pa hūm̐~X dkar po gcig tu~X gyura~X pasa~X las dang bag chags thams cad rnama~X para~X dga~X nas hūm̐ de nyid rim gyis zla tshes kyi dbyingasa~X su~X thima~X nas zla tshes me long lta bu'i ye shes yongs su gyur pa~X lasa~X/ thugs kyi phyaga~X rgya~X rdo rje 'od 'bara~X ba gcig tu gyur/ de las rdo rje sems dpa'i skura~X gyura~X cing 'o~Xd ze~Xr rab tu 'phro~X bas brji~Xd par bsgom mo/ / de'i spyi gtsuga~X tu~X 'khor ba las rnama~X para~X rgyala~X ba'i~X rtags su kun tu bzang po'i sku tshon gang ba gcig bsgoma~X ste/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zla ba'i gdan la bzhag nas/ phaṭa kyi sgras 'og min du 'phangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal du zhugs yum gyi mkhar rdo rje sems dpar bskyed de de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras su byas nas sems can gyi don byed par bsam mo/ / de ltar bsgral ba'i phan yon ni sdig pa can de dag phyi ma ngan song mu mtha' med par skye nges mngon spyod kyis bsgral bas mtho ris su thar pa thob pa'i thabs 'di ni/ theg pa gzhan las ngo~X mtsha~Xr ba rdo rje theg pa'i gsang chen te sdig can nga~Xn 'a~Xgro las thara~X nas grol ba thob pa'i~X thabasa~X 'di ni khyad par 'phags pa'o/

/ kha cig gsod pa 'di ni zhe sdang gi las yin pas lam dam pa ma yin no zhe na/ de'ang dam pa rnams ni zhe sdang med pa'i phan sems kyis sgrol pas 'gro ba thar pa la dgod pa'i phyir nyes pa med de/ rig byed bla ma las/ gang du gdug pa gdug spyod pa/ / de la nyes pa ma mthong ngo*/ / zhes pa dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang ngan song sbyong ba las kyang*/ bla ma dmod brtson ma rungs dang*/ / de sogs byed pa tshar gcod na/ / 'grub gyur zhes ni kun rig gsungs/ / zhes pa dang*/ yang bla ma dmod la brtson pa dang*/ / dkon cog gsum la gnod pa dang*/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig pa ni/ / sngags mkhan sngags kyis bsgral bar bya/ / zhes so/ / gsum pa sbyor sgrol gyi nyes pas mi gos pa ye shes sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ don dam par chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs ye~X gdod ma nasa~X skye~X ba me~Xd pa'i de~X bzhina~X nyi~Xd yin te/ dkon cog ta la la'i mdo las/ chos kun ma skyes rtag tu nam mkha' 'dra/ / zhes pa dang*/ chos thams cad 'byung ba med pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas yod min sangs rgyas chos med de/ / nam yang sems can med par sus mthong zhing*/ / nam mkha' 'dra ba'i chos nyid sus shes pa/ / de ni myur du skyes bu gtso bor 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / kun rdzob snang tsam nyid nas rang bzhin med bzhin du rkyen gyis sna tshogs su snang ba'i shing bu rde'u las rta glang dang skyes pa bud med la sogs pa'i rnam par shar ba'i sgyu~X ma~Xr snanga~X ba~X dang ngos gzung med pa'i miga~X yora~X gyi tshula~X te/ ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo las/ ji ltar sgyu mar gyur pa'i gzugs/ / skyes pa ma yin 'ong ba min/ / sna tshogs chos rnams de 'dra ste/ / skyes pa ma yin 'ong ba min/ / zhes so/ / de ltar chos rnams thams cad ye nas dag cing sgyu ma'i rang bzhin yin pas sbyor sgrol yang ye nas dag cing sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du khong du chud pa'i rnal 'byor bas/

sbyora~X ba dang sgrola~X ba'i bya~X ba~X kuna~X byasa~X kyanga~X byed dus nyid nas las gsog byed kyi nyes pas bskyed pa'i sbyor sgrol rang mtshan pa rdula~X phra rab kyi cha~X tsama~X yanga~X don la byasa~X pa~X meda~X de/ 'dzin zhen med pa'i phyir ro/ / de skad du'ang ye shes rgyas pa las/ ji ltar sgyu ma'i mkhan po dag/ rang gis sprul ba'i sgyu ma la/ / dge dang mi dge'i 'du byed pa/ / nyes pa gang gis mi gos ltar/ / thabs la mkhas pas rnam par spyod/ / ces pa dang*/ sdud pa las/ skye bo phal cher mgo mang bye ba gcod byed kyang*/ / 'gro kun sprul 'drar rab shes de la 'jigs pa med/ / ces pa dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las/ sems can thams cad bsad na yang*/ / de la sdig gis gos pa med/ / ces so/ / de'ang sdig pa rang mtshan pa 'byung ba la bden zhen rang mtshan yod pa dgos shing ngo bo ma grub pa dang*/ 'du shes gzhan du gyur pa dang*/ 'dzin zhen med pa smyo ba'i gang zag gi nyes pas kyang ltung ba med par bzhag ste/

'dul ba mdo rtsa las/ rmi lam ni med pa dang 'dra'o/ / de'i 'bras bu ni ma byas pa nyid do/ / zhes pa dang*/ smyo ba dang sems 'khrugs pa la ltung ba med do/ / zhes pa dang*/ shes gtso 'du shes gzhan du gyur pa nyid na'o/ / zhes pa la sogs pas shes te/ 'dir yang sbyor sgrol rmi lam ltar ngo bo med par rtogs pa dang*/ 'du shes lhar gyur pa dang*/ smyon pa ltar bden zhen med pas nyes pa med pa'o/ / gnyis pa rol pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung gi don no/ / dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ ji ltar bya ba'i thabs so/ / dang po ni/ ga na tsakra'i sgra las tshogs kyi 'khor lo ste/ de'i mtshan nyid gsang sngags kyi kun tu spyod pa'i skabs gang zhig rten dang gang zag dang yo byad khyad par can tshogs pa ste/ kun gsal las/ rten dang gang zag yo byad tshogs/ / thabs chen gsang bas tshogs zhes bya/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa la gsum ste/ dbye ba dngos dang*/ las rim dang*/ gang gi don du bya ba'o/ / dang po ni/ rdo rje las rim las/ skye bo mdza' ba kun tshogs pa/ / rnal 'byor 'dus pa'i tshogs zhes bya/ / 'byor pa'i longs spyod tshang ba ni/ / bde ba'i longs spyod tshogs su bshad/ / lha dang dam can kun 'dus pa/ / 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs su bshad/ / tshogs gnyis rgyun du rdzogs byed pa/ / tshogs chen po ru nges par brtag/ ces pas/ rnam pa bzhi ste/ skal ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs/ 'byor ldan yo byad kyi tshogs/ dngos grub lha'i tshogs/ bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs so/ / dang po ni/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo zung du tshogs pa ste thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin mtshon pa'o/ / de'ang 'dus pa chung ngu'i tshe gtso bo yab yum tsam/ sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin zung gsum/ rigs lnga'i mtshon byed zung lnga ste/ gnyis dang*/ drug dang*/ bcu tshang ba'o/ / 'dus pa 'bring la dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i grangs te brgya'o/

/ 'dus pa chen po la de yan chad rab tu mang po'o/ / de skad du'ang gsang rgyud las/ 'dus pa chung la gnyis drug bcu/ / 'bring la dkyil 'khor grangs yin te/ / chen po rab tu mang po'o/ / zhes so/ / de'ang rnal 'byor pho mo gang rung mang po tshogs kyang zung du ma 'brel bas dpa' bo'i dga' ston dang*/ dpa' mo'i ston mo zhes par 'gyur ro/ / gnyis pa ni/ phyi nang gsang ba'i yo byad thams cad yin la/ khyad par du sha dang chang ni med du mi rung ba'i thabs dang shes rab kyi rdzas te de las/ ma hā mam̐ sa bdud rtsir bcas/ / med du mi rung dngos grub rdzas/ / bza' btung 'bru bcud shing 'bras dang*/ / 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad do/ / zhes so/ / de'ang glu gar dang rol mo'i sprin phung du mas brgyan pa'o/ / gsum pa ni/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs gtso bo la 'khor gyis bskor ba thams cad de dngos kyi sku dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu lhar bskyed pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bsod nams kyi zhing du spyan drangs pa thams cad do/ / bzhi pa ni/ rgyun gyi tshogs gnyis dang khyad par du tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i tshe thabs bskyed rim dang 'brel ba'i kun tu spyod pa snang bcas thams cad bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ shes rab rdzogs rim gyis bsdus pa'i zab mo skye med du rtogs shing bsgom pa rnams ye shes so/ / gnyis pa las rim la gnyis te/ zhi ba dang*/ khro bo'i rim pa'o/ / dang po ni/ zhi ba'i tshogs kyi tshe rnal 'byor pa rnams zhi ba'i cha lugs dang phyag mtshan dang me tog phog pa'i lha'i rtags dang ldan pas tshogs khang du zhugs pa na/ gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i sgo ba bzhi tshogs khang gi sgo nas sdod pas/ legs par 'ongs sam zhes pa'i brdar mdzub mo gcig bsgrengs pa'i lan du/ 'ongs so zhes gnyis bsgrengs te nang du phyin pa las las kyi rdo rjes rigs gang yin zhes pa'i brdar/

rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya gdengs pa'i lan du| rigs gang la me tog phog pa'i gtso bo de'i phyag rgya bstan to/ / de nas rdo rje slob dpon la phyag 'tshal te/ dbang gi rim pas bum dbang dge bsnyen/ gsang dbang dge tshul/ shes rab ye shes dge slong*/ rdzogs pa chen po gnas brtan te/ gtso bo'i phyogs bzhi nas rigs bzhi gral rkyang pa'am/ g.yas g.yon dang gung la rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi gral mtshon pa rdo rje dang 'khor lo la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan gral mgor bzhag pa nas rim gyis 'khod de/ cho ga rdzogs par byed pa yin no/ / gnyis pa khro bo la yang tshul de dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ / zhi khro phyogs gcig pa'i tshogs 'khor la ni zhi ba'i rnal 'byor pho mo rnams rdo rje slob dpon gyi g.yas gral dang*/ khro bo rnams g.yon gral la 'khod do/ / rnal 'byor pho mo yang grangs mnyam na shin tu legs so/ / gsum pa gang gi don du bya ba ni/ las bzhi'i bye brag gis shes par bya ste/ rnal 'byor pa gang dag dam tshig gso zhing sgrib pa sbyong na zhi ba'i don du tshogs kyis bskangs shing*/ tshe dang 'byor pa spel na rgyas pa/ dbang dang dgug pa'i ched du dbang*/ bgegs dang gdug pa tshar gcod pa la sogs pa'i don du drag po'i rim pa so so'i 'dod don bsgrub pa la sbyor ba yin no/ / gsum pa ji ltar bya ba'i thabs la lnga ste/ dang po rten dang yo byad bsham pa ni/ gnas der mtshan mo la sogs pa'i tshe lha'i dkyil 'khor ras bris sam rdul tshon tshom bu bkod pa'i drung du phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor pa dang*/ nang mchod bdud rtsi ril bus bran pa rnams bsham mo/ / gnyis pa rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab pa ni rnal 'byor pho mo kun gral la 'khod pa la las kyi rdo rjes phyag 'tshal zhing me tog gtor nas phod ka'i phu dung pus mor bsnol zhing 'dud de/

hoḥdapal kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin tshad med pa'i thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don la bzhugs pa bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che ge mos gtso mdzad rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams dgongs su gsol/ chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po'i rang bzhin du gdod nas mngon par byang chub kyang*/ 'gro ba'i khams rnams ma rig pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu kun tu khyab pa la dgongs te/ thugs rje chen po'i rol pas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du ting nge 'dzin zab mos rnal 'byor la gnas par zhu 'tshal/ zhes dal bus brjod nas phyag bya'o/ / gsum pa lha'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ de nas bgegs la gtor ma byin nas rgya mtsho'i mthar bskrad de/ me ru me dpung mtshon cha'i ra ba khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i mtshams bcad de sngar bstan pa bzhin lha'i dkyil 'khor du gsal btab la/ mchod pas mnyes pa'i bar du mnyes par bya ste/ tshogs mchod rnams bsang sbyangs spel bsgyur ji lta ba bzhin bya'o/ / de'ang thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin las grub par byin gyis brlabs te mchod do/ / bzhi pa longs spyod pa ni lag pa gnyis kyi mthil du nyi ma dang zla ba'i dbus su dpa' bo 'bru lnga dang dpa' mo 'bru lnga las/ tshogs kyi lha yab yum bcu 'dod yon lnga'i mchod sprin 'gyed pa gsal bar bskyed nas/ bza' btung la reg pas mnyes par bsams la/ de nas phung po khams dang skye mched kyi lha mchod par bya'o/ / de yang las kyi rdo rjes phyag 'tshal zhing thabs dang shes rab kyi rdzas pad+ma'i phyag rgyas brim zhing*/ hūm̐ dpa' bo chen po dgongs su gsol/ 'di ni chos rnams bzang po ste/ / 'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ / bram ze khyi dang gdol ba gsum/ / rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/ / zhes pa'i lan du len pa pos kyang pad+ma'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku*/

/ gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ / 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral/ / de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal/ / a la la hoḥ/ zhes pas blangs te longs spyod/ de'ang tshogs kyi gral du rtsod pa dang ku co dang tha mal gyi snang bas bden par zhen pa la sogs pa mi bya bar/ tshim pa dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ 'dzin zhen med pas/ lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems chos nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gsum du shes par bya'o/ / lnga pa mjug gi bya ba ni/ rjes la lhag ma'i gtor ma btang la/ rdo rje'i glu dang*/ dpal gyi bro dang*/ bsngo ba dang*/ bkra shis brjod pa rnams bya'o/ / de'i phan yon yang*/ rdo rje'i dra ba las/ bsod nams nang na tshogs 'khor mchog/ tshe 'dir bsam pa kun 'grub cing*/ / bgegs dang bar chad zhi ba dang*/ / phyi ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing*/ / kun tu bzang po thob par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / de'ang rnam pa gsum gyis theg pa 'og ma'i mchod sbyin las 'phags te/ yul lhar gsal bas sangs rgyas yin pa dang*/ dngos grub bdud rtsir gyur pas tha mal ma yin pa dang*/ bsam pa chos nyid du rol pas 'dzin zhen med pa ste/ de'i phyir thabs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i theg pa shes rab khyad par can gyis 'phags so/ / gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis te/ kun tu bzang po'i tshogs mchod mdor bstan pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / dang po la gsum las/ rang bzhin shes par bya ba ni dag pa gsum dang mnyam pa bzhis chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa kun tu bzang po'i zhing du mtshon pa ste/ de'ang phyi snoda~X kyi 'jig rten 'byung ba lnga'i ngo bo yum lnga'i rang bzhin du dag cing*/ nang bcuda~X kyi sems can phung po lngas bsdus pa yab lngar dag la/ rang rang gi rgyuda~X kyi dbang po rnam par shes pa dang de dag gi yul rnams sems dpa' dang sems ma dang sgo ba yab yum du dag pa'o/ / yang snod gzhal khang*/ bcud lha dang lha mo/ rang gi rgyud ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin dkyil 'khor chen por gnas pa rnama~Xs ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin du rnam par dga~X par rtoga~Xs shi~Xng*/

snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad don dam par ma skyes par mnyam zhing kun rdzob tu sgyu ma lta bur mnyama~X pa gnyisa~X dang*/ phung po lnga sangs rgyas su mnyam pa dang*/ rnam shes brgyad ye shes su mnyam pa ste/ lhaga~X pa'i~X mnyama~X pa gnyisa~X kyisa~X chos thams cad la bzang ngan blang dor med pa'i dkyila~X 'kho~Xr te/ chos nyid don gyi gnas lugs ji ltar shar zhing snang ba de dag rang bzhin kuna~X tu~X bza~Xng po~X'i zhinga~X khams rgya chad phyogs lhung med pas 'khor 'das kun la khyab pa ste/ kun byed las/ kye/ dkyil ni ma nor don gyi snying po ste/ 'khor ni 'khor 'das brdal ba yongs la khyab/ / ces so/ / gang gis shes par bya ba ni/ de ltar rdzogs pa chen po'i rang bzhin du rtogs pas chos nyid don gyi dkyil 'khor la dbang thob pa'i tshe sgo gsum gyi byeda~X spyoda~X ci byas kyang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs che~Xn po gnyisa~X ngam ngam shugs kyis rdzogs par gyura~X na~Xs ci snang ye shes su 'char ba ste/ nam mkha' che las/ chos kun skye med lhun rdzogs shing*/ / ye nas grol bar rtogs pa na/ / kun spyod bskyed rdzogs lhun gyis grub/ / ma byas rang bzhin rdzogs par snang*/ / zhes so/ / de'ang sngar smos pa bzhin sngags kyi ya~Xn la~Xg lnga ma~X nyama~Xs shing yo~X byada~X lnga dang ldana~X pa dang cho~X ga~X lnga po rdzoga~Xs pa~Xr she~Xs pa~X yi~X rna~Xl 'byora~X pas dus khyad par can la sogs par dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su rten gang zag tshoga~Xs kyi~X yo byad rnams yongs su tshogs pa'i dkyila~X 'kho~Xr gyisa~X mnyes par byas te/ bsgrubs na 'bras bu ni gnas skabs rig 'dzin gsum dang 'phrin las bzhi mthar thug ngesa~X para~X legasa~X pa'i~X dgosa~X pa~X byang chub 'gru~Xb par 'gyur ro/ / gnyis pa dkyil 'khor so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ rten dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin dang*/ de ji ltar bsgrub pa'i rim pa'o/

/ dang po la gnyis te/ zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ro/ / dang po la gsum ste/ tshom bu lnga pa/ gsum pa/ gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ / dang po ni/ rigs lnga~X dnga~X rigs lnga'i zhing yum lnga dang gnyis su med par sbyora~X ba~X lasa~X tshoma~X bu~X lnga~X yi~X lha~X yab yum rtsa ba lnga las yab yum bcu/ rigs bzhi po re re'ang bcu bcu ste/ lnga bcu bko~Xd la~X phyi rol tu bsrung ba'i 'khor lo khog pa stong pa phyogs mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis te rtsibs bcu la hūm̐ ka ra la sogs pa'i khro~X bo~X bcu~X dnga~X*/ rdo rje sgra 'byin ma la sogs pa khro~X mo~X ba~Xcu bar chad bsrung ba'i 'kho~Xr lo~X'i tshula~X du~X rnama~X pa~Xr bsgo~Xm par bya'o/ / de'ang dbus su gtso bo yab yum kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin la/ sems dpa' rdo rje/ rin cen rdo rje/ chos kyi rdo rje/ las kyi rdo rje bzhi'i yum/ brtan ma rdo rje/ 'bar ma rdo rje/ sdud ma rdo rje/ bskyod ma rdo rje ste yab yum bcu'o/ / shar du mi bskyod pa yab yum la/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje rgyal po/ rdo rje chags pa/ ¿rdo rje legs pa bzhi'i yum/ sgeg mo| bdug pa/ lcags kyu/ rdo rje sgrol ma'o/ / lhor rin cen 'byung ldan yab yum la| rdo rje rin cen/ rdo rje gzi brjid/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje bzhad pa bzhi'i yum/ phreng ma/ me tog ma/ zhags pa ma/ rdo rje bde ma'o/ / nub tu 'od dpag med yab yum la/ rdo rje chos/ rdo rje rnon po/ rdo rje 'khor lo/ / rdo rje smra ba bzhi'i yum/ glu ma/ mar me/ lcags sgrog ma/ rdo rje gsal bkra ma'o/ / byang du don yod grub pa yab yum la/ rdo rje las/ rdo rje bsrung ba/ rdo rje gnod sbyin/ rdo rje khu tshur bzhi'i yum/ gar ma/ dri chab ma/ dril bu ma/ rdo rje 'bebs ma'o/ / de ltar lnga bcu'i phyi rol tu khro bo bcu yab yum dang bcas pas lha bdun cu ni tshom bu lnga pa'o/

/ spyir na tshom bu ni sgo dang rta babs la sogs pa gzhal med khang gi rnam par med pa'i lha'i gtso 'khor yin la/ dkyil 'khor ni gzhal med khang dang bcas par 'dod kyang*/ 'dir lha de dag skor tshoms su 'dug pa'i cha nas btags pa yin no/ / gnyis pa tshom bu gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ de~X bzhina~X gshegs pa'i riga~Xs dnga~X rdo~X rje'i~X riga~Xs dang pad+ma~X'i~X riga~Xs te~X re re'ang yab yum bcu bcu'i rang bzhin sku~X gsunga~X thuga~Xs kyi lha sum cu'i dkyil 'khor gyi mthar khro~X bo~X'i tsho~Xgs te sgo ba yab yum brgyad dnga~X ldana~X pa~X yi~X tshoma~X bu~X gsuma~X gyi~X lha~X rnamasa~X bsgo~Xm par bya'o/ / gsum pa tshom bu gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ riga~Xs thams cada~X kyi nang nas de bzhin nyid kun tu bzang po'i riga~Xs te~X rigasa~X lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi~X gtso~X bo rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin ni/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor rigs lngar phye ba'i thugs kyi thugs te gtso bo rnam snang mthing gas brgyan pa ni thuga~Xs kyi~X mcho~Xgalha bcu'i dkyil 'khor gyi mthar sgo ba yab yum brgyad kyi khro~X bo'i~X tshogasa~X dnga~X lda~Xn pa~X yi~X tsho~Xm bu~X gciga~X pa'i~X lha~X bco brgyad po rnama~Xs bsgoma~X par bya'o/ / gnyis pa khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ khro~X bo~X lnga dang khro~X mo~X kro dhī shwa ri lnga'i~X tshoga~Xs chena~X po~X ste yab yum bcu dang*/ de dag gi bya ba bsgrub pa'i pho~X nya~X gnas kyi ma mo brgyad dang*/ phyaga~X rnya~Xn yul gyi phra men brgyad dang*/ bka~X' nyana~X ye shes kyi sgo ma bzhi dang ༵/ ci~X bgyi~X'i las byed dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad la~X soga~Xs pa khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi tshoga~Xs rnama~Xs kyisa~X 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du tshogs sgrub na'ang*/ gnas skabs su gdug pa can tshar gcod pa la sogs pa drag po'i las rnams dang*/ mthar thug nges par legs pa'i dgongs pa mchog gi dngos grub 'grub bo/ / gnyis pa de nyid ji ltar bsgrub pa'i rim pa la bzhi ste/ tshom bu gcig pa/ gsum pa/ lnga pa/ rdo rje'i dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor ji ltar bsgrub pa'o/ / dang po la'ang gnyis las/ gang zag gang gis bsgrub pa ni sems nyid rnala~X ma'i don la blo chos nyid du 'byora~X pa ste/ dbye na/ gzhi rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor/ lam bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor/ 'bras bu lhun grub kyi rnal 'byor gsum las/ lam mo/ / de'ang rim gnyis las/ gzhi dang rang bzhin 'bras bu'i tshul/ / bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ / zhes pa dang*/ dbu ma las/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ / byang chub bsgrub pa kha cig la'o/ / zhes so/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba zab mo rmad du byung ba'i sngaga~Xs kyi tshig don 'changa~X bar byed pa'o/ / de'ang man+t+ra'i sgra las sngags te/ gsang sngags/ rig sngags/ gzungs sngags gsum gyi rang bzhin 'chang ba'o/

/ dang po ni/ phyi nang gi lta sgom spyod 'bras gsang ba rmad du byung bas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skyob par byed pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ drang srong la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob pa'i rig pa'i mthus sdug bsngal las skyob pa'o/ / gsum pa ni/ bden tshig bgos pa'i tshig 'bras bu phan gnod byed pa'o/ / de lta bu'i don gyis bsgrub par bya ba'i dngo~Xs gruba~X ni~X mchog dang thun mong gi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa ste/ de nyid chos thams cad ye nas mnyama~X pa nyid rang bzhin rdzoga~Xs pa chen po'i ngang du lhuna~X gyis gruba~X cing dbyer med pa phyogs bral 'dzin zhen med pa'i nganga~X du gnasa~X shinga~X*/ blang dor med par spyoda~X pasa~X ci~X la~X'ang thoga~Xs chags dang zhen pa meda~X pa'i~X rang bzhin chos thama~Xs cada~X ye~X nasa~X ngo bo gcig cing dbyera~X meda~X par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas bsgrub pa~X'o~X/ / dkyil 'khor gang bsgrub pa ni thugs rdo~X rje~X'i riga~Xs su~X rigs thamasa~X cada~X kyi dkyi~Xl 'khor 'dus pas/ lha dang gzhal yas khang pa thams cad ye shes kyi 'oda~X zer 'phro~X zhing gzi brjid 'bara~X b.ra~X raba~X tu~X bsgoma~X zhing*/ 'dod yon thams cad la zhen chagasa~X meda~X pa lha la lha mchod tshula~X gyisa~X rol zhing bstima~X para~X bya~X'o/ / de'i 'bras bu sems nyid gnyi~Xs su me~Xd pa'i chos skur gyu~Xr nasa~X lhun gyis grub pa'i phyaga~X rgya~X chena~X po'i go 'phang 'thob bo/ / gnyis pa tshom bu gsum pa ni/ snga ma las gzhan yanga~X na~X sku~X mi bskyod pa gsunga~X 'od dpag med thuga~Xs rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor nyida~X bsgrub par bya ste~X/ sangs rgyas thama~Xs cada~X kyi dkyil 'khor ma~X lusa~X pa bsdu na sku~X gsunga~X thuga~Xs kyi dkyil 'khor du 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ / de bsgrub pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi tinga~X nge 'dzi~Xn yang lha'i rnam par gsala~X zhing mtshan dang dpe byad du 'ba~Xr ba'i 'oda~X ze~Xr 'phro~X bas sems can gyi don byed par bsgom pa'o/

/ 'dod yon thams cad yum du bsam pa yab kyis rol pas gnyisa~X su meda~X pa'i chos dbyinga~Xs spros pa dang bral ba'i rang bzhin gyi~X nga~Xng du~X thi~Xm pa~Xr bsam mo/ / 'bras bu lhun gyis grub pa'i riga~X 'dzina~X gyi dngosa~X gruba~X mchoga~X thoba~X par 'gyura~X ro/ / de las gdul bya'i don du lha'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr ma~X lusa~X pa yon tan gyi dpal 'bara~X ba~X 'gruba~X cing*/ sems can nyona~X mo~Xngs pa'i sduga~X bsnga~Xl ma lus pa se~Xl ba~Xr mdza~Xd nas/ sems can de dag rdo~X rje'i ༵riga~Xs su~X skye~X ba~X'i gna~Xs la 'god pa'i 'phrin las byed do/ / gsum pa tshom bu lnga pa la yang gnyis las/ gang zag gang gis tshul ji lta bus bsgrub pa'i tshul ni/ sngaga~Xs 'changa~X ba'i rnal 'byor pas dngo~Xs gruba~X yanga~X dga~X pa ni~X rgyud la thob par bya ba'i phyir/ yab yum thaba~Xs dnga~X she~Xs raba~X tu gsal zhing ting nge 'dzin gsum la sogs pa'i cho ga thama~Xs ca~Xd kyi~X tshom bu'i dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr lnga~X dnga~X phyi rol tu khro~X phre~Xng bsgo~Xm mo/ / 'dod yon la chaga~Xs pa~X me~Xd pa~X'i tshula~X gyisa~X ni~X lha la lha thim pa'i tshula~X gyisa~X mchod bya mchod byed gnyi~Xs su~X 'dzin zhen me~Xd pa~Xr bstima~X pa~Xr bya'o~X/ / 'bras bu dngo~Xs gruba~X mcho~Xg gi~X snyinga~X po~X lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin 'gru~Xb bo/ / de'ang kha cig tshom bu gcig pas phyag rgya dang*/ gsum pas tshes dbang dang*/ lnga pas lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin so sor 'grub par 'dod pa ni ma 'brel te/ tshom bu re res kyang gnas skabs su rig 'dzin gsum dang mthar thug lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ / bzhi pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la'ang gnyis las/ gang zag gang gis ji ltar bsgrub pa ni/ rnala~X 'byo~Xr pa yab thaba~Xs dnga~X yum shesa~X raba~X kyi rang bzhin gyisa~X/ de~X bzhi~Xn gshega~Xs pa lnga dnga~X lnga'i yu~Xm du~X bsgoma~X zhing dbang po dang rtog tshogs se~Xms dpa'a~X dang semasa~X ma~X sgo ba yab yum dang bcas pa nyida~X du~X bsgoma~X par bya'o/

/ lha de dag kyang 'o~Xd zera~X gyi tshogs rnama~X pa~X ma~Xng po~X phyogs bcur 'phro~X ba'o/ / 'grel pa spar khab las 'di sgyu 'phrul bsdus pa lha bco brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor yin no zer ba'ang mi 'gal mod kyi/ gzhung du rgyal ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du gsal lo/ / gsum pa gang sgrub thabs kyi yan lag la gsum las/ gang bsgrub pa ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag ni/ chos thams cad dkyil 'khor du sgrub pa'i tshe phyi nang gi lus dang longs spyod la sogs pa spyad par bya ba'i yul dang*/ spyod byed bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyis rol pas so~X so~X'i sngagasa~X dnga~X phyaga~X rgya~X dnga~X tinga~X nge 'dzina~X gyi rnam pa skabs su gang bab pa rnams phyin ci ma log pa yanga~X dga~X par so~X sora~X gsa~Xl zhing ma 'dres par shes par bya'o/ / ji ltar bsgrub pa mthun pa'i yan lag ni sgrub pa'i gnasa~X mtshan nyid tshang zhing bar chad med pa dnga~X nye bar mkho ba'i lo~Xngs spyoda~X mtha' gnyis su ma lhung zhing ci~X bde~X bar yod pa dang ༵/ des mtshon nas sgrub pa'i grogs su 'gyur pa'i yo byad dang rten dang dam rdzas la sogs pa mthun pa'i rkyen rnams ma~X nyama~Xs par tshang zhing 'gal rkyen med la/ sgrub pa'i blo~X ni~X/ rkyen gzhan gyis mi 'phrog c-ing mtha' gcig tu tshugs pas zhe bcad raba~X dang lda~Xn pa'i rnal 'byor pasa~X/ sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i dnga~X po~X ngas ma grub kyi bar du stan 'di las ldang ba dang gnas 'di nas 'gro bar mi bya'o snyam pa la sogs pa'i dma~X bca' ji ltar nosa~X pa bzhi~Xn du~X brtan par bya~X zhing*/ sgrub dus su de las gzhan pa'i bya ba la brtson pa dang*/ rtags dang mtshan ma ngan pa'am/ ma byung bas sgyid lug pa dang*/ ngas mi 'grub snyam du bdag nyid brnyas pas le~X lo~X rnams dang*/ sos dal dang dus su mi sgrub cing lus ngag cha babs su byed pa'i sgyida~X snyoma~Xs la lus pa rnams meda~X pa~X yi~X sgo nas brtson 'grus bskyed cing*/

sngags dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yin nam ma yin nam 'bras bu 'byung ngam mi 'byung ngam snyam pa la sogs pa'i the~X tshoma~X dang yid gnyis meda~X para~X yin nges snyam pa mtha' gcig tu gting tshugs pa'i blos sgruba~X par byasa~X na~X gang sgrub kyi dkyila~X 'kho~Xr thama~Xs cada~X 'gruba~X para~X 'gyura~X te/ rdo~X rje~X gsa~Xng ba'i mchoga~X sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i chos sku dma~X pa~X 'thoba~X par 'gyur ro/ / nam gyi tshe sgrub pa dus kyi yan lag ni/ sgruba~X pa'i~X zhaga~X ni/ le'u dgu par/ zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam/ / zhes pa la sogs pa dnga~X sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i tshe~Xs granga~Xs dang gza' skar la sogs pa ni~X rgyas pa'i rgyuda~X la~Xs/ dus ni yar ngo'i brgyad la brtsam/ / shin tu skar ma rgyal rnams la/ / byang chub spyod pa cher spyod pas/ / gsang mchog dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ / gza' skar shis pa'ang blang bar bya/ / zhes smo~Xs pa~X bzhina~X du~X bshada~X par bya'o/ / de'ang spang blang med pas nges gzung mi 'thad do zhe na/ ngo bo la de ltar yin yang kun rdzob rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i rten 'brel gyis mthun pa'i tshe 'jug gi mi mthun pa'i tshe mi 'jug ste/ drod gsher 'dzom dus sa bon gdab kyi de las gzhan gyi dus su mi gdab pa dang 'dra bar shes par bya ste/ rngam glog las/ rig byed dag gi yan lag las/ / dus rnams shes par bya ba ni/ / bkra shis lha yi nyi ma dang*/ / 'byor dang dus tshod bzang ba ni/ / mtshan ma'i rtog pa yin mod kyang*/ / brtags dang dngos grub mtshan ma 'byung*/ / zhes so/ / 'dir phyin ci log gi grong khyer lhun mtho zhing the tshom gyi rtsig pa brgal bar dka' ba'i ra bas bskor nas/ mthong ba dang shes pa rgya chung ngur gyur dag pa na re/ khyed kyi gsang ba snying po 'di rgyud ma yin te/ rgyud la kha 'phangs pas so zhe na/ de lta na khyed rang rgyud du 'dod pa'i nges brjod bla ma dang*/

brtag gnyis la sogs pa'ang rgyud ma yin par 'gyur te/ rgyud gzhan la kha 'phangs pa'i phyir ro/ / de'ang*/ ji skad mang du brjod pas ci/ / ji ltar de nyid bsdus pa yi/ / dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bya/ / zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ 'jam dpal las kyang*/ rgyud chen sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ zhes 'phangs so/ / des na ston pas rgyud mtshungs par gsungs pa'i rang bzhin gong 'og gi zlos pa spang ba dang*/ rtsa rgyud 'di las 'phros pa'i yan lag gi rgyud dang 'grel ba bsgrub pa'i don du kha 'phangs te gsungs pa yin no/ / gsum pa skabs kyi don bsdu ba ni/ chos thams cad kun tu bzang po'i rol par ye nas dag pas thams cad spang blang med par spyod par bya'o/ / rdo~X rje~X gsanga~X ba'i~X ngo bo rgyud 'di ni/ tshiga~X tu~X'o~X/ / zhesa~X gsungs dus lhun stug po bkod pa'i rang snang thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rol pa las gzhan ma yin pas de~X bzhina~X gshe~Xgs pa~X nyida~X la~X de~X bzhi~Xn gshe~Xgs pa~X nyida~X che~Xd du~X gle~Xng ngo~X zhes bya ba ste/ yul yul can gnyis su med par mtshon pa yin no/ / tshul 'dis chos thams cad rang snang du bstan te/ rang snang la rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa rmi lam dang 'dra bar ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes par bstan to/ / chos nyid gsa~Xng ba'i~X sny-inga~X po~X gang snang ye shes kyi rol pa de~X kho~X na~X nyida~X ngesa~X pa~X lasa~X/ rnal 'byor pa lta spyod mthun pa kun 'dus pa dang*/ de rnams kyis 'byor pa'i yo byad bde bar spyod pa dang*/ de'i dus su yi dam gyi lha dang mkha' 'gro dam can 'du bar byed pa dang*/ zhen 'dzin med pa'i sgo nas rgyud la tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pas tshoga~Xs kyi~X dkyi~Xl 'kho~Xr gyi~X don te/ gang snang gi chos thams cad thabs shes kyi lam du byed pa'i le~X'u~X ste~X bcu~X gciga~X pa'i rnam par bshad pa~X'o~X/ / / / ༈ don gnyis pa de'i yan lag bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum ste/
